hero.sub: Diskכvri & vεrifikεshכn kכntrola fכ di Vortex pi-to-piεr nεtwכk. Opin. Dɛn dɔn ɛnkript am. Nɔbɔdi nɔ go ebul fɔ stɔp am.

network.label: NETWORK .
network.body: Ɛni kɔmpin gɛt sayn aydentiti. Klaynt dɛn kin chɛk bifo dɛn kɔnɛkt, di no dɛn kin pruv ɔnaship we dɛn rɛjista. No sentral ɔtoriti nɔ go ebul fɔ mek lɛk se wetin kriptografi dɔn ɔlrɛdi kɔnfɔm.
network.dual_title: Dɛn dɔn chɛk am tu tɛm
network.dual_body: Rejistret wit di kɔntrol AND sial on-chen via Solana. Tu indipɛndɛnt witnɛs dɛn kɔnfɔm kɔd hash ɛn pubkey. Sef fɔ sɛnsitiv sɛshɔn dɛn.
network.ctrl_body: Sayn pruv se di node gɛt in prayvet ki, bɔt kɔd intɛgriti nɔ de ankɔr on-chen. Fayn fɔ bɔku pan di sɛshɔn dɛn; risk = trɔst di kɔntrol ɔpreshɔn.
network.unverif_body: Dɛn no am frɔm kɔnfig ɔ gɔsip. No kriptografik pruf yet. Yuz ɔl fɔ butstrap di piɔ list — nɔ ɛva as handoff target fɔ layv sɛshɔn.

security.label: SECURITY .
security.body: Fo indipendent Ed25519 keypairs, each wan wit wan singl narrow job. If yu kɔmprɔmis ɛni wan ki nɔ de brok di ɔda wan dɛn.
security.release_signs: Kod manifest (INTEGRITY.sig.json) we de sho aw fɔ du am.
security.controller_verified: Klaynt — frɔm SNS ɔ bil pin
security.user_signs: Seshɔn token dɛn, mɛsej ɛnvilɔp dɛn
security.step1_n: 01 / RESOLVE Di wan dɛn we de wok.
security.step1_d: Rid vortexx.sol on-chen. Rikɔd dɛn we Solana wallet sayn — i nɔ pɔsibul fɔ DNS-hajɛk.
security.step2_d: Klaynt de kɔl /v1/integrity. Rijek ɛni rispɔns pas status: verified frɔm di pin rilis ki.
security.step3_n: 03 / VERIFY Di wan dɛn we de wok.
security.step3_d: Evri API kol de riton {payload, sig, signed_by}. Klaynt de chɛk di Ed25519 sayn bifo i trɔst.
security.step4_n: 04 / SEAL Di wan dɛn we de wok.
security.step4_d: Sial nodes: klaynt de rid code_hash frɔm Solana rɛjista. Divεrjεns frכm kכntrola = pεrmanεntli blaklist.
security.check_auth: Rɛspɔns ɔthɛntiti — i nɔ pɔsibul fɔ fɔj /v1/nodes if di kɔntrolɔ in prayvet ki nɔ de.
security.check_integrity: Kɔd intɛgriti — kɔntrol fayl dɛn we dɛn hash ɛn krɔs-chɛk na ɛvri statap. Tampering de ritɔn 503 bifo ɛni trafik de sav.
security.check_identity: Node identity — node fɔ sayn rɛjista wit dɛn yon ki. Wan pɔsin we atak nɔ kin ebul fɔ rɛjista fɔ ɔda node in pɔbki.
security.check_dns: DNS hajɛk protɛkshɔn — .sol rɛkɔd dɛn layv pan Solana. Wan ɛnimi nid fɔ kɔmprɔmis di walet, nɔto jɔs wan DNS rɛjista.
security.check_handoff: Handoff security — seshɔn transfa dɛn kin kɛr Ed25519-sayn token dɛn wit anti-riplay, we valid fɔ 5 minit nɔmɔ. Target de rijek sɔs we dɛn nɔ no.
security.check_transport: Transport prayvesi — kɔnɛkshɔn URL we yu ISP / Cloudflare de si. Yuz di Tor miro if di mɛtadata impɔtant.
security.check_content: Mɛsej kɔntinyu — NOT we di kɔntrolɔ tɔch. Ɛnd-to-ɛnd ɛnkript bitwin di wan dɛn we de yuz am. Kontrola nɔ kin rid natin ivin if i ful-ɔp wit kɔmprɔmis.
security.check_host: Host OS / kernel — if di VPS gɛt rut, dɛn kin tif di ki dɛn. Yuz hadwae-bak sayn fɔ paranoid diploymɛnt.

access.label: ACCESS .
access.heading_line1: Ɔltɛm we pɔsin kin ebul fɔ rich to am.
access.body: Bɔku ɛntri pɔynt dɛn min se nɔ wan ɛntiti nɔ go ebul fɔ blok yu akses. Miro sayt dɛn de sav di sem sayn kɔntinyu frɔm indipɛndɛnt infrastukchɔ.
access.tunnel_body: Fri *.trycloudflare.com adrɛs. No akɔn nɔ nid fɔ de. URL de chenj we di tכnel de stat bak — trit am lεk ephemeral.
access.tor_body: .aniɔn adrɛs, we pɔsin kin rich na tru Tor nɔmɔ. Sɛns-pruf ɛn mɛtadata-prayvet, bɔt slo. Nid wan Tor klaynt.
access.ipfs_title: Di tin dɛn we dɛn sheb
access.ipfs_body: Kɔntinɛnt-adrɛs kɔpi fɔ di statik frɔntɛnd. Eni IPFS getway kin sav am — no single server fo blok.
access.direct_body: Rigyul domɛyn + TLS. Opshɔn we fast pas ɔl. Blɔkabl na DNS/IP lɛvɛl — fɔdɔm bak to ɔda pipul dɛn if dɛn sɛns am.
access.mirrors_body: Ɔda ɔs dɛn we de sav di ɛksaktɔl sem sayn kɔntinyu lɛk dis kɔntrol. εvri miro de prob wan wan tεm — wan grεn dכt min se yu kin rich insay di las 5 minit. Tor .onion miro dɛn nɔ kin ebul fɔ chɛk dɛn wɛlbɔdi if dɛn nɔ gɛt lokal Tor prɔksi.

start.label: GET STARTED .
start.step1: Instɔl Vortex na yu divays — mobayl ɔ dɛsktɔp.
start.step2: Pik Global nɛtwɔk mod na di sɛtup wizad.
start.step3: Paste di kɔntrol URL (ɔto-rizɔlt via SNS) ɔ ɛni ɛntri URL frɔm di Ɛntri dɛn pej.
start.step4: Verifay se di pubkey na yu app mach di kɔntrol finga prɛnt we de dɔŋ ya. Wan mismatch min fɔ chenj di we aw dɛn de du tin.
start.step5: Yu don konekt. Node list, sayn, ɛn routin dɛn de handle ɔtomɛtik.
start.fingerprint_note: Pin dis ki insay yu klaynt bifo yu trɔst ɛni ansa.

treasury.label: TREASURY & REWARDS .
treasury.transparency_title: Transparency we de na di chen
treasury.transparency_body: Ɔl di protɔkɔl fi — node rɛjista fi ɛn 20% kɔt pan prɛmiɔm sabskripshɔn — de flɔ to di trɔs walet na Solana. Ɛnibɔdi kin chɛk ɛni transakshɔn na pɔblik.
treasury.rewards_title: Di riwɔd dɛn we di ɔpreshɔn de gi
treasury.rewards_body: 70% pan ɛni prɛmiɔm sab de go to di riwɔd pul, we dɛn sheb pro-rata to aktiv node ɔpreshɔn. 20% de gi mɔni fɔ di kɔr divɛlɔpmɛnt. 10% de bɔn ɔ sidɔm as inshɔrans.

gravitixDocs.title: Gravitix Langwej Rifrɛns
gravitixDocs.subtitle: Wan ay-pɔfɔmɛnshɔn skriptin langwej fɔ bil bot. 96 ficha dɛn. Rust bakɛnd.
gravitixDocs.introDesc: Gravitix na domɛyn-spɛsifi k langwej (DSL) we dɛn mek frɔm di grɔn fɔ rayt Vortex bot. Usay ɔda langwej dɛn nid laybri, kɔl bak, ɛn bɔyla plet, Gravitix de gi yu fɔs-klas ivin handla, tɔk-tɔk flɔ, ɛn bilt-in stet — ɔl dis insay wan klin, ridable sɛntaks we dɛn inspɛkt frɔm Rust.
gravitixDocs.goalReadable: Ridabl — kɔd de rid lɛk intent, nɔto mashin
gravitixDocs.goalSafe: Sef — statik tayp dɛn kin kech mistek bifo rɔntaym
gravitixDocs.goalExpressive: Ɛksprɛsiv — flɔ, gad, ɛn patɛn maching na dɛn bil-in
gravitixDocs.goalMinimal: Minimal — nɔ klas, nɔ ɛritaj, nɔ freym fɔ lan
gravitixDocs.whoDesc: Gravitix na fɔ ɛnibɔdi we want fɔ bil Vortex bot kwik — ilɛksɛf yu nɔ ɛva rayt kɔd bifo, ɔ yu na sizin divɛlɔpa we taya wit Python boilerplate. Dis rεfrεns de tich Gravitix frכm fכs prinsipul dεm: no prεviכs εkspiriεns nid.
gravitixDocs.howToReadDesc: Ɛni pat de bil pan di wan dɛn we bin dɔn de bifo. If yu na nyu pɔsin fɔ mek program, rid frɔm ɔp to dɔŋ. If yu dɔn sabi ɔda langwej, yuz di tebul fɔ jomp dairekt to wetin yu lɛk.
gravitixDocs.quickStartDesc: Di fastest rod frɔm ziro to wan bot we de rɔn.
gravitixDocs.whatHappenedDesc: on /start { ... } — de difayn wan handla we de rɔn we yuza sɛn /start. emit "..." — de sɛn mɛsej bak to di pɔsin we de yuz am. {ctx.first_name} — intapɔlet di yuza in fɔs nem insay di string.
gravitixDocs.runningDesc: Insay di Gravitix IDE, klik di Run bɔtin we de na di ɔp bar. Enta yu Vortex Bot Token wen yu aks yu. Di bot stat wantɛm wantɛm — nɔ bil stɛp nid.
gravitixDocs.syntaxDesc: Ɛvri Gravitix program dɛn bil am frɔm tri bɛsik bildin blɔk dɛn: handla, ɛmit stetmɛnt, ɛn lɔjik.

gravitixDocs.typesDesc: Ɛvri valyu na Gravitix gɛt wan kayn. Di tayp sistem na statik: dɛn de chɛk di tayp dɛn we dɛn de kɔmpilayt, bifo yu bot rɔn.

complex_type.p3: Ɔl di 4 besik ɔpreshɔn dɛn de wok pan kɔmpleks valyu dɛn dairekt wan. Gravitix de fala standad kɔmpleks aritmɛtik lɔ dɛn:
complex_type.p4: Signal prɔsesin (ɔdio analisis, FFT), fraktal jenɛreshɔn (Mandelbrot sɛt), fizik simulshɔn, ilɛktrik impedans kɔlkyulɛshɔn, ɛn kwantum kɔmpiutishɔn ɔl nid kɔmpleks aritmɛtik. Gravitix de mek yu ron dɛn kɔlkyulɛshɔn ya rayt insay wan Vortex bot we nɔ gɛt ɛksternal laybri.

intro.p1: Gravitix na domɛyn-spɛsifi k langwej (DSL) we dɛn mek frɔm di grɔn fɔ rayt Vortex bot. Usay ɔda langwej dɛn nid laybri, kɔl bak, ɛn bɔyla plet, Gravitix de gi yu fɔs-klas ivin handla, tɔk-tɔk flows, ɛn bilt-in state — ɔl dis insay wan klin, ridable sintaks we dɛn inspɛkt frɔm Rust.
intro.p2: Gravitix na fɔ ɛnibɔdi we want fɔ bil Vortex bot kwik — ilɛksɛf yu nɔ ɛva rayt kɔd bifo, ɔ yu na sizin divɛlɔpa we taya wit Python boilerplate. Dis rεfrεns de tich Gravitix frכm fכs prinsipul dεm: nכ prεviכs εkspiriεns nid.
intro.p3: Ɛni pat de bil pan di wan dɛn we bin dɔn de bifo. If yu na nyu pɔsin fɔ mek program, rid frɔm ɔp to dɔŋ. If yu dɔn sabi ɔda langwej, yuz di tebul fɔ jomp dairekt to wetin yu lɛk.
intro.p4: Tru dis rɛfrɛns, → min "evalyu to" ɔ "prodyuz", ɛn // ... de sho kɔmɛnt dɛn we di kɔmpayla nɔ de tek tɛm wit.

math_special.h1: Gamma & di wok dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit am
math_special.p1: Di Gamma fכnshכn Γ(n) na di kכntinyu jεnaralisεshכn כf fכktכrial: Γ(n) = (n−1)! fɔ pɔsitiv intaj dɛn. I de ɛkstɛnd faktɔrial to rial ɛn kɔmpleks nɔmba dɛn.
math_special.p2: Di mistek fɛnshɔn erf(x) = (2/√π)∫₀ˣ e^(−t2)dt na di intagral fɔ di Gaussian. I gɛt dairekt rilayshɔn to di nɔmal CDF ɛn i de apia na ɔt ikwɛshɔn ɛn prɔbabiliti tiori.
math_special.p3: ζ(dɛn) = Σ 1/nˢ fɔ n=1,2,3,... (we Re(dɛn)>1). Konekt to praymɛnt distribyushɔn via di Euler prodak. Di Riemann Hypothesis (unsolved!) de kɔnsɛntret di ziro dɛm fɔ ζ na di kɔmpleks plen.
math_special.p4: Bessel fכnshכn Jₙ(x) εn Yₙ(x) na sכlushכn to Bessel in difrεnshal ikwyulet: x2y'' + xy' + (x2−n2)y = 0. Dεn de apin insay wev prכpagεshכn, hεt kכndukshכn insay silinda, εn kwantum mεkanik.
math_special.p5: Ai(x) ɛn Bi(x) na sɔlvishɔn fɔ y'' = xy. Dɛn de apin insay kwantum tanɛl (WKB aprɔksimɛshɔn) ɛn ɔptik (difrakshɔn).
math_special.p6: Dɛn pɔlinɔmial famili ya kin apin as ayjɛnfɔnshɔn fɔ impɔtant ɔpreshɔn ɛn dɛn kin yuz dɛn na spɛktral mɛtɔd, kwadrat, ɛn kwantum mɛkaniks.
math_special.p7: K(k) ɛn E(k) na kɔmplit ɛliptik intagrɛl dɛn we na di fɔs ɛn sɛkɔn kayn. Dɛn kin kɔmpyutayt di tɛm fɔ wan nɔ-layn pendul ɛn di perimita fɔ wan ɛlips.
math_special.td1: Γ(x) = ∫₀^∞ tˣ⁻1e⁻dt. Lanczos aprɔksimɛshɔn. Γ(n+1)=n, di wan dɛn we de!
math_special.td2: ln|Γ(x)|. Avoids ovaflow fɔ big x.
math_special.td5: P3(x): ɔrtogɔnal pan [−1,1]. Angular pat pan haydrojɛn wɛvfɔnkshɔn dɛn.
math_special.td6: H3(x): ɔrtogɔnal w.r.t. e^(−x2) we dɛn kɔl. Kwantum hamonik ɔsilatɔ.
math_special.td8: L3(x): ortogonal pan [0,∞) w.r.t. e^(−x) we dɛn kɔl. Haydrojen raydial wɛvfɔnkshɔn dɛn.

types.h7_b: Implementation overview for "void .". The mechanism is implemented in the corresponding module under `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, or `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. The module README calls out exact file paths.
types.h7_c: The "void ." mechanism evolved across Vortex releases. The design traces back to published research and production practices of prior messengers. Version history in `CHANGELOG.md` records when each piece landed and what motivated it.

architexDocs.title: Architex Langwej Rifrɛns
architexDocs.subtitle: Wan diklaretiv UI langwej fɔ Vortex Mini Apps. Riaktiv stet, kompozabl layouts, ziro bild step.
architexDocs.introDesc: Architex na wan smɔl diklaretiv DSL we dɛn mek fɔ ship UI insay di Vortex mɛsenja. Yu de tɔk bɔt aw di skrin fɔ tan lɛk; di rɔntaym de kip piksɛl dɛn in sink wit stet ɔtomɛtik wan. Nɔ vayrɔyal DOM, nɔ bɔndlɛr, nɔ JSX — di `.arx` fayl na di ap.
architexDocs.goalDeclarative: Diklɛrativ — yu rayt di UI we yu want, nɔto di stɛp dɛn fɔ bil am
architexDocs.goalReactive: Riaktiv — `~count += 1` ɛn ɛvri lɛbl we de rid am de ɔpdet in ples
architexDocs.goalPortable: Portable — di sem `.arx` de rɔn pan wɛb, iOS, ɛn Andrɔyd rɔntaym dɛn we nɔ gɛt ɛdit
architexDocs.goalTiny: Tiny — parser + renderer ship in ɔnda 30 KB, so Mini Apps opin wantɛm wantɛm
architexDocs.goalReadable: Ridabl — indenteshɔn na strɔkchɔ; modifya dɛn de chen wit `::`; no pɔntueshɔn taks nɔ de
architexDocs.whoDesc: Ɛnibɔdi we want fɔ ship intaraktiv skrin na Vortex — kɔstɔma fɔm, dashbɔd, vot pej, Telegram-stayl Mini Apps. If yu dɔn ɛva rayt HTML+CSS+JS, Architex go fil se yu sabi am bɔt i go rayt fast. If yu nɔ dɔn du am, Architex na saful introdukshɔn bak to riaktiv programin bikɔs di langwej de kip di futprin smɔl.
architexDocs.howToReadDesc: Ɛni pat de bil pan di wan we bin de bifo. Start na Kwik Start, dɔn rid Sintaks, Stet, Layout, Modifiers, Actions, ɛn di advans sɛkshɔn las. Jɔmp rawnd via di tebul ɔf kɔntinyu if yu dɔn no Riakt ɔ Svelte — di kɔnsɛpt dɛn map klin wan.
architexDocs.quickStartDesc: Di shɔt rod frɔm wan blank fayl to wan Mini App we de rɔn.
architexDocs.firstScreenExample:
@skrin Halo

  ~nem = "wɔl".

  kol :: pad(24) gap(12) senta

    hεda "Alo, {~nem}!" :: bold saiz(28)

    input ~nem :: pad(8) rayus(6) bɔda(#ccc)

    text "Tayp wan nem ɔp — dis tɛks de ɔpdet as yu de tayp."
      :: saiz(12) kala(#888)
architexDocs.whatHappenedDesc: `@screen Hello` de diklare di rut. `~name = "world"` de mek wan riaktiv vεriεbul. `col`, `hɛda`, `input`, `tɛks` na kɔmpɔnɛnt dɛn we dɛn bil insay. `::` de ataya modifya dɛn (padding, kɔlɔ, saiz). We di yuza tayp insay di input, ɛvri `{~nem}` intapɔleshɔn de ɔpdet — nɔ waya, nɔ sabskripshɔn, nɔ rɛnd wit an.
architexDocs.runningItDesc: Opin di Architex tab na di Vortex bot studio, pas di kɔd, pres Run. Di rɔntaym de rɛnd insay di privyu pan ɛn hot-rilod pan sev. We yu de pablish, yu yuza dɛn de opin di ap frɔm ɛni chat — nɔ instɔl.
architexDocs.syntaxDesc: Ɛvri Architex program na 4 tin dɛn mek am: diklareshɔn dɛn we de stat wit `@`, riaktiv vɛriɔbul dɛn we dɛn prɛfiks wit `~`, kɔmpɔnɛnt dɛn we dɛn rayt as bare aydentifaya, ɛn modifya dɛn we dɛn ataya afta `::`.
architexDocs.anatomyDeclDesc: `@screen Name`, `@theme`, `@import "./lib.arx"`, ɛn `@for item in ~list` ɔl de stat na kɔlɔm 0. Ɔltin we dɛn indent dɔŋ dɛn na da blɔk de.
architexDocs.anatomyCompDesc: Kɔmpɔnɛnt dɛn sidɔm na dɛn yon layn: `tɛks`, `bɔtɔn`, `imej`, `hɛda`, `lɛbul`, `badj`, `divayda`, `kɔl`, `rɔw`. Dɛn pozishɔnal argumɛnt de kam rayt afta di nem: `tɛks ~mɛsej`, `bɔtɔn "Sev"`, `imej "/logo.png"`.
architexDocs.anatomyModifierDesc: Afta `::` yu kin chen as many modifiers as yu laik. Ɛni wan de tek ziro ɔ mɔ argumɛnt dɛn insay brakɛt: `:: pad(24) gap(16) sɛnta bold saiz(20) kala(#4f8ef7)`. Modifaya dɛn na pozishɔnal, nɔto ki wɔd — ɔda nɔ impɔtant pas di las-rayta-win wan dɛn lɛk `kɔlɔ`.
architexDocs.anatomyActionDesc: `=>` pan wan bɔtin (ɔ ɛni intaraktiv kɔmpɔnɛnt) de rɔn di asaynmɛnt ɔ fɛnshɔn kɔl we de fala. Bɔku bɔku `=>` chen sayd-bay-sayd: `bɔtɔn "Sɔbmit" => ~bizi = tru => sɛn(akshɔn: "sɛv", data: ~fɔm)`.
architexDocs.reactiveVarsDesc: Eni nem we dɛn prɛfiks wit `~` na riaktiv sɛl. Rayt `~count = 0` fɔ diklar, `~count = 5` fɔ ri-asaynd, `~count += 1` fɔ ɔpdet. εvri UI node we de rid di sεl — dayrekt כ via intapolεshכn — de ri-rεnd we di sεl chenj.
architexDocs.computedVarsDesc: Yuz `:=` insted of `=` fɔ diklar wan kɔmpyutayt ɛksprɛshɔn: `~tɔtal := ~kɔnt * ~stɛp`. Di rayt-an sayd de ri-evalyu ɛnitɛm we ɛni dipɛnsin chenj. No manual sabskripshɔn nɔ de ɛn no stale-value bug nɔ de — if yu rid `~a` sɔmsay na di ɛksprɛshɔn, yu ɔtomɛtik dipen pan am.
architexDocs.typeAnnotationsDesc: Anoteshɔn na opshɔnal bɔt ɛp wit ɔtokɔmplit ɛn mistek mɛsej: `~kɔnt: nɔmba = 0`, `~nem: string = ""`, `~ok: bulian = lay`, `~aytem: arenjmɛnt = []`, `~yuz: ɔbjɛkt = {}`. If yu skip dɛn di tayp de infɛr frɔm di initialiser.
architexDocs.supportedTypes: Di kayn dɛn we dɛn sɔpɔt
architexDocs.supportedTypesList: `nɔmba`, `string`, `bulian`, `ɛri`, `ɔbjɛkt`, `nul`. Dɛn kin pas deti ɛn blob dɛn as string ɛn tin dɛn. Di rɔntaym de yuz JavaScript in kɔstɔm lɔ dɛn ɔnda di hud, so `~kɔnt + 1` de wok ivin if `~kɔnt` bigin layf as string.
architexDocs.stringInterpolationDesc: Ɛni string kin ɛmbad ɛksprɛshɔn wit `{...}`: `"Hɛlo, {~yuz.nem}!"`, `"Tɔtal: {~kɔnt * ~prayz}"`. Intapɔleshɔn na riaktiv ɔltɛm.
architexDocs.layoutDesc: Architex gɛt tu kɔntena dɛn we dɛn kin kɔmpoz ɛn wan duzin lif kɔmpɔnɛnt dɛn. Nest dem wit indentation — no klosing tags.
architexDocs.containersDesc: `col` stak pikin dɛn vertikal, `row` ɔrizɔntal. Dɛn tu aksept `gap(n)`, `pad(n)`, `sɛnta`, `grɔ`, ɛn wan wit/ayt modifya. Indent pikin dεm wan lεvεl dip fכ nεst.
architexDocs.containerExample:
row :: gap(8) pad(16) na di sɛnt
  imej "/avatar.png" :: w(40) h(40) rayus(20)
  kol :: grow gap(2)
    teks ~nem :: bold
    teks ~bio :: saiz(12) kala(#888)
architexDocs.leafComponents: Di komponent dɛn we de na di lif
architexDocs.leafComponentsList: `text` — ɛni bɔdi kɔpi. `hɛda` — sɛmantik wan edlayn. `label` — smɔl kapshɔn tɛks. `bɔtɔn` — kɔntrol we pɔsin kin tap. `input` — tɛks fil we dɛn tay to wan riaktiv var. `imej` — pikchɔ frɔm wan URL. `badge` — tag we shep lɛk pil. `divayda` — tin separatɔ layn. `toast` — snekbar we nɔ de te. `tabs` / `tab` — tab swicha.
architexDocs.componentTextDesc: `text "Hello"` de rɛnd wan statik string. `text ~message` de rɛnd wan riaktiv wan. Kɔmbayn wit intapɔleshɔn: `tɛks "Tɔtal: {~kɔnt}"`.
architexDocs.componentHeaderDesc: Tɛks we de na di edlayn. Difɔlt to big, bold pas `tɛks`. Semweso pozishɔnal argumɛnt: `hɛda "Sɛtin"`. Saiz skel wit skrin — ɔvalayz wit `sayz(n)`.
architexDocs.componentButtonDesc: Elemɛnt we pɔsin kin tap. Di posishunal string na di lɛbl; di `=>` akshɔn de rɔn pan tap. `bɔtɔn "Sev" => ~draft = nul`. Bɔku bɔku `=>` faya dɛn insay ɔda.
architexDocs.componentInputDesc: Tu-way-bound tɛks fil. Di riaktiv vɛriɔbul afta di nem de ol di valyu we de naw: `input ~email`. Modifaya dɛn: `pleshɔlda("...")`, `debounce(300)` fɔ throttled ɔpdet dɛn.
architexDocs.componentImageDesc: Lod frɔm wan HTTPS URL ɔ `/uploads/...` pat. Modifaya dɛn `w(px)`, `h(px)`, `radius(px)` de trim di bɔks. Fɔl bak to wan pleshɔlda silhouette if di URL 404s.
architexDocs.componentDividerDesc: Hairline separator, 1px, de ɔna di kɔrɛnt tim kɔlɔ. Nɔ agyumɛnt nɔ de.
architexDocs.componentBadgeDesc: Pil we de ɔg in kɔntinyu: `badge ~count`, `badge "nyu"`. Yuz fɔ kɔnta dɛn we nɔ rid ɛn tag chips.
architexDocs.componentLabelDesc: Kapshɔn/ɛlpa tɛks — we pɔsin kin si. Good fɔ fɔm fil nem dɛn.
architexDocs.componentToastDesc: Notis we nɔ de blok. `toast ~visible "Dɛn dɔn sev am!" :: duration(2000)` sho fɔ 2 s ɛnitɛm we `~visible` na tru, dɔn ɔto-dismis. No modal stacking, no z-index wɔ dɛn.
architexDocs.componentTabsDesc: Tab kɔntena we dɛn baynd to wan riaktiv string: `tabs ~activeTab`. Insay am, ɛni `tab "Label" "key"` de diklar wan tab; di bɔdi we dɛn indent dɔŋ de sho we di ki mach.
architexDocs.modifiers: Di wan dɛn we de chenj
architexDocs.modifiersDesc: Modifiers na di onli we fɔ stayl wan kɔmpɔnɛnt. Chen dem afta `::`. Dɛn kin kam insay fayv famili dɛn: difrɛns, sayz, kɔlɔ, taypografi, ɛn bihayvya.
architexDocs.modSpacing: Spays we dɛn kin put difrɛn say dɛn
architexDocs.modSpacingDesc: `pad(n)` — padding na ɔl di say dɛn. `pad(x, y)` — ɔrizɔntal + vertikal. `pad(top, rayt, bottom, lef)` — CSS-ɔda. `gap(n)` — spes bitwin pikin dɛm fɔ wan `col` / `row`. `margin(n)` — ɔda spays frɔm brɔda ɛn sista dɛn.
architexDocs.modSizing: Di sayz we dɛn de mek
architexDocs.modSizingDesc: `w(px)` — fiks wit. `h(px)` — fiks ayt. `grow` — ful di ples we lɛf na wan row/kɔl. `senta` — senta along di kros aks; insay wan `col` i de sεntrכl כrizכnal, insay wan `rכw` i de sεntrכ vεtikal.
architexDocs.modColourDesc: `kɔlɔ(#rrggbb)` — fɔgrɔn. `bg(#rrggbb)` — bakgrɔn. Dɛn tu aksept tim token: `color(~primary)` de rid frɔm di `@theme` blɔk we de naw. Opasiti de go tru wan 8-dijit heks: `#00000080` na 50 %% blak.
architexDocs.modTypographyDesc: `size(px)` — font saiz. `bold` / `italic` — wet ɛn stayl. `align(lɛft|senta|rayt)` — tɛks alaynɛshɔn.
architexDocs.modVisibility: Di we aw pɔsin kin si tin
architexDocs.modVisibilityDesc: `hidden(~flag)` — de unmount di node we di flag na tru. `visible(~flag)` — invas we pɔsin kin si. Di no dɛm we nɔ dɔn mawnt de shed dɛn DOM, so kɔndishɔnal UI na chip.
architexDocs.modBehaviourDesc: `debounce(ms)` pan `input` throttles ɔpdet dɛn. `placeholder("...")` de sho wan hint string. `fɔmat(kayn, arg)` pan `tɛks` fɔmat wan nɔmba: `fɔmat("kɔrɛnt", "USD")`, `fɔmat("pasɛnt")`, `fɔmat("kɔmpakt")`.
architexDocs.modRadiusDesc: `radius(px)` de rawnd kɔna dɛn. `border(#rrggbb)` de drɔ wan 1 px strɔk. `border(px, #rrggbb)` de sɛt tiknɛs bak.
architexDocs.actionsDesc: Akshɔn dɛn kin chenj stet ɔ tɔk to di ɔda wɔl. Dɛn de rɔn sinkrɔnal wan na di tap/kipres handla.
architexDocs.actionAssignDesc: `=> ~kɔnt = 0`, `=> ~bizi = tru`, `=> ~list = []`. Eni riaktiv vayriɔbul na tin we pɔsin kin rayt.
architexDocs.actionIncDecDesc: `+= n`, `-= n`, `*= n`, `/= n`. `=> ~kɔnt += 1` na idiomatik fɔ kɔnta.
architexDocs.actionMultipleDesc: Bɔku bɔku `=>` na di sem layn faya ɔp-to-bɔt na di sem tik, so di UI de ɔpdet wan tɛm na di ɛnd: `bɔtɔn "Bai" => ~bizi = tru => sɛn(akshɔn: "bay") => ~bizi = lay`. Fɔ async wok, prɛf wan kɔmpyutayt `@reaction`.
architexDocs.actionSendDesc: `send(action: "name", ...args)` na di brij bak to di bot. Di ɔs (Vortex rɔntaym) de gɛt am as JSON RPC mɛsej ɛn i kin kɔl yu bot in kɔd. Yuz am fɔ login, API fetch, pe — ɛnitin we di DSL insɛf nɔ ebul fɔ ɛksprɛs.
architexDocs.actionNavigate: Navigation we yu go ebul fɔ waka
architexDocs.actionNavigateDesc: `goto("ScreenName", arg: valyu, ...)` de push ɔda `@skrin` pan di stak; `bak()` de pop. Di rɔntaym de animate bay difɔlt.
architexDocs.actionHostBuiltinsDesc: `copy(~text)`, `share(~text)`, `haptic("layt" | "medium" | "hevi")`, `vibrate(ms)`, `alert("...")`, `kɔnfɛm("...") => ~ok = it` — di `it` shɔthand na di ritɔn valyu fɔ di ɛksprɛshɔn we de bifo.
architexDocs.themeDesc: Diklar wan palet wan tɛm, yuz am bak ɔlsay. Token dɛn kin bi rɛgyula riaktiv vɛriɔbul so yu ap kin ship wan dak-mɔd tɔgl insay tri layn dɛn.
architexDocs.importsDesc: `@import "./shared/ui.arx"` de pul ɛvri `@component` ɛn `@screen` frɔm da fayl de insay di skɔp we de naw. Paths na rilitiv to di fayl we dɛn de import; sɛkɔral import dɛn de detekt ɛn ripɔt na parse tɛm.
architexDocs.componentsDesc: Difayn wan tɛm, yuz bɔku tɛm: `@komponent Avatar url saiz\n imej url :: w(sayz) h(sayz) rayus(sayz / 2)`. Insay di kɔmpɔnɛnt bɔdi di nem paramita dɛn de insay skɔp as plein aydentifaya (witout `~`).
architexDocs.forLoopsDesc: `@fɔ aytem na ~list` de rɛnd wan rɔw fɔ ɛni ɛlimɛnt. `@fɔ aytem, ​​idx insay ~list` de tay di ziro-bɛs indeks bak. Di rɔntaym de trak aydentiti via di ɛlimɛnt sɛf, so fɔ ad aytem dɛn na di tap pan wan 10 000-rɔw list de kɔst O(1) DOM wok.
architexDocs.forExample:
@fɔ aytem, idx insay ~aytem dɛn
  row :: gap(8) pad(4) .
    badge ~idx
    teks ~aytem :: gro
architexDocs.ternaryDesc: `kɔnd ? a : b` de wok ɛnisay we dɛn aksept wan ɛksprɛshɔn. Nest fɔ enums: `~status >= 10 ? "hay" : ~status >= 5 ? "mid" : "lɔ"`.
architexDocs.slotsDesc: Insay wan kɔmpɔnɛnt diklareshɔn, `slot` de mak usay di pɔsin we kɔl in bɔdi de plɔg in. Tink bɔt am lɛk di Riakt pikin dɛn / Vue difɔlt slot.
architexDocs.reactivityDesc: Ɛni `~var` na signal. We yu rid am insay wan kɔmpyutayt, modifya argumɛnt, ɔ intapɔleshɔn, di rɔntaym de not di rid insay di kɔrɛnt dipɛnsin grafik. We yu rayt, ɛvri no we rid am de gɛt ri-evalyu — wan tɛm, na di ɛnd pan di maykrotask we de naw.
architexDocs.reactivityBatchingDesc: Bɔku raytin dɛn na di sem handla de batch. `=> ~a = 1 => ~b = 2` de trigεr εksakכt wan rεndεr pas.
architexDocs.reactivityEqualityDesc: Bay difɔlt di rɔntaym de yuz strikt ikwalti (`===`). Rayt di sem valyu nɔ de ri-rɔn natin. Pas wan nyu ɔbjɛkt/ɛri fɔ fos wan ɔpdet; i de ɛnkɔrej fɔ mek i nɔ chenj bɔt dɛn nɔ nid am.
architexDocs.examplesDesc: Fo kanɔn ap dɛn, ɛni wan pan dɛn gɛt insɛf ɛn ɔnda 40 layn dɛn. Kɔpi ɛni wan pan dɛn na di Architex tab ɛn prɛs Run.
architexDocs.exampleCounter: Kaunta — riaktiv stet, kɔmpyutayt, bɔtin handla, tɛks binding.
architexDocs.exampleTodo: Todo — list rɛndrin, ad / pul, inlayn ɛditin.
architexDocs.exampleProfile: Profayl — imej, badge, kɔndishɔnal visibiliti, nevigishɔn.
architexDocs.exampleKiller: Kila ficha — tim, import, tab, tost, fɔmat nɔmba, ternaries, tayp vars.
architexDocs.errors: Kɔmɔn mistek dɛn ɛn wetin fɔ du
architexDocs.errUnknownName: `unknown name ~foo` — yu yuz wan riaktiv variebul bifo yu deklare am. Ad `~foo = ...` na di tap pan di `@skrin` we de kɔba.
architexDocs.errIndent: `unexpected indent` — pikin dεm fכ bi wan lεvεl dip pas dεn mama εn papa. Architex de yuz ɛksaktɔli tu spɛs pan ɛni lɛvul; tab dɛn nɔ gri fɔ avɔyd invisible-whitespace bɔg dɛn.
architexDocs.errModifier: `unknown modifier` — yu rayt `:: shadow` bɔt di rɔntaym nɔ sɔpɔt am. Chek di modifya list we de ɔp; Architex strikt bɔt nem dɛn we dɛn nɔ no fɔ protɛkt fɔwad kɔmpitibliti.
architexDocs.errType: `tayp mismatch` — ɛgz. yu pas wan string usay dɛn de ɛkspɛkt nɔmba. Anotate di riaktiv variebul (`~count: number`) ɛn di parser go tɛl yu usay di bad valyu kɔmɔt.
architexDocs.errDebug: Fɔ dibɔg na rɔntaym, rap di sɔspɛkt ɛksprɛshɔn insay `debug(...)` — di rɔntaym de lɔg ɛvri ɛvalueshɔn to di kɔnsol we nɔ afɛkt di valyu.
architexDocs.compatWeb: Wɛb — de rɛnd insay vanila DOM wit CSS vɛriɔbul fɔ tim token. No Riakt / Vue / Svelte dipεndεns.
architexDocs.compatIOS: iOS — di sem `.arx` de pars ɛn rɛnd insay SwiftUI views via di Vortex iOS host. Ɛvri modifya de map to wan SwiftUI stayl.
architexDocs.compatAndroid: Andrɔyd — di ɔs de rɛnd insay Jetpack Kɔmpoz. Jɛst modifya dɛn (`:: onTap`, `:: onLongPress`) translet to Kɔmpoz ikwal dɛn.
architexDocs.compatVersions: Vɛshɔn polisi — Architex de garanti bakwɔd kɔmpitibliti fɔ `.arx` fayl dɛn akɔdin to smɔl vɛshɔn dɛn. Wan `.arx` fayl we dɛn rayt agens 0.1 stil de wok pan 0.9.
architexDocs.nextSteps: Di nɛks tin dɛn we yu fɔ du
architexDocs.nextStepsDesc: Rid di kukbuk fɔ patɛns (list dɛn we nɔ gɛt ɛnd, fɔm, pemɛnt), di tul gayd fɔ di CLI ɛn VS Kɔd plɔgin, ɛn di kɔntribyushɔn gayd if yu want fɔ ad wan kɔmpɔnɛnt we dɛn bil insay. Di ful sɔs de na github.com/vortex/Architex.

meta.title: Vortex Rifrɛns
meta.subtitle: Everi sabsistim of Vortex na wan ples.
meta.intro: Dis rɛfrɛns na ɔltin bay we dɛn mek am. Start ɛnisay — ɛni chapta na insɛf sɛf. Ɛvri stetmɛnt de link bak to sɔs pat dɛn we i rili impɔtant. Ɛvri invariant, dɛn kɔl am klia wan.
meta.howToUse: Di tebul we de na di lɛft say de sho di chapta dɛn we de ya. Klik wan chapta fɔ jomp to am; ɛni chapta gɛt sɔb-hɛdin ɛn list dɛn we yu kin skan insay 30 sɛkɔn bifo yu dayv insay.

architecture.title: Akitekchɔ ɔvaviu
architecture.subtitle: Tri prɔses — klaynt, node, kɔntrol — ɛn wan protɔkɔl we de tay dɛn.
architecture.intro: Vortex na disɛntralayz mɛsenja. Insted of wan singl bak-ɛnd we wan kɔmni gɛt, i de fedaret wan opin mɛsh fɔ indipɛndɛnt **nodes**, we wan kɔmpakt **kɔntrola** we de pablish wan sayn manifest fɔ di kɔd we i dɔn atɛst. **Klaynt** de ol ɔl di prayvet ki dɛn ɛn rɛnd UI. Di ɔda pat na dis chapta de waka di tri prɔses, dɛn bɔda, ɛn di data we de flɔ bitwin dɛn.
architecture.h1p1: Sɛntralized mɛsenja na wan pɔynt fɔ fos. Wan kot ɔda, wan klawd-prɔvayda ɔtjɛj, ɔ wan hostile akwyeshɔn ɔl translet to "yuzman dɛn lɔs akses". Vortex saydstep dat bay we i de lɛ ɛnibɔdi rɔn wan no ɛn lɛ di klaynt dɛn muv bitwin no dɛn we dɛn nɔ ri-rɛjista.
architecture.h1p2: Disɛntralayzeshɔn gɛt fɔ kip kɔnfidɛns ɛn intɛgriti. Wan fedareshɔn fɔ di sava dɛn we dɛn nɔ trɔst de wok nɔmɔ if di sava dɛn nɔ ebul fɔ rid pleintɛks ɛn dɛn nɔ ebul fɔ fɔj mɛsej. Vortex de enfors ɔl tu via ɛnd-to-ɛnd ɛnkripshɔn ɛn Ed25519 atɛsteshɔn pan ɛvri krɔs-nɔd mɛsej.
architecture.h1p3: Di kɔntrol na di wan sɛntralayz-ish pis, bɔt i smɔl. I jɔs de pablish `INTEGRITY.sig.json` ɛn wan list fɔ ɛntri pɔynt dɛn we dɛn kin trɔst. Enibodi kin self-host wan miro, so ivin di kontrola no bi wan point of failure — jos wan single source of truth for "which pubkey signs official releases".
architecture.h1l1: Nɔ vendor lɔk-in: klaynt dɛn kin mayk dɛn aydentiti bitwin no dɛm ɛni tɛm bay we dɛn ri-sayn di X25519 pabkey wit nyu JWT.
architecture.h1l2: Nɔ ɔtjɛj kɔrɛleshɔn: we wan node go dɔŋ, di wan dɛn we de yuz ɔda node dɛn nɔ kin notis.
architecture.h1l3: Nɔ wan jɔrisdikshɔn: di wan dɛn we de wok de pik dɛn ligal os, ɛn di wan dɛn we de yuz am de pik dɛn ɔpreshɔn.
architecture.h1l4: No single UI: iOS, Andrɔyd, wɛb na fɔs-klas kɔmpin — nɔ pletfɔm na tin wrap oba ɔda wan.
architecture.h2p1: Di klaynt de rɔn pan wan yuza in divays. Dat na di wangren ples we plaintɛks mɛsej, prayvet ki, ɛn fayl-in-di-klia de liv. Di node nɔ de ɛva si dɛn.
architecture.h2p2: Ɛvri pletfɔm we dɛn sɔpɔt de impruv di sem waya protɔkɔl dɛn (HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC). SOLID-split ficha modul (`api/` protɔkɔl, `impl/` kɔd, `ui/` views) kip di kɔntrakt tayt ɛn pletfɔm-spɛsifi k kɔd lokaliz.
architecture.h2p3: Stɔrej na di divays: Kichen / EncryptedSharedPreferences / HttpOnly kuki fɔ token dɛn; SQLite (GRDB na iOS, Rum na Andrɔyd, IndexedDB wrapper na wɛb) fɔ kesh sayfatɛks + di FTS indeks.
architecture.h2l1: iOS — Swift Pakɛj wit 30+ ficha mɔdyul dɛn. Min diploymɛnt target iOS 17.
architecture.h2l2: Andrɔyd — Kotlin + Kɔmpoz + Hilt. minSdk 26, targetSdk 34, we yu de du.
architecture.h2l3: Wɛb — vanila JS PWA, savis woka, nɔ bil stɛp biyɔn ES mɔdyul bɔndlin.
architecture.h2l4: Desktop — Tauri wrap rawnd di wɛb klaynt; di sem bɔndɛl, nativ Chrome rɛnda.
architecture.h3p1: Node na Python prɔses (`python -m app.main`, ɔ di bɔndɛl `run.py`) we de lisin pan 9000 bay difɔlt. I de persist sayfatɛks, fan aut WebSocket ivin, ol TURN kredibiliti, ɛn brɔkers fedareshɔn wit ɔda no dɛm.
architecture.h3p2: Di node layt na tin we dɛn mek bay wilful. I de ɛksplɔz lɛk 120 rod dɛn akɔdin to di `/api/*` tik plus `/ws` fɔ rial-taym fan-ɔut. Di hevi liftin (kripto, prezɛns, scheduling) na factor insay `ap/sikyɔriti/`, `ap/transpɔt/`, `ap/pi/`.
architecture.h3p3: Wan singl node na di difɔlt SQLite mod de handle ~50 kɔnkɔrɛnt yuza dɛn kɔmfyut wan pan wan M1. Wit Postgres ɛn Redis ɛnabul, di sem kɔd de skel ɔrizɔntal — ɛvri node kin bi stetlɛs pas di DB ɛn fan-ɔut.
architecture.h3l1: Ɛntri pɔynt dɛn: `/api/*` HTTPS, `/ws` WebSocket, `/v1/integriti` ɛn `/hɛlth` fɔ layf.
architecture.h3l2: Dipɛnsin dɛn: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.x, uvicorn, kriptografi (OpenSSL), pqcrypto (liboqs), paytɔn-multipat, Pilo, Rust ɛkstenshɔn `vortex_chat` fɔ hot-pat kripto.
architecture.h3l3: Opshɔnal: Redis (prɛzɛns fan-ɔut akɔs bɔku no dɛm), Postgres (prɔdakshɔn DB), kɔturn (TURN rilay), fluent-bit (lɔg shiping).
architecture.h3l4: Baynary saiz: ~60 MB Python dεp + ~10 MB Rust εkstenshכn. Docker imej lɛk 400 MB bifo skwash.
architecture.h4: Di pɔsin we de kɔntrol di tin
architecture.h4p1: Di kɔntrol na wan sɛpret Python prɔses (`vortex_controller`) wit wan smɔl rizin: pablish ɛn verify `INTEGRITY.sig.json`, ɛksplɔz ɛntri URL dɛn, ɛn trak di wɛlbɔdi fɔ di fedaret kɔmpin dɛn.
architecture.h4p2: We yu stat di kɔntrol de waka di sɔs tik, hash ɛvri fayl, ɛn kɔmpia agens di manifɔst. If ɛni hash mismatch di kɔntrol nɔ gri fɔ stat. Dis min se wan tampered on-disk file nɔ go ebul fɔ sav `status:"verified"`.
architecture.h4p3: Klaynt dɛn kin hit `/v1/integrity` bifo dɛn trɔst wan node. If dɛn si `status != "verified"` dɛn nɔ gri fɔ gi kredibiliti, period. Dat na di trɔst ankɔ.
architecture.h4l1: Sayn wit `ki/rilis.ki` (Ed25519). Pɔblik haf bak insay klaynt rilis dɛn.
architecture.h4l2: Manifest ɛntri dɛm: `{path, sha256, size}` fɔ ɛvri fayl we nɔ gitignored.
architecture.h4l3: Ribild: `paytɔn -m vorteks_kɔntrola.intɛgriti.sayn_tul`. Autput `INTEGRITY.sig.json` na di repo rut.
architecture.h4l4: Roteshɔn: ɔpreshɔn dɛn we de fɔk Vortex riples `rilis.ki`. Klaynt dɛn we dɛn kɔnfigyut wit dɛn pubkey den trɔst da fɔk de.
architecture.h5p1: Wok tru wetin kin apin we Alis sɛn "hi" to Bɔb:
architecture.h5p2: 1. Klaynt de luk di rum in rut ki na in lokal stoa. If i nɔ de, i kin tek wan fresh ɛnvilɔp frɔm `/api/rooms/{id}/keys` fɔ in yon pɔbki. Fɔs-taym DM dɛn de rɔn wan-raun Diffie-Hellman pan prekeys.
architecture.h5p3: 2. Klaynt de freym di peylɔd as CBOR `{v:1, tɛks:"hi", reply_to:null, sɛn_at:...}`, de jenarayz wan random 96-bit nonce, sial wit AES-256-GCM, ɛn POST `/api/rooms/{id}/messages` wit `{ciphertext: hex, nonce: hex, sender_pseudo: heks}`.
architecture.h5p4: 3. Node de stoa di row ɛn fan aut `{type:"m", rum:..., msg:{id, ct, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at}}` to ɛvri kɔnɛkt WebSocket we sabskrip to di rum.
architecture.h5p5: 4. Bob in klaynt de risiv di freym, dekript wit di sem rut ki, verify sender pseudo matches expected membership, en render di bubble.
architecture.h5p6: 5. Bob in klaynt de post `POST /api/rooms/{id}/read` wit di las rid mɛsej id. Dat de trig wan `{type:"r"}` brodkas so Alis in bɔbul sho wan tik.
architecture.h6p1: CBOR (RFC 8949) na strikt, baynary, ɛn fast fɔ ɛnkɔd. We yu kɔmpia am wit JSON i de kɔt peylɔd saiz bay ~30 % pan tipik chat sayfatɛks ɛn i de pul di wayt spɛs ambigwiti.
architecture.h6p2: We yu kɔmpia am wit Protobuf i nɔ nid skima jenɛra ɛn i nɔ de friz fil nɔmba dɛn. Dat impɔtant bikɔs Vortex de evolv — wi dɔn ad `thread_id`, `reply_to`, `reactions_count`, `kind` ova rilis dɛn we nɔ brok ol klaynt dɛn.
architecture.h6p3: CBOR na in bak we Saynal, Matrix, ɛn NIP-29 de yuz fɔ rizin dɛn we rili fiba. Fɔ mach wetin dɛn pik min se wi protɔkɔl izi fɔ ɔdit bay sikyɔriti risach pipul dɛn we dɔn ɔlrɛdi no di ɛnkɔdin.
architecture.h7p1: Evri freym de kari `v:<int>`. Di vɛshɔn we de naw na 1. Dɛn kin drɔp wan freym we gɛt wan vɛshɔn we dɛn nɔ no; klaynt dɛn kin log wan wɔnin ɛn kɔntinyu wit di nɛks freym.
architecture.h7p2: Bakwɔd kɔmpatibiliti de garanti fɔ ɛni freym we stil de kɛr `v:1`. Fɔwad kɔmpitibliti na di bɛst-ɛfɔt: dɛn ad nyu fil dɛn na di ɛnd pan di dikt, ol klaynt dɛn nɔ de pe atɛnshɔn to dɛn.
architecture.h7p3: Had brek de rizɛv fɔ sikyɔriti-kritikal chenj dɛn (e.g. swap HKDF kɔntɛks string dɛn). Insay dɛn kes dɛn de di vɛshɔn de bamp to 2 ɛn dɛn de pablish wan maykreshɔn winda.
architecture.h1_a: di Vortex nεtwכk de split insay tri prכsεs dεm. Ɛni wan pan dɛn de rɔn fɔ dɛnsɛf, de tɔk to di ɔda wan dɛn tru waya protɔkɔl dɛn we dɛn dɔn difayn fayn fayn wan, ɛn dɛn kin chenj dɛn fɔ dɛnsɛf. No monolith nɔ de — ɛvri ficha de plɔg insay wan pan di tri rol dɛn.
architecture.h1_b: Wan klaynt de ol ki ɛn rɛnd UI. Wan node de persist sayfatɛks, fan aut ivintɛns ova WebSocket, ɛn brɔkers WebRTC signalling. Wan kɔntrolɔ de pablish di sayn manifest ɛn ɛntrɛ URL dɛn. Dɛn kin kɔmyuniket ova HTTPS + WebSocket yuz CBOR-ɛnkɔd peylɔd dɛn insay AES-GCM ɛnvilɔp dɛn.
architecture.h1_c: Di split bin introdyus insay v0.0.3 afta di fɔs monolith vɛshɔn rɔn insay tu prɔblɛm: rilis atɛsteshɔn bin tay to di node we de rɔn (so wan kɔmprɔmis node kin lay bɔt in yon kɔd), ɛn fedareshɔn nɔ bin pɔsibul bikɔs node stet ɛn trɔst stet bin de liv insay di sem tebul dɛn. Split atɛsteshɔn aut insay in yon prɔses gi ɛvri ɔpreshɔn wan singl pubkey fɔ pin ɛn lɛ wi skel fedareshɔn to arbitri N.
architecture.h2_a: Di node/kɔntrola split de ayzolayt di mɔs sikyɔriti-sɛnsitiv artifakt (di sayn manifest) frɔm di big atak sɔfa (di API sava).
architecture.h2_b: Kɔntrola de kip wan smɔl SQLite DB: pɔbki dɛn we dɛn kin trɔst, miro URL dɛn, ɛn wɛlbɔdi skɔ dɛn. I nɔ gri fɔ stat if INTEGRITY.sig.json nɔ mach di on-disk tri — fayl we dɛn tamper nɔ go ɛva ebul fɔ sav `status:"verified"`. Di node de rɔn pan in yon Postgres/SQLite ɛn i nɔ de ɛva ol di rilis ki.
architecture.h2_c: Di patɛn kɔmɔt frɔm Chrome in rut-stɔ split (sɛt dɛn de liv na di brawza in rilis trak, nɔto di wɛb ɔrijin) ɛn Debian in Rilis.gpg (manifɛst sayn, pakej dɛn nɔ sayn). Dɛn bin adopt am bikɔs ɔl tu di dizayn dɛn bin sev fɔ lɔng lɔng tɛm we dɛn bin de rivyu di advasarial.
architecture.h3_a: TLS 1.3 pan ɛvri hop, ɛnd-to-ɛnd ɛnkript peylɔd dɛn insay. TLS de handle transpɔt; AES-GCM de handle di tin dɛn we de insay.
architecture.h3_b: Bitwin klaynt ɛn node: HTTPS (`/api/*`) ɛn WSS (`/ws`). Bitwin di no dɛm: HTTPS (`/fedareshɔn/*`). Bitwin node ɛn kɔntrol: HTTPS (`/v1/*`). Ɔl de yuz TLS 1.3 wit Chrome 120 finga prɛnt fɔ rɛsist DPI.
architecture.h3_c: Fɔs Vortex bin de yuz raw TCP wit kɔstɔm nɔys-prɔtokol hanshɛk. Switch to TLS 1.3 in v0.0.4 afta i rialize se kɔstɔm protɔkɔl dɛn de signal "intrestin" to pasiv ɔbzhɔva dɛn. TLS 1.3 na boring, ubiquitous, ɛn ECH-rɛdi — tri prɔpati dɛn we wi bin want.
architecture.h3_f:
transpɔt layt: TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446) + opshɔnal ECH (RFC 9460)
kɔntinyu layt: AES-256-GCM sial insay CBOR
architecture.h4_a: Wan ɔtbaund mɛsej de go tru 4 step dɛn: freym → ɛnkript → post → fan aut.
architecture.h4_b: Klaynt kɔmpyutayt di rum ki (X25519 + HKDF), fram di mɛsej as CBOR, sial wit AES-256-GCM yuz wan random 96-bit nonce, POST to `/api/rooms/{id}/messages`. Node de stoa di sayfatɛks row ɛn fan aut to ɛvri kɔnɛkt WebSocket we sabskripshɔn to di rum. Di klaynt in klaynt de dikript wit di sem ki. Raun-trip latɛns ɔnda 50 ms pan lokal LAN, ~120 ms tipik WAN.
architecture.h4_c: Di fo-step paip na di sem wan we Signal bin yuz insay 2014; wi chenj onli di transpot (WebSocket insted of Signal's TCP) en di enkodin (CBOR insted of protobuf). Fɔ mach wan dizayn we dɛn dɔn pruv, pas fɔ mek nyu wan.
architecture.h5_a: Wi pik CBOR ova JSON ɛn Protobuf afta wi kɔmpia peylɔd saiz, evolvabiliti, ɛn dibɔg ergonomics pan rial chat woklɔd.
architecture.h5_b: CBOR de prodyuz ~30% smɔl peylɔd pas JSON pan yunikɔd-hɛvi mɛsej, i nɔ gɛt wayt spɛs ambigwiti, ɛn i de sɔpɔt fil adishɔn we nɔ gɛt skima jenɛra. Proto go nid .proto fayl fɔ ɛni rilis ɛn i go friz fil nɔmba dɛn.
architecture.h5_c: Signal swich frɔm protobuf to CBOR-layk framing insay 2017 fɔ di sem rizin dɛn. Matrix de yuz CBOR insay in stet-rɛzolushɔn layt. CBOR na IETF standad (RFC 8949) ɛn ɛvri langwej we wi de tɔch gɛt machɔ laybri.
architecture.h5_f:
CBOR saiz: ~0.7 × JSON pan miks utf-8
          ~1.05 × protobuf pan di sem skima
Add wan fil = append na di ɛnd. Ol klaynt dɛn nɔ de tek tɛm.
architecture.h6_a: Wetin mek CBOR — pat pan di akitekchɔ chapta. dis na wan pan di kכr mεkanism dεm we dεn rεfrεns tru di Vortex rεfrεns. Rid di chapta we de rawnd am fɔ no mɔ bɔt di tin dɛn we de apin; dis pat de zoom in pan di spεsifi k bihayvya.
architecture.h6_b: Implimɛnt ɔvaviu fɔ "Wetin mek CBOR". Di mɛkanism de implimɛnt insay di kɔrɛspɔndɛns mɔdyul ɔnda `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, ɔ `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Di modul README de kɔl ɔut ɛksaktɔ fayl pat dɛn.
architecture.h6_c: di "Wetin mek CBOR" mεkanism evolv across Vortex rilis dεm. Di dizayn de tray bak to di risach ɛn prodakshɔn prɔsis we dɛn bin dɔn pablish we di mɛsenja dɛn we bin dɔn de bifo bin du. Vɛshɔn istri na `CHANGELOG.md` de rikodɔ we ɛni wan pan di pis land ɛn wetin mek i du am.
architecture.h7_a: Protocol versioning — pat pan di akitekchɔ chapta. dis na wan pan di kכr mεkanism dεm we dεn rεfrεns tru di Vortex rεfrεns. Rid di chapta we de rawnd am fɔ no mɔ bɔt di tin dɛn we de apin; dis pat de zoom in pan di spεsifi k bihayvya.
architecture.h7_b: Implimɛnt ɔvaviu fɔ "Protocol versioning". Di mɛkanism de implimɛnt insay di kɔrɛspɔndɛns mɔdyul ɔnda `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, ɔ `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Di modul README de kɔl ɔut ɛksaktɔ fayl pat dɛn.
architecture.h7_c: di "Protocol versioning" mεkanism evolv across Vortex rilis dεm. Di dizayn de tray bak to di risach ɛn prodakshɔn prɔsis we dɛn bin dɔn pablish we di mɛsenja dɛn we bin dɔn de bifo bin du. Vɛshɔn istri na `CHANGELOG.md` de rikodɔ we ɛni wan pan di pis land ɛn wetin mek i du am.

crypto.title: Kriptografik primitiv dɛn
crypto.subtitle: Ɛvri algɔritm we de na di stak, in purpose, in paramita dɛn, in RFC.
crypto.intro: Vortex de yuz ɔl di primitiv dɛn we dɛn kɔmpin dɛn dɔn rivyu. No kɔstɔm blɔk sayfa, nɔ KDF dɛn we dɛn gro na os, nɔ novel sayn skim dɛn. Dis chapta de dokumɛnt ɛvri primitiv we wi de yuz, di ɛksaktɔ paramita dɛn, ɛn di rizin biɛn ɛni chus.
crypto.h1p1: Curve25519 (RFC 7748) in in Montgomery fɔm, we dɛn yuz fɔ Ɛliptik-kɔv Diffie-Hellman. 32-bayt prayvet ki, 32-bayt pɔblik ki, 32-bayt shered sikrit autput.
crypto.h1p2: Yuz fɔ: statik divays aydentiti, ɛfimɛral sɛshɔn ki, sial push ɛnvilɔp, rum ki wrap, fedareshɔn ɛnvilɔp.
crypto.h1p3: iOS implimɛnt: `Kɔrv25519.KiAgreemɛnt.PrayvetKi` frɔm KriptoKit. Andrɔyd: `x25519-dalek` bay JNI. Node: `kriptografi.hazmat.primitivs.asimɛtrik.x25519` ova OpenSSL.
crypto.h1p4: Ɔl tri intarop bit-fɔ-bit. Raund-trip tested against RFC 7748 Alis/Bob tɛst vektɔ pan ɛvri bild.
crypto.h1p5: Pɔfɔmɛnshɔn: ~100 μs fɔ wan Diffie-Hellman pan 2020 Ayfon, ~30 μs pan 2020 Mak. Wan rawnd rum-ki wrap fɔ 200 mɛmba grup de tek lɛk 10 ms wɔl-klɔk.
crypto.h1p6: Kɔnstant-taym: yes, ɔl tu na di kɔv aritmɛtik ɛn di raw-bayt dikɔdin pat.
crypto.h1p7: Sayd-channel posture: Montgomery ladder na imyun to di klas of timing atak we hit Weierstrass curves; OpenSSL ɛn Swift CryptoKit ɔl tu de yuz am.
crypto.h1p8: Ki serialayzeshɔn: 32-bayt smɔl-endian. Pɔblik ki dɛn kin klem pan import so di input dɛn we nɔ fayn nɔ kin mek lɔw-ɔda-pɔynt lik.
crypto.h1l1: Wetin mek X25519 ɛn nɔto P-256: fast, smɔl, nɔ NIST-kɔv kɔnsyans.
crypto.h1l2: Wetin mek 32-bayt ɔtput ɛn nɔto 64: de mach HKDF-SHA256 input lɔng ɛksaktɔli.
crypto.h1l3: Wetin mek Montgomery ɛn nɔto Edwards: wi jɔs nid DH, nɔto sayn, pan dis ki matirial. Edwards go nid wan kɔnvɛnshɔn stɛp ɛvri tɛm.
crypto.h2p1: EdDSA (RFC 8032) ova ɛdwɔd25519. 32-bayt pɔblik ki, 64-bayt sayn.
crypto.h2p2: Yuz fɔ: node atɛsteshɔn pan fedareshɔn mɛsej, rilis-ki sayn oba di intɛgriti manifɔst, bot diploy sayn, divays lɔng tɛm aydentiti fɔ Dabl Ratchet.
crypto.h2p3: Ditɛminism: di RFC 8032 we wi de yuz de prodyuz di sem sayn tu tɛm fɔ di sem mɛsej + ki. Apple in CryptoKit na iOS 17+ de yuz di RFC 8032bis randomized variant — ɔl tu valid ɛn dɛn ɔl tu de verify wit ɛni kɔmpliant verifya.
crypto.h2p4: Vεrifikεshכn kכst: ~200 μs pan wan mכdan CPU. Batch verify (`batch_verify ([msg, sig, pk] * N)`) na ~ 10× fasta fɔ ɛni sayn.
crypto.h2p5: Fɔmat fɔ sayn: `R || S`, 32 bayt ɛvri wan, smɔl-endian.
crypto.h2l1: Pɔblik ki ripreshɔn: 32-bayt kɔmprɛs pɔynt. Ɔltɛm valid — nɔ "point at infinity" kes nɔ de.
crypto.h2l2: Prayvet ki ripreshɔn: 32-bayt sid. di εkspεnd skel de kכmכt pan di flay via SHA-512.
crypto.h2l3: Wetin mek yu nɔ ECDSA: ECDSA nid ay kwaliti RNG fɔ ɛvri sayn; wan bias RNG de lik di prayvet ki. Ed25519 na deterministic, nɔ RNG nid na sayn tɛm.
crypto.h3p1: AES in Galois/Kɔnta Mɔd (NIST SP 800-38D). 256-bit ki, 96-bit nons, 128-bit ɔthɛntishɔn tag.
crypto.h3p2: Yuz fɔ: di mɛsej sayfatɛks ɛnvilɔp, fayl chunk ɛnvilɔp, ɛnkript bak-ap peylɔd, sial push peylɔd.
crypto.h3p3: Nonce konstrakshɔn: ɛvri mɛsej de jenarayz wan fresh 96-bit random nonce. Di node de trak di las 10^6 nonces pan wan rum ɛn drɔp dupliket difensiv wan — di klaynt nɔ fɔ jenarayz dupliket insay di fɔs ples, bɔt asum-natin nɔ chip.
crypto.h3p4: Wetin mek 96-bit nonces ɛn nɔto 128-bit: 96 bits na di GCM-standad "deterministic" nonces lɔng, ɛn i de gi wi 2^32 random nonces bifo batde kɔlishin bi wan kɔnsyans. Wan singl rum ki de rotate long bifo dat, so i sef.
crypto.h3p5: Tag saiz: ful 128 bits. Wi nɔ de trunket — stɔrɔj ​​sevings nɔ impɔtant ɛn truncation de inkrisayz fɔj prɔbabiliti.
crypto.h3l1: Hadwɔd aksilarayshɔn: AES-NI (x86), ARMv8-A kripto ɛkstenshɔn, dediket kripto blɔk pan Apple Silicon. Enkripshɔn thruput ~3 GB/s.
crypto.h3l2: Na ol ARM divays dɛn we nɔ gɛt kripto ɛkstenshɔn: ~300 MB/s via softwe. Stil fast pas disk IO.
crypto.h3l3: Asosiet data: di freym hεda (`{v, rum_id, sender_pseudo}`) dεn pas am as AAD so wan fכj hεda nכ go vεrifik.
crypto.h4p1: HKDF (RFC 5869) wit SHA-256. Derive multiple 32-bayt sab-ki frɔm wan singl 32-bayt input.
crypto.h4p2: Yuz fɔ: split di X25519 ɔtput insay wan ɛnkripshɔn ki + MAC ki + hεda ki; we dɛn pul di rut ratchet ki frɔm wan Diffie-Hellman rawnd; bildin fɔ ɛni-chunk fayl ki frɔm di fayl rut.
crypto.h4p3: Info string dɛn kin ɔltɛm ditɛminist ASCII: `"v1: ɛnkripshɔn"`, `"v1: mac"`, `"v1:hɛda"`, `"v1: bak-ap"`. Vɛshɔn de mek wi rɔta di ɔl ki hayarki via info-string chenj.
crypto.h4p4: Sɔl na sɔntin we pɔsin kin disayd fɔ du. Insay Vortex wi de yuz di rum id as sɔl fɔ rum-ki derivashɔn so difrɛn rum dɛn nɔ kin aksidɛntli yuz derived ki dɛn bak ivin if di sem X25519 ɔtput apia.
crypto.h4l1: Wetin mek SHA-256 ɛn nɔto SHA-512: ɔl di pletfɔm dɛn gɛt hadwae SHA-256 aksilarayshɔn; SHA-512 de fast smɔl pan 64-bit CPU bɔt nɔto pan fon.
crypto.h4l2: Wetin mek nɔto KMAC-based KDF: KMAC na nich. HKDF de na ɛvri kripto laybri we wi de yuz.
crypto.h5p1: Argon2id (RFC 9106) we de na di wɔl. Paramita: m=64 MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32.
crypto.h5p2: Yuz fɔ: sava-sayd paswɔd hash (`users.password_hash`), lokal-bak-ap rap ki, sid-frɛz impɔtɔt dɛrivashɔn.
crypto.h5p3: Wetin mek dɛn paramita ya: OWASP 2023 rɛkɛmɔndeshɔn. 64 MiB + 3 itɛreshɔn de tek ~0.5 s pan wan Ayfon X — wi sloslo sɔpɔt divays. Wan ASIC atak pɔsin wit 100× di mɛmori bandwidth fɔ wan fon stil nid ~5 ms fɔ ɛni tray. Lɔng paswɔd (ɛntrɔpi > 40 bit) kin bi kɔmpyuta infeasible fɔ krak pan skel.
crypto.h5p4: Stɔrej fɔmat: `argon2:<encoded>` usay dɛn ɛnkɔd na di RFC-fɔmat string we inklud sɔl, mɛmori, itɛreshɔn, ɛn hash.
crypto.h5l1: Wetin mek Argon2id ɛn nɔto Argon2i ɔ Argon2d: 2id na di haybrid — fɔs pas de rɛsist sayd-chanɛl (i-mɔd), sɔbsɛkɛn pas de rɛsist GPU/ASIC (d-mɔd). Signal de yuz di sem tin.
crypto.h5l2: Dummy-hash kɔmpiashɔn: ivin we di yuza nɔ de, wi stil de rɔn wan fek Argon2 verify wit wan kɔnstant hash. Dis de ikwal di tɛm fɔ login so di wan dɛn we de atak nɔ go ebul fɔ kɔnt di yuzɛn nem dɛn bay di tɛm we dɛn de ansa.
crypto.h5l3: Rihash pan login: if sava admin bamp mɛmori kɔst, ol hash dɛn de ri-hash na nɛks saksesful login. Transparent to di pɔsin we de yuz am.
crypto.h6p1: FIPS 203 (NIST, 2024) Di wan dɛn we de stɔdi bɔt di Baybul. ML-KEM-768. 1184-bayt pɔblik ki, 1088-bayt sayfatɛks, 32-bayt shered sikrit.
crypto.h6p2: Yuz fɔ: haybrid post-kwantam sɛshɔn ki dɛn. We ɔl tu di kɔmpin dɛn advatayz Kyber sɔpɔt di sɛshɔn ki na `HKDF(x25519_output || kyber_output)`.
crypto.h6p3: Wetin mek haybrid: ivin if Kyber brok leta (i komparetiv yɔŋ), di X25519 pat stil de protɛkt wi. We yu kam togɛda, i de gi di bɛst-ɔf-ɔl tu.
crypto.h6p4: Wetin mek Kyber ɛn nɔto di ɔda NIST kandidet dɛn: na di wan we dɛn pik fɔ standad. Kod avaylabl na brayt (liboqs, pqcrypto).
crypto.h6l1: Pεrformεns: ki jεnereshכn ~100 μs, εnkapsulεshכn ~30 μs, dεkapsulεshכn ~50 μs. Negligible kɔmpia to rawnd-trip latɛns.
crypto.h6l2: Bandwidth kɔst: 1088 bayt fɔ wan sɛshɔn sayfatɛks, 1184 bayt fɔ di pɔblik ki. Dɛn kin pe di sɛshɔn di fɔs tɛm we dɛn kɔntakt am; afta dat na ziro.
crypto.h6l3: Sava sayd: `pqcrypto` Python pakej wit `kem.ml_kem_768`. Klaynt sayd: liboqs via pletfɔm bindings.
crypto.h7p1: Signal in Dabl Ratchet (as dɛn spɛsifa am na di 2016 pɔblik spɛshal). Kɔmbayn wan Diffie-Hellman ratchet wit wan simɛtrik-ki chen.
crypto.h7p2: Dɛn kin yuz am fɔ: dairekt mɛsej bitwin tu divays dɛn. Grup rum dɛn de yuz wan simpul "sɛnda ki" skim we dɛn ki ɔf di rum rut.
crypto.h7p3: Prɔpati dɛn: fɔwad sikrit (we yu kɔmprɔmis divays, i de jɔs ɛksplɔz mɛsej dɛn we i dɔn ɔlrɛdi gɛt, nɔto di wan dɛn we go kam), post-kɔmprɔmis sikyɔriti (ri-ratcheting heals afta wan ki kɔmprɔmis), ɔt-ɔf-ɔda delivri (te to 1000 mɛsej dɛn fɔ skip).
crypto.h7l1: Chen lεngth kap: 1000 mεsej pan wan chen bifo fכs ri-ratchet. Limit damej frɔm chen ki we dɛn tif.
crypto.h7l2: Skipped-key cache: i kin rich 1000 aut-ɔda ki dɛn we dɛn kin kip na mɛmori fɔ ɛni chen. Bifo dat, dɛn nɔ gri wit di mɛsej as stale.
crypto.h7l3: Hɛda ɛnkripshɔn: on bay difɔlt. Di hεda de kכri ratchet mεtadata εn i εnkript wit wan dεdiket hεda ki we kכmכt frכm di rut via HKDF.
crypto.h8p1: Nɔn-kriptografik fayl aydentiti ɛn intɛgriti de yuz BLAKE3 bikɔs i 10× fast pas SHA-256 pan big blob.
crypto.h8p2: Yuz fɔ: fayl `sha256` kɔlɔm na di DB (istri nem; rili BLAKE3 ɔnda di hud sins v0.1.2), atɛshmɛnt dɛdup, fayl-ɔplɔd intɛgriti chɛk.
crypto.h8p3: Sekyuriti posishɔn: BLAKE3 na kriptografik wan strɔng (256-bit); wi kɔl di kɔlɔm `sha256` fɔ maykreshɔn kɔmpatibiliti nɔmɔ.
crypto.h9p1: Ɔl di nonces, prekeys, chalenj valyu dɛn de jenarayz via di OS RNG: `SecRandom` na iOS, `java.security.SecureRandom` na Andrɔyd, `secrets.token_bytes` na Python (we dɛn de rap `/dev/urandom` ɔ ikwal).
crypto.h9p2: Nɔ ɛva `random.random()`, nɔ ɛva `Math.random()`, nɔ ɛva `rand()`. Lint rul dɛn ban dɛn yus na di kripto modul dɛn.
crypto.h10: Opareshɔn dɛn we dɛn kin du ɔltɛm
crypto.h10p1: HMAC kɔmpiashɔn, sayn verifyeshɔn, paswɔd hash verifyeshɔn — ɔl de yuz kɔnstant-taym primitiv fɔ mek dɛn nɔ taym sayd-chanɛl.
crypto.h1_a: X25519 na ɛliptik-kɔv Difi-Hɛlman oba Kɔv25519 insay in Mɔntgɔmɛri fɔm. 32-bayt ki, 32-bayt shered sikrit. Ɛvri prayvet ki / statik divays aydentiti / sɛshɔn ki insay Vortex de yuz am.
crypto.h1_b: Alis ɛn Bɔb ɛvri wan gɛt prayvet ki a, b ɛn pɔblik ki A = a·G, B = b·G usay G na di kɔv bays pɔynt. Dɛn kɔmpyutayt s = a·B = b·A. Dis shered 32-bayt sikrit de go insay HKDF-SHA256 fɔ gɛt simɛtrik AES-GCM ki dɛn. Di kɔv aritmɛtik de du insay kɔnstant tɛm yuz di Montgomery lada; no branch nɔ de pan sikrit data.
crypto.h1_c: Curve25519 na Daniel J. Bernstein bin pablish am insay 2005 ɛn na di IETF bin pik am insay RFC 7748 (2016). Na Signal, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard bin adopt am. Vortex de yuz am bikɔs i fast pas P-256, i gɛt tayt 32-bayt ki saiz, i de avɔyd NIST kɔv kɔnsyans, ɛn ɛvri pletfɔm de ship wan had implimɛnt.
crypto.h1_f:
Prayvet ki: a ∈ [0, 2255) (32 bayt smɔl-ɛndian)
Pɔblik ki: A = a · G (32-bayt kɔmprɛs pɔynt) .
Sikrit we dɛn sheb: s = a · B = b · A (32 bayt, →HKDF input)
crypto.h2_a: Ed25519 na di sayn brɔda ɛn sista fɔ X25519, we de yuz di sem kɔv insay in twist-Edwards fɔm. 32-bayt pɔblik ki, 64-bayt sayn, ditɛministic bay difɔlt.
crypto.h2_b: Fɔ sayn mɛsej m wit prayvet ki d: kɔmpyutayt r = SHA-512(d, m), R = r·G, c = SHA-512(R, A, m), S = r + c·a. Sayn na (R, S). Vɛrifikɛshɔn: chɛk R + c·A = S·G. Ditarministik sayn de avɔyd nɔs-riyuz risk kɔmplit wan — tu sayn dɛn fɔ di sem mɛsej wit di sem ki na bit-idɛntik.
crypto.h2_c: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) bin kɔmɔt na Bernstein in 2011 pepa wit Duif, Lange, Schwabe, ɛn Yang. Widly adopted afta 2013. Apple in KriptoKit, Google in Tink, libsodium, OpenSSH ɔl de yuz am. Vortex de sayn ɛvri fedareshɔn ɛnvilɔp ɛn ɛvri node atɛst wit Ed25519.
crypto.h2_f:
Sayn(d, m): r = SHA-512(d∥m);  R = r·G we yu de yuz
              c = SHA-512 (R∥A∥m);  S = r + c·a
              ritɔn (R, S) .

Verifay: c = SHA-512(R∥A∥m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G
crypto.h3_a: AES na Galois/Kɔnta Mɔd. 256-bit ki, 96-bit random nonce, 128-bit ɔthɛntishɔn tag. Ɛvri ɛnkript blob na Vortex de yuz GCM.
crypto.h3_b: GCM de rɔn AES insay CTR mod ɛn kɔmpyutayt wan GHASH oba di sayfatɛks + AAD yuz difrɛn ki we kɔmɔt frɔm di ɛnkripshɔn ki. Tag = GHASH(AAD, sayfatɛks) ⊕ AES-CTR(0). Dikripshɔn de ri-kɔmpyut GHASH ɛn kɔmpia — ɛni singl bit-flip de fel fɔ verify. Hadwɔd-aksɛleret pan ɛvri mɔdan CPU via AES-NI ɔ ARMv8-A kripto ɛkstenshɔn.
crypto.h3_c: AES win di NIST AES kɔmpitishɔn insay 2001. GCM bin standad insay NIST SP 800-38D insay 2007 ɛn na di difɔlt AEAD insay TLS 1.3. Vortex pik 256-bit ki ivin if 128-bit go inof agens klasical advasari — di jomp to 256-bit gi wi roughly 128 bits of post-kwantam sikyɔriti ɔnda Grover in algɔritm.
crypto.h3_f:
Enkript(k, n, aad, pt): ct = AES-CTR(k, n, pt)
                          tag = GHASH_h(aad∥ct∥lɛns) ⊕ AES(k, n∥1)
                          ritɔn ct∥tag
Nonce riyuz ⇒ kɔnfidɛnsi + ɔthɛntiti brok.
crypto.h4_a: HKDF (HMAC-based KDF, RFC 5869) de tɔn wan ki to bɔku. Tek wan ay-ɛntrɔpi input ɛn wan kɔntɛks lɛbl; i de pul 32 bayt pan ɛni lɛbl.
crypto.h4_b: Tu-step: Ɛkstrakt ɛn Ɛkspɛn. Ekstrakt = HMAC-SHA256(sɔlt, IKM) → PRK. Ekspand = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, info∥kɔnta) kɔnkaten fɔ len bayt. Wi de yuz dis fɔ split wan X25519 ɔtput insay wan ɛnkripshɔn ki, wan MAC ki, ɛn wan hεda ki wit info string "v1:enkripshɔn", "v1:mac", "v1:hɛda".
crypto.h4_c: HKDF na Hugo Krawczyk bin pablish am na EUROCRYPT 2010 ɛn standad am as RFC 5869 insay 2010. Na TLS 1.3 bin yuz am fɔ in schedule, bay Signal fɔ Double Ratchet, bay WireGuard fɔ sɛshɔn ki. Di vɛshɔn insay info string dɛn de mek wi rɔta di ɔl ki hayarki bay we wi bamp "v1" → "v2".
crypto.h4_f:
PRK = HMAC-SHA256(sɔl, IKM) .
T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ info ∥ i) .
OKM = T(1) ∥ T(2) ∥ ... trunk to len bayt
crypto.h5_a: Argon2id na mɛmori-had paswɔd hash we dɛn mek fɔ tinap agens GPU ɛn ASIC atak pipul dɛn. Paramita m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32.
crypto.h5_b: Argon2id miks Argon2i (resist sayd-chanɛl bay we i nɔ branch pan paswɔd-dɛrɛv data) wit Argon2d (ful mɛmori we nɔ prɛdiktibɛl so paralel hadwae nɔ kin kɔt kɔna). Fɔs haf-pas na data-indipɛndɛnt (i-mɔd); di rεmεndant na di data-dipεndεnt (d-mכd). 0.5 sɛkɔn fɔ kɔmpyutayt pan wan Ayfon X na wi paramita, roughly 5 ms pan wan ASIC — di ~100× spid-ap na smɔl tin we yu kɔmpia am wit SHA-256-bɛs hash usay ASIC dɛn win bay 1 000 000×.
crypto.h5_c: Argon2 win di 2015 Paswɔd Hashing Kɔmpitishɔn we Dmitry Khovratovich ɛn Alex Biryukov ɔganayz. Standardized as RFC 9106 in 2021. Na 1Paswɔd, Bitwarden, LastPass yuz am. Vortex in paramita dɛn kɔmɔt frɔm OWASP 2023 rɛkɛmɔndeshɔn dɛn, we dɛn dɔn tun dɔŋ fɔ mek login pan wi sloslo sɔpɔt divays (iPhone X) ɔnda 1 sɛkɔn.
crypto.h5_f:
kost(m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) ≈ 0.5 s pan Ayfon X
di kɔst fɔ atak: m × t × (p / atak_paralelism)
Na 1010 gɛs/s wit 40-bit paswɔd ɛntrɔpi:
  1012 sɛkɔn = 32 000 ia
crypto.h6_a: Kyber-768 (ML-KEM-768) na di NIST-standardized post-kwantam ki enkapsuleshɔn mɛkanism. Gi kwantum-sef seshɔn ki dɛn we dɛn jɔyn wit X25519.
crypto.h6_b: Alis de jenarayz (pk, sk). Bob kɔl Ɛnkapsul(pk) → (c, ss); sɛn c to Alis. Alis kɔl Dikapsul(sk, c) → ss. Tu sayd naw de sheb ss, we na 32-bayt sikrit. Sekyuriti de ridyus to di Module-LWE prɔblɛm, we dɛn biliv se na kwantum-had. Wi kin kɔba am wit X25519: sɛshɔn_ki = HKDF(x25519_ɔtput ∥ kyber_ɔtput). If ɛni wan pan di af dɛn nɔ day, di sɛshɔn kin sev.
crypto.h6_c: Kyber na NIST bin pik am insay Julay 2022 afta 6 ia kɔmpitishɔn. Standardized as FIPS 203 in August 2024. Vortex ship Kyber as opshɔnal bikɔs i ad ~2 KB pan ɛni sɛshɔn hanshɛk; ɛnabul bay difɔlt fɔ pe tay, opt-in ɔdasay. Di haybrid aprɔch na in Signal bin rɛkɔmɛnd insay 2023 ɛn Chrome bin adopt am insay 2024.
crypto.h6_f:
KeyGen(): (pk ∈ Zq^k, sk ∈ Zq^k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B
Enkaps(pk): (ct ∈ Zq^k, ss ∈ {0,1}256) ct = 1088 B
Dikaps(sk,ct): ss ∈ {0,1}256
haybrid seshɔn = HKDF(x25519_ɔt ∥ kyber_ɔut, info="sɛshɔn-v1")
crypto.h7_a: Signal in Double Ratchet de gi fɔwad sikrit ɛn post-kɔmprɔmis sikyɔriti fɔ 1: 1 chat.
crypto.h7_b: Tu chen dɛn: wan chen we de sɛn ɛn wan chen we de tek. εvri mεsej de advans in chen via HKDF. εvri so tεm wan Diffie-Hellman ratchet de advans di rut, ri-key di tu chen dεm. If yu kɔmprɔmis chen ki, i de mek yu no di mɛsej dɛn nɔmɔ we i ɛnkript dairekt wan. Afta DH ratchet, fiuja mɛsej dɛn sef ivin if pɔsin we atak pɔsin tif chen ki.
crypto.h7_c: Na Trevor Perrin ɛn Moxie Marlinspike bin disayn am insay 2013, dɛn diploy am na Signal 2014, we WhatsApp (2016), Facebook Mɛsenja Sikrit Kɔnvɔshɔn, Skype Prayvet Kɔnvɔshɔn dɛn adopt am. Pɔblik spɛshal insay 2016. Vortex in implimɛnt na dairekt pɔt; interop wit ɔda Signal-protocol klaynt dɛn de na di v0.4 rodmap.
crypto.h7_f:
sɛn: CK = HKDF(CK, "stɛp");  MK = HKDF(CK, "msg")
risiv: CK' = HKDF(CK', "stɛp"); MK' = HKDF(CK', "msg")
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(wi_ɛf, dɛn_ɛf), RK_prev)
crypto.h8_a: BLAKE3 hashing fɔ fayl dɛn — pat pan di kripto chapta. dis na wan pan di kכr mεkanism dεm we dεn rεfrεns tru di Vortex rεfrεns. Rid di chapta we de rawnd am fɔ no mɔ bɔt di tin dɛn we de apin; dis pat de zoom in pan di spεsifi k bihayvya.
crypto.h8_b: Implimɛnt ɔvaviu fɔ "BLAKE3 hashing fɔ fayl dɛn". Di mɛkanism de implimɛnt insay di kɔrɛspɔndɛns mɔdyul ɔnda `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, ɔ `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Di modul README de kɔl ɔut ɛksaktɔ fayl pat dɛn.
crypto.h8_c: Di "BLAKE3 hashing for files" mεkanism evolv across Vortex rilis dεm. Di dizayn de tray bak to di risach ɛn prodakshɔn prɔsis we dɛn bin dɔn pablish we di mɛsenja dɛn we bin dɔn de bifo bin du. Vɛshɔn istri na `CHANGELOG.md` de rikodɔ we ɛni wan pan di pis land ɛn wetin mek i du am.
