cryptoWire.title: Kripto waya fɔmat dɛn
cryptoWire.subtitle: Eksakt bayt layout fɔ ɛvri ɛnkript blob.
cryptoWire.intro: Dis chapta de spɛl di bayt dɛn we de na di waya. Ɛnibɔdi we de impruv ɔda klaynt ɔ fɔrɛns tul kin rid wit am.
cryptoWire.h1p1: Strukchɔ: `{v: 1, nonce:<12-bayt heks>, sayfatɛks:<vɛriɔbul heks>, sɛnda_pseudo:<32-hɛks>, sɛn_at:<unix_ms>}`. Dɛn sɛn am ova HTTPS (POST) ɛn WebSocket (frɛm tayp `m`).
cryptoWire.h1p2: `ciphertext` kɔntinyu afta AES-GCM dikripshɔn: CBOR `{v:1, tɛks?:<string>, atɛshmɛnt?:[<fayl_id>, ...], riply_to?:<msg_id>, ɛdit?:[<prior_text>, ...], menshɔn?:[<yuz_id>, ...]}`.
cryptoWire.h1p3: Tag de tray: `ciphertext` bayt string na (ɛnkript peylɔd || 16-bayt tag). Klaynt split pan lɔng.
cryptoWire.h1p4: AAD: di lכw-kεs hεks rum id de pas as asosiet data. We yu tay di rum id, dat de mek yu nɔ ebul fɔ ple bak di rum we yu de krɔs.
cryptoWire.h2p1: Fayl rut ki na random 32 bayt. Per-chunk ki: `HKDF(rut, info: "fayl:chunk:" + <ɔfset>, len: 32)`.
cryptoWire.h2p2: Chunk sayfatɛks: AES-GCM wit ɛni-chunk ki, random 96-bit nons, AAD: `<fayl_id> || <ɔfset>`. Maks chunk saiz 512 KiB.
cryptoWire.h2p3: Whole-file integrity: di klaynt de kɔmpyutayt BLAKE3 ova pleinttext ɛn sɛn as `plain_blake3` to di pɔsin we de gɛt am tru di rum mɛsej. Di pɔsin we gɛt di kɔmpyuta kin kɔmpyutayt bak afta i dɔn dawnlod ɛn chɛk am.
cryptoWire.h3: Envilɔp we dɛn dɔn sial fɔ push
cryptoWire.h3p1: Klaynt de ɔplod `p256dh_pub` (32-bayt X25519) to di node.
cryptoWire.h3p2: We wan push de du, node de jenarayz wan ephemeral X25519 ki, du DH wit `p256dh_pub`, derive wan AES-GCM ki via HKDF.
cryptoWire.h3p3: Sial blob: `{ɛndpɔynt, p256dh: klaynt in pɔb, ɔth: 16 bayt, data: sayfatɛks||tɛg}`. APNs/FCM si onli `data`.
cryptoWire.h3p4: Klaynt dekript pan risiv yuz in prayvet ki ɛn di `p256dh` (we na rili di node in ɛfimɛral pɔb na di ɛnvilɔp).
cryptoWire.h4: Backup blob we yu kin yuz
cryptoWire.h4p1: Paswɔd deriv bak-ap ki via Argon2id (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, sɔl=<random 16B>, hashLen=32).
cryptoWire.h4p2: Blob: `{sɔlt, nonce, sayfatɛks}`. Sayfatɛks na CBOR fɔ `{v:1, rum dɛn:[{id,key,ct_refs}...], prɔfayl:{...}, kɔntakt dɛn:[...]}`.
cryptoWire.h4p3: Stored either lokal (iCloud / Google Drive) ɔ pan wan node na di yuza in prayvet rum.
cryptoWire.h5p1: Krɔs-nod mɛsej: `{sɔs_node: <pubkey>, target_yuz: <id>, insay: {... di sem lɛk rum ɛnvilɔp ...}, sig: <64-bayt Ed25519>}`.
cryptoWire.h5p2: `sig` kɔba di CBOR-sirilayz `{sɔs_nɔd, target_yuz, insay}`. Target de verify agens `source_node` pubkey frɔm `trusted_nodes`.
cryptoWire.h1_a: Wan singl rum mɛsej na di waya na CBOR dikt wit ɛnkript peylɔd, nonce, pɔsin we sɛn am in lay lay nem, ɛn tɛmstamp. Di ɛnvilɔp na di sem if i de rayd HTTPS (POST) ɔ WebSocket (frɛm tayp `m`).
cryptoWire.h1_b: Klaynt de siriɔs di mɛsej bɔdi `{v:1, tɛks, riply_to, sɛn_at}` as CBOR → `pt`. Jenarayz wan random 12-bayt nons. Kompyut `aad = heks (rum_id)`. Kɔl `ct = AES-GCM-256-Ɛnkript(rum_ki, nonce, pt, aad)`. Rap insay `{v: 1, sayfatɛks: heks(ct), nonce: heks(nɔns), sɛnda_pseudo: heks(pseudo), sɛn_at: unix_ms}` ɛn sɛn. Risiva de verify GCM tag we i de dikript, dɔn CBOR-pars di pleinttext.
cryptoWire.h1_c: Di waya shep na vɛshɔn-tɛg sins v0.0.4 afta wan abortiv v0.0.3 rilis we nɔ bin gɛt `v` fil — wi bin gɛt fɔ bamp di ɔl fɔmat we wi ad `thread_id` bikɔs ol klaynt dɛn krash pan di ki we wi nɔ no. Lɛsin we wi lan: ɛvri fiuja waya shep de kɛr `v:N` na in fɔs fil so fɔwad kɔmpitibliti de klia.
cryptoWire.h2_a: Dɛn split fayl dɛn to fiks-sayz chunks, ɛni wan gɛt in yon ki we kɔmɔt frɔm di fayl rut ɛn di chunk ɔfset. Per-chunk enkripshɔn de mek di pɔsin we sɛn am stɔp/rizum pan ɛni chunk bɔda.
cryptoWire.h2_b: Fayl rut ki na random 32 bayt. Per-chunk ki na `HKDF(rut, info="fayl:chunk:" + str(ɔfset), len=32)`. Ɛni chunk na AES-GCM ɛnkript wit in yon ki, random 96-bit nonce, ɛn `aad = file_id ∥ ɔfset`. Chunks difɔlt to 512 KiB; 4 MiB kap. Ful-fayl BLAKE3 de sɛn as `plain_blake3` na di rum mɛsej we de rɛfrɛns di fayl so di wan dɛn we de gɛt am go ebul fɔ chɛk afta dɛn dɔn dikript.
cryptoWire.h2_c: Chunked E2E enkripshɔn wit per-chunk ki na Mega.nz bin payɔnia am insay 2013 ɛn na Signal in big-fayl sɔpɔt bin rifin am insay 2019. Vortex in 512 KiB difɔlt na di sayz we TCP flɔ kɔntrol de kip di paip ful witout lɔng tel na mobayl 4G. Wi bin test 256/512/1024/4096 KiB ɛn 512 na bin di swit ples na wi mɛzhɔmɛnt.
cryptoWire.h3_a: Sial push ɛnvilɔp de ayd notis peylɔd frɔm Apple / Google / Mozilla bay we i de ɛnkript wit wan divays-spɛsifi k X25519 ki.
cryptoWire.h3_b: Klaynt de rɛjista `p256dh_pub` ɛn `auth` na di node. We wan push de du, node de ron ephemeral-ECDH wit p256dh_pub, derive key + nonce via HKDF wit di auth sikrit as salt. Enkript `{taytul, bɔdi, rum_id, mɛsej_id}` wit AES-GCM. Send di rεkɔd as di opaque `data` fil to di push prɔvayda. Divays ɛkstenshɔn de ri-drayv, dikript, rɛnd.
cryptoWire.h3_c: Sial push na di Wɛb Push Mɛsej Ɛnkripshɔn spɛshal (RFC 8291, 2017). Apple adopt am insay iOS 16 in Notis Savis Ɛkstenshɔn dɛn. Bifo sial push bi big sopot, Signal and WhatsApp send silent "something arrived" pings witout konten and mek di ap fetch di mesej on wek-ap — we bi slo. Sial push de gi wi ɛnd-to-ɛnd prayvet pat plus instant rɛnd.
cryptoWire.h4_a: Enkript bak-ap blob de mek yuzman ristɔr rum ki + profayl + las 90 dez pan nyu divays frɔm paswɔd nɔmɔ.
cryptoWire.h4_b: Bak-ap ki deriv frɔm di paswɔd via Argon2id wit wan random 16-bayt sɔl. Peylɔd na CBOR: `{v:1, rum dɛn: [{id, ki, msg_ref_ids}], prɔfayl, kɔntakt dɛn}`. Enkript wit AES-GCM ɔnda di ki we dɛn pul. Stored either lokal (iCloud / Google Drive) ɔ as fayl na di yuza in prayvet klawd rum. Ristɔr: ɛnta paswɔd → Argon2id → dikript → riimpɔt ki ɛn rɛfrɛns dɛn.
cryptoWire.h4_c: Di fɔmat na mɔdel pan 1Password in OPVault (2013) ɛn Bitwarden in ɛnkript ɛkspɔt (2017). Dɛn tu de yuz KDF-dɛn-AEAD wit sɔl-bɔnd mɛtadata. Vortex ad di 90-de trim bikɔs ful istri bak-ap dɛn bin 100 MB+ insay tɛst; di big big pat pan di ristɔ dɛn jɔs nid mɛsej dɛn we dɛn jɔs dɔn mek, ɛn ol kɔntinyu stil de we pɔsin kin ebul fɔ rich tru di sava sayfa tɛks we di pɔsin we de yuz am gɛt kɔnɛktiviti.
cryptoWire.h5_a: Krɔs-nɔd fedareshɔn mɛsej de rap di insay ɛnvilɔp we dɛn dɔn ɔlrɛdi ɛnkript insay wan sayn ɔda ɛnvilɔp we de ɔtɛnɛtik di sɔs node.
cryptoWire.h5_b: Node A de sirializ `{sɔs_node, target_yuz, insay_kt, insay_nɔns, sɛn_at}` as CBOR. Sayn wit in Ed25519 prayvet rilis ki → `sig`. POSTs `{envlop, sig}` to node B in `/federeshɔn/deliver`. B de verify `sig` agens di pubkey fɔ `source_node` insay `federations`, chɛk tɛmstamp insay 5 minit skew winda, dɔn i rayt di insay sayfatɛks to in yon `messages` tebul fɔ di target yuza.
cryptoWire.h5_c: Sayn ɔta ɛnvilɔp dɛn we dɛn lɛnt frɔm Matrix in fedareshɔn spɛshal (2015) ɛn ActivityPub in HTTP Sayn (2018). Di 5 minit winda de mach SMTP in RFC 5321 rɛkɛmɔndeshɔn ɛn i de mek dɛn nɔ riplay atak usay pɔsin we atak de kech wan fedareshɔn POST ɛn ple am bak sɔm awa afta dat. Vortex pik Ed25519 ova RSA-PSS bikɔs Ed25519 sayn dɛn na 64 bayt vs RSA-PSS-2048 in 256 bayt — i impɔtant we fedareshɔn de chat.
cryptoWire.h2_f:
fayl_rut = rand (32) .
chunk_key(o) = HKDF(fayl_rut, "fayl:chunk:" + o, 32)
chunk_ct(o) = AES-GCM(chunk_key(o), rand(12), pleintɛks, aad=fayl_id ∥ o)
ful_hash = BLAKE3(plɛnteks_bayt_ɔf_ful_fayl) // sɛn as plein_blake3
cryptoWire.h3_f:
ephemeral = (priv, pɔb);  ikm = ECDH(ephemeral.priv, p256dh_pub) Di wan dɛn we de stɔdi di Baybul.
prk = HMAC-SHA256(ɔt, ikm) ɛn di ɔda wan dɛn.
key = HKDF-Expand(prk, "Kɔntinɛnt-Ɛnkɔdin: aes128gcm\0", 16)
nonce = HKDF-Expand(prk, "Kɔntinyu-Ɛnkɔdin: nonce\0", 12)
ct = AES-GCM(ki, nonce, CBOR{taytul, bɔdi, rum_id, mɛsej_id})
waya = sɔl(16) ∥ rs(4) ∥ idlɛn(1) ∥ ɛfimɛral.pub(32) ∥ ct
cryptoWire.h4_f:
sɔl = rand(16) .
ki = Argon2id (paswɔd, sɔl, m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4, len = 32)
nonce = rand(12) ɛn di ɔda wan dɛn.
ct = AES-GCM(ki, nonce, CBOR{rum, profayl, kɔntakt}, aad="vortex-bak-ap-v1")
fayl = {v: 1, sɔl, nɔs, ct}

auth.title: Ɔthɛntishɔn
auth.subtitle: Rɛjista, login, rifresh, rivok. JWT + X25519 + opshɔnal paski / sid / 2FA.
auth.intro: Vortex de gi JWT dɛn we nɔ de te (15 min akses, 30 dez rifresh) wit di yuza in X25519 pɔblik ki we dɛn dɔn baynd in. Ɛvri sɛnsitiv ɛndpɔynt chɛk JWT + de chɛk fɔ si if dɛn nɔ pul di ki. Dis chapta de tɔk bɔt ɛvri flɔ ɛnd-to-ɛnd.
auth.h1p1: Di klaynt bigin bay we i de jenarayz wan fresh 32-bayt X25519 prayvet ki wit di OS RNG. I derive di pablik ki, encode as 64 hex chars.
auth.h1p2: Di klaynt de post `POST /api/ɔtɛnɛshɔn/rɛjista` wit `{yuz nem, paswɔd, x25519_pɔblik_ki, displei_nem, fon, imel, avatar_emoji, kayba_pɔblik_ki?}`.
auth.h1p3: Node validet: yuzɛn nem de mach `^[a-z0-9_]{3,30}$` (lɔwa-kɛs fɔ avɔyd ɔmograf skwatin); paswɔd pas zxcvbn-stayl trɛnk (min skɔ 2); fon mach E.164 if dɛn gi am; imel mach RFC 5322 besik regex if dɛn gi am.
auth.h1p4: Node de chɛk `x25519_public_key` yuniknɛs — ɛni pɔbki kin rɛjista ɛksaktɔli wan akɔn. Dis de stɔp bɔku bɔku rɛjista atak dɛn we de yuz di sem pɔbki bak.
auth.h1p5: Node de ron Argon2id pan di paswɔd (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) ɛn i de kip `argon2:$...$` insay `users.password_hash`.
auth.h1p6: Node mint tu JWT: akses (15 min, `jti:<divays_id>`) ɛn rifresh (30 d). Klɛm: `{sab: yuz_id, jti: divays_id, tayp: akses|rifresh, ɛksp: ...}`. Sayn HS256 ova wan 64-bayt sava sikrit we dɛn lod frɔm `.env`.
auth.h1p7: Node de mek wan `yuz_divays` row: `{yuz_id, divays_id, yuz_ejɛnt, kriyayt_na}`. Ɛni rifresh tay to in divays_id; we yu pul wan divays, na da strim de nɔmɔ de kil.
auth.h1p8: Rispɔns: `{ok, yuz_id, yuzɛn nem, akses_token, rifresh_token, x25519_pɔblik_ki, kayba_pɔblik_ki, displei_nem, avatar_url, fon, imel}`.
auth.h1p9: Klaynt de kip token dɛn na Kichen (iOS) / EncryptedSharedPreferences (Android) / HttpOnly SameSite=Strict kuki dɛn (wɛb).
auth.h1l1: Rayt limit: 5 rɛjista fɔ 60 sɛkɔn fɔ IP. TESTING=tru de disable dis.
auth.h1l2: Invayt mod: if `REGISTRATION_MODE=invite`, di bɔdi fɔ inklud wan valid `invite_code`. Kod dɛn de jenarayz via di admin API.
auth.h1l3: Klos mod: `REGISTRATION_MODE=klos`. Na di sid admin nɔmɔ kin rɛjista. Di wan dɛn we de yuz am afta dat kin kam tru invayt link dɛn fɔ go insay patikyula rum dɛn.
auth.h2p1: Klaynt de post `POST /api/ɔtɛnɛshɔn/lɔgin` wit `{yuz nem, paswɔd}`.
auth.h2p2: Node de aks `yuz` bay smɔl smɔl yuzɛn nem. If dɛn nɔ fɛn am, i stil de rɔn wan dɔmi Argon2 verify agens wan kɔnstant hash fɔ ikwal di tɛm (~0.5 s ɛni we).
auth.h2p3: If Argon2 verify sakses ɛn di akɔn nɔ disable, node de ritɔn di sem ɛnvilɔp we rɛjista de. Wan nyu `user_devices` row de kriet; di row dɛn we dɔn de, dɛn kin lɛf dɛn wan so dat di pɔsin we de yuz am kin sayn insay bɔku divays dɛn.
auth.h2p4: If verify nɔ wok, node de ritɔn 401 wit `{error:"invalid credentials"}`. Nɔ difrɛns bitwin "rɔng yuzɛn nem" ɛn "rɔng paswɔd" na di ansa.
auth.h2l1: Rεt limit: 10 fεil atεmpt pan 60 sεkכnd pan IP. If yu pas, i de ritɔn 429 wit wan `Rɛtray-Afta` hεda.
auth.h2l2: Akɔn lɔk ɔut: 20 fayl atɛmpt insay 24 h flag di akɔn fɔ admin rivyu. Legit yuza dɛn jɔs paswɔd-riset dɛn we fɔ go insay.
auth.h2l3: Seshɔn trakin: `/api/authentication/devices` de list ɔl di aktiv sɛshɔn dɛn; yuza kin rivok ɛni wan.
auth.h3p1: We di akses token de nia fɔ dɔn (klaynt de trak `exp` lokal wan) ɔ we wan riŋwe de ritɔn 401 wit `token expired`, di klaynt de post `POST /api/authentication/refresh` wit `{refresh_token}`.
auth.h3p2: Node dekod di rifresh, chɛk di `jti` stil de na `user_devices` (nɔ rivok), chɛk `exp`, ɛn mint wan fresh akses token.
auth.h3p3: Rifresh roteshɔn de ɔf bay difɔlt. Enable wit `ROTATE_REFRESH=true` fɔ gi fresh rifresh bak.
auth.h3p4: If di rifresh dɔn pas, rivok, ɔ fɔj, node de ritɔn 401. Klaynt de log aut lokal ɛn aks fɔ ri-login.
auth.h4p1: Wɛb klaynt dɛn kin rɛjista wan pletfɔm ɔthɛntiket (Tɔch ID, Fes ID, Windows Hello, Andrɔyd bayometrik). Sava de kip `{kredibiliti_id, pɔblik_ki, kɔnta}`.
auth.h4p2: Login: `POST /api/ɔtɛnɛshɔn/paski/bigin` → sava de ritɔn chalenj; klaynt sayn wit di paski prayvet (we dɛn ol na Sikyu Ɛnklav / TPM); `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → sava de verify ɛn isyu JWT.
auth.h4p3: Kaunta monotonicity chɛk: ɛvri verifyeshɔn fɔ inkrimɛnt di kɔnta. If i nɔ du dat, dɛn kin trit di paski lɛk se dɛn dɔn klon am ɛn dɛn nɔ gri fɔ tek am.
auth.h5p1: As disasta-rikavari path, di yuza kin ɛkspɔt 24-wɔd BIP-39 sid. Impɔt am pan ɛni divays de rikostrɔk di X25519 aydentiti (sid → HKDF → statik ki) ɛn pruv posɛshɔn via wan sayn chalenj.
auth.h5p2: Sid nɔ de ɛva kɔmɔt na di divays. Di node de onli si di derived X25519 pablik ki en wan signature ova wan server chalenj.
auth.h5p3: Ɛntropi: 256 bit (32 bayt). BIP-39 checksum na standad, so dɛn kin kech tayp bifo dɛn rich na di sava.
auth.h6p1: TOTP (RFC 6238) wit 30-s stɛp ɛn 6-dijit kɔd. Opshɔnal fɔ ɛni pɔsin we de yuz am.
auth.h6p2: Inrɔlmɛnt: `POST /api/ɔtɛnɛshɔn/2fa/sɛtup` de ritɔn wan sikrit + otpauth URI + QR. Yuzman de skan wit Google Ɔthɛntikɛta / Ɔti / 1Paswɔd. Yuza post bak wan sampul 6-dijit kod fɔ pruv se di ap de wok.
auth.h6p3: Login wit 2FA: afta paswɔd pas, node de ritɔn `{needs_2fa: true}`. Klaynt de aks fɔ wan kɔd ɛn post to `/api/authentication/login/2fa`.
auth.h6p4: Rεt limit: 5 TOTP tray pan 5 min pan wan yuza. If yu pas dat, i kin mek yu koldɔwn fɔ 60 sɛkɔn ɛn i kin mek yu wɔn yu bay imel.
auth.h6p5: Bak-ap kɔd dɛn: 12 × 10-dijit kɔd dɛn we dɛn kin sho wan tɛm we dɛn inrɔl. Yu kin yuz ɛni kɔd jɔs wan tɛm.
auth.h7p1: Wan fon we yu dɔn log in kin onbɔd nyu tablɛt wit QR kɔd. Divays A de post `POST /api/authentication/qr/begin` → sava de ritɔn wan nonce ɛn TTL.
auth.h7p2: Divays A de sho di QR we gɛt `nonce + yuza_id + sava_url`. Divays B de skan ɛn post `POST /api/ɔtɛnɛshɔn/qr/vɛrifay` wit di nonce.
auth.h7p3: Sava verify nonce stil layv (TTL 60 s, wan-shot), tay divays B in fresh X25519 pabkey to yuza A in akaunt (nyu `user_devices` row), ɛn ritɔn JWT to divays B.
auth.h7p4: Divays A de gɛt WebSocket notis `{type:"n", event:"new_device"}` so di yuza kin kɔnfɔm / rivok insay rial tɛm.
auth.h8p1: Wi kin mek di sem mistek bak fɔ "unknown username" ɛn "wrong password" bay wilful. Sayn ap ret limit de ayd us yuzɛn nem dɛn de.
auth.h8p2: Profayl ɛndpɔynt dɛn (`/api/users/{username}`) nid fɔ gɛt ɔth. Atak pɔsin nɔ kin ebul fɔ kɔnt yuz nem dɛn if i nɔ gɛt valid token.
auth.h8p3: Rate limit pan `/api/authentication/login` de kip brut fos to wan krawl.
auth.h1_a: Rejista de mek nyu aydentiti: X25519 kipa na di divays, Argon2id paswɔd hash na di sava, JWT pe we dɛn gi pan sakrifays.
auth.h1_b: Step 1: klaynt de rɔn `crypto.randomBytes(32)` fɔ di X25519 prayvet ki, deriv di pɔblik ki (~100 μs pan fon). Step 2: POST /api/ɔtɛnɛshɔn/rɛjista wit `{yuz nem, paswɔd, x25519_pɔblik_ki, displei_nem, fon, imel, avatar_emoji}`. Step 3: node validet via Pydantic (yuznem regex, paswɔd ≥ 8 chars, fon E.164, imel RFC-5322-lite). Step 4: node de rɔn Argon2id(paswɔd) → `argon2:...`, de kip na `users.paswɔd_hash`. Step 5: node ishu akses JWT (15 min) + rifresh JWT (30 dez), persist wan `yuz_divays` row.
auth.h1_c: Di flɔ na di mɔdan ɛvolushɔn fɔ PHP in mysql_rial_escape_string ɛra. Ɛvri mɔdan auth stak — Auth0, Firebase, Supabase — de du roughly dis shep. Di spesifik twist na Vortex na fɔ sɛn di X25519 pubkey na di rejista kɔl: i min se di akɔn tay to wan lɔng tɛm E2E aydentiti frɔm freym wan, nɔ ad leta. Inspɛkt frɔm Signal in 2013 protɔkɔl dizayn.
auth.h2_a: Lɔgin de chɛk di paswɔd agens di Argon2 hash we dɛn dɔn kip ɛn i de gi fresh JWT pe if i mach.
auth.h2_b: POST /api/ɔtɛnɛshɔn/lɔgin wit `{yuz nem, paswɔd}`. Node de aks `yuz` bay smɔl smɔl yuzɛn nem. If dɛn fɛn am, i de chɛk Argon2id insay kɔnstant tɛm agens `users.password_hash`. If dɛn nɔ fɛn am, stil de rɔn wan dɔmi Argon2 verify agens wan kɔnstant string fɔ ikwal di tɛm. Sakses → nyu JWT pe + nyu `yuz_divays` row (wan pan ɛni divays we yu dɔn log in). Failure → 401 wit wan jenɛrik "invalid credentials" — nɔ difrɛns bitwin bad yuzɛn nem ɛn bad paswɔd, fɔ rɛsist enumeration.
auth.h2_c: Kɔnstant-taym verifyeshɔn ɛn dɛmi hashing fɔ yuza dɛn we nɔ de na di patɛn Saynal we dɛn adopt insay 2014 afta risach pipul dɛn sho timing enumeration pan dɛn login ɛndpɔynt. Frɔm da tɛm de dɛn dɔn adopt am bɔku bɔku wan — django-aks, authelia, Keycloak ɔl de yuz am. Di prɛktis ad ~0.5 s to ɛvri fayl lɔgin tray, we fayn; wi de rate-limit login na 10/min/IP eniwe.
auth.h2_f:
dummy_hash = Argon2id("__taymin_ikwaliza__", sɔl=fiks, ...)

login(u, p): we yu de login.
  row = yuza dɛn.find(yuz nem=u.lɔwa ())
  if row na Nɔn:
      Argon2Verify (dummy_hash, p) // ikwal di tɛm
      rayz 401
  if nɔto Argon2Verify (row.paswɔd_hash, p):
      rayz 401
  ritɔn isyu_jwt(rɔw) .
auth.h3_a: Akses token dɛn kin dɔn afta 15 minit. Rifresh de chenj wan rifresh token we de liv fɔ lɔng tɛm fɔ wan fresh akses token we nɔ de aks di yuza bak fɔ in paswɔd.
auth.h3_b: Klaynt de trak `exp` lokal wan. We `now + 30s > exp`, ɔ we wan riŋwe ritɔn 401 wit `token_expired`, di klaynt de POST di rifresh token to `/api/authentication/refresh`. Node de dikɔd, chɛk `jti` de na `user_devices` ɛn nɔto `revoked_at`, chɛk `exp`, ɛn mint nyu 15 minit akses token. Rifresh roteshɔn na opt-in via `ROTATE_REFRESH=true` — ɔf bay difɔlt bikɔs fɔ rɔta rifresh token dɛn na ɛvri akses rifresh de mek wan rɛs we tu klaynt dɛn rifresh wan tɛm.
auth.h3_c: OAuth 2.0 (RFC 6749, 2012) introdyus di akses + rifresh separeshɔn. Di 15 minit akses layf tɛm na di midyan akɔdin to di industri — Google de yuz 1 awa, Auth0 difɔlt to 24 awa, Okta to 1 awa. Wi pik 15 min fɔ minimiz di winda we wan tif akses token yusful. 30 dez rifresh de mach wetin bɔku pan di mobayl ap dɛn nid fɔ kip di wan dɛn we de yuz am fɔ log in akɔdin to wan mɔnt we dɛn nɔ de du natin.
auth.h4_a: WebAuthn / paski login de yuz wan pletfɔm ɔthɛntikɛta (Tɔch ID, Fes ID, Windows Hello, Andrɔyd bayometrik) instead ɔf paswɔd.
auth.h4_b: Inrɔlmɛnt: sava de post wan chalenj; di klaynt in ɔthɛntiket de jenarayz wan nyu kipa insay in sikyɔriti ɛnklav ɛn sɛn bak di pɔblik ki + atɛsteshɔn. Sava de kip `{kredibiliti_id, pɔblik_ki, kɔnta}`. Login: `POST /api/ɔtɛnɛshɔn/paski/bigin` → sava de ritɔn wan chalenj; klaynt sayn wit di ɔthɛntikɛtɔ in prayvet ki (we dɛn ol na Sikyu Ɛnklav, nɔ de ɛva kɔmɔt na di chip); `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → sava de chɛk di sayn agens di pɔblik ki we dɛn dɔn kip. Wan monotonic kaunta de detekt klon authenticators.
auth.h4_c: FIDO2 / WebAuthn bin standad bay di W3C insay 2019 afta di ia dɛn we di FIDO Alɛyshɔn dɔn wok. Apple ad pletfɔm-ɔtɛnɛtik sɔpɔt insay iOS 16 (2022); Google, Microsoft, 1Paswɔd bin fala. Vortex adopt WebAuthn insay v0.0.8. I opshɔnal bɔt dɛn rili kɔmɛnt am — paski yuza dɛn nɔ de ɛva si phishing-based akɔn tek ova bikɔs di prayvet ki nɔ de ɛva krɔs di divays bɔda.
auth.h5_a: sid-frεz rεkכvri de rεkכnstrכkt di X25519 aydentiti pan nyu divays frכm 24-wכd BIP-39 mεmכnik. Nɔ ɛva nid di sava fɔ ol ɛni dikripshɔn matirial.
auth.h5_b: Yuzman de rayt dɔŋ di mnemonik we i fɔs lanch (opshɔnal, wan tɛm prɔmpt). Fɔ rikavari: pan nyu divays, yuzman de ɛnta di mnemonic; klaynt de ron PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512(mnemonic, "mnemonic", 2048 raun) → 64 bayt sid. di sid in fכs 32 bayt dεm de bi di X25519 prayvet ki; pɔblik ki na in dɛn pul am. Na di nyu pɔblik ki nɔmɔ dɛn tɛl di sava; i de verify posɛshɔn wit wan Ed25519 chalenj-rɛspɔns (sayn nonce), dɔn i de gi JWT dɛn.
auth.h5_c: BIP-39 (Bitcoin Improvement Proposal 39, 2013) na di kanonik we fɔ ɛnkɔd kriptografik sikrit dɛn as mɛmbaful wɔd list. 2048-wɔd Inglish dikshɔnari wit 4-bayt chɛksam na di ɛnd. Vortex yuz 24 wɔd bikɔs di industri standad fɔ ay-sikyɔriti walet (Trezor, Ledger) na 24. 12 wɔd go inof fɔ 128-bit sikyɔriti bɔt i nɔ luk sɔbstanshal inof to bɔku yuza dɛn.
auth.h5_f:
wɔd dɛn = BIP39_Ɛnkɔd(ɛntrɔpi=256_bit + 8_bit_chɛksam)
sid = PBKDF2-SHA512(wɔd dɛn, "mnɛmɔnik", rawnd dɛn=2048, len=64)
sk = sid[0:32] // X25519 prayvet
pk = sk · G // X25519 pɔblik
auth.h6_a: Tu-faktɔ ɔthɛntishɔn de ad wan tɛm-bɛs wan tɛm paswɔd (TOTP) stɛp afta paswɔd verifyeshɔn.
auth.h6_b: Enrolment: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` → sava de jenarayz wan 160-bit random sikrit, ritɔn am as base32 string + wan otpauth:// URI fɔ QR skan. Yuzman de skan wit Google Ɔthɛntikɛtɔ / Ɔti / 1Paswɔd; post bak wan sampul 6-dijit kod fɔ pruv se sɛtup wok. Login: afta paswɔd pas, sava de ritɔn `{needs_2fa: true}` insted ɔf JWTs. Klaynt de aks fɔ di 6-dijit kɔd ɛn POST dɛn `/api/authentication/login/2fa`. Sava de verify HOTP(sikrit, T=now_unix / 30) agens di kɔd.
auth.h6_c: TOTP bin standad as RFC 6238 insay 2011 bay Mak Pei. Bifo dat, RSA SecurID bin de yuz wan prɔpriet algɔrithm; afta, evri 2FA ap setul pan TOTP. Vortex in 30-sekɔnd stɛp ɛn 6-dijit lɔng na di RFC difɔlt dɛn. Bak-ap kɔd (12 × 10-dijit, sho wan tɛm) dɛn borrow frɔm GitHub in dizayn frɔm 2012.
auth.h6_f:
sikrit = rand(20 bayt) // 160 bit fɔ wan RFC 6238
TOTP(sikrit, t) = HOTP(sikrit, ⌊t / 30⌋)
HOTP(k, c) = trunkat(HMAC-SHA1(k, c) ) mod 106

windo: ±1 step tolerate fɔ klok skew
auth.h7_a: QR login de pe nyu divays insay wan akɔn we dɔn de we yu nɔ tayp di paswɔd bak. Di fon we dɔn ɔlrɛdi log in de sayn wan nonce we di nyu divays de yuz fɔ ɔthɛntikayt.
auth.h7_b: Divays A de post `/api/ɔtɛnɛshɔn/qr/bigin`. Sava de jenarayz wan 128-bit nonce wit TTL 60s, bind am to A in user_id, ritɔn am. A de sho di nonce we dɛn ɛnkɔd as QR (inklud `nonce + user_id + server_url`). Divays B de skan, post `/api/ɔtɛnɛshɔn/qr/vɛrifay` wit di nonce. Serva: nonce valid ɛn wan-shot? Asosiet B in fresh X25519 pubkey wit user_id (nyu `user_devices` row), mint JWTs fɔ B. Divays A de gɛt WebSocket notis so di yuza kin si ɛn opshɔnal fɔ rivok.
auth.h7_c: QR-based pairing bin fɔs pɔpul bay WhatsApp Wɛb insay 2015. Telegram bin fala; Signal kɔpi am fɔ dɛn mɔlti-divays sɔpɔt insay 2021. Vortex in twist: ɛni pairing ivin de sɔfa pan di ɔrijinal divays wit wan "kɔnfɛm" bɔtin, so wan atak we grap di QR frɔm wan skrinshɔt nɔ go ebul fɔ dɔn pe witout yuz intarakshɔn pan divays A.
auth.h8_a: Akɔn enumereshɔn resistans — pat pan di auth chapta. dis na wan pan di kכr mεkanism dεm we dεn rεfrεns tru di Vortex rεfrεns. Rid di chapta we de rawnd am fɔ no mɔ bɔt di tin dɛn we de apin; dis pat de zoom in pan di spεsifi k bihayvya.
auth.h8_b: Implimɛnt ɔvaviu fɔ "Akɔnt ɛnyumɛreshɔn rɛsistɛns". Di mɛkanism de implimɛnt insay di kɔrɛspɔndɛns mɔdyul ɔnda `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, ɔ `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Di modul README de kɔl ɔut ɛksaktɔ fayl pat dɛn.
auth.h8_c: di "Account enumeration resistance" mεkanism evolv across Vortex rilis dεm. Di dizayn de tray bak to di risach ɛn prodakshɔn prɔsis we dɛn bin dɔn pablish we di mɛsenja dɛn we bin dɔn de bifo bin du. Vɛshɔn istri na `CHANGELOG.md` de rikodɔ we ɛni wan pan di pis land ɛn wetin mek i du am.

rooms.title: Rum dɛn ɛn mɛsej dɛn
rooms.subtitle: Di 4 rum tayp, mɛmbaship, ki roteshɔn, mɛsej.
rooms.intro: Ɔl di 4 rum kayn dɛn — DM, prayvet grup, pɔblik grup, chanɛl — de sheb wan ɔndalayn `rum` tebul. Bihayvya na gated bay boolean flags.
rooms.h1p1: **DM**: ɛksaktɔli tu mɛmba, `is_dm=tru`, `is_prayvet=tru`. Nem ɔto-sɛt to di ɔda mɛmba in handel.
rooms.h1p2: **Prayvet grup**: invayt-onli, `is_prayvet=tru`, `is_channel=false`. Maks 5000 mɛmba dɛn bay difɔlt.
rooms.h1p3: **Pɔblik grup**: `is_prayvet=fals`. Ɛnibɔdi we gɛt inviteshɔn link kin jɔyn; list na di pɔblik dairektrɔ if di ɔna opt in.
rooms.h1p4: **Channel**: brodkas-onli, `is_channel=tru`. Na di ɔna/admin dɛn nɔmɔ kin post; mɛmba dɛn we kin de ɔltɛm kin rid.
rooms.h2: Membaship ɛn di wok dɛn we pɔsin kin du
rooms.h2p1: Rol dɛn: `ɔna`, `admin`, `mɛmba`. Na wan ɔna nɔmɔ fɔ ɛni rum (we dɛn kin asaynd).
rooms.h2p2: Admin dɛn kin invayt, kik, mute, ɛn ɛdit rum sɛtin. Memba dɛn kin sɛn mɛsej, riak, ɛdit dɛn yon, dilit dɛn yon.
rooms.h2p3: Permishɔn kaskad: ɔna dɛn gɛt ɛvri admin pawa. Admins no kin demote di owner.
rooms.h2p4: Rol chenj de jenarayz wan sistem mɛsej (`kind: "role_changed"`) we ɛvri mɛmba kin si.
rooms.h3p1: Ɛni rum gɛt 32-bayt **rut ki** we dɛn jenarayz pan krieshɔn via `secrets.token_bytes(32)` na di krieta in divays.
rooms.h3p2: Ɛni mɛmba kin gɛt wan ɛnvilɔp `{mɛmba_id, ɛnvilɔp: X25519_ɛnkript(mɛmba_pɔbki, rut_ki)}` we dɛn kip na `rum_ki`.
rooms.h3p3: We mɛmba jɔyn, ɛni mɛmba we dɔn de in klaynt kin mek nyu ɛnvilɔp fɔ dɛn. Envelope minting na O(1) fɔ ɛni jɔyn.
rooms.h3p4: We mɛmba kɔmɔt, di rum de rɔta: krieta (ɔ fɔs aktif admin) de gɛt nyu rut, i de ri-ɛnvɔlɔp to di mɛmba dɛn we lɛf, i de post `{type:"k", rum:..., new_envelopes:[...]}` via WebSocket. Ol sayfatɛks de kɔntinyu fɔ rid wit di ol ki we di klaynt dɛn stil dɔn kesh.
rooms.h3l1: Variant-B key publish: fɔ pɔblik rum dɛn we gɛt > 1000 mɛmba dɛn, ɛnvilɔp dɛn kin stɔp fɔ skel. Bifo dat, di ɔna de sayn ɛn pablish di rut ki we de naw na `room_public_keys` tebul. Di klaynt dɛn kin chɛk di sayn agens di rum in ɔna pɔbki. Roteshɔn pan mɛmba lɛf na so no-op fɔ Variant-B rum dɛn.
rooms.h3l2: Pseudo fɔ ɛni rum: ɛni rum gɛt `rum_pseudo_salt` bak. Memba pseudonyms in mɛsej dɛn na `HMAC-SHA256(salt, user_id)` we dɛn kɔt to 16 heks chars. Node nɔ kin ebul fɔ no us yuza sɛn us mɛsej if i nɔ gɛt klaynt-sayd map.
rooms.h4p1: Mɛsej dɛn gɛt monotonik ID dɛn fɔ ɛni rum (64-bit ɔto-inkrimɛn, `bigserial` na Postgres, `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY` insay SQLite).
rooms.h4p2: Ɔda na di sava-asaynd am. Klaynt dɛn nɔ de fɛt fɔ di tɛmstamp; dɛn de rɛnd insay ID ɔda ɛn sho di pɔsin we sɛn in wɔl-klɔk tɛm as UI mɛtadata nɔmɔ.
rooms.h4p3: Ɛdit: nyu sayfatɛks de tek ples fɔ ol in-ples, `edit_at` ɔpdet dɛn. Klaynt dɛn de sho `(ɛdit)` mak.
rooms.h4p4: Dilit: sɛt `dilit_at`, nul ɔt sayfatɛks. `{type:"m", dilit:tru}` brodkas.
rooms.h4p5: Riplies: `reply_to` = mɛsej id we dɛn rɛfrɛns. Klaynt dɛn kin rɛnd wan smɔl kot hεda.
rooms.h5: Di we aw pipul dɛn kin biev
rooms.h5p1: Riakshɔn na row dɛn na `riakshɔn(mɛsej_id, yuz_id, imɔji, kriyayt_at)`. Klaynt POST dɛn `/api/mɛsej/{id}/riakshɔn/{emoji}`. DELETE fɔ nɔ-riakt.
rooms.h5p2: Node fans aut `{type:"m", riakshɔn:[...]}` to ɛvri sabskriptɔ. Klaynt dɛn kin gɛda.
rooms.h5p3: No restrikshɔn pan emoji — ɛni Yunikɔd. Klaynt dɛn de-dupe ɛn rɛnd kɔnt.
rooms.h6: Thread dɛn we dɛn kin yuz
rooms.h6p1: Trɛd na lay lay rum we gɛt rut pan mɛsej. `POST /api/messages/{id}/thread` de mek `{id: <nyu_rum_id>, mama ɛn papa_mɛsej_id: <msg_id>, mama ɛn papa_rum_id: <ɔrijinal>}`.
rooms.h6p2: Thread rum dɛn kin gɛt mɛmbaship frɔm di mama ɔ papa. Eni parent-room memba kin post in eni thread.
rooms.h6p3: Ki derivashɔn: trɛd rut ki = `HKDF(mama ɛn papa_rut, info: "trɛd:" + <mama ɛn papa_mɛsej_id>, len: 32)`. Kompromis of di thread key no de lik parent.
rooms.h7: Mɛsej dɛn we dɛn dɔn pin
rooms.h7p1: Admins kin pin op to 10 mesej fo evri rum. `POST /api/rums/{id}/pin` wit `{mɛsej_id}`.
rooms.h7p2: Pinned set de lod pan rum opin; klaynt dɛn de rɛnd wan pin hεda na di tap.
rooms.h8: Draft dɛn we dɛn kin yuz
rooms.h8p1: Draft fɔ ɛni rum de kɔntinyu fɔ de na di no: `PUT /api/rooms/{id}/draft` wit `{text}`. `GET` de ritɔn kɔrɛnt. `DELETE` de klia.
rooms.h8p2: Klaynt dɛn kin sink draft dɛn akɔdin to divays dɛn so fɔ tayp na di fon kin dɔn na di dɛsktɔp. Draft dɛn nɔto ɛnd-to-ɛnd ɛnkript — dɛn na pleintɛks we di sava kin si. Dat na wan deliberate tred fɔ kros-divays UX. Yuza dɛn we de agens kin disable sync per-room.
rooms.h9: Mɛsej dɛn we dɛn dɔn sɛtul
rooms.h9p1: `POST /api/scheduled` wit `{rum_id, sayfatɛks, sɛn_na}`. Node de stoa na `scheduled_messages`; wan cron woka de komit pan taim.
rooms.h9p2: Editable ɛn kansel te di send_at tik faya. Afta yu dɔn sɛn, di mɛsej kin bi ɔdinari rɔw na `mɛsej`.
rooms.h1_a: Ɔl di 4 rum kayn (DM, prayvet grup, pɔblik grup, chanɛl) de sheb wan `rum` tebul. Difrɛns de insay tri buli flag dɛn.
rooms.h1_b: Flags: `na_dm`, `na_prayvet`, `na_chanɛl`. DM: na_dm=tru, na_prayvet=tru, ɛksaktɔli 2 mɛmba. Prayvet grup: is_private=true, is_channel=false, i go rich 5000 mɛmba dɛn. Pɔblik grup: is_private=false, list insay dairektrɔ if di ɔna opt in. Chanɛl: is_channel=true, na di ɔna/admin dɛn nɔmɔ de post. Ɔl de sheb ki manejmɛnt, fan-ɔut, riakshɔn, trɛd.
rooms.h1_c: Singl-tebul polimכfism na wan patεn frכm Martin Fowler in *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture* (2002). Telegram de yuz tri difrɛn kayn rum dɛn insay; Slak de yuz chanɛl + DM + mɔlti-pati DM as 4 kayn; Discord de yuz "channels" fo evritin. Wi pik wan-tebul afta profayl sho di men kɔst na di fan-ɔut (we yunifom akɔs di kayn dɛn) ɛn afta v0.0.3 rifakta miks tri tebul dɛn we fiba to wan.
rooms.h1_f:
CREATE TABLE rum dɛn (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, .
  tayp VARCHAR(16), -- lɛgsi, ridandant wit flag
  nem VARCHAR(256), .
  na_prayvet BOOLEAN, .
  na_chanɛl BOOLEAN, .
  na_dm BOOLEAN, .
  mɛmba_kɔnt INT, .
  avatar_url VARCHAR(512), di wan dɛn we de wok na di wɔl.
  we dɛn mek_na TIMESTAMP, .
  kriyayt_bay BIGINT REFERENCES yuza dɛn(id)
);
rooms.h2_a: Rol dɛn na tri-taya: ɔna, admin, mɛmba. Eksakt wan ona fo wan rum, at least wan admin, arbitrarily plenti memba.
rooms.h2_b: `rum_members(rum_id, yuza_id, rol, jɔyn_at, muted_te)`. Roles kaskad: ɔna dɛn gɛt ɛvri admin pawa. Admin dɛn kin invayt, kik, mute, ɛn ɛdit rum sɛtin bɔt dɛn nɔ kin ebul fɔ pul di ɔna. Memba dɛn kin sɛn mɛsej, riak, ɛdit dɛn yon, dilit dɛn yon. Ɔna transfa via `PATCH /api/rooms/{id}` wit `nyu_ɔna_id` — ol ɔna drɔp to admin.
rooms.h2_c: Ɔna/admin/mɛmba na di tripartit IRC op/voys/yuz mɔdel frɔm 1988, leta Slak, Diskɔrd, Telegram bin adopt am. Di patikyula chuk fɔ gɛt ɛksaktɔli wan ɔna (nɔto bɔku) kɔmɔt frɔm ligal kɔnsidareshɔn: insay jɔrisdikshɔn dɛn wit grup-laybiliti lɔ, fɔ gɛt klia wan ɔna de mek DMCA ɛn di sem kayn rikwest dɛn izi.
rooms.h2_f:
CREATE TABLE rum_mɛmba dɛn (
  rum_id BIGINT, .
  yuz_id BIGINT, .
  rol VARCHAR(16) CHECK(rol IN (‘ɔna’,‘admin’,‘mɛmba’)),
  jɔyn_na TIMESTAMP, .
  muted_te TIMESTAMP, .
  PRIMARY KEY (rum_id, yuz_id)
);
rooms.h3_a: Ɛni rum gɛt 32 bayt simɛtrik rut ki. Memba dɛn ol kɔpi dɛn we dɛn rap ɔnda dɛn X25519 pɔbki.
rooms.h3_b: Na krieshɔn, klaynt de jenarayz `rut_key = sikrit.token_bayt(32)`. Fɔ ɛni mɛmba, klaynt de ɛnkript `root_key` ɔnda `X25519(member_pubkey)` → ɛnvilɔp. Envilɔp dɛn de liv insay `rum_keys(rum_id, yuza_id, ɛnvilɔp)`. We pɔsin we de yuz am jɔyn, ɛni mɛmba we dɔn de in klaynt kin min nyu ɛnvilɔp fɔ dɛn. We yuza kɔmɔt, di ɔna ɔ di fɔs aktif admin de rɔta — i de jenarayz nyu rut_ki, i de ri-ɛnvɔlɔp fɔ di mɛmba dɛn we lɛf, i de brodkas `{type:"k", rum:..., new_envelopes:[...]}` ova WebSocket.
rooms.h3_c: Per-member wrapping na di patna we Signal bin payɔnia insay 2014 fɔ in grup dɛn-v2. Matrix in Megolm de yuz wan sem kayn "sender keys" aprɔch. Vortex bin go wit ɛni-mɛmba ɛnvilɔp bikɔs i simpul fɔ rizin bɔt: nɔ fɔdɔm sikrit drift bitwin di wan dɛn we de sɛn. Di tred-ɔf na O(N) ɛnvilɔp mintin pan mɛmbaship chenj, we fayn te to ~5000 mɛmba dɛn; public-channel Variant-B de saydstep di limit.
rooms.h3_f:
pan kriet:
  rut_ki = rand (32) ɛn di .
  fɔ m insay mɛmba dɛn:
    ɛnvilɔp[m] = X25519_Ɛnkript(m.pubki, rut_ki)

we yu de na lɛf:
  nyu_rut = rand (32) .
  ribroadcast(nyu ɛnvilɔp fɔ di mɛmba dɛn we lɛf)
rooms.h4_a: Variant-B key publish de tek ples fɔ ɛni mɛmba ɛnvilɔp wit wan ki we dɛn sayn, we dɛn post na tebul we pipul dɛn kin rid. Skel to 100k+ mɛmba dɛn.
rooms.h4_b: Insted of O(N) envelope minting, di ona de sain di root_key en post to `room_public_keys(room_id, key, signed_by, signed_at)`. Klaynt dɛn kin kam, chɛk agens di ɔna in Ed25519 pɔbki, ɛn yuz am. Rotation na no-op fɔ mɛmbaship chenj — ɛnibɔdi we bin gɛt di ki stil gɛt am ivin if dɛn dɔn kik dɛn. Dat na akseptabl fɔ pɔblik anɔns-chanɛl usay "dip istri" nɔto trɛt mɔdel bɔt rich ɛn skel na.
rooms.h4_c: Variant-B na mכdel pan Matrix in "wol ridabl" histri visibiliti kכmbayn wit sayn ki roteshכn. Ad to Vortex in v0.0.8 afta di beta bin gɛt 50k-mɛmba pɔblik chanɛl we in piɔriɔdik ri-ɛnvɔlɔp bɔrst dɛn satεrayt di node. Di sayn-ɛn-pɔblish aprɔch de skel linya wit ki roteshɔn (we nɔ bɔku) pas wit mɛmbaship chenj (we kɔnstant).
rooms.h4_f:
Variant-B we dɛn kin yuz: .
  ɔna sayn dɛn: sig = Ed25519Sayn(ɔna_priv, rum_id ∥ rut_ki ∥ vɛshɔn)
  pablish: rum_pɔblik_ki dɛn += {rum_id, rut_ki, vɛshɔn, sig}
  klaynt: GET /api/rums/{id}/public-key → verify sig agens owner_pubkey
rooms.h5_a: Invayt kɔd dɛn na 32 heks char dɛn. Opshɔnal maks_yuz, expires_at, asayn_rol, rivokabl.
rooms.h5_b: `POST /api/rooms/{id}/invite` (admin-onli) de mek wan row insay `invites(kɔd, rum_id, kriet_bay, maks_yuz, yuz_kɔunt, expires_at, asayn_rol, rivoked_at)`. `POST /api/rooms/join` wit di kɔd de chɛk validiti (nɔ rivok, nɔ dɔn, yuz_kaunt < max_yuz), inkrimɛnt `used_count`, mek `room_members` row, ritɔn rum mɛtadata. Rivok via `DELETE /api/invites/{code}` — leta jɔyn dɛn nɔ de wok.
rooms.h5_c: Invayt kod as primitiv na ol as IRC in `+i` mod (1988). Telegram in pɔblik invayt link dɛn wit ɛkspɛri ɛn yuz limit dɛn bin introduks insay 2017. Vortex in vɛryɔnt ad `assign_role` so ɔna dɛn kin gi admin-grantin kɔd dɛn sef wan insay wan-shot fɔmat — yusful fɔ onbɔd nyu modarɛta we nɔ nid fɔ no dɛn ɛksaktɔ yuz id bifo tɛm.
rooms.h5_f:
invayt row:
  kod : VARCHAR(64) -- 32 heks char dɛn
  rum_id : BIGINT .
  maks_yuz : INT -- NULL = nɔ gɛt limit
  yuz_kɔunt : INT .
  expires_at : TIMESTAMP -- NULL = nɔ ɛva
  asayn_rol : VARCHAR(16) -- NULL = mɛmba
  rivoked_at : TIMESTAMP -- NULL = liv
rooms.h6_a: Wan mɛsej row de kip sayfatɛks + mɛtadata; di pɔsin we sɛn di mɛsej nɔ de ɛva kip am na klia tɛks.
rooms.h6_b: `mɛsej(id, rum_id, sɛnda_id, sayfatɛks, nonce, sɛnda_pseudo, sɛn_at, ɛdit_at?, dilit_at?, riply_to?, thread_id?, kayn)`. `sender_id` de fɔ akses kɔntrol ɛn i de indeks. `sender_pseudo` na wan per-rum deterministic hash of sender_id so fan-out nɔ nid fɔ tɔch di yuza dɛn tebul. `kind` na wan pan: tɛks, imej, fayl, vɔys, kɔl, sistɛm. `sayfatɛks` na opak AES-GCM ɔtput; na di rum mɛmba dɛn nɔmɔ we gɛt di ki kin dikript.
rooms.h6_c: Di sender_pseudo aydia kɔmɔt frɔm Signal sealed-sender (2018). Signal de yuz am fɔ blaynd di sava fɔ mek i no di pɔsin we sɛn am; wi de yuz am fɔ wan sem kayn tin bɔt kip `sender_id` klia tɛks fɔ ACL ɛn ret limit. Di split de mek wi enfɔs "only members can post" witout di server lan udat se wetin pan wan ful DB dump.
rooms.h7_a: Ɛdit dɛn ɔvarayt `sayfatɛks` na ples ɛn bamp `ɛdited_at`. Dilit nul aut sayfatɛks ɛn sɛt `dilit_at`.
rooms.h7_b: Ɛdit: `PATCH /api/mɛsej/{id}` wit nyu `{sayfatɛks, nonce}`. Na di pɔsin nɔmɔ we sɛn di mɛsej go ebul fɔ ɛdit dɛn yon mɛsej. Row in sayfatɛks/nɔns riples, `ɛdited_at = naw`, `kayn` nɔ chenj. Fan-out `{tayp:"m", id, ct, nonce, ɛdit_at}`. Dilit: `DELETE /api/mɛsej dɛn/{id}`. Sender ɔ admin kin dilit. `dilit_at = naw`, `sayfatɛks = NULL`. Row stays so riplies stil mek sense. Fan-out `{tayp:"m", dilit:tru, id}`.
rooms.h7_c: Ɛdit-in-ples na di Telegram/Slak patɛn; Diskɔd bin kip wan ful ɛdit istri fɔs ɛn afta dat dɛn drɔp am fɔ prayvet pat. Vortex kip di laytst nɔmɔ — ɛdit istri na sɔs fɔ PR insidɛnt we wan dilit-ɛdit de rikavari. Sɔft-dilit wit nul sayfatɛks na frɔm di sem Telegram plebuk ɛn i de kip riply chen dɛn we nɔ de kip kɔntinyu.
rooms.h7_f:
ɛdit: UPDATE mɛsej dɛn SET sayfatɛks = $1, nonce = $2, ɛdit_at = NOW() WHERE id = $3
dilit: UPDATE mɛsej dɛn SET dilit_at = NOW(), sayfatɛks = NULL WHERE id = $1
rooms.h8_a: Drafts — pat pan di rum dɛn chapta. dis na wan pan di kכr mεkanism dεm we dεn rεfrεns tru di Vortex rεfrεns. Rid di chapta we de rawnd am fɔ no mɔ bɔt di tin dɛn we de apin; dis pat de zoom in pan di spεsifi k bihayvya.
rooms.h8_b: Implimɛnt ɔvaviu fɔ "Drafts". Di mɛkanism de implimɛnt insay di kɔrɛspɔndɛns mɔdyul ɔnda `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, ɔ `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Di modul README de kɔl ɔut ɛksaktɔ fayl pat dɛn.
rooms.h8_c: di "Drafts" mεkanism evolv akraos Vortex rilis dεm. Di dizayn de tray bak to di risach ɛn prodakshɔn prɔsis we dɛn bin dɔn pablish we di mɛsenja dɛn we bin dɔn de bifo bin du. Vɛshɔn istri na `CHANGELOG.md` de rikodɔ we ɛni wan pan di pis land ɛn wetin mek i du am.
rooms.h9_a: Scheduled messages — pat pan di rum dɛn chapta. dis na wan pan di kכr mεkanism dεm we dεn rεfrεns tru di Vortex rεfrεns. Rid di chapta we de rawnd am fɔ no mɔ bɔt di tin dɛn we de apin; dis pat de zoom in pan di spεsifi k bihayvya.
rooms.h9_b: Implimɛnt ɔvaviu fɔ "Scheduled messages". Di mɛkanism de implimɛnt insay di kɔrɛspɔndɛns mɔdyul ɔnda `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, ɔ `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Di modul README de kɔl ɔut ɛksaktɔ fayl pat dɛn.

files.title: Fayl dɛn ɛn atɛshmɛnt dɛn
files.subtitle: Singl-shot fɔ smɔl, risumabl fɔ big, klaynt-sayd ɛnkripshɔn fɔ ɔl tu.
files.intro: Ɛni fayl we dɛn ɔplod de go tru di sem ɛnkripshɔn paip layn. di difrεns bitwin pat dεm na purely bכt nεtwכk rεsiliεns: rεsumable de tכlerεt flaky link dεm.
files.h1p1: Kap: 5 MB. Dɛn kin yuz am fɔ foto, vɔys not, shɔt klip dɛn.
files.h1p2: Klaynt de ɛnkript di ɔl fayl wit AES-GCM, random 96-bit nonce, ki = `fayl_rut = sikrit.token_bayt(32)`.
files.h1p3: POSTs `multipart/form-data` to `/api/files` wit fil dɛm `fayl` (sayfatɛks), `plain_blake3` (integriti klem), `mime_type` (hint; sava ri-chɛk wit `python-magic`).
files.h1p4: Node de stoa ɔnda `uploads/<category>/<sha256>.bin` ɛn ritɔn `{file_id, url}`.
files.h1p5: Dɔn di klaynt kin post wan rum mɛsej we de rɛfrɛns di fayl_id ɛn kɛr di fayl_rut insay in sayfatɛks so dat di rum mɛmba dɛn kin dikript.
files.h2: Pat we yu kin yuz fɔ ɔplod bak
files.h2p2: Stej 1: `POST /api/fayl/risumable/init` wit `{fayl nem, saiz, chunk_size_hint}`. Node alɔkat wan ɔplod id, pik wan chunk saiz (difɔlt 512 KiB, kap na 4 MiB), ritɔn `{upload_id, chunk_size}`.
files.h2p3: Stej 2: fɔ ɛni chunk, `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` wit raw sayfatɛks bɔdi. Ɔfset dɛn fɔ alaynɛd ​​to `chunk_size`.
files.h2p4: Stej 3: `POST /api/fayl/risayum/{upload_id}/finalise` wit `{plain_blake3}`. Node de riassemble, verify saiz, stoa, ritɔn `{file_id, url}`.
files.h2p5: Failure handling: intarapt ɔplod kin bigin bak bay we yu ri-post ɔl di ɔfset dɛn we nɔ de. Node trak us ɔfset dɛn kam na Redis (ɔ in-mɛmori fɔ SQLite mod).
files.h2p6: TTL: dɛn kin pul di ɔplɔd dɛn we nɔ dɔn afta 24 h.
files.h3p1: Imej ɔplod (MIME `imej/*`) de trig wan Pilo-bɛs thumbnail jenɛra na 256×256 JPEG q=80. Dɛn kin kip am ɔnda `uploads/thumbs/<hash>.jpg`.
files.h3p2: Thumbnails na klaynt-sayd enkript bak — risipiɛnt nid di file_root fɔ rɛnd. Sev bandwidth fɔ list prɛviu.
files.h3p3: Vidio ɔplod (MIME `vidio/*`) de trig wan ffmpeg-based posta ɛkstrakshɔn na 10 % pan di klip durayshɔn, we dɛn kip di sem we.
files.h4: MIME fɔ mek dɛn du wetin dɛn se
files.h4p1: `mime_type` we di klaynt dɔn sɛn na hint. Sava de rɔn `python-magic` agens di fɔs 1 KB ɛn i de rijɛkt if di tayp we dɛn snif de na di dinay list: `application/x-dosexec`, `application/x-sharedlib`, `application/x-mach-binary`.
files.h4p2: Dis de stɔp di wan dɛn we nɔ gɛt sɛns fɔ mek dɛn nɔ aksidɛntli sheb malwea tru di mɛsenja. Motivated atakers kin stil baypas wit kɔrɛkt-lɛbul kɔntena dɛn — di difens na klaynt-sayd unwrap rifyus, nɔto sava-sayd sniff.
files.h5p1: Difɔlt: lokal faylsistim. Good fɔ singl-node diploy.
files.h5p2: S3: sɛt `STƆRƐJ_BƐKƐND=s3` + `S3_BƆKƐT=...`. Fayl dɛn de strim dairekt to S3 we dɛn nɔ tɔch di node in disk. Dɛn kin yuz di URL dɛn we dɛn dɔn sayn bifo tɛm fɔ dawnlod.
files.h5p3: IPFS: ɛkspirimɛnt. Uplod dɛn de anɔys CID dɛn tru di DHT; dawlod dɛn kin kam wit ɛni pinin node.
files.h1_a: Single-shot upload na di fast path fɔ ɛnitin ɔnda 5 MB — foto, vɔys not, shɔt klip. Wan HTTPS POST, wan enkript blob, wan row insay `fayl`.
files.h1_b: Klaynt de ɛnkript di fayl bayt dɛn ɛnd-to-ɛnd wit AES-GCM ɔnda wan random 32-bayt `fayl_rut`. POSTs `multipart/form-data` to `/api/files` wit fil dɛm `fayl` (sayfatɛks), `plain_blake3` (integriti klem), `mime_type` (hint). Node de enfɔs di 5 MB kap na di risiv bafa lɛvɛl, i de rɔn `python-magic` fɔ tayp ditekshɔn, i de rijɛkt if MIME de na di dinay list, i de kip ɔnda `uploads/<category>/<hash>.bin`, i de ritɔn `{file_id, url, mime_type, size}`. Dɔn di klaynt kin post wan rum mɛsej we de rɛfrɛns `file_id` ɛn kɛr `file_root` insay in sayfatɛks.
files.h1_c: Di 5 MB kap na di sem nɔmba we Slak ɛn Telegram de yuz fɔ dɛn "inlayn" ɔplɔd pat. Big fayl dɛn kin go na di rod we dɛn kin yuz bak. Di fɔs Vortex bin gɛt 100 MB singl-shot kap; wi drɔp to 5 MB afta profayl sho se singl-shot ɔplod ɔp 5 MB bin gɛt 40 % drɔp rɛt na mobayl nɛtwɔk. Di resumable path na striktli beta fo big fayl dem ivin if na mo roundtrips pan hapi path dem.
files.h2_a: Risumabl ɔplɔd na di rod fɔ big fayl dɛn. Klaynt ɔplod fiks-sayz chunks, kin stɔp, kin bigin bak pan ɛni chunk bɔda, kin rikavari frɔm nɛtwɔk blips.
files.h2_b: Tri-stej protɔkɔl. Init: `POST /api/files/resumable/init` wit `{fayl nem, saiz, chunk_size_hint}` → node de alɔkat `upload_id` + kɔnfɔm chunk saiz. Chunks: fɔ ɛni ɔfset, `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` wit raw sayfatɛks bɔdi. Ɔfset dɛn fɔ bi multiples fɔ chunk_size. Finalise: `POST /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/finalise` wit `{plain_blake3}` — node de riassemble, verify saiz + tag, stoa, ritɔn `{file_id, url}`.
files.h2_c: Di tri-stej protɔkɔl na di sem shep lɛk tus.io (Resumable Uploads, 2013), AWS S3 multipart uploads, ɛn Google Drive risumable uploads. Vortex adopt di tus.io shep bikɔs na bin di simpul mats fɔ FastAPI + strimin. Di 24 h TTL pan ɔplod dɛn we nɔ dɔn de mach S3 in difɔlt ɛn balans dɛn de risum fleksibiliti agens yus fɔ di sava disk.
files.h3_a: Dɛn kin jenarayz smɔl smɔl tin dɛn na di sava-sayd we dɛn de ɔplod bɔt dɛn kin de ɛnkript ɔnda di sem fayl rut, so na di rum mɛmba dɛn nɔmɔ kin rɛnd dɛn.
files.h3_b: Fɔ `imej/*` MIME, Pilo de jenarayz wan 256×256 JPEG q=80 frɔm di dikript prɛviu. Wait — nɔ, di sava nɔ ɛva gɛt pleintɛks. Kɔrɛkt flɔ: klaynt de jenarayz di thumb lokal wan, ɛnkript wit di sem file_root + nyu nonce, ɔplod as brɔda ɛn sista blob, ɛn rɛfrɛns `thumb_id` na di rum mɛsej. Sava de kip di sayfa tɛks. Fɔ `vidio/*`, di klaynt de du di sem tin wit wan ffmpeg-derived kifrɛm.
files.h3_c: Ali Vortex bin gɛt sava-sayd thumbnail jenɛreshɔn frɔm pleintɛks — wi bin pul da kapabiliti de insay v0.0.4 afta wan sikyɔriti rivyu pɔynt se i brok di E2E garanti. Klaynt-sayd thumbs na di patɛn we Signal dɔn yuz frɔm 2018 ɛn WhatsApp frɔm 2020. Bandwidth kɔst nɔ impɔtant — wan 256×256 JPEG de ɔnda 20 KB.
files.h4_a: Di sava enfɔs wan MIME dinay list na di snif layt fɔ stɔp aksidɛntli-distributed ɛgzikutabl dɛn.
files.h4_b: Afta di ful ɔplod (singl-shot) ɔ dɔn (resumable), di sava de rɔn `python-magic` oba di fɔs 1 KB pan di sayfatɛks in ɔs kɔntena fɔ no di tru tayp. If di snif ripɔt `application/x-dosexec` (Windows PE), `application/x-sharedlib` (Linux ELF), ɔ `application/x-mach-binary` (macOS Mach-O), di ɔplod de rijɛkt wit 415 Unsupported Media Type. Dis na sava polisi, nɔto sikyɔriti bɔda — di klaynt in rum mɛmba dɛn kin stil instɔl wan wrap fɔmat we de baypas di snif.
files.h4_c: MIME snif as dinay polisi na IETF draft-mime-sniffing-0X frɔm 2012. Diskɔrd / Slak / Telegram ɔl de du am. Di limiteshɔn (zipped/containerised executables bypass sniff) dɔn no frɔm 2016 — wi difens na layt: plus yuz-sayd wɔnin pan ɛni fayl wit ɛgzibit ɛkstenshɔn.
files.h5_a: Storage backends — pat pan di fayl dɛn chapta. dis na wan pan di kכr mεkanism dεm we dεn rεfrεns tru di Vortex rεfrεns. Rid di chapta we de rawnd am fɔ no mɔ bɔt di tin dɛn we de apin; dis pat de zoom in pan di spεsifi k bihayvya.
files.h5_b: Implimɛnt ɔvaviu fɔ "Stɔrej bakɛnd dɛn". Di mɛkanism de implimɛnt insay di kɔrɛspɔndɛns mɔdyul ɔnda `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, ɔ `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Di modul README de kɔl ɔut ɛksaktɔ fayl pat dɛn.
files.h5_c: Di "Storage backends" mεkanism evolv across Vortex rilis dεm. Di dizayn de tray bak to di risach ɛn prodakshɔn prɔsis we dɛn bin dɔn pablish we di mɛsenja dɛn we bin dɔn de bifo bin du. Vɛshɔn istri na `CHANGELOG.md` de rikodɔ we ɛni wan pan di pis land ɛn wetin mek i du am.

presence.title: Prɛzɛns ɛn dilivri signal dɛn
presence.subtitle: Tayp indikɛtɔ, rid risit, las-si — ɔl na ephemeral.
presence.intro: Dɛn signal dɛn ya kin mek nɔys. Vortex kip dɛn ɔf-persistens bay difɔlt: tayp layf na Redis (ɔ in-mɛmori), rid risit na di wan signal we de sev we dɛn ristart.
presence.h1: Di tin dɛn we de sho se yu de tayp
presence.h1p1: Klaynt de sɛn `{tayp:"t", rum:..., stet:"start"|"stɔp"}` pan kistrok. Debounced to at most wan ivent pan 3 s.
presence.h1p2: Node brodkas `{type:"t", rum:..., yuza:..., stet:...}` to ɔl di WebSockets we dɛn dɔn sabskripshɔn.
presence.h1p3: Auto-expire: `start` witout wan fכlכw `stכp` tεm aut afta 10 s na di klaynt sayd.
presence.h2p2: Node de kɔntinyu fɔ de na `rid_risit(rum_id, yuz_id, mɛsej_id, rid_at)` ɛn brodkas `{tayp:"r", rum:..., yuza:..., mɛsej_id:...}`.
presence.h2p3: Klaynt dɛn de rɛnd "seen by N" ɔnda ɔtbaund mɛsej dɛn.
presence.h2p4: Prayvesi: yuzman kin disable "seen" ɔltogɛda; den di node nכ de persist risit fכ dεm. Trade-off: dɛn nɔ kin si ɔda pipul dɛn risit bak (symmetry).
presence.h3: Las tɛm we dɛn si am
presence.h3p1: Node de trak `presence.last_seen_at` (unix ms) fɔ ɛni yuza. Updated pan ɛvri WebSocket freym.
presence.h3p2: Granularity tiers (user-choosable): εksakεt, rawnd to nia 5 min, rawnd to nia awa, "rεsεntli", כ כf.
presence.h4: Indikɛtɔ we de na di intanɛt
presence.h4p1: Wan yuza de "onlayn" if i gɛt at le wan aktif WebSocket pan ɛni wan pan dɛn divays.
presence.h4p2: Visible to contacts only — non-contacts si las-sien bɔt nɔto layf dɔt.
presence.h1_a: Tayping indikɛtɔ de sɛn tru WebSocket freym `{type:"t", rum, stet: "start"|"stop"}` ɛn brodkas bay di node to ɛvri sabskriptɔ na di rum.
presence.h1_b: Klaynt debounces na 3 s — fɔs kistrok de sɛn `start`, afta dat insay 3 s nɔ de du natin. 10 s afta di las kistrok, klaynt de sɛn `stɔp`. Node brodkas di freym verbatim, prefiks wit `user_id`. No persistens — tayp stet de liv in-mεmכri per-rum dikt (כ Redis pub/sub fכ mכlti-node). Auto-expire 10 s na di risiva sayd: if no ɔpdet nɔ kam, klaynt dɛn kin tek am se dɛn dɔn stɔp.
presence.h1_c: Tayp indikɛtɔ dɛn go bak to AIM / ICQ (1997). Mɔdan debounced dizayn dɛn tray to Skype 2006 ɛn iMessage 2011. Di 3 s / 10 s nɔmba dɛn kɔmɔt frɔm iMessage in ɔbshɔb bihayvya — wi A/B tɛst 2/5, 3/10, 5/15 ɛn 3/10 bin gɛt di bɛst sɔbjɛktiv "matches human rhythm" fidbak.
presence.h2_a: Rid risit de kɔntinyu: klaynt POST las-rid mɛsej id; node de stoa na `read_receipts` ɛn brodkas.
presence.h2_b: `POST /api/rums/{id}/rid` wit `{las_rid_mɛsej_id}`. Node de ɔpdet `rid_risit(rum_id, yuz_id, mɛsej_id, rid_at)` wit UPSERT sɛmantiks. Brodkas `{tayp:"r", rum, yuza, mɛsej_id, rid_at}`. Klaynt dɛn de rɛnd "seen by N" ɔnda ɔtbaund mɛsej dɛn. Prayvesi: di pɔsin we de yuz am kin disable di risit dɛn ɔltogɛda; den di node nכ de persist fכ dεm AND dεn nכ de si כda pipul dεn risit (symmetric).
presence.h2_c: Rid risit bin kam ɔlsay afta iMessage 2011 ɛn WhatsApp 2014. Di simɛtri lɔ (if yu ayd yu yon, yu nɔ de si ɔda pipul dɛn) na frɔm Telegram 2014 ɛn na di wangren we fɔ avɔyd wan-way sɔvɛlayshɔn chanɛl. Vortex de enfors simetri na di sava — nɔto jɔs di klaynt — so klaynt dɛn we de lay bɔt di flag stil nɔ de gɛt visibiliti.
presence.h3_a: Las-si na wan singl fɔ ɛni yuza tɛmstamp, we dɛn de ɔpdet pan ɛvri WebSocket freym ɛn ol we nɔ freym nɔ kam.
presence.h3_b: Node de trak `presence.last_seen_at` as yuniks ms. Updated pan ɛvri ɔthɛntiket WebSocket freym frɔm da yuza de. Rid via `GET /api/yuz/{id}/prɛzɛns`. Sabskripshɔn via `{type:"sub_presence", user}` fɔ gɛt layv push pan chenj. Granularity na yuz-kɔnfigyut: ɛksaktɔ tɛmstamp, rawnd to 5 min, rawnd to 1 h, "risanli", ɔ ɔf.
presence.h3_c: Granularity tiers de tray to WhatsApp in 2012 prayvet ɔpdet afta kɔmplen bɔt las-siin stalking. Telegram insay 2013 ad di "rεsεntli / insay wan wik / insay wan mכnt" bכkit dεm. Vortex in 5 min / 1 h / "rεsεntli" de εko Telegram. Di "off" opshɔn de simɛtrik wan ayd di yuza fɔ si ɔda pipul dɛn las-si fɔ di sem rizin lɛk rid risit.
presence.h4_a: Onlayn indikɛtɔ: wan yuza de "onlayn" if dɛn gɛt at le wan layv WebSocket pan ɛni wan pan dɛn divays.
presence.h4_b: Node kip `active_ws_count(user_id)` na mɛmori. Inkrimεnt pan WS כpgrεd, dεkrεshכn pan klos. `onlayn = aktif_ws_kɔunt(yuz_id) > 0`. Visible to contacts only — non-contacts si las-seen (subject to granularity) bɔt nɔ ɛva di layf grɛn dɔt. Chenj ivent faya wen di kaunt kros ziro in eni dairekshon.
presence.h4_c: Kontakt-onli visibiliti na di mɔdel we ɛvri siriɔs mɛsenja dɔn sɛtul pan afta bɔku bɔku stalk insidɛnt (WhatsApp 2014, Telegram 2015). Fɔs Vortex mek ɔlman si am na di intanɛt; wi flip di difɔlt afta wan beta rivyuɔ pɔynt se pɔblik rum dɛn go lik prɛzɛns fɔ tawzin strenja dɛn to tawzin ɔda strenja dɛn.
presence.h3_f:
granulariti: 1. .
  ekzakt → ritɔn las_we dɛn si_na
  5_min → ritɔn ⌊las_si_na / 300000⌋ · 300000
  1_awa → ritɔn ⌊las_si_na / 3600000⌋ · 3600000
  rεsεntεnt → ritɔn 'rεsεntli' if (naw - las_seen_at) < 7d else 'long ago'.
  ɔf → ritɔn nul; dis yuza tu no kin si oda pipul
presence.h4_f:
onlayn(u) = (|{ws ∈ opin_ws : ws.yuz_id == u}| > 0)
visibility: kɔntakt-onli (nɔ-kɔntakt si las-siin nɔmɔ)
chenj ivent faya iff onlain(u) transishɔn 0 ↔ 1

calls.title: WebRTC kɔl dɛn
calls.subtitle: Voys + vidio, 1: 1 ɛn grup, signal ova WebSocket, rilay via coturn.
calls.intro: Vortex de yuz di stok WebRTC stak. Node na signal-onli. Wans dɛn kɔmpin dɛn kɔnɛkt dɛn ICE kandidet dɛn, di midia de flɔ dairekt (pi-to-piɔ) ɔ tru di TURN rilay pan bad NAT.
calls.h1p1: Di pɔsin we kɔl: `POST /api/kɔl/{rum_id}/start` wit `{vidio: bool, ɔdio: bool}`. Node de alɔkat wan kɔl_id, brodkas `{tayp:"c", kayn:"invayt", kɔl_id, vidio, ɔdio}` to rum.
calls.h1p2: Di pɔsin we dɛn kɔl aksept: `POST /api/kɔl/{kɔl_id}/aksept` → `{tayp:"c", kayn:"aksept"}`.
calls.h1p3: Ɔfa/ansa ɛkshɛnj: `{kayn:"ɔfa", sdp:...}` → `{kayn:"ansa", sdp:...}` → `{kayn:"kandidet", ays:...}` × N te dɛn kɔnɛkt am.
calls.h1p4: Kɔl dɔn: `POST /api/kɔl/{kɔl_id}/ɛnd`. Ɛni say kin hang ɔp. Node de rikodɔ `kɔl_rɛkɔd(kɔl_id, durayshɔn_dɛn, vidio, ɔdio, pati dɛn)`.
calls.h2p1: Serva Intaraktiv Kɔnektiviti Ɛstablishmɛnt. Pipul dɛn kin chenj kandidet dɛn (ɔs, srflx, prflx, rilay).
calls.h2p2: STUN: we dɛn bɔnd wit kɔtɔn. Stun-onli mod we dɛn yuz fɔ simɛtrik-NAT ditekshɔn.
calls.h2p3: TURN: coturn wit HMAC-sayn shɔt layf kredibiliti. Each kol get fresh creds valid fo 24 h.
calls.h2p4: Kredibiliti: `{yuz nem: <taymstamp>:<yuz_id>, paswɔd: base64(HMAC-SHA1(sikrit, yuz nem))}`. Standart RFC 5389 layout.
calls.h3p1: Odio: Opus 48 kHz vayriɔbul bitrɛt (6-128 kbps). DTX on fɔ silɛns sɔpreshɔn.
calls.h3p2: Vidio: VP9 (dɛn kin lɛk am) / H.264 / AV1 (opt-in). Simulcast fɔ grup kɔl: di pɔsin we de kɔl de ɛnkɔd tri rizɔlt dɛn wan tɛm.
calls.h3p3: FEC: ɔltɛm de on fɔ ɔdio; fɔ vidio if bitrate edrum alaw.
calls.h4p1: Fɔ > 2 patisipan dɛn, Vortex de spawn wan SFU (Sɛlektiv Fɔwad Yunit) na di no. Ɛni patisipan de ɔplod wan tɛm, SFU fans aut.
calls.h4p2: Naw, na ɔdio-onli te to 100 patisipan dɛn; vidio grup dɛn we dɛn kap na 8 insay v0.1 (vidio SFU hardening in v0.3 rodmap).
calls.h4p3: SFU de yuz di sem koturn rilay fɔ traversal; no ɔda savis nɔ nid fɔ de.
calls.h5p1: Na yu kin yuz `getDisplayMedia`. Klaynt ad nyu trak to di PiaKɔnɛkshɔn we dɔn de; rinegoshiet ɔf/ansa.
calls.h5p2: Di wan dɛn we de gɛt di fim kin rɛnd di skrin we dɛn sheb as wan sɛpret vidio trak. Na mobayl, skrin sherin nid OS-lɛvɛl pɔmishɔn — iOS prɔmpt, Andrɔyd de sho wan sistɛm dayalɔg.
calls.h6p1: WebRTC in bilt-in NetEQ de handle loss ɛn jitter. We i rili pwɛl di klaynt kin drɔp rizɔlt ɔ disable di vidio ɔltogɛda we i de kip di odio layf.
calls.h6p2: Wan 500 ms friz de trigεr wan rikonekt tray (ICE ristart). Di wan dɛn we de yuz am de si "Reconnecting..." ɔvlay.
calls.h1_a: Kɔl signalin de rayd di sem WebSocket we dɛn kin yuz fɔ chat. Node na signal-onli — i de brok SDP ɛn ICE bitwin in kɔmpin bɔt i nɔ de ɛva tɔch di midia.
calls.h1_b: Di pɔsin we de kɔl de POST `/api/kɔl/{rum_id}/start` wit `{vidio, ɔdio}`. Node de alɔkat `kɔl_id`, brodkas `{tayp:"c", kayn:"invayt", kɔl_id, vidio, ɔdio}` to di rum. Di pɔsin we dɛn kɔl de post `/api/kɔl/{kɔl_id}/aksept` → `{tayp:"c", kayn:"aksept"}`. SDP ɔf/ansa ɛkshɛnj: `{kayn:"ɔfa", sdp}` → `{kayn:"ansa", sdp}`. ICE kandidet dɛm: `{kind:"kandidet", ays}` × N te PiaKɔnɛkshɔn ripɔt `kɔnekt`.
calls.h1_c: SDP + ICE signal na di standad WebRTC patεn we dεn dεskrεb na RFC 8839 εn 8841. Vortex nכ de invent nכtin ya; na di sem flɔ Chrome, Firefox, ɛn ɛvri WebRTC laybri implimɛnt. Di node-as-signalling-only choice kɔmɔt frɔm di rializashɔn se SFU-stayl midia fɔwad tay ɔp bandwid ɛn nid hadwɔd we wi nɔ want fɔ ship na di bays instɔl.
calls.h2_a: ICE de fɛn wan rod tru NAT dɛn we de yuz ɔs + sava-riflɛsɛf + rilay kandidet dɛn. koturn handel STUN εn TURN na di Vortex sayd.
calls.h2_b: Ɛni piɔ de enumɛret kandidet dɛn: ɔs (lɔkal IP dɛn), srflx (sava-riflɛsɛf via STUN), rilay (TURN-alɔkat). Pipul dɛn we de kɔmpin dɛn kin chenj ɔl di kandidet dɛn; εvri pe de fכm wan "pa", kכnektiviti chεk de sεnd wan STUN binding rεkεshכn ova UDP. Fɔs saksesful pe kin bi di rod we dɛn dɔn pik. Bihayn simetrik NAT, na di rilay pe nɔmɔ de wok — na da tɛm de di TURN rilay rili de rilay midia.
calls.h2_c: ICE bin standad as RFC 5245 insay 2010 ɛn dɛn bin rifresh am as RFC 8445 insay 2018. Bihayn wan kyaria-grɛd-NAT, STUN de fel lɛk 15 % pan di tɛm ɛn TURN nɔ go ebul fɔ avɔyd. coturn na di rɛfrɛns opin-sɔs TURN sava; wi ship am bikɔs di ɔda we (kɔmɛshɔnal Twilio/Vonage TURN) de kɔst fɔ wan minit fɔ rilay ɔdio.
calls.h3_a: TURN kredibiliti na shɔt-layv HMAC-sayn yuzɛn nem/paswɔd pe we dɛn gi fɔ ɛni kɔl, nɔto sikrit we de liv lɔng.
calls.h3_b: We kɔl stat, node de jenarayz `yuz nem = "<ɛkspiri_yuniks>:<yuz_id>"` ɛn `paswɔd = bays64(HMAC-SHA1(sava_sikrit, yuzɛn nem))`. Dɛn tu gɛt TTL 24 h. Klaynt de yuz dɛn na in RTCPeerConnection kɔnfig. coturn de verify di HMAC na seshɔn sɛtup. Di kred dɛn we dɔn dɔn de fel di HMAC chɛk — dɛn kin stɔp fɔ wok ɔtomɛtik wan we nɔ gɛt rivokeshɔn database.
calls.h3_c: Short-lived HMAC creds kɔmɔt frɔm RFC 5389 (STUN) ɛn na di patɛn we ɛvri prodakshɔn WebRTC diploymɛnt de yuz. Twilio, Google, Xirsys ɔl de du am. Di ɔltɛrnativ — statik TURN kred — de lik if ɛni klaynt kɔmprɔmis. Short-lived creds limit di damej winda to 24 h.
calls.h4_a: Odio na Opus na 48 kHz wit DTX; vidio na VP9 praymari / H.264 fɔlbak / AV1 opt-in.
calls.h4_b: Odio: Opus 48 kHz, 6-128 kbps VBR. DTX (Discontinuous Transmission) de stɔp fɔ sɛn we yu nɔ de tɔk, i de bigin bak pan vɔys. FEC pan ɔltɛm. Vidio: VP9 na di beslayn; H.264 advatayz fɔ divays dɛn we nɔ gɛt hadwae VP9 dikɔd (iOS bifo A10 Bionic); AV1 we dɛn de gi as opt-in fɔ prɛmiɔm pan mɔdan hadwae. Simulcast fɔ grup kɔl: pɔsin we de kɔl de ɛnkɔd tri rizɔlt dɛn wan tɛm, SFU fans aut di rayt wan to ɛni pɔsin we de wach.
calls.h4_c: Opus na IETF in royalti-fri ɔdio kɔdɛk (RFC 6716, 2012). VP9 na Google in opin H.265-ikwivalɛnt. H.264 na fɔlbak bikɔs Apple bin ol ɔut pan VP9 sɔpɔt te 2021. AV1 bin bi viable pan fon afta di iPhone 15 Pro (2023) ɛn Pixel 8 (2023) ad hadwae dikɔd. Vortex in kɔdɛks miks na di sem Google Mit yuz.
calls.h5_a: Grup kɔl dɛn de yuz wan SFU (Sɛlektiv Fɔwad Yunit) na di node. Ɛni wan pan di wan dɛn we tek pat kin ɔplod wan tɛm; SFU fɔwad to ɔlman.
calls.h5_b: Fɔ > 2 kɔmpin dɛn di pɔsin we de kɔl de post `/api/calls/{room_id}/group/start`. Node spin op wan SFU instans we baund to di kol. Ɛni patisipan opin wan PiaKɔnɛkshɔn to di SFU instead ɔf to ɛvri ɔda piɔ. Uplink: ɛni wan de sɛn 1 strim. Daunlink: SFU fɔwad N-1 strim dɛn. Simulcast layers min se SFU pik di rizolyushon we fit to each viewer in available bandwidth.
calls.h5_c: SFU akitekchɔ de frɔm Jitsi in Vidiobrij (2013). Bifo SFU, WebRTC grup kɔl dɛn bin ful-mɛsh — ɛni piɔ bin kɔd N-1 strim dɛn, we de skel kwadratik wan. Zum, Google Mit, Jitsi, Sayn grup kɔl ɔl yuz SFU. Vortex ɔdio-onli grup kɔl dɛn we dɛn ship insay v0.0.8; vidio grup kɔl dɛn de na di v0.3 rodmap.
calls.h6_a: Skrin sherin na nyu midia trak na di PiaKɔnɛkshɔn we de naw, we dɛn rinegoshiet tru ɔf/ansa.
calls.h6_b: Yuz tap Sheb Skrin → brawza / iOS / Andrɔyd kɔl `getDisplayMedia()`. Ritɔn MediaStream na adTrack-ed to di PiaKɔnɛkshɔn. Rinegoshieshɔn faya: nyu ɔf/ansa wit di ad trak. Di wan dɛn we de gɛt di fim kin rɛnd di skrin we dɛn sheb as sɛpret vidio ɛlimɛnt. Na iOS, skrin sherin nid Brodkas Uplod Ɛkstenshɔn; na Andrɔyd, na fɔgrɔn savis + MediaProjection pɔmishɔn.

federation.title: Fɛdareshɔn
federation.subtitle: Trusted pubkeys, sayn gɔsip, kros-node DM dɛn.
federation.intro: Fɛdareshɔn de mek yuza dɛn na node A mɛsej yuza dɛn na node B. Na opt-in fɔ ɛni ɔpreshɔn. Node pubkeys dɛn kin trɔst klia wan; no otomatik "eni node kin fedaret wit mi" mod de.
federation.h1p1: Ɛni node de mentɛn `fedareshɔn(pubkey, ɛndpɔynt, wɛlbɔdi_skɔ, ad_at, ad_bay)`.
federation.h1p2: Fɔ ad wan kɔmpin nid fɔ mek di ɔpreshɔn sayn admin akshɔn. Di admin UI de sho di rimot in finga prɛnt so di ɔpreshɔn dɛn kin verify aut-ɔf-band.
federation.h1p3: Pipul dɛn we dɛn dɔn pul de stil de na DB we dɛn mak `revoked_at` fɔ ɔdit. Nyu fedareshɔn rikwest frɔm di sem pubkey dɛn kin rijɛkt te wan admin un-rivok.
federation.h2p1: Outbound frɔm A to user@B: node A de rap di mɛsej ɛnvilɔp insay wan sayn blob ɛn POST `/federation/deliver` pan node B.
federation.h2p2: Envlop: `{sɔs_nɔd, target_yuz, insay_sayfatɛks, insay_nɔns, sɛn_at, sig}`. Sig de kɔba ɔltin pas sig insɛf.
federation.h2p3: Node B de verify sayn agens `source_node` pubkey frɔm in `federations` tebul. Invalid sig → 401 + ɔdit ivin.
federation.h3p1: If B nɔ ebul fɔ rich, A de kiyu na `federation_outbox(target_node, payload, atɛmpt, nɛks_ritray_at)`.
federation.h3p2: Ekspɔnɛnshal bak-ɔf: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, kap na 6h. I nɔ kin wok fɔ ɔltɛm afta 14 dez.
federation.h3p3: Opareshɔn alert faya we ɔtbɔks dip > 1000 mɛsej — de sho se fedareshɔn link dɔn stɔp.
federation.h4: Di we aw dɛn de wach di wɛlbɔdi biznɛs
federation.h4p1: εvri 60 s εvri node de ping `GET /v1/health` pan εvri peer. Rispɔns tɛm + stetɔs we dɛn trak.
federation.h4p2: Ɛlth skɔ: initial 100. Ɛni tɛm we dɔn pas de pul 1; ɛni sakses de ad 1 (kap 100). Skɔ 0 → fedareshɔn stɔp fɔ da kɔmpin de.
federation.h4p3: Published via `GET /v1/peers` fɔ ɔpreshɔn dashbɔd dɛn.
federation.h1_a: Fɛdareshɔn in Vortex na mutual-trust rilayshɔn bitwin tu node ɔpreshɔn. Ɛni node de pablish wan 32-bayt Ed25519 pɔblik ki; di ɔda node ad am to wan `trusted_nodes` tebul nia in ɛndpɔynt ɛn wan wɛlbɔdi skɔ.
federation.h1_b: Fɔ ad wan pɔbki we yu kin trɔst, i nid fɔ mek di ɔpreshɔn sayn wan admin riŋwe wit di node in yon rilis ki. Di UI de sho di rimot in finga prɛnt insay 64-hɛks-char fɔm so admin dɛn kin verify aut ɔf band. We dɛn ad am, dɛn kin chɛk ɛvri inbaund fedareshɔn ɛnvilɔp agens da pubkey in Ed25519 sayn de — dɛn kin no fɔj wantɛm wantɛm ɛn dɛn kin log am. Rivokeshɔn na saf: di rɔw de de mak `revoked_at` fɔ ɔdit, bɔt di ɛnvilɔp sayn naw nɔ de wok.
federation.h1_c: Di patɛn kɔmɔt frɔm Matrix in fedareshɔn (we ɛvri sava de advatayz wan sayn ki ɛn ɛvri ivin de sayn wit am) ɛn frɔm imel in DKIM (we DNS de pablish di sayn pabki). Matrix pruv se di mכdel de wok pan skel — dεn nεtwכk gεt ova 100k fedaret sava dεm. Vortex in vεryכnt difrεnt bay we i nid εksplisit mכtalman opt-in insted כf Matrix in "εni sava kin fεdεrayt bay difכlt" rul; wi bin tred konvinyens fo wan strong difens agenst rogue federeshon.
federation.h1_f:
trɔst_nɔd dɛn row:
  pubkey : 32 bayt Ed25519. Di wan dɛn we de wok
  ɛndpɔynt : https://...
  hεlth_skɔ : int [0, 100] .
  added_at : yuniks_ms
  added_by : admin_yuz_id
  rivoked_at : yuniks_ms | NULL .
federation.h2_a: Wan krɔs-nod mɛsej de rayd di sem E2E ɛnvilɔp lɛk wan lokal wan, we dɛn rap insay wan sayn ɔda ɛnvilɔp we de ɔtɛnɛtik di node we de sɛn to di node we de tek am.
federation.h2_b: Node A want fɔ deliv to yuz@B. Step 1: A de sirializ `{sɔs_nɔd, target_yuz, insay_sayfatɛks, insay_nɔns, sɛn_at}`. Step 2: A sayn di serialized bytes wit in Ed25519 prayvet ki → `sig`. Step 3: A POST di tuple to `POST /federation/deliver` pan node B. Step 4: B luk op `source_node` insay in `trusted_nodes`, verify `sig`, chɛk `sent_at` agens riplay-window, ɛn persist di insay ɛnvilɔp na in lokal `messages` tebul. Di klaynt we de tek am de si am jɔs lɛk lokal mɛsej — di fedareshɔn layt nɔ de si to di ɛnd yuza dɛn.
federation.h2_c: Di ɔta sayn ɛnvilɔp dɛn borrow am frɔm Matrix in `m.room.message` fedareshɔn ivin dɛm. Di riplay winda (5 minit) ɛn di rikwaymɛnt fɔ mek sɔs-sayn tɛmstamp dɛn mach di wɔl klok, dɛn borrow am frɔm DKIM. Ali Vortex (v0.0.2) bin tray fɔ mek fedareshɔn we nɔ sayn wit TLS klaynt sɛt; wi swich to payload signatures in v0.0.5 afta wi rialize klaynt certs nɔ de sev frɔm lod balansa ɛn ayd di aktual ɔthɛntishɔn frɔm di aplikeshɔn layt.
federation.h3_a: We di rimot node nɔ ebul fɔ rich, di node we de sɛn de kiyu di ɛnvilɔp insay in `federation_outbox` ɛn tray bak wit ɛkspɔnɛnshal bak-ɔf.
federation.h3_b: Bak-off schedule: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, kap na 6h. Na ɛni fayl tray di row in `attempt` kɔlɔm inkrimɛn ɛn `next_retry_at` de sɛt to naw + kɔrɛnt-stɛp. Wan bakgrɔn woka (`app/federation/outbox_worker.py`) de wek ɛvri 5 s ɛn pik row dɛn usay `next_retry_at <= naw()`. Sakses de dilit di row; 14 dez we i nɔ wok de mak am fɔ ɔltɛm ɛn sɛn admin alert.
federation.h3_c: Ekspɔnɛnshal bak-ɔf wit siling na di sem patɛn we Kafka de yuz fɔ prodyusɔ ritray ɛn SMTP de yuz fɔ bounced mail. Di 14-de kap de mach SMTP in RFC 5321 rɛkɛmɔndeshɔn. Fɔs vɛshɔn dɛn bin de yuz fiks 60-sɛkɔn ritray we bin de mek tɛnda-hɛd spayk dɛn we wan kɔmpin kam bak ɔnlayn afta wan ɔtjɛj; eksponensial spred fiks dat in v0.0.7.
federation.h3_f:
dilay(n) = min(6h, 1s · 2ⁿ) fɔ n = 0, 1, 2, ...

ri-tray schedule: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 32s, 64s, 128s, 256s, ..., 6h
alert: ɔtbɔks_dip > 1000 fɔ > 5 min
federation.h4_a: εvri 60 sekכnd εvri node de ping εvri peer in `/v1/health` εndpכynt. Skɔ drift ɔp pan sakrifays, dɔŋ pan fayl, bɔund insay [0, 100].
federation.h4_b: Skor stat na 100 pan ad. Ɛni sakrifays ad +1 (kap na 100), ɛni tɛm aut de pul -1 (flɔ na 0). Skɔ 0 de stɔp fedareshɔn to da piɔ de — nyu mɛsej dɛn de kiyu na ɔtbɔks, nɔ nyu ɔtbaund delivri tray te di skɔ klaym bak ɔp 20. Di skɔ de ɛksplɔz via `GET /v1/peers` fɔ ɔpreshɔn dashbɔd ɛn via `/metrics` fɔ Prometheus. Sɔdan skɔ drɔp akɔdin to bɔku kɔmpin dɛn insay wan shɔt winda de trig wan "nɛtwɔk patishɔn sɔspɛkt" alɛt.
federation.h4_c: Di AIMD-stayl skɔ na inspɛkt frɔm TCP in kɔnjɛshɔn winda ɛn Akamai in wɛlbɔdi-chɛk dampa. di asimεtrik ±1 stεp (insted כf di TCP halving) de mek rεkכvεshכn slo pas fεil, we de bias di sistεm tכwεd kכshכn — wi go bεtε fכ pכz fεdareshכn we wi nכ sכri pas fכ sεnd dupliket mεsej tru wan flap link. Add in v0.0.6 afta wan misbehaving peer flod tu gud peer wit retries.
federation.h4_f:
pan sakses: skor = min(100, skor + 1)
pan taym ɔut: skɔ = maks(0, skɔ - 1)
if skor == 0: pause_federeshɔn(piɔ) .
if skor >= 20: risum_federeshɔn(piɔ) // histeresis

gossip.title: Gossip ɛn kɔmpin diskvayri
gossip.subtitle: Aw di no dɛm de fɛn dɛnsɛf we nɔ gɛt sɛntral rɛjista.
gossip.intro: biyכn di kכntrola in atεst list, Vortex no dεm de gכsip piεr dεm bitwin dεn sεf. Dis de diskɔba nyu no dɛm as di ɔpreshɔn dɛn de spin dɛn ɔp, ivin if di kɔntrolɔ nɔ atɛst dɛn yet.
gossip.h1p1: Ɛvri 60 s, node de pik wan random piɔ ɛn sɛn wan 256-bit Blɔm filta fɔ piɔ we dɛn sabi. Pipul dɛn kin ansa wit di kɔmpin dɛn NOT na di filta, plus in yon filta. Bandwidth na `O(nyu piɔs × 32 bayt)`, tipikli ɔnda 1 KiB fɔ wan rawnd.
gossip.h1p2: Ɛni kɔmpin we dɛn advatayz, di advatayzmɛnt node de sayn am. Klaynt dɛn kin chɛk sayn dɛn pan fɔs kɔntakt — pɔsin we atak nɔ kin ebul fɔ fɔj in kɔmpin insay di gɔsip.
gossip.h1p3: Di rawnd na rεt-limited: wan εkshεnj pan wan piεr pan 30 s (slaydin winda).
gossip.h2p1: Nyu node dɛn kin stat wit 8 hadkɔd butstrap kɔntrol dɛn. Fɔs gɔsip rawnd diskɔba dɔzɛn kɔmpin dɛn; di netwok de kכnvεrj insay ~1 minit.
gossip.h2p2: Butstrap list na tin we pɔsin kin ɛdit bay `.env` `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=pubkey1@endpoint1,pubkey2@endpoint2,...`.
gossip.h3p1: Ɛni kɔmpin we dɛn advatayz fɔ gɛt sayn wit di ɔpreshɔn in Ed25519 rilis ki. Fɔ mek yu kɔmpin anɔnsmɛnt, yu nid fɔ tif wan valid ki.
gossip.h3p2: Pruf-ɔf-wok (adjɔstabl, difɔlt 2^18 lida ziro) pan nyu piɔ rɛjista de kip bɔlk Sybil-bɔt wev dɛn nɔ prɛktikal.
gossip.h3p3: Reputeshɔn sistɛm: dɛn kɔmpin dɛn we de biev bad (bad sayn, fɔj anɔnsmɛnt, ripit tɛm aut) kin gɛt dɛn reputeshɔn rɔtin. Ziro reputeshɔn → blaklist.
gossip.h1_a: Ɛvri 60 s ɛni node de pik wan random piɔ ɛn sɛn wan 256-bit Blɔm filta we de sɔma di piɔ dɛn we dɛn sabi. Pipul dɛn kin ansa wit nyu kɔmpin dɛn + in yon filta. Bandwidth na `O(nyu_pi dɛn × 32 bayt)`.
gossip.h1_b: Blɔm filta k=5 hash, m=256 bit. Node A de insay ɔl in peer_ids we i sabi. Sen to peer B. B de aks di filta wit ɛni wan pan in kɔmpin; enitin we mis, B de sen to A (plus in own filta). A de du di sem chɛk insay rivays. afta di εkshεnj di tu no dεm de sheb roughly di sem no. Tipik ɛkshɛnj: 200-800 bayt. Ɔpdet dɛn kin kɔnvɛrj akɔdin to di nɛtwɔk insay ~5 rawnd (5 minit) tank to di gɔsip prɔpati.
gossip.h1_c: Blɔm-filta gɔsip de frɔm Kɔnɛl in 1998 bimodal maltikɔst pepa. Apache Cassandra de yuz am fɔ bi mɛmba; Bitcoin fɔ transakshɔn rilay; IPFS fɔ DHT mentenɛns. Di O(log N) kɔnvɛgshɔn prɔpati na wetin mek am gud fit fɔ wi yus — wi nɔ nid glob ɔl views, jɔs eventually-consistent peer knowledge. Filta saiz (256 bits) de tun so fals-positiv rεt na < 1 % na 100 piεr.
gossip.h2_a: Nyu node dɛn kin stat wit 8 hadkɔd butstrap kɔntrol dɛn. Fɔs gɔsip rawnd diskɔba mɔ; konvεrj in ~1 minit.
gossip.h2_b: `.env` de ship wit `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=pubkey1@ɛndpɔynt1,pubki2@ɛndpɔynt2,...`. We yu stat, node de tray ɛni wan insay ɔda. Fɔs fɔ ansa de gi wan initial piɔ list (via `GET /v1/trusted_nodes`). Node insert dem insay in lokal piers tebul, mak dem as bootstrapped, en stat di 60 s gossip loop. Raun dɛn we kin kam afta dat kin diskɔba peers-of-peers.
gossip.h2_c: Hadkod butstrap na di sem patɛn Bitcoin, Ethereum, IPFS yuz. di כda we — DHT-bεys fכ diskכvri — nid fכ fכs fכ εntri εni we. Vortex in 8 butstrap kaunt bin pik bikɔs fɔ gɛt > 4 de gi resilience agens 2-3 simultaneous downtime events, ɛn < 16 de kip di `.env` fayl ridabl. Adjɔst fɔ ɛni-diploymɛnt bay we yu ɛdit `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS`.
gossip.h3_a: Ɛni kɔmpin we dɛn advatayz fɔ gɛt sayn bay in ɔrijin ɔpreshɔn in Ed25519 rilis ki. Wan pɔsin we atak nɔ kin ebul fɔ mek in kɔmpin dɛn na di nɛtwɔk.
gossip.h3_b: We node A advatayz piɔ P insay gɔsip to node B, A inklud `P.pubkey`, `P.endpoint`, ɛn wan tɛmstamp, ɔl dɛn sayn bay P in yon rilis ki. B verify di sayn bifo i trɔst P. If B leta kɔntakt P ɛn P in TLS cert + fɔs at bit nɔ mach di advatayz pubkey, di advatayzmɛnt de mak pɔyzin ɛn prɔpagɛt dɔŋ.
gossip.h3_c: Sayn piɔ advatayzmɛnt na standad anti-Sybil primitiv frɔm Chord (2001) ɛn Kademlia (2002). Bitcoin in addr mɛsej dɛn de yuz wan wik mɔdel (nɔ gɛt sayn, i de abop pan kɔnɛkshɔn kɔst as Sybil ditɛrɛnt); Ethereum in diskv5 sayn dɛn. Vortex adopt sayn advatayzmɛnt dɛn na v0.0.6 afta wan testnet atak pɔsin advatayz 1000 fek kɔmpin dɛn tru wan singl lɛjitimɛnt node.
gossip.h1_f:
filta: k=5, m=256 bit
insert(x) = fɔ i insay 0..k: filta [hash_i (x) mod m] = 1
kweshon(x) = fo i in 0..k: chek filta[hash_i(x) mod m].
fals-positiv na 100 pier, 256 bit, k=5: ~0.4 %
gossip.h2_f:
.env: .
  BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=abcd...@https://a.ɛgzampul,efgh...@https://b.ɛgzampul

statap: .
  fɔ piɔ na BOOTSTRAP_PEERS:
    tray: peers ← peer.get ('/v1/trusted_nodes'); brek
    pas nɔmɔ: kɔntinyu
  stat gɔsip lɔp
gossip.h3_f:
advatayzmɛnt = {pɔbki, ɛndpɔynt, advatayz_na}
sig = Ed25519-Sayn (pubkey_priv, CBOR(advatayzmɛnt))
gɔsip peylɔd: [..., {ad, sig}, ...]
