stealth.title: Stealth nɛtwɔk
stealth.subtitle: Fayv layers, 28 mɛkanism dɛn. Ɔltin frɔm TLS padding to Tor anɔynt savis.
stealth.intro: Vortex de tek am se na neshɔn-stet-grɛd ɛnimi. Di stɔl stak de layt so ivin we dɛn baypas di ɔda layt dɛn, di wan dɛn we de insay stil de gi savis we dɔn pwɛl-bɔt we de wok.
stealth.h1p1: Layer 1 — finga prɛnt nɔmalizeshɔn. Stɔp pasiv klasafayda dɛn.
stealth.h1p2: Layer 2 — shep / saiz mɔf. Stɔp trafik-analysis klasafayda dɛn.
stealth.h1p3: Layer 3 — protɔkɔl kamoflaj. Stɔp fɔ aktif DPI.
stealth.h1p4: Layer 4 — transpɔt dɛn we dɛn kin plɔg. Wok na netwok we de blok wi praymari.
stealth.h1p5: Layer 5 — las-rεsכt fכlbak. Onion, BMP, rilay we gɛt bɔku bɔku hop. I de wok we natin nɔ de du am.
stealth.h2p1: TLS 1.3 ClientHello de mach Chrome na Windows 11 bayt-fɔ-bayt. JA3/JA4 hash de mach Chrome 120 — nɔ Vortex-spɛsifi k finga prɛnt.
stealth.h2p2: Rikɔd-layer padding: ɔl di TLS rɛkɛd dɛn pad to 16 KB. Paket saiz dɛn de mach bɔku bɔku brawza trafik.
stealth.h2p3: Kɔnstant-rɛyt sɛn: kiyu de ɛmit wan freym ɛvri N ms ilɛksɛf di aplikeshɔn aktiviti. Idle periods emit dummy frames we dɛn mak insay di insay ɛnvilɔp so di wan dɛn we de gɛt dɛn kin trowe dɛn.
stealth.h2p4: Timing jitter: 0-50 ms random dilay pan egres fɔ win latɛns-bɛs DPI.
stealth.h3p1: YouTube-720p morfer: paket-sayz distribyushɔn, bɔrst kadɛns, ɛn saylɛns gap dɛn de mach wan YouTube layv strim. Klasifa dɛn we de luk fɔ mɛsenja at bit nɔ de mach.
stealth.h3p2: Multipath: di sem fכlכ split ova Wi-Fi, sεlyul, εn eni aktv VPN wan tεm. Riassembly na di risiva. Defeat singl-pat shep.
stealth.h3p3: WebRTC data chanɛl tanɛl: we dɛn blok TLS bɔt WebRTC de wok, Vortex de tanɛl tru wan DTLS-SRTP chanɛl to wan kɔmpin we dɛn sabi.
stealth.h3p4: Dikɔy kɔnɛkshɔn: 3 lɔng-layf idɔl TLS sɛshɔn to Google, YouTube, ɛn Cloudflare. Obsava de si nɔmal brawza bihayvya.
stealth.h4p1: DoH (RFC 8484): ɔl DNS rizolt via DoH to Cloudflare / Google / Kwad9. ISP de si HTTPS nɔmɔ to dɛn rizɔlt dɛn de, nɔto di aktual domɛyn list.
stealth.h4p2: ECH (Encrypted Client Hello): SNI enkript wit wan ki we dɛn pablish na di DNS HTTPS rɛkɛd. Pasiv ɔbzhɔva dɛn nɔ kin si di dɛstineshɔn ɔs nem.
stealth.h4p3: Probe ditekshɔn: node de trak rikwest dɛn we nɔ gɛt ɔth sɛshɔn. Tri fail prob frכm wan IP insay 5 min trigεr di "decoy site" mod — dat IP naw de si wan plain HTML landing pej wit 200 OK.
stealth.h4p4: DGA (Domain Generation Algorithm): ditɛministic domɛyn jenɛratɔ we dɛn sid wit tide in de. If dɛn blok praymari ɛndpɔynt, di klaynt dɛn kin kɔmpyutayt di nɛks kandidet ɛn tray.
stealth.h5: Level 4 — Transpɔt dɛn we dɛn kin plɔg
stealth.h5p1: vmess / vless / trojan / shadowtls: standad V2Ray-stayl transpɔt wit wan JSON kɔnfig we yu kin plɔg.
stealth.h5p2: Rialiti: TLS-insay-TLS tanɛl. Ɔta han shek target dɛn www.microsoft.com; insay anshεk na Vortex. di prob dεm we de agens di כta kin fכwכd to Microsoft so aktv prob de sho natin.
stealth.h5p3: Snowflake: volontia brawza dɛn de rilay Vortex trafik oba WebRTC. Di wan dɛn we de instɔl di Snowflake ɛkstenshɔn de gi kɔva.
stealth.h5p4: NaiveProxy: de modify HTTPS probes fɔ blɛnd wit Chromium in yon bihayvya dɔŋ to di maykrosɛkɔnd.
stealth.h6p1: Onion services: evri node de ekspoz insef tu as `.onion`. Klaynt dɛn we gɛt Tor sɔpɔt kin fɔdɔm tru to dis we ɔl ɔda tin nɔ wok.
stealth.h6p2: Blaynd Mɛylbɔks Prɔtokɔlɔ (BMP): anonymous stoa-ɛn-fɔwad fɔ mɛsej. Si BMP chapta.
stealth.h6p3: Multi-hop relay: mɛsej kin bounce tru 5 intamɛdiet no dɛm, ɛvri wan de ad wan layt fɔ ɛnvilɔp. Laik Tor bot in wi own mesh.
stealth.h6p4: OHTTP (RFC 9458): ɔbliviɔs HTTP tru wan rilay. No wan pati nɔ de si ɔl tu di rikwest ɛn di ansa.
stealth.h1_a: Stealth de ɔganayz as fayv indipɛndɛnt layers. Ɛni layt de win difrɛn klas fɔ ɛnimi. Failure fכ wan layεr de dεgrad to di nεks — i nכ de kaskad.
stealth.h1_b: Lay 1 de nכmal wi TLS finga prεnt so pasiv DPI nכ kin klas. Layer 2 morphs trafik shep fɔ luk lɛk strimin. Lay 3 de kamoflaj di protכkכl via ECH / DoH / prob-rεspכns trik dεm. Lay 4 de swich to plɔg transpɔt (vmess, rialiti, Snowflake) we di praymari de aktiv wan blɔk. Lay 5 na las-risɔt: Tor anɔynt, BMP, mɔlti-hop rilay.
stealth.h1_c: Di layt mɔdel kɔmɔt frɔm Tor in plɔg-transpɔt akitɛkɛt (2013). Vortex ad fayv layers insted of Tor in tri bikɔs bay 2025 di advasarial land skay inklud DPI we rɛkɔgnayz Tor in transpɔt dɛnsɛf (Great Firewall 2020, Iran 2022). Ɛni Vortex layt bin introduks afta wan fil insidɛnt: L1 afta Kazakhstan blok (2019-ikwivalɛnt), L2 afta Iran in 2022 krakdaun, L3 afta Chaina in 2020 DoH ditekshɔn, L4 afta Turkey in 2023 blɔk, L5 we dɛn de pripia.
stealth.h1_f:
Advasari klas | Dɛn bin win am bay
------------------ | -----------
pasiv DPI | L1 (finga prɛnt) .
trafik analisis | L2 (shep) .
aktif DPI | L3 (kamuflaj) .
blok bay IP | L4 (transpɔt) .
ɔl ɔda tin | L5 (aniɔn / BMP) .
stealth.h2_a: Lay 1 de mek Vortex trafik nɔ difrɛn frɔm Chrome na Windows 11 na di TLS layt.
stealth.h2_b: ClientHello ɔda, ɛkstenshɔn list, sayfa suit list, ALPN valyu dɛn — ɔl dɛn dɔn tun fɔ mach Chrome 120 in ɛksaktɔ bayt dɛn. JA3/JA4 hash de mach di Chrome rilis we de naw. TLS rεkɔd padding to 16 KB. Konstant-rate sender de emit wan freym evri N ms wit dummy fillers durin idle. Timing jitter 0-50 ms fɔ win latɛns analisis. Dikɔy kɔnɛkshɔn to Google, YouTube, Cloudflare de rɔn na bakgrɔn pan 45 s intaval.
stealth.h2_c: JA3/JA4 finga prɛnt na Salesfors injinia dɛn bin pablish am insay 2017. Bay 2019 i bin standad insay ɛntapraiz DPI. Vortex in finga prɛnt nɔmalizeshɔn de mɔdel pan uTLS, di Go laybri we Snowflake de yuz fɔ di sem tin. Kɔnstant-rɛyt sɛnda na dairekt pɔt fɔ WireGuard in "kɔva trafik" prɔpɔzal.
stealth.h3_a: Lay 2 morphs trafik fɔ luk lɛk bulk strimin midia pas intaraktiv chat.
stealth.h3_b: YouTube-720p morfer: paket-sayz distribyushɔn mach wan 720p YouTube layv strim (ɛmpirikal tebul), bɔrst kadɛns mats, saylɛns gap mach. Multipath: di sem lכjik strim split ova Wi-Fi, sεlyul, εn eni aktv VPN wan tεm; risiva de riassemble in sikwins nɔmba ɔda. WebRTC data chanɛl fɔlbak: we dɛn blok TLS bɔt WebRTC de pas, tanɛl Vortex tru wan DTLS-SRTP data chanɛl to wan kɔmpin we dɛn sabi.
stealth.h3_c: Trafik morphing risach go bak to Wright et al. 2009. Obfs4 impliment am as in "morph" sab-mod in 2014. Meek+domain-fronting tich wi se di shep impɔtant lɛk di ɛnkripshɔn. YouTube-spɛsifi k dɛn pik bikɔs na di singl big sayt we nɔ blok na mɔs ristrikt nɛtwɔk dɛn — fɔ ayd insay YouTube-shep trafik na "ayd insay di krawd".
stealth.h3_f:
paket_sayz[i] ~ P(sayz | YT-720p)
send_delay [i] ~ P(dilay | YT-720p)
dummy_frames we dɛn put insay di tɛm we dɛn nɔ de wok fɔ mek dɛn kɔntinyu fɔ gɛt di ɛnvilɔp shep
stealth.h4_a: Lay 3 de kamoflaj di protכkכl aydentiti insεf — SNI, DNS, rεspכns kכd dεm.
stealth.h4_b: DoH (RFC 8484): ɔl DNS de go tru DNS-ɔva-HTTPS to Cloudflare/Google/Quad9. ISP de si HTTPS nɔmɔ to dɛn rizɔlt dɛn de. ECH (RFC 9460): SNI na enkript wit wan ki we dɛn pablish na di DNS HTTPS rɛkɛd. Pasiv obsכva dεm de si כnli di fכnt-εnd IP. Probe ditekshɔn: no dɛm de trak unauth'd IP dɛm we de hit `/api/*`; tri fεil insay 5 min flip di IP to "decoy mode" — dat IP naw de si wan statik HTML landing pej wit 200 OK. DGA: deterministic domain generator we dɛn sid wit tide in de so klaynt dɛn kin fɛn fɔlbak we dɛn blok di praymari.
stealth.h4_c: DoH bin lanch insay Fayafaks 2018 ɛn bi di difɔlt fɔ Chrome insay 2019. ECH bin go tru fayv draft bifo standadayz insay 2024 — Vortex ship sɔpɔt di tɛm we dɛn bin de draft-13 ɛn naw i de sɔpɔt di fayn spɛshal. Probe-response decoys na borrow frɔm meek in 2014 dizayn ɛn rifin insay 2023 afta Iran in aktif probers dɔn aydentify meek bay in rispɔns timing.
stealth.h5_a: Lay 4 de yuz transpɔt we dɛn kin plɔg — tɔd-pati tanɛl dɛn we tan lɛk ɔda tin ɔltogɛda.
stealth.h5_b: vmess/vless/trojan: standad V2Ray-stayl ɔtbaund transpɔt dɛn; konfig JSON. Rialiti: TLS-insay-TLS tanɛl usay ɔda anshɛk de tɔch www.microsoft.com; insay anshεk na Vortex. Aktiv prob dεm to di כta dεn de fכwad to Microsoft, so prob de sho natin. Snowflake: volontia brawza dɛn de rilay Vortex oba WebRTC; no infra na wi sayd. NaiveProxy: de modify HTTPS probes fɔ blɛnd wit Chromium in ɛksaktɔ bihayvya.
stealth.h5_c: V2Ray in VMess bin introdyus insay 2015 bay di Chaynish anti-sɛnsɔship kɔmyuniti. Trojan launched in 2019. Riality na frɔm 2022 — wan rispɔns to di Gret Fayawɔl in TLS finga prɛnt ditekshɔn. Snowflake na Tor Projek in 2020 riplesmɛnt fɔ obfs4; Vortex ad sɔpɔt insay v0.0.9 afta Iran in 2023 ful-skel blɔk fɔ Tor ɛntrɛ poɛnt.
stealth.h5_f:
rialiti inbaund ɛgzampul:
  savaNem: www.maykrosoft.com
  dest: www.maykrosɔft.kɔm:443
  shɔtId dɛn: ["<random>"].
klaynt kɔnɛkt to wi IP, SNI=www.microsoft.com, wi proksi di rial Microsoft rispɔns
if pat de mach shortId+auth ⇒ rod to Vortex .
stealth.h6_a: Lay 5 na di las-risɔt bag fɔ trik: anɔynt savis, BMP stoa-ɛn-fɔwad, mɔlti-hop rilay, OHTTP.
stealth.h6_b: Ɛvri node de pablish wan `.onion` adrɛs. Klaynt dɛn we gɛt Tor-kapabl ɔs de fɔdɔm tru we TLS + L1-L4 ɔl de fel. BMP (Blind Mailbox Protocol): di pɔsin we sɛn di tin de drɔp wan ɛnkript blob na ɛni node we dɛn ki bay `HKDF(recipient_pubkey, "bmp-v1")`; gɔsip de mek pipul dɛn no bɔt am; di pɔsin we de tek am de pul frɔm dɛn os node. Multi-hop: mɛsej dɛn de bounce tru te to 5 intamɛdiet no dɛm, ɛvri wan de ad wan layt fɔ ɛnvilɔp — lɛk Tor bɔt insay wi yon mɛsh. OHTTP (RFC 9458): oblivious HTTP tru wan rilay so no wan pati nɔ de si ɔl tu di rikwest ɛn rispɔns.
stealth.h6_c: Aniɔn savis de bak to 2004 na Tor. BMP na wi yon invenshɔn, we dɛn mɔdel pan Tor in hiden savis diskrɔptɔ gɔsip. Multi-hop rilay miro Signal in sial-sɛnda plus anɔynt routin. OHTTP na frɔm 2024, na Cloudflare ɛn Apple mek am fɔ privacy-preserving telemetry; wi adopt am na v0.0.9 as di las fallback.
stealth.h6_f:
BMP mɛylbɔks_id = HKDF(di pɔsin we gɛt am, "bmp-v1", 32)
Dipɔsit: POST /bmp/dipɔsit { mɛylbɔks_id, blob }
Pik-ap: GET /bmp/mɛsej dɛn (auth'd)
TTL: 7200 s |  Maks blob: 1 MB |  Maks fɔ ɛni node: 500 MB

bmp.title: Blaynd Mɛylbɔks Prɔtokɔlɔ
bmp.subtitle: Anonymous stoa-ɛn-fɔwad fɔ mɛsej dɛn tru di gɔsip mɛsh.
bmp.intro: BMP de mek pɔsin we de sɛn mɛsej de put mɛsej na ɛni node we nɔ de sho udat i bi. Di mɛsej de gɔsip te i rich di pɔsin in os node, usay i de dikript lɛk aw i kin du.
bmp.h1: Di we aw dɛn de du am
bmp.h1p1: Senda deriv `mailbox_id = HKDF(rɛsipiɛnt_pabki, info: "bmp-v1", len: 32)`. Na di pɔsin nɔmɔ we sɛn am (we sabi recipient_pubkey) kin kɔmpyutayt am; di pɔsin we de tek am sɛf no.
bmp.h1p2: Sender post `POST /bmp/deposit` wit `{mailbox_id, blob}` to ɛni gɔsip node.
bmp.h1p3: Node de stoa pe fɔ te to 7200 s. Node inklud bak di mailbox_id insay nɛks gɔsip rawnd in Blɔm filta.
bmp.h1p4: Ɔda no dɛm de pul blob fɔ mailbox_id dɛm we dɛn lokal bisin bɔt (di wan dɛn we de gɛt na dɛn node).
bmp.h1p5: Di klaynt in klaynt de poll `GET /bmp/messages` ɛn dikript ɛni nyu blob wit in ɔspitul ki matirial.
bmp.h2p1: No node nɔ kin link blob to pɔsin we sɛn — di pɔsin we sɛn in TLS kɔnekshɔn de sho di sɔs IP, bɔt wan chen ɔf anɔynt hop bitwin di pɔsin we sɛn ɛn di fɔs BMP node de pul dat bak.
bmp.h2p2: Risipient-hiding: blob na enkript wit di risipient in pabkey. Midul no dɛm de si ɔl wan opaque bayt string ɛn wan random mailbox_id.
bmp.h2p3: No delivri kɔnfɔmeshɔn to di pɔsin we sɛn am. At-most-wan tɛm sɛmantiks.
bmp.h3p1: Maks blob saiz: 1 MB. Big big peylɔd dɛn fɔ chunk tru di ɔdinari fayl flɔ.
bmp.h3p2: Maks stכrej pan wan node: 500 MB כf dipכsit in tכtal. LRU evikshɔn na kap. Di wan dɛn we de wok kin ebul fɔ tyu.
bmp.h3p3: Spam: per-IP dipɔsit ret limited to 10 / min. Di mɛylbɔks ID dɛn we dɛn obshɔb pas 3 tɛm / awa pan wan node na rit-limited as dɛn saspek flɔd.
bmp.h4p1: Di wan dɛn we gɛt ay sɛns: di pɔsin we sɛn nɔ nid fɔ no di pɔsin in os node.
bmp.h4p2: Intamittent connectivity: blobs de wet te di risipiɛnt ri-kɔnekt ɛn poll.
bmp.h4p3: Anonymous whistleblowing: sender-side onion + BMP = nɔ gɛt mɛtadata bɔt udat put wetin.
bmp.h1_a: BMP na wan anonymous stoa-ɛn-fɔwad layt. Sender drop wan blob na eni gossip-enabled node; di blob de wet na wan mɛyl bɔks we dɛn ki nɔmɔ to di pɔsin we gɛt am in pɔblik ki.
bmp.h1_b: Sender kompyut `mailbox_id = HKDF(rɛsipiɛnt_pabki, "bmp-v1", 32)`. Na pɔsin nɔmɔ we sabi `recipient_pubkey` kin kɔmpyutayt am — di pɔsin we gɛt am no, di pɔsin we sɛn am no, tɔd pati nɔ no. Senda de POST `{mailbox_id, blob}` to ɛni node we de gɔsip. Node de stoa di pe fɔ te 7200 s (2 h), ɛn anɔys di mailbox_id na di nɛks gɔsip ɛkshɛnj Blɔm filta. Ɔda no dɛm we si di mailbox_id lokal wan de mach wan yuza in kesh mɛylbɔks de pul di blob ɛn fɔwad to da yuza in klaynt.
bmp.h1_c: BMP na di Vortex tim bin disayn am frɔm skrach. Wi bil am bikɔs no men mɛsenja nɔ bin rɛdi fɔ spɛn di risɔs dɛn we dɛn nid fɔ ayd mɛtadata ɛnd-to-ɛnd — ɛvri siriɔs prɔdak bin de ship kɔntinyu ɛnkripshɔn bɔt lɛf di delivri layt opin, so wan sava stil no udat de tɔk to udat ɛn ustɛm. Insai di tim wi kip de se "a sekuriti mesenja we de lik di soshal grafik na onli haf sekuriti." BMP na wi ansa: di pɔsin we sɛn am, di pɔsin we gɛt am, ɛn di tin we de insay ɔl kin bi opaque; nכ wan node na di mεsh de ol inof pis fכ rεkכnstrכkt wan kכnvכshכn. I de rɔn oba Vortex in yon gɔsip fabrik pas bolt-ɔn infrastukchɔ, we na wetin mek di kɔmɛshɔnal kɔst rizinɔs ɛn di dizayn ɔditabl in-haus.
bmp.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF(di pɔsin we gɛt di pabki, info="bmp-v1", len=32)

Dipɔsit: POST /bmp/dipɔsit {mɛylbɔks_id: 32B, blob: ≤1 MB}
Anɔns: gɔsip Blɔm filta += mailbɔks_id
Pik-ap: GET /bmp/messages (auth'd) → blob fɔ yuz in mailbox_ids
TTL: 7200 s |  per-node stɔrɔj ​​kap: 500 MB |  dipɔsit ret: 10/min/IP
bmp.h2_a: BMP gi tri indipɛndɛnt prayvesi prɔpati dɛn: pɔsin we sɛn-ayd, pɔsin we gɛt am-ayd, kɔntinyu-ayd.
bmp.h2_b: Sender-hiding: TLS kɔnekshɔn to di dipɔsit node de sho sɔs IP; ad wan Tor hop ɔ wan chen we gɛt anɔynt-rout to di fɔs BMP node de pul dat. Recipient-hiding: mailbox_id na wan-way hash fɔ recipient_pubkey we dɛn sɔlt wit di BMP vɛshɔn string — wan midul node de si wan opaque 32-bayt aydentifaya. Kɔntinɛnt-aydin: blob dɔn ɔlrɛdi E2E-ɛnkript fɔ di pɔsin we de gɛt am we de yuz ɔdinari Vortex rum / DM ki dɛn, so di midul node de si ɔl di sayfatɛks.
bmp.h2_c: Di tri-prɔpati fɔmyulashɔn na aw Pond bin diskrayb in gol dɛn insay 2014. Vortex bin rifin am bay we i mek di mailbox_id kɔlishin-rɛsistant (256-bit hash) so tu yuza dɛn we nɔ gɛt ɛnitin fɔ du wit dɛnsɛf nɔ go ebul fɔ aksidɛntli sheb wan mɛylbɔks. di 7200-sεkכnd TTL kכmכt frכm obsכbishכn se 95 % pan di rεsipiεnt dεm na wi beta pul insay 2 h; wan lכng TTL inflated per-node stכrej we nכ notis dεlivεri gεn.
bmp.h2_f:
Advasa we de si node stet:
  - no se mailbox_id de na di tɛm T
  - du NOT no senda (bin bi TLS/Tor hop away)
  - du NOT no di pɔsin we de tek am (mailbox_id na wan-way hash)
  - du NOT no kɔntinyu (blob na E2E-ɛnkript)
bmp.h3_a: Had limit pan blob saiz, per-node stɔrɔj, ɛn dipɔsit ret de kip BMP fɔ bi dɛd-drop fɔ arbitri data.
bmp.h3_b: Maks blob saiz: 1 MB. Big big peylɔd dɛn fɔ chunk tru di ɔdinari fayl sistɛm, we gɛt in yon stɔrɔj ​​pat. Maks pan ɛni-nɔd stɔrɔj: 500 MB totɛl fɔ BMP dipɔsit. We di kap rich, di ol-fɔs evikshɔn de drɔp blob bifo dɛn TTL — ɔpreshɔn dɛn kin ajɔst via `BMP_MAX_BYTES` env var. Dipɔsit ret fɔ wan IP: 10 fɔ wan minit, fɔ mek di wata nɔ kam frɔm wan pɔsin we atak am. Di mɛylbɔks ID dɛn we dɛn si pas 3 tɛm/awa ɔlsay na di nɛtwɔk, na rit-limited as "suspected flood target".
bmp.h3_c: Di 1 MB blob kap de mach IRC DCC-send kɔnvɛnshɔn ɛn Signal in sial-sɛnda kap — big inof fɔ shɔt mɛsej ɛn thumbnail, smɔl inof we atakman nɔ go ebul fɔ yuz BMP fɔ fayl ɔs. 500 MB pan ɛni-nɔd na OSS-difɔlt sɛns; big ɔpreshɔn dɛn de rayz am wit `BMP_MAX_BYTES`. Ret limit kam afta wan v0.0.8 beta usay wan tɛsta in tɛst skript ful 50 no dɛm wit dipɔsit insay 20 minit.
bmp.h3_f:
di limit dɛn:
  BMP_BLOB_MAX_BAYT = 1_000_000 # 1 MB .
  BMP_NODE_MAKS_BAYT = 500_000_000 # 500 MB .
  BMP_DEPOSIT_RATE = 10 # fɔ wan minit fɔ wan IP
  BMP_FLOOD_THRESHOLD = 3 # di sem mɛylbɔks_id fɔ wan awa
bmp.h4_a: BMP de shayn insay tri sɛnɛriɔ: di wan dɛn we gɛt ay sɛns, di wan dɛn we de kɔnɛkt wan wan tɛm, di wan dɛn we dɛn nɔ no dɛn nem.
bmp.h4_b: High-censorship: sender no sabi di risipient in hom node (en maybe no kin rich am eniwe). Drop at eni peer, let gossip route. Kɔnɛkshɔn we kin apin wan wan tɛm: di pɔsin we de gɛt am kin ɔflayna fɔ lɔng tɛm; blob de wet, no retries nid. Anonymous whistleblowing: sender-side onion + BMP = nɔ gɛt mɛtadata bɔt udat put wetin. We dɛn put am togɛda wit wan rum ki we di wan dɛn we dɛn kin trɔst nɔmɔ no, di tin dɛn we de insay de nɔ kin shayn bak to ɛni intasepta.
bmp.h4_c: Di tri yus kes dɛm de trak di histrikal motiveshɔn fɔ dɛd drɔp na fizik spaynaj (Soviet-ɛra), fɔ `alt.anonymous.messages` na Usenet (1990s), ɛn fɔ SecureDrop (2013 go bifo). BMP na wi tray fɔ briŋ da istri de insay wan mɔdan mɛsenja we nɔ nid fɔ gɛt sɛpret tul.

push.title: Push notis dɛn
push.subtitle: APNs, FCM, Web Push — ɔl wit sial ɛnvilɔp so di prɔvayda dɛn nɔ go ebul fɔ rid.
push.intro: Standart push savis (APN, FCM, Wɛb Push) si ɛvri peylɔd. Vortex de rap ɛni notis insay wan sɛpret E2E layt so di pɔsin we de gi am go si wan opaque blob nɔmɔ we nɔ gɛt rum id, pɔsin we sɛn am, ɔ tɛks.
push.h1p1: Klaynt kin gɛt wan pletfɔm token (APNs divays token, FCM rɛjista id, ɔ Wɛb Push sabskripshɔn JWT).
push.h1p2: Klaynt de jenarayz wan fresh 32-bayt X25519 ki `p256dh_pub` ɛn wan 16-bayt `auth` sikrit. POSTs `/api/push/subscribe` wit `{ɛndpɔynt, p256dh, ɔth, pletfɔm}`.
push.h1p3: Node de kɔntinyu fɔ de `push_sabskripshɔn dɛn(yuz_id, ɛndpɔynt, p256dh, ɔth, pletfɔm, kriyayt_at)`.
push.h2p1: We notis de (nyu mɛsej na muted rum we dɛn dɔn sɛt fɔ notis, menshɔn, kɔl inviteshɔn), node de ɛnkript di peylɔd wit AES-GCM yuz wan ki we kɔmɔt frɔm `ECDH(p256dh_pub, ephemeral_priv)` via HKDF.
push.h2p2: Node pakej `{ɛndpɔynt, TTL, urgency, tɔpik: <collapse_key>, data: <ciphertext>}` ɛn sɛn to APN dɛn / FCM / Wɛb Push sava.
push.h2p3: Prɔvayda de si ɔl `data` (sayfatɛks) + `tɔpik`. No plainteks lik.
push.h3p1: Per-rum tɔpik ki: `rum:<id>`. Bɔku mɛsej dɛn na di sem rum kin kol to wan notis na di OS lɛvɛl.
push.h3p2: Tɔpik fɔ ɛni kɔl: `kɔl:<id>`. We yu ansa ɔ we yu nɔ gri fɔ tek am, dat kin pul di ban; nyu kol invayt na di sem rum riples di ol wan.
push.h4p1: iOS: Notis Savis Ɛkstenshɔn de dikript insay di NSE prɔses (sɛparet frɔm men ap). Yuz di sem CryptoKit primitiv dɛn.
push.h4p2: Andrɔyd: FirebaseMessagingService de dikript insay bakgrɔn savis. JobScheduler de schedule aktual UI ɔpdet we di ap de fɔgrɔn.
push.h4p3: Wɛb: Savis Wokman de dikript insay di SW kɔntɛks, post wan lokal notis tru Wɛb Notis API.
push.h5: Quirks we gɛt fɔ du wit di pɔsin we de gi am
push.h5p1: APNs: nid fɔ rifresh di prɔvayda token ɛvri 60 min. Token rifresh de otomatik via Apple in `auth-team-id` + `auth-key-id` + p8 ki fayl.
push.h5p2: FCM: lɛgsi HTTP ɛndpɔynt nɔ de wok igen; wi de yuz di HTTP v1 ɛndpɔynt wit OAuth2 savis akɔn kredibiliti. Rotashɔn ɛvri 1 h.
push.h5p3: Wɛb Push: VAPID ki (wan ki pe fɔ ɛni node). TTL kap pan 28 dez bay mɔs brawza dɛn.
push.h1_a: Klaynt de rɛjista wan divays token (APNs/FCM/Web Push) togɛda wit wan fresh X25519 pɔblik ki ɛn wan 16-bayt ɔth sikrit.
push.h1_b: Klaynt de jenarayz `p256dh_priv = rand(32)` ɛn `auth = rand(16)`. Diriv `p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G`. POSTs `/api/push/subscribe` wit `{ɛndpɔynt, p256dh, ɔth, pletfɔm, yuza_ejɛnt}`. Node persist `push_subscriptions(yuz_id, ɛndpɔynt, p256dh, ɔth, pletfɔm, kriyayt_at, las_rifresh_at)`. Roteshɔn: di klaynt de ri-sabskripshɔn pan ɛvri ap lonch, we de rifresh `last_refreshed_at`. Dɛn kin pul di sabskripshɔn dɛn we dɔn ol pas 30 dez.
push.h1_c: Di p256dh + auth fil dɛm kɔmɔt frɔm di Wɛb Push RFC 8291 (2017). Wi yuz dɛn bak fɔ APN ɛn FCM pan ɔl we dɛn savis dɛn de nɔ nid di sial fɔmat — fɔ du dat de kip wan kɔd pat akɔdin to ɔl tri. Bifo v0.0.5 Vortex sɛn pleintɛks peylɔd dɛn tru di push savis dɛn; afta Apple in 2022 push prayvesi ɔpdet ɛn wan sɛpret insidɛnt usay wan miskɔnfigyut FCM projɛkt lik notis, wi muv ɔltin to sial ɛnvilɔp.
push.h1_f:
p256dh_priv = rand (32) ɛn di ɔda wan dɛn.
p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G // X25519 .
auth = rand(16) ɛn di ɔda wan dɛn.

POST /api/push/sabskraib
  { ɛndpɔynt, p256dh: heks (p256dh_pub), ɔth: heks(ɔt), pletfɔm }
push.h2_a: We notis fɔ dɔn, di node kin ɛnkript di peylɔd so na di pɔsin in divays nɔmɔ go ebul fɔ rid am. Di push savis (Apple / Google / Mozilla) de si wan opaque blob nɔmɔ.
push.h2_b: Node pik wan ephemeral X25519 kipa. Dεriv `ikm = ECDH(εfεmεral_priv, p256dh_pכb)`. Rɔn HKDF(sɔl=ɔth, ikm, info="aesgcm", len=32) → ki. Enkript `{taytul, bɔdi, rum_id, mɛsej_id}` as CBOR → AES-GCM wit di derived ki + random 96-bit nonce. Send `{ɛndpɔynt, TTL, urgency, tɔpik: kollaps_ki, data: sayfatɛks, aes128gcm: {sɔl, pɔb_ɛfɛmɛral}}` to APNs/FCM/Wɛb-Push. Divays de risiv, ɛkstenshɔn / savis woka de rɔn di sem ki derivashɔn in rivas, dikript, sho notis.
push.h2_c: Sial push na dairekt di Wɛb Push Mɛsej Ɛnkripshɔn spɛshal frɔm 2017 (RFC 8291 + RFC 8188). Apple in 2022 iOS 16 ɔpdet ad fɔs-klas sɔpɔt fɔ notis savis ɛkstenshɔn dɛn we de du di dikripshɔn; Andrɔyd dɔn sɔpɔt am tru FCM data mɛsej fɔ lɔng lɔng tɛm. Vortex na wan pan di smɔl mɛsenja dɛn we de impruv di ful flɔ wit di sem kɔd na ɔl di tri pletfɔm dɛn — iOS de yuz `NotificationServiceExtension`, Andrɔyd de yuz `FirebaseMessagingService`, Wɛb de yuz di savis woka.
push.h2_f:
efemeral_priv = rand (32);  efεmεral_pub = εfεmεral_priv · G
ikm = ECDH(efimɛral_priv, p256dh_pub) .
prk = HMAC-SHA256(ɔt, ikm) ɛn di ɔda wan dɛn.
key = HKDF-Expand(prk, "Kɔntinɛnt-Ɛnkɔdin: aes128gcm\x00", 16)
nonce= HKDF-Expand(prk, "Kɔntinyu-Ɛnkɔdin: nonce\x00", 12)
ct = AES-GCM-Enkript(ki, nonce, peylod)
send { ɛndpɔynt, data: sɔl∥rɛkɔd_sayz∥idlen∥ephemeral_pub∥ct }
push.h3_a: Kollaps ki dɛn de mek bɔku notis frɔm di sem chat nɔ stak lɛk wan wan ban dɛn — di OS de jɔyn dɛn to wan.
push.h3_b: Per-rum kollaps: tɔpik = `rum:<id>`. APN dɛn `apns-collapse-id` ɛn FCM in `collapse_key` de tɛl di OS fɔ riples di notis dɛn we dɛn bin dɔn gɛt bifo wit di sem tɔpik. Yuza de si wan baner fɔ ɛni rum ilɛksɛf bɔku mɛsej dɛn kam. Per-kɔl kollaps: tɔpik = `kɔl:<id>`; nyu kɔl inviteshɔn fɔ di sem rum fɔ tek di ples fɔ di wan dɛn we bin de bifo. Per-mention: topic = `mεnshכn:<yuz>:<rum>`; wan menshɔn baner fɔ ɛni yuza-rum pe.
push.h3_c: Dɛn bin ad kollaps ki to APN dɛn na iOS 10 (2016) ɛn to FCM insay 2014. Bifo dat, mɔlti-mɛsej bɔrst dɛn bin de jenarayz mɔlti-ban stak dɛn we di wan dɛn we de yuz am bin et yunifom. Telegram bin payɔnia fɔ di fɔdɔm we dɛn bin fɔdɔm pan ɛni rum UX insay 2015; ɔl di big big mɛsenja dɛn bin de fala am. Vortex in split insay rum / kɔl / menshɔn kollaps kam frɔm yuz fidbak na di v0.0.6 beta se "kɔl inviteshɔn riples chat ban" fil rɔng — sɛpret tɔpik dɛn fiks am.
push.h3_f:
APNs: apns-collapse-id = rum:42 → de riples di baner dɛn we bin de bifo
FCM: collapse_key = kol:17 → de riples di baner dɛn we bin de bifo
Wɛb: tɔpik = menshɔn:u12:r5 → de riples di ban dɛn we bin de bifo
push.h4_a: Ɛni pletfɔm gɛt in yon gotcha. iOS nid di Notis Savis Ɛkstenshɔn; Andrɔyd nid FCM data mɛsej; Wɛb nid di savis wokman + VAPID.
push.h4_b: iOS: di ap bɔndɛl de ship wan `NotificationServiceExtension` target. Sistem de delivr di enkript peylod to di NSE; NSE gɛt 30 s CPU + 25 MB mɛmori fɔ dikript ɛn mute di notis bifo dɛn sho am. FCM: wi de sɛn `data` mɛsej (nɔto `notification`) so di ap in FirebaseMessagingService de rɔn we wi rich — dat de gi wi kɔntrol fɔ sho if wi fɔ sho wan ban. Wɛb Push: savis woka de intasept `push` ivin, dikript, sho via `self.registration.showNotification`.
push.h4_c: Di NSE patɛn na Apple bin introduks am na iOS 10 (2016) spɛshal fɔ mɛsej-dikripshɔn yuz kes dɛn. Bifo dat, ɛnd-to-ɛnd ɛnkript mɛsenja dɛn bin gɛt fɔ pik bitwin pleintɛks push peylɔd (prayvesi-ɔstil) ɛn badge-onli push (UX-ɔstil). WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram ɔl jomp to NSE insay wan ia. Vortex de fala di sem patɛn.
push.h5_a: Prɔvayda-spɛsifi k quirks — pat pan di push chapta. dis na wan pan di kכr mεkanism dεm we dεn rεfrεns tru di Vortex rεfrεns. Rid di chapta we de rawnd am fɔ no mɔ bɔt di tin dɛn we de apin; dis pat de zoom in pan di spεsifi k bihayvya.
push.h5_b: Implimɛnt ɔvaviu fɔ "Prɔvayda-spɛsifi k quirks". Di mɛkanism de implimɛnt insay di kɔrɛspɔndɛns mɔdyul ɔnda `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, ɔ `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Di modul README de kɔl ɔut ɛksaktɔ fayl pat dɛn.
push.h5_c: di "Provider-specific quirks" mεkanism evolv across Vortex rilis dεm. Di dizayn de tray bak to di risach ɛn prodakshɔn prɔsis we dɛn bin dɔn pablish we di mɛsenja dɛn we bin dɔn de bifo bin du. Vɛshɔn istri na `CHANGELOG.md` de rikodɔ we ɛni wan pan di pis land ɛn wetin mek i du am.

controller.title: Kɔntrola savis
controller.subtitle: Integriti atɛsteshɔn, ɛntri diskvayri, wɛlbɔdi monitarin.
controller.intro: Di kɔntrol na wan sɛpret Python prɔses. I atak sɔfays na smɔl smɔl (lɛk duzin rod dɛn) ɛn in trɔst de pin to wan singl Ed25519 pɔblik ki we dɛn bek insay klaynt dɛn.
controller.h1p1: `GET /v1/integrity` — atɛsteshɔn rizɔlt. Skima: `{status, sayn_bay, trusted_pubkey, vɛshɔn, bil_at, mach, mismatch, mis, ɛkstra, mɛsej}`.
controller.h1p2: `GET /v1/hɛlth` — layf we pɔsin gɛt. Skima: `{status: "ok", vɛshɔn, pɔbki, stats:{ɔnlayn, apruv, tɔtal}}`.
controller.h1p4: `GET /v1/mirrors` — miro kɔntrol dɛn (DNS + IPFS + .aniɔn vɛryɔnt dɛn).
controller.h1p5: `GET /v1/trusted_nodes` — fedaret kɔmpin dɛn we dɛn sabi.
controller.h1p6: `GET /v1/hatbit/{pubkey}` — node layfnɛs prob. Na fedaret node dɛn de yuz am fɔ kip dɛn rɛjista fresh.
controller.h1p7: `POST /v1/register` — wan nyu node de aplay fɔ trɔst. I nid fɔ gɛt admin aprɔval pas `AUTO_APPROVE=true`.
controller.h2p1: Manifest fayl: `INTEGRITY.sig.json`. I gɛt ɛni fayl BLAKE3 hash + Ed25519 sayn.
controller.h2p2: Jɛnɛreshɔn: `paytɔn -m vorteks_kɔntrola.intɛgriti.sayn_tul`. Rid di rilis ki frɔm `keys/release.key`, waka tri, rayt manifest.
controller.h2p3: Verifikeshɔn: kɔntrolɔ de rid di manifest we i stat ɛn kɔmpia agens disk. Startup de fel lawd wan pan mismatch.
controller.h3p1: Miro dɛn de rɔn di sem kɔntrol kɔd wit di sem rilis ki we dɛn kɔpi oba. Klaynt dɛn kin si di sem `signed_by` akɔdin to miro — wan we fɔ no fek miro na fɔ kɔmpia pubkeys.
controller.h3p2: DNSLink / SNS / IPFS de pablish pɔynta dɛn to wan pan sɔm miro dɛn. Klaynt dɛn kin tray insay prayoritɛd ɔda wit tɛmaut.
controller.h3p3: Di `vortex.sol-mirror/` dairektrɔ na dis repo na wan rɛdi-fɔ-go trycloudflare miro fɔ divɛlɔpmɛnt.
controller.h1_a: Kontrola in pɔblik API sɔfays na lɛk wan duzin rod dɛn. Ɔl smɔl, ɔl bin de pe atɛnshɔn pan atɛst ɛn ɛntrɛ-URL diskvayri.
controller.h1_b: `/v1/integrity` — sayn manifest atɛsteshɔn. `/v1/health` — layfnɛs + pɔbki + stats. `/v1/entries` — ɛntri URL fɔ kɔnɛkt. `/v1/mirrors` — miro kɔntrol dɛn. `/v1/trusted_nodes` — fedareshɔn kɔmpin dɛn. `/v1/hatbit/{pubkey}` — node layfnɛs prob. `/v1/register` — nyu node de aplay fɔ trɔst (admin aprɔval pas `AUTO_APPROVE=true`). Na dat — deliberately narrow fɔ kip di atak surface minimal.
controller.h1_c: Di narrow-surface design de infɔm bay di obshɔbishɔn se di atɛsteshɔn prɔses de bi di ays-valyu target wans klaynt dɛn pin to am. Smɔl kɔd = smɔl sɔfa. Kɔmpia to di node we gɛt 120+ rod dɛn; di kɔntrol gɛt 12. Di sem kayn patɛn: Debian in apt-get de trɔst wan smɔl `Release.gpg` prɔses we difrɛn frɔm di pakej hostin.
controller.h2_a: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool` de waka di sɔs tik, hash ɛvri fayl, sayn wit di rilis ki, rayt `INTEGRITY.sig.json`.
controller.h2_b: Tul de rid `keys/release.key` (32-bayt Ed25519 prayvet ki). Walks `vortex_controller/` + `app/` (nɔ de inklud fayl dɛn we dɛn dɔn gitignored). Fɔ ɛni fayl: `blake3(kɔntinɛnt) → hash`. Bil manifest `{vɛshɔn, bil_at, fayl dɛn: [{path, sha256, saiz}]}`. Kɔmpyuta `kanonik_bayt = CBOR(manifɛst)`. Sayn dɛn: `sig = Ed25519-Sayn(rilis_ki, kanonikal_bayt)`. Rayt `INTEGRITY.sig.json = {manifest, sayn_bay: pubkey, sig}`.
controller.h2_c: Sayn manifest dɛn go bak to Debian in Rilis.gpg (1997) ɛn PGP-sayn Linux kɛnal tarballs. Sigstore (2021) rifin di mכdel fכ saplae-chεn atεstεshכn. Vortex in vɛshɔn na mɔ laytwɛt bikɔs i de atɛst wan singl diploymɛnt, nɔto wan mɔlti-pati rilis chen. Wi kin adopt Sigstore in v0.4 fɔ pɔblik rilis.
controller.h3_a: Miro dɛn de rɔn di sem kɔntrol kɔd wit di sem rilis ki. Bɔku DNS / SNS / IPFS ɛntri dɛn de sho wan pan sɔm miro dɛn.
controller.h3_b: Opareshɔn dɛn kin sɛt N miro dɛn (tipikli 3-5). Ɛni wan de rɔn di sem `vortex_controller` kɔd wit di sem `keys/release.key`. Klaynt dɛn de si di sem `signed_by` akɔdin to miro — wan gud saniti chɛk. DNS/SNS/IPFS rεkכd list miro wit prayorities. Klaynt dɛn kin tray insay prayoritɛd ɔda, wit 7-sɛkɔn tɛmaut fɔ ɛni tray. Di `vortex.sol-mirror/` dairektrɔ na dis repo na prɛ-wayd trycloudflare miro ɛgzampul.
controller.h3_c: Bɔku miro wit prayoritɛd lukɔp na di sem patɛn we SMTP de yuz fɔ MX rɛkɛd ɛn HTTPS de yuz fɔ SRV rɛkɔd. Tor in dairektrɔ ɔtoriti dɛn na wan rilayt mɔdel — 9 hadkɔd DA dɛn + vot dɛn. Vortex pik "pik miro we de wok" pas "quorum vote" bikɔs vot-based dizayn dɛn de mɔ resilient bɔt dɛn slo fɔ butstrap.
controller.h1_f:
/v1/integriti : GET → atɛsteshɔn rizɔlt
/v1/health : GET → {status, vɛshɔn, pɔbki, stats}
/v1/entries : GET → [{prɔtokɔlɔ, url}, ...]
/v1/mirrors : GET → [kɔntrola_url, ...]
/v1/trusted_nodes : GET → [{pɔbki, ɛndpɔynt, wɛlbɔdi}, ...]
/v1/heartbeat/{pk} : POST (frɔm rɛjista no dɛm nɔmɔ)
/v1/register : POST (fɔ nyu no dɛm)
controller.h3_f:
DNSLink TXT _dnslink.vortexx.sol: dnslink=/ipfs/<CID>
SNS rikodɔ vortexx.sol: {"miro dɛn": [url1, url2, url3]}
IPFS CID: INTEGRITY.sig.json we dɛn kɔpi
klaynt pik: fɔs rispɔnsiv in prayoritɛd ɔda, 7 s tɛmaut

storage.title: Stɔrej layt
storage.subtitle: SQLite fɔ dev, Postgres fɔ prod, Alembic fɔ maykreshɔn, GRDB/Room/IndexedDB pan klaynt dɛn.
storage.intro: Vortex in node stכrej na SQL. Switch bitwin SQLite (dev) ɛn Postgres (prod) na DATABASE_URL chenj — nɔ kɔd fɔk.

storage.h2p1: Alembik insay `alembik/vɛshɔn dɛn/`. Linear history, wan rivishɔn fɔ ɛni rilis (sɔntɛnde sɔm pan ɛni rilis).

storage.h2p3: Prod mod: `alembic apgrɛd ed` bifo yu stat. Docker imej de ron am na di entrypoint.
storage.h3p1: `messages(room_id, id DESC)` — praymari indeks fɔ pejin fetch.
storage.h3p2: `messages(room_id, sent_at DESC)` — fɔ ɔda we de bays pan tɛm pan ɛdit.
storage.h3p4: `read_receipts(room_id, message_id)` — fɔ `we N` lukap dɛn si.
storage.h3p6: FTS vayrɔyal tebul dɛn (FTS5 SQLite / tsvector Postgres) fɔ ful-tɛks sɔch.
storage.h4p1: `make db-backup` de prodyuz wan arkiv we gɛt tɛmstamp. Enkript we yu rɛst wit ɔpreshɔn ki.
storage.h4p2: Ritɛnshɔn: ɛvride fɔ 14 dez, ɛvri wik fɔ 4 wik, ɛvri mɔnt fɔ 12 mɔnt.
storage.h4p3: Rɛstɔrɔshɔn: `mek db-ristɔrɔshɔn FILE=<pat>`. Rɔn pan wan stej DB fɔs; ɔpreshɔn de verify den swap.
storage.h1_a: Node stɔrɔj ​​na SQL. SQLite fɔ dev ɛn smɔl sɛlf-ɔs; PostgreSQL fɔ fedaret ɔ mɔlti-nɔd prodakshɔn. Semweso SQLAlchemy 2.x async kod de drayv ɔl tu.
storage.h1_b: Konfig via `DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///vortex.db` ɔ `postgresql+asyncpg://yuz: pw@hɔst/db`. Single konfig, no kod fok. SQLite de rɔn in-prɔses; Postgres de rɔn sɛpret wan. Pɔfɔmɛnshɔn: SQLite de handle ~50 kɔnkɔrɛnt yuza dɛn kɔmfyut wan pan wan M1; Postgres skel to tawzin. Maygrɛshɔn Postgres → SQLite na wan-we via `pg_dump --data-only` + SQLite import; di ɔda dairekshɔn na di sem.
storage.h1_c: Di "wan ORM, tu bakɛnd" patɛn na tɛn ia ol SQLAlchemy prɛktis. Vortex de yuz di async 2.x API so ɛvri kwɛstyɔn de wet. Wi pik SQLAlchemy Core ova Django ORM / Tortoise ORM / raw `asyncpg` fɔ di richa maykreshɔn stori ɛn di mats wit FastAPI in async idioms.
storage.h2_a: 18 kor tebul: yuza, yuza_divays, rum, rum_memba, mɛsej, riakshɔn, fayl, rid_risit, prezɛns, fedareshɔn, fedareshɔn_ɔtbɔks, scheduled_mɛsej, kɔntakt, sev_gif, fɔlda, bot_instɔlɛshɔn, sɛshɔn, push_sabskripshɔn.
storage.h2_b: Yuz dɛn tebul na di aydentiti rut. rum_mɛmba dɛn de ol (rum, yuza, rol, jɔyn_at, muted_te). mɛsej dɛn kin kɛr sayfatɛks + mɛtadata; indeks pan (rum_id, id) fɔ pejin fetch. riakshכn dεm na kכmpawnd-praymari-ki tεbul. Ɔl ɔda tin dɛn na tin we nɔ rayt. Stɔrej de gro linya wit mɛsej kɔnt — lɛk 1 KB pan ɛni mɛsej na disk afta indeks ɔvahɛd.
storage.h2_c: Di skima bin stebul afta v0.0.4. Bifo dis tɛm wi bin gɛt sɛpret `dm_messages` ɛn `group_messages` tebul dɛn; merged in v0.0.3 afta di fanout kod dupliket akɔdin to ɔl tu. Di 18 tebul dɛn na di minimum fɔ wan ficha-kɔmplit mɛsenja; big diploymɛnt dɛn ad analitiks tebul bɔt dɛn nɔ nid fɔ ɔpreshɔn.
storage.h3_a: Alembic de manej di maykreshɔn dɛn. Linear rivishɔn istri, wan rivishɔn fɔ ɛni rilis. Ɛvri rivishɔn gɛt ɔl tu di `upgrade()` ɛn `downgrade()` fɛnshɔn dɛn.
storage.h3_b: `alembic/versions/` de ol rivishɔn dɛn. Ɛni wan pan dɛn na Python fayl wit ɔpgrɛd/dɔwngrɛd. CI de ron `alembic upgrade head` + `alembic downgrade -1` + `alembic upgrade head` fɔ verify rawnd-trip. Prodakshɔn: `mek db-migrate` de ɛksɛkutiv na di Docker ɛntripɔynt bifo di ap stat. Dev mod de yuz `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` so itɛreshɔn fast we nɔ nid maykreshɔn pan ɛvri ribɛs.
storage.h3_c: Alembic (Michael Bayer, 2011) na di kanonik SQLAlchemy maykreshɔn tul. Linear history (nɔto branching) na choice — i de avɔyd di "tu divɛlɔpa dɛn mek di sem rivishɔn nɔmba" prɔblɛm. Django in maykreshɔn dɛn de yuz di sem we. Rails bin muf frɔm linya to tɛmstamp insay 2014 bɔt dɛn bin ri-adopt linya-wit-mɛj insay 2020.
storage.h4_a: Ki indeks dɛn kin tek tɛm pik so hot rid (mɛsej, riakshɔn, rid risit) kin hit disk smɔl.
storage.h4_b: `messages(room_id, id DESC)` — praymari pejin indeks. `messages(room_id, sent_at DESC)` — tɛm-ɔda fɔlbak fɔ ɛdit. `reactions(message_id)` — agregeshɔn pan rum opin. `read_receipts(rum_id, message_id)` — "we N si" de kɔnt. `yuz_divays(yuz_id)` — divays list. FTS vayrɔyal tebul fɔ fɛn (FTS5 na SQLite, tsvector na Postgres).
storage.h4_c: Indeks chukchuk bin kɔmɔt frɔm ɛksplen-plan-prɔfaylin di tɛm we dɛn bin de du v0.0.4 lod tɛst. Wi bin stat wit naiv indeks ɛn ad/rimov bays pan di kwɛstyɔn patɛn we wi bin si. Di `messages(room_id, id DESC)` na di singl hottest indeks — roughly 80 % of rids hit am. We yu kip am smɔl (nɔ gɛt kɔlɔm dɛn we de insay) i de mek i fit insay mɛmori.

bots.title: Bot freymwɔk
bots.subtitle: Gravitix DSL + Python SDK + makit ples + antispam.
bots.intro: Bot na fɔs klas rum patisipan dɛn. Dɛn kin sayn mɛsej dɛn wit wan bot in Ed25519 ki so dɛn kin no fɔj.
bots.h1p1: Tu opshɔn: Python SDK ɔ Gravitix DSL. Python na fɔ kɔmpleks wokflɔ; Gravitix fɔ ivent-driven chat bot dɛn we nid fɔ ship kwik kwik wan.
bots.h1p2:
Python ɛgzampul: `frɔm vortex_bot import Bot
bot = Bot(token=...)
@bot.on_message
async def echo(msg): wet fɔ bot.sɛnd(msg.rum_id, msg.tɛks)
bot.run()`. Di SDK de handle WebSocket, rikonekshɔn, ɛnkripshɔn ki ɛkshɛnj.
bots.h1p3: Gravitix ɛgzampul: `on /start { emit "Alo, {ctx.fɔs_nem}!" }`. I de kɔmpilayt to baytkɔd ɛn i de rɔn insay wan intaprita we gɛt sanbɔks.
bots.h1p4: Bot token de isyu na bot krieshɔn. Yu dɔn lɔs token? `POST /api/bots/{id}/rotate-token` de gi nyu wan.
bots.h2p1: Tu diploymɛnt mɔdel: in-prɔses (kɔrotin insay di node) ɛn ɛksternal (bɔt pol `/api/bots/{id}/updates`).
bots.h2p2: In-prosɛs: ziro nɛtwɔk hop, fastest, bɔt ɔpreshɔn fɔ trɔst bot kɔd. Good fɔ yu yon bot dɛn.
bots.h2p3: Ekstanshal: wɛbhuk ɔ lɔng-pɔl. No node-lɛvel trɔst nɔ nid. Good fɔ tɔd-pati bot ɛn di makit.
bots.h2p4: Gravitix bot dɛn kin ɔltɛm rɔn in-prɔses na di sandbɔks — dɛn nɔ gɛt faylsistim ɔ nɛtwɔk akses pas ɛksplisit API.
bots.h3p1: Pɔblik bot dɛn kin sɔbmit to di makit. Rivyu pipul dɛn de chɛk fɔ no se kɔd nɔ de phish, nɔ de spam, nɔ de lik yuz data.
bots.h3p2: Kategori: prodaktiviti, gem, nyus, yutiliti, ai, transleshɔn.
bots.h3p3: Instɔl: wan klik. Node de sabskripshɔn di yuza to di bot in yuzɛn nem so DM dɛn de rout kɔrɛkt wan.
bots.h3p4: Mɔnitizayshɔn: fri, wan tɛm bay, sabskripshɔn. Platform fi 10 %% pan di gros.
bots.h4p1: Wan antispam bot we nɔ de si de wach ɛni rum. Chɛk: link density > 3 pan minit, kapital-lɛta ratio > 70 %% fɔ 10+ char, ripit mɛsej, sɔdɛn bɔrst fɔ nyu-akɔn jɔyn.
bots.h4p2: Akshɔn dɛn: wɔn → tɛm dɔn (5 min) → kik → ban. Apil go to rum admin.
bots.h1_a: Bot na fɔs klas rum patisipan dɛn. Ɛni wan pan dɛn gɛt Ed25519 ki ɛn wan token; ɛvri mɛsej we dɛn kin sɛn, dɛn kin sayn am, so dɛn kin no se dɛn dɔn mek fɔj.
bots.h1_b: Krio: ɔna POST `/api/bots` wit `{yuz nem, displei_nem, kɔd}`. Node de mek wan `users` row wit `is_bot=true`, de jenarayz wan Ed25519 keypair, ritɔn di prayvet-ki bot token to di ɔna (dɛn sho am wan tɛm). Rɔn: bot ɔl tu de liv in-prɔses as kɔrotin ɔ ɛksternal poll `/api/bots/{id}/updates` wit in token. Mesej frɔm bot dɛn kin kɛr `from_bot: true` flag ɛn dɛn kin sayn wit di bot in prayvet ki.
bots.h1_c: Bot APIs na Slack (2014) bin payɔnia ɛn Telegram (2015) bin rifin dɛn. Vortex in twist: bot sayn dɛn de tay mɛsej to di bot aydentiti, so wan kɔmprɔmis node nɔ bin ebul fɔ mek "@bot se X". Matrix in bot sɔpɔt ad dis prɔpati insay 2021 via fedareshɔn sayn dɛm; Vortex gɛt am frɔm v0.0.5.
bots.h2_a: Gravitix na domɛyn-spɛsifi k langwej fɔ rayt ivin-driv bot. Tiny, expresive, kompil to sandboxed bytecode.
bots.h2_b: Sintaks: `on /start { emit "Alo, {ctx.fɔs_nem}!" }`. Handlers de bind to triggers (kɔmand, regex, ivin). Bɔdi na sikwins fɔ `emit`, `let`, `if`, `schedul`, ɛn ɔda tin dɛn Kɔmpayla de ɛmit baytkɔd; runtime de intaprit insay sandbɔks we nɔ gɛt faylsistim, we nɔ gɛt arbitri nɛtwɔk, na Vortex in API nɔmɔ. Ful rɛfrɛns na di Gravitix docs chapta.
bots.h2_c: Gravitix bin disayn di tɛm we v0.0.6 afta dɛn obshɔb se mɔs bot kɔd na 80 % bɔylplet fɔ waya di Vortex SDK, wit wan kɛnal we gɛt aktual lɔjik na di midul. A DSL de mek di lɔjik shayn ɛn nɔ de shovel arbitri Python insay wan bot-dev ɛnvayrɔmɛnt usay sanbɔks rɔnawe go mɔs.
bots.h3_a: Ɛvri rum gɛt wan antispam bot we wi nɔ de si we de wach fɔ flɔd, link spam, mɛsej dɛn we de ripit, ɛn nyu-akɔn jɔyn bɔrst.
bots.h3_b: Rul: link density > 3 pan minit frɔm wan yuza, ALL-CAPS ratio > 70 % pan mɛsej ≥ 10 char, mɛsej ripit > 3 tɛm insay 30 s, bɔrst ɔf jɔyn wit akɔn ej < 24 h > 20 insay 60 s. Akshɔn dɛn kin go ɔp: wɔnin → 5 minit tɛmaut → 1 awa kik → ban (admin aprɔval fɔ ban). Tuneable per-rum via `/antispam konfig`.
bots.h3_c: Antispam heuristics kɔmɔt frɔm wan sɛntesis fɔ IRC-era bot lɔ dɛn (Eggdrop, BitchX) ɛn mɔdan sistɛm dɛn lɛk Discord AutoMod. Di spεsifi k thrεshold dεm na Vortex bin tכn εgεst wan 6 mכnt beta kכpכs fכ 200k mεsej dεm; fals-positiv rεt na ~0.3 % pan di obsεv ban-apil rεt.
bots.h4_a: Pɔblik bot dɛn kin sɔbmit to di makit. Di wan dɛn we de rivyu de chɛk fɔ si if dɛn nɔ de fishin / nɔ spam / nɔ de lik data. Di wan dɛn we de yuz am kin browz bay kategori ɛn instɔl wit wan klik.
bots.h4_b: Sɔbmishɔn: ɔna post bot sɔs + diskripshɔn. Rivyua de rɔn di kɔd na sanbɔks, rid am fɔ anti-patɛn dɛn we dɛn sabi, chɛk ɛni nɛtwɔk kɔl we de go tru API dɛn we dɛn alaw, chɛk prayvesi polisi. Listing: kategori, prays, raytin, instɔl kɔnt. Instɔl: `POST /api/bots/{id}/install` — node de mek wan sabskripshɔn fɔ ɛni yuza. Mɔnitizayshɔn: fri / wan tɛm / sabskripshɔn; pletfɔm de tek 10 %.
bots.h4_c: Ap makit ples dɛn go bak to di 2008 Ap Stɔ. Slak Ap Dayrɛktɔri (2015), Diskɔrd Bɔt Listin (2017), Telegram Bot Store (2024). Vortex in 10 % kot smɔl pas Apple in 30 % ɛn smɔl smɔl pas Shopify in 20 %, we dɛn pik fɔ insentif divɛlɔpa dɛn fɔ pablish. Di rivyu polisi na fɔ GitLab in "rivyu bay difɔlt, delist pan kɔmplen".
bots.h3_f:
di tin dɛn we kin mek pɔsin want fɔ du sɔntin:
  link_density > 3/min → wɔn
  ɔl_kap_rɛshɔ > 0.7 (≥10c) → wɔn
  ripit_kɔunt > 3 insay 30s → wɔn
  new_joiner_burst > 20 in 60s → rum lɔk

eskalayshɔn: .
  2 wɔnin → 5 min tɛm aut
  3 wɔnin → 1 h kik
  4 wɔnin → ban (admin gri)
bots.h4_f:
kategori: prodaktiviti, gem, nyus, yutiliti, ai, transleshɔn
prayz: fri | wan tɛm (USD amɔnt) | sabskripshɔn (USD/mɔnt)
kot: 90 % to divɛlɔpa, 10 % to Vortex
rivyu: manual, ~3 biznɛs dez target tɔnarawnd

ops.title: Di we aw dɛn de du di wok
ops.subtitle: Diploy, monita, rol bak.
ops.intro: Ɛvri ɔpreshɔnal task gɛt `mek` target ɔ CLI kɔmand. Ops pej dɛn de liv na `diploy/`.
ops.h1p1: `docker kompoz op` de bring op node, kontrola, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1p2: Volyum dɛn: `/data/vortex.db`, ​​`/data/ɔplɔd`, `/data/lɔg`. Mount to host fɔ mek yu kɔntinyu fɔ du am.
ops.h1p3: Envayrɔmɛnt: `.env` insay repo rut. Nɔ ɛva kɔmit. `.env.example` na di tɛmplat.
ops.h1p4: Caddy auto-fetch Let's Encrypt sɛt. Let's Encrypt rεt limit dεm de aplay — yuz stej fכ εkspεriεns.
ops.h2: Mek di tin dɛn we yu want fɔ du
ops.h2p1: `mek instɔl` — instɔl Python deps + dev tul dɛn.
ops.h2p2: `make dev` — uvicorn wit rilod pan pɔt 9000.
ops.h2p4: `mek lint` — ruf + mypy. CI blok pan fayl.
ops.h2p5: `mek docker-bild` — bil imej we dɛn tag `vortex:<VERSION>`.
ops.h2p8: `mek ci` — ron di ful CI paip layn lokal wan.
ops.h3: Wizad we de du mami ɛn dadi biznɛs
ops.h3p1: `Vortex Wizard.app` na wan PyInstaller bɔndɛl wit wan pywebview GUI.
ops.h3p2: Fɔs-rɔn flɔ: pik node nem → jenarayz rilis ki → kɔnfigyut TLS (Let's Encrypt / bring-yu-own / sɛlf-sayn) → pik ɛntri URL dɛn → ɛnabul stɔl → opin fayawɔl pɔt dɛn.
ops.h3p3: Afta sɛtup, wizad de de as di admin kɔnsol: stat/stɔp node, si lɔg dɛn, rɔta ki dɛn, ad fedaret piɔ dɛn.
ops.h4p1: Evri rilis we dɛn tag insay git. Tag sɛf sayn wit rilis ki so di tag insɛf na verifiable.
ops.h4p2: Rollback: `git chɛk-ɔut <tag> && mek docker-bild && docker kɔmpoz ɔp -d`. Running nodes drein ɛn ristart.
ops.h4p3: DB: Alembic `downgrade <rev>` sɔpɔt fɔ wan smɔl vɛshɔn bak. Fɔ go bak, i nid fɔ mek pɔsin du sɔntin wit in an.
ops.h1_a: `docker compose up` de bring op di ful Vortex stak: node, kɔntrolɔ, Postgres, Redis, kɔturn, Kadi.
ops.h1_b: `docker-compose.yml` na di repo rut. Volyum `/data/vortex.db`, ​​`/data/uploads`, `/data/logs` we dɛn dɔn mawnt to ɔs so dat data de kɔntinyu fɔ de akɔdin to ristart. Healthchecks: node hεlty iff `/hεlth/rεdi` de ritɔn 200; kɔntrol iff `/v1/integriti` de ritɔn we dɛn dɔn chɛk. Caddy auto-fetch Let's Encrypt sɛt. `.env` de saplae sikrit (nɔ ɛva kɔmit). `.env.example` na di tɛmplat.
ops.h1_c: Docker Compose na di de-facto patɛn fɔ multi-container self-hosted savis dɛn. Umami, Ghost, Plausible, Miniflux ɔl de yuz am. Vortex in kɔmpoz fayl bin itɛrayt frɔm v0.0.2 go bifo; di shep we de naw stebul insay v0.0.5. Alternativ (k8s, nomad) dεn lεf as εksεsayz fכ big כpεrayt dεm.
ops.h2_a: Makefile na di sentral entrypoint fɔ ɛvri dev ɛn ops akshɔn. `mek ɛp` de list di target dɛn.
ops.h2_b: `mek instɔl` → `pip instɔl -r rikwaymɛnt.txt`. `mek dev` → uvicorn wit rilod. `mek test` → pytest + kɔvarej, autput `kɔvarej.xml`. `mek lint` → ruf + mypy. `mek docker-bild` → `docker bild -t vorteks:$VERSION`. `mek db-maygrɛt` → `alembik ɔpgrɛd ed`. `mek db-bak-ap` / `mek db-ristכr FILE=...`. `mek ci` → ful CI paip layn lokal wan.
ops.h2_c: Wan Makefile as di kanonik ɛntripɔynt na dikɛd-ol Yuniks prɔsis, we ɛvri big Python prɔjek (pytest, django, flask, fastapi) dɔn adopt. Ɔda tul dɛn (Poetry, Hatch, uv) na flawa-ɔf-di-ia; Mek na boring ɛn universal.
ops.h3_a: Di sɛtup wizad na PyInstaller bɔndɛl (`Vortex Wizard.app`) wit pywebview GUI we de waka fɔs-taym ɔpreshɔn tru diploymɛnt.
ops.h3_b: Fɔs-rɔn flɔ: pik node nem → jenarayz rilis ki (Ed25519 kipa we dɛn sev to `keys/release.key`) → kɔnfigyut TLS (Let's Encrypt / bring-yu-ɔwn / sɛlf-sayn) → pik ɛntri URL dɛn (vortexx.sol / kɔstɔm domɛyn / .onion) → ɛnabul stɔl lɛvɛl → opin fayawɔl pɔt dɛn (iptables/ufw/pf) we de na di wɔl. Afta fɔs rɔn, wizad de de as admin kɔnsol: stat/stɔp node, si lɔg dɛn, rɔta ki dɛn, ad fedaret piɔ dɛn.
ops.h3_c: Sɛtup wizad na di patɛn fɔ sɛlf-hɔst tul dɛn we de tɔch nɔ-sysadmin yuza dɛn: Ghost in onboarding (2015), Standard Notes in sava sɛtup, Mastodon in instɔleshɔn kwɛstyɔn dɛn. PyInstaller de mek wi ship wan dabl-klik baynary; pywebview de rɛnd wan lokal HTML pej we wan bɔnd FastAPI admin API de sav pan 127.0.0.1 — brawza UX we nɔ gɛt di kɔmplisiti fɔ bil wan nativ GUI.
ops.h4_a: Evri rilis de tag in git. Rollback na `git chɛk-ɔut <tag> && mek docker-bild && docker kɔmpoz ɔp -d`. Maygrɛshɔn dɛn gɛt `downgrade()` fɛnshɔn dɛn.
ops.h4_b: Tag dɛn de sayn wit di rilis ki so di tag insɛf go verify. Rolbak prosidur: chɛk-ɔut ol tag, ribild imej, rikriet kɔntena dɛn — rɔn kɔnɛkshɔn dɛn dreyn pan SIGTERM (difɔlt 15 s grɛs). DB: `alembic downgrade <rev>` de rivεrt wan rivishכn. Data lɔs avɔyd: wi nɔ de ɛva drɔp kɔlɔm dɛn na wan rilis; drop dεm de apin N+1 afta kכd stכp fכ rid dεm.
ops.h4_c: Di "kɔd-dɛn-kɔd" maykreshɔn patɛn (ɛkspand-maygrɛt-kɔntrakt) na standad fɔ ziro-dɔwntaym diploymɛnt. Stripe in maykreshɔn gayd (2019) de diskraib am di bɛst we. Vortex adopt am afta wan insidɛnt na v0.0.3 usay wan kɔlɔm drɔp fɔs fɔ 30 minit mentenɛns winda.

mobile.title: Mobayl klaynt dɛn
mobile.subtitle: iOS ɛn Andrɔyd — nativ UI, di sem protɔkɔl.
mobile.intro: Dɛn tu mobayl klaynt dɛn ya na ful kɔmpin, nɔto tin wɛb wrapa. Nativ luk, nativ pefɔmɛns, nativ intagreshɔn (CallKit, ConnectionService, Lɔk Skrin widget dɛn).
mobile.h1p1: Swift Pakej in `ios/Modul/`. 30+ ficha modul, ɛni wan SOLID-split `api/` + `impl/` + `ui/`.
mobile.h1p2: Ap target na `ios/VortexApp/`. XcodeGen spec na `ios/project.yml` de rijeneret di xcodeproj.
mobile.h1p3: Kripto: KriptoKit (X25519, Ed25519, AES-GCM, HKDF) + Argon2Swift (Argon2id).
mobile.h1p4: DB: GRDB + FTS5. Ɔl di muteshon dɛn de go tru `db.write`.
mobile.h1p6: Push: APN dɛn via `UNUserNotificationCenter` + Notis Savis Ɛkstenshɔn fɔ dikripshɔn.
mobile.h2p1: Gradle projɛkt na `android/`. 22 ficha modul wit Hilt DI, di sem `api / impl / di / ui` split.
mobile.h2p2: minSdk 26, targetSdk 34, we yu de du.
mobile.h3p1: Semweso 146-lɔkal bɔndɛl wit nativ nem dɛn (`Русский ru`, `Inglish en`, `中文 zh`, ...).
mobile.h3p2: Semweso 1500-emoji katalog wit 9 kategori + skin-tɔn + MRU + sɔch.
mobile.h3p3: Same multi-account X25519 chalenj-rεspכns fכ swich.
mobile.h3p4: Semweso chat fɔlda dɛn (Ɔl / Arkiv / kɔstɔm) wit drɛg-ɛn-drɔp riɔda.
mobile.h3p5: Semweso sev-GIFs list (nɔ Tenor — pɔsin in kɔllɛkshɔn nɔmɔ).
mobile.h3p6: Semweso scheduled-messages UI, kɔntakt skrin, prɛmiɔm stetɔs pej.
mobile.h1_a: iOS klaynt na Swift Pakɛj wit 30+ ficha mɔdyul dɛn. Di sem HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC protɔkɔl lɛk ɛvri ɔda klaynt.
mobile.h1_b: Modul dɛn we dɛn ɔganayz bay ficha: `Butstrap`, `Auth`, `Chat`, `Fayl`, `Kɔl`, `Push`, `Imoji`, `Fɔlda`, `Akɔnt`, `SevGifs`, `Kɔntakt`, `Schedul`, `Primiɔm`, `Riakshɔn`, .... Ɛni wan split insay `api/` (protokol), `impl/` (kɔnkrit klas), `ui/` (SwiftUI views). Kripto: KriptoKit fɔ X25519 / Ed25519 / AES-GCM; Argon2Swift fɔ Argon2id. DB: GRDB wit FTS5. WebRTC: stasel/WebRTC XCFrɛmwɔk. Push: APN dɛn wit Notis Savis Ɛkstenshɔn fɔ sial-push dikripshɔn.
mobile.h1_c: Modular pakej na di standad Swift praktis sins Swift Package Manager 5.0 (2019). Wi split insay api/impl/ui na SOLID-ish: dipεndεns invεshכn (mכdyul dεm dipεnd pan api/ nכmכ), separeshכn כf kכnsεn, tεstabiliti (swap impl fכ tεst). Di 30+ modul kɔnt na wan chuk fɔ bil paralelism — ɛni modul de kɔmpilayt insay aysolɛshɔn.
mobile.h2_a: Andrɔyd klaynt miro dɛn iOS: Kotlin + Kɔmpoz + Hilt DI. 22 ficha modul, di sem `api / impl / di` split.
mobile.h2_b: minSdk 26 (Andrɔyd 8), targetSdk 34 (Andrɔyd 14). Kripto: AndrɔydX sikyɔriti + Tink fɔ AES-GCM; argon2-jvm fɔ Argon2id. DB: Rum wit FTS4 trig. WebRTC: Strim WebRTC Andrɔyd. Push: FCM via FirebaseMessagingService + sial ɛnvilɔp dikripshɔn. Gradle multi-module, Hilt de kɔnɛkt ficha modul dɛn we nɔ gɛt dairekt dipɛnsin.
mobile.h2_c: Compose na Google in diklaretiv UI tulkit, stebul sins 2021. Hilt (2020) na di Google-ɛndɔs DI fremwɔk pan tap Dagger 2. Tugeda dɛn de mach SwiftUI + prɔpati wrapa dɛn na iOS fɔ wan nia-idɛntik akitekchral fil. Vortex adopt Kompoz/Hilt frɔm v0.0.4 go bifo; bifo dis tɛm, Andrɔyd bin de na View-based.
mobile.h3_a: Tude iOS ɛn Andrɔyd bɔnd di sem 146-lɔkal JSON sɛt wit nativ nem ɛn 1500-emoji katalog — wan yuza we de rayt 🥹 pan iOS 17 rɛnd 🥹 pan Andrɔyd 9.
mobile.h3_b: `ios/Modul/Sɔs/I18N/Risɔs/lɔkal/*.json` de mirɔ `android/ap/src/mɛn/ɛset/lɔkal/*.json`. Dɛn tu ap dɛn ya kin lod di rayt lokal we dɛn fɔs lanch (langwej pik skrin) ɛn dɛn kin kɔntinyu fɔ pik. Di emoji katalog na 9-kategori JSON we dɛn ship insay ɔl tu di bɔndɛl dɛn; i de saydstep OS-lεvεl imoji-sεt divεrjεns we כdasay de kכz כnrεndered `?` glyphs pan ol OS dεm.
mobile.h3_c: Ship yu yon emoji katalog na di patna we Telegram de yuz (dɛn Twemoji fɔk) ɛn WhatsApp yuz te 2022. Di tred-ɔf: ~300 KB ɛkstra fɔ ɛni ap bɔndɛl fɔ emoji + ~1.2 MB fɔ lokal. Worth it fɔ kros-pletfɔm kɔnsistɛns.

webclient.title: Wɛb klaynt
webclient.subtitle: PWA, vanila JS, ɔflayn mɔd, savis wokman.
webclient.intro: Wɛb klaynt na wan vanila-JS PWA. No Riakt, no bundler biyond ESM. ~400 KB gzipped totɛl, inklud 146 lokal.
webclient.h1p1: `static/js/main.js` na di ɛntri. Ficha modul les-lod pan fɔs yuz.
webclient.h1p2: Stet: per-rum ring bafa dɛn na IndexedDB, in-mɛmori dikript kesh. Savis Wokman de midul fɔ fetch.
webclient.h1p3: UI: Liquid Glass ifekt dɛn via CSS bakdrop-filta. No freym nɔ de; ivent delegɛshɔn + idempotent rɛnd ɛlda dɛn.
webclient.h2p1: Eni rayt we dɛn mek we dɛn de ɔflayn kiyu to IndexedDB. SW de flush we kɔnɛkshɔn kam bak.
webclient.h2p2: Idempotency ki pan ɛvri POST de mek dupliket ritray sakses sef wan.
webclient.h2p3: Ridin de wok ful wan ɔflayn — ɔl di sayfatɛks we dɛn dɔn sink de liv na IndexedDB.
webclient.h3p1: 146 lokal dɛn na `statik/lɔkal dɛn/*.json`. Welkam skrin (`lang-picker.js`) de saykl tru nativ-nem hint.
webclient.h3p2: Rɔntaym lokal switch: `document.documentElement.lang = kɔd` + ri-rɛnd lɛbl dɛn via `data-i18n` atribyut dɛn.
webclient.h1_a: Wɛb klaynt na wan vanila-JS PWA. No Riak, no bild step biyond ESM bundling. Total JS we dɛn ship: ~400 KB we dɛn gzip.
webclient.h1_b: `templates/base.html` na di Jinja2-rɛnda shel. `static/js/main.js` na di ES-mɔdyul ɛntrɛ. Ficha modul dɛn na `static/js/<ficha>/` les-lɔd pan fɔs yuz. CSS in `static/css/` wit wan 1-fayl-pa-komponent kɔnvɛnshɔn. Savis Wokman de handle di kesh; initial lod na frɔm nɛtwɔk, afta dat na frɔm kesh; ɔpdet chɛk dɛn pan nevigishɔn.
webclient.h1_c: Stay off frameworks bin bi wan deliberate v0.0.1 disishun afta benchmarking React en Vue PWAs na ~1.5 MB gzipped wit similar features. Vanila JS + ES modul dɛn de gi wi ~400 KB. Di tred-ɔf na mɔ DOM-manipuleshɔn bɔylplet, we wi de mitigate wit smɔl ɛlda dɛn na `static/js/lib/dom.js`.
webclient.h2_a: Ɔflayn mɔd: ɔtgo rayt kiyu to IndexedDB; Savis Wokman de flush we kɔnɛkshɔn kam bak.
webclient.h2_b: Eni POST / PATCH we di yuza mek ɔflayna gɛt idempotency ki ɛn land na `outbox` (IndexedDB). Savis Wokman de lisin fɔ `ɔnlayn` ivin ɛn ri-post wit di idempotency ki as hεda. Sava de rɛkɔgnayz dupliket dɛn via idempotency ki ɛn ritɔn di ɔrijinal rispɔns. Ridin de wok ful ɔflayna — ɔl di sink sayfatɛks de liv insay IndexedDB ɛn dikript lokal wan wit di in-mɛmori ki dɛn.
webclient.h2_c: Idempotency ki fɔ POST dɛn we dɛn kin tray bak na Stripe in 2017 kɔnvɛnshɔn, we bɔku pan di mɔdan API dɛn dɔn adopt. IndexedDB as ɔtbɔks na di patɛn Google Drayv wɛb de yuz fɔ ɔflayn ɛdit. Vortex in implimɛnt na ~200 layn dɛn na `static/js/lib/outbox.js`.
webclient.h3_a: 146-langwej bɔndɛl na `statik/lɔkal/*.json`. Welkam skrin saykl tru nativ-nem hint (`Выберите язык` / `Pik yu langwej` / `选择语言` / ...).
webclient.h3_b: Fɔs lonch: `lang-picker.js` sho wan tayprayta-animated hint we de rɔta tru 97 lokal dɛn na 45 ms/char, stɔp 1.8 s, dilit na 30 ms/char, advans. Yuzman de pik wan langwej; bin kɔntinyu fɔ de na `localStorage.vortex_lang`. Ɛvri rɔn we de kam afta dat de rid di chuk we dɛn dɔn sev. Rɔntaym switch: `setLang(code)` de lod di JSON, ri-rɛnd `data-i18n` ɛlimɛnt dɛn.
webclient.h3_c: Di tayprayta-hint patɛn na ɔmajɛ to ol tɛminal splash skrin ɛn dɛn bin adopt am fɔ UX wam afta di v0.0.6 beta sho se yuza dɛn ignore wan statik drɔpdɔwn. Sayklin hint de gi 1 sɛkɔn winda fɔ ɛni yuza fɔ si dɛn langwej in nem ɛn no am wantɛm wantɛm.
webclient.h1_f:
shel: tɛmplat/base.html (Jinja2 we dɛn rɛnd wit sava)
ɛntri: statik/js/mɛn.js (ES mɔdyul)
ficha dɛn: statik/js/{chat,rum,ɔth,kɔl,fayl,bɔt}/...
SW: statik/savis-wokman.js
saiz: ~400 KB gzipped totɛl
webclient.h2_f:
ɔflayna rayt flɔ:
  1. kɔmpyutayt idempotency_key = rand (16).hɛks
  2. db.outbox.put ({url, we, bɔdi, idempotency_ki, ts})
  3. pan 'onlayn': flush ɔtbɔks
     fɔ ɛni row: fetch(url, {mɛtɔd, bɔdi, hεda dɛn: {"Idempotency-Key": ikey}})
       → 2xx: pul di row
       → 4xx: drɔp row (fɔ ɔltɛm nɔ wok) .
       → 5xx/ɔflayn: tray bak leta

lang-pikɛr.js:
  hints = ["Выберите язык", "Pik yu langwej", "Elige tu idioma", ...]
  tayp hint na 45 ms/char → stɔp 1.8 s → dilit na 30 ms/char → stɔp 0.2 s → nɛks

security.title: Di we aw pɔsin kin tinap fɔ sikyɔriti
security.subtitle: Threat model, difens-in-dip, WAF, ɔdit trel, kanari.
security.intro: Vortex de yuz difens-in-dip: fɔ brok wan layt nɔ inof, rial atak pɔsin nid fɔ win bɔku indipɛndɛnt win.
security.h1p1: **Pasiv nɛtwɔk ɔbzhɔva**: de si TLS paket dɛn; de du saiz/taym analisis. Dɛn bin win am bay Level 1 stealth.
security.h1p2: **Aktiv nɛtwɔk atak**: kin drɔp/dilay/injɛkt. Dɛn bin win am bay Level 2-4 stealth.
security.h1p3: **Komprɔmis node ɔpreshɔn**: de si sayfatɛks + mɛtadata. Di tin dɛn we de insay di mɛsej kin stil bi kɔnfidɛns.
security.h1p4: **Stolen client device**: plaintext fɔ mɛsej dɛn we dɔn pas we dɛn dɔn ɛksplɔz. Dabl Ratchet limit to di sɛshɔn we de naw; wayp-ɔn-nɛks-ɔnlɔk de.
security.h1p5: **Kwantum ɛnimi wit stod past trafik**: win bay haybrid Kyber-768 sɛshɔn ki we ɔl tu di kɔmpin dɛn advatayz PQ.
security.h2p1: Rikwest inspɛkta: SQLi patɛn, pat travasal, tɛmplat injɛkshɔn, LFI, NoSQLi. Drɔp bifo di ap kɔd.
security.h2p2: Rat limit: global 1000 req/s sɔft kap wit bɔrst; fɔ ɛni rod (lɔgin 10/min, rɛjista 5/min); per-yuz 100 req/s afta auth.
security.h3p1: Ivent dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit sikyɔriti (admin akshɔn, fedareshɔn chenj, rilis ɔpgrɛd, panik wayp) hash-chened via `app/security/canary.py`.
security.h3p2: Chen brek ⇒ tampering detekt. Alert faya dɛn.
security.h3p3: `/api/admin/audit` de ɛksplɔz di lɔg (admin ɔth nɔmɔ). Na fɔ apɛnd nɔmɔ.
security.h4: Rispɔns we di tin we apin
security.h4p1: Canary fayl sayn ɛvride wit rilis ki. Absence ⇒ kɔmprɔmis we dɛn sɔspɛkt.
security.h4p2: Imejɛnsi rivokeshɔn: admin de brodkas `{tayp:"n", ivin:"kɔmprɔmis", ...}` to ɛvri WebSocket. Klaynt dɛn kin wayp di ki dɛn we dɛn dɔn kech.
security.h4p3: Roteshɔn: nyu rilis ki, ri-sayn manifɔst, ri-pɔblish. Klaynt dɛn de ri-bootstrap.
security.h1_a: Fo ɛnimi klas dɛn de drɛb di dizayn: pasiv ɔbzhɔva, aktif atak, kɔmprɔmis ɔpreshɔn, kɔmprɔmis divays. Ɛni wan pan dɛn win bay difrɛn layt.
security.h1_b: Pasiv ɔbzhɔva: de si TLS-ɛnkript paket, de du trafik analisis. Dɛn bin win am bay Level 1-2 stealth. Aktiv atak: kin drɔp/dilay/injɛkt paket dɛn. Dɛn bin win am bay Level 3-4 stealth. Kɔmprɔmis ɔpreshɔn: de si sayfatɛks + mɛtadata. Dɛn dɔn win am bay E2E kripto + mɛtadata minimayzeshɔn. Divays we dɔn kɔmprɔmis: de si klia tɛks fɔ mɛsej dɛn we dɔn pas. Damej we dɛn bɔnd bay fɔdɔm sikrit (Dɔbul Ratchet) ɛn panik wayp.
security.h1_c: Di fכ-klas mכdel kכmכt frכm Schneier in 1999 "Applied Cryptography" trεt mכdel taksonomi, we dεn εkstend wit post-Snowden obsכbishכn bכt stet-lεvεl obsכva. Ɛvri mɔdan sikyu-mɛsenja dizayn de tɔk bɔt sɔntin lɛk am. Vortex in twist na fɔ ad fayv klas fɔ di v0.4 rodmap: kwantum-ɛnibɛl ɛnimi wit stod past trafik, we Kyber de handle.
security.h2_a: Di WAF de inspɛkt ɛvri rikwest bifo i rich di ap kɔd, i de rijɛkt SQL-i, pat traversal, tɛmplat injɛkshɔn, NoSQLi.
security.h2_b: `app/security/middleware.py::WAFMiddleware` de ron ~50 regex chɛk agens URL, kwɛstyɔn, ɛn bɔdi. Patεn dεm we dεn no-malicious (`UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config }}`, `$where`) → 403. Rεt limit: gכl 1000 rεq/s sכft kap wit bכrst tכlerεns; per-rout `/lɔgin` 10/min, `/rɛjista` 5/min; per-yuz 100 req/s afta auth. Jio-blɔk opshɔnal via `GEO_BLOCK=RU,CN,IR` fɔ satisfay sankshɔn rikwaymɛnt fɔ kɔmpliant ɔpreshɔn.
security.h2_c: WAFs as midulwɛr na wan establish patɛn — mod_security (2002), Cloudflare in WAF, AWS WAF. Vortex's na intentionally minimal bikɔs wan hevi WAF de mek lay lay positif dɛm we de drawn rial threat. Di regex list bin kompilayt frɔm OWASP Top 10 sayn ɛn rifin insay v0.0.5 afta wan beta WAF rul blok di literal string "DROP TABLE" insay wan chat mɛsej bɔt SQL.
security.h3_a: Ivent dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit sikyɔriti land na wan hash-chened ɔdit lɔg. We di chen brok, dat de sho se dɛn dɔn chenj am.
security.h3_b: Ɛvri admin akshɔn, fedareshɔn chenj, rilis ɔpgrɛd, ɔ panik wayp, dɛn put am insay `audit_log(ts, event, actor_id, target_id, detail_cbor)`. Ɛni rɔw de kɛr `prev_hash = hash(prev_row)`. Di kɔrɛnt rɔw in hash de kɔmpyutayt oba `ts ∥ ivin ∥ prev_hash`. If dɛn dilit ɔ chenj ɛni rɔw, di row dɛn we de kam afta dat in `prev_hash` chen de brok — we dɛn kin no bay we dɛn riplay di chen.
security.h3_c: Hash-chened ɔdit lɔg na wan ol primitiv (hash-linked timestamping, 1991). Linux auditd de yuz dɛn. Git in kɔmit DAG na essentially di sem strɔkchɔ. Vortex ad dɛm na v0.0.6 afta wan kɔnsultɛnt pɔynt se wan kɔmprɔmis node kin silently erase log rows.
security.h4_a: Insidɛnt rispɔns na prɛ-plan: kanari pruv se rilis ki nɔ kɔmprɔmis; imejensi rivokeshɔn de wayp di ki dɛn we dɛn dɔn kech akɔdin to ɔl di klaynt dɛn.
security.h4_b: Daily `canary.txt` we di rilis ki sayn, we dɛn pablish nia di kɔntrol. Klaynt dɛn opshɔnal fɔ verify pan statap — absɛns ⇒ kɔmprɔmis sɔspɛkt. If dɛn kɔnfyus kɔmprɔmis: admin de brodkas `{type:"n", ivin:"kɔmprɔmis", rizin}` ova ɛvri WebSocket. Klaynt dɛn de wayp di ki dɛn we dɛn dɔn kech, fos fɔ login bak. Nyu rilis ki mint, manifest ri-sayn, klaynt dɛn ri-bootstrap frɔm di miro intɛgriti ɛndpɔynt. Ol sayfatɛks we dɛn mek we dɛn mek am fɔ mek pɔsin nɔ ebul fɔ rid am.
security.h4_c: Kanari fayl dɛn tray to Apple in 2013 warrant kanari ɛn di `canarywatch.org` projɛkt. Signal de yuz dɛn. Vortex's na otomatik: wan kron de sayn `canary.txt` wit di rilis ki evri 24 h. Imejɛnsi rivokeshɔn brodkas na di sem patɛn we Let's Encrypt de yuz fɔ sɛtifiket mas-rivokeshɔn.

privacy.title: Prayvesi ɛn fɔ fala di lɔ
privacy.subtitle: GDPR, rayt-fɔ-ɛras, mɛtadata minimizayshɔn, data pɔtabiliti.
privacy.intro: Vortex ship GDPR ɛn CCPA tul aut ɔf di bɔks. Di ɔpreshɔn dɛn we de na di jɔrisdikshɔn dɛn we dɛn dɔn rigul gɛt wan admin ɛndpɔynt fɔ ɛvri lɔ we dɛn aks fɔ.
privacy.h1p1: No IP logs bay difɔlt. Rivas prɔksi strip dɛn `X-Real-IP` pas nɔmɔ di ɔpreshɔn opt in.
privacy.h1p2: `sender_pseudo` insay mɛsej row dɛn de hash rial sɛnda ID dɛn — wan DB dɔmp de sho ɔl di pseudonym dɛn fɔ ɛni rum.
privacy.h1p3: Sɔch de yuz ɛnkript-token dɛn. Klaynt de ɛnkript ki wɔd dɛn wit rum ki; node de kip opaque token dɛn; lukɔp na ɛksaktɔ-match pan sayfatɛks token dɛn.
privacy.h1p4: Las-si truncated to yuza in pik granularity.
privacy.h2p1: `POST /api/privacy/erase` de mek di yuza rɔw nɔ no in nem, i de wayp dɛn mɛsej dɛn we dɛn sɛn (mɛtadata we dɛn kip fɔ kworom), i de dilit fayl dɛn frɔm disk.
privacy.h2p2: Fɛdareshɔn: sayn gɔsip de tɛl dɛn kɔmpin dɛn; dɛn kin ɛras na dɛn sayd insay 72 h.
privacy.h2p3: Odit: erasure de log wit di timestamp ɛn (hashed) yuz id so di ɔpreshɔn kin pruv se i de fala di lɔ.
privacy.h3p1: `GET /api/privacy/export` de strim wan zip: profayl JSON, sɛn/risiv sayfatɛks, fayl rɛfrɛns wit ɛni-fayl rut ki, kɔntakt list.
privacy.h3p2: Jɛnɛreshɔn tɛm: ~5 min fɔ 10 k mɛsej, we dɛn bɔnd bay IO.
privacy.h3p3: Di pɔsin we gɛt di sik fɔ dikript sayfa tɛks na di say we i de; ɛkspɔt tul dɛn de ship alongsay.
privacy.h4p1: Lɔng-pres logo 5 s → lokal wayp wantɛm wantɛm: ki dɛn, mɛsej dɛn we dɛn dɔn kesh, atɛshmɛnt dɛn.
privacy.h4p2: Kɔpl wayp: `/api/privacy/panic` bak de tombstone di sava-sayd akɔn.
privacy.h1_a: No IP logs bay difɔlt. No yuz-identifying metadata pan mɛsej row dɛn. Ful-tɛks sɔch oba token dɛn we dɛn dɔn ɛnkript.
privacy.h1_b: Rivεs prכksi strip `X-Real-IP` bifo di node si am pas כpεrayt opt ​​in fכ rεt-limitin. Mesej row dɛn de kip `sender_id` (fɔ ACL) ɛn `sender_pseudo` (fɔ fan-ɔut); sender_pseudo na HMAC(rum_salt, sender_id) so wan DB dump nɔ de sho udat tɔk wetin akɔdin to rum dɛn. Sɔch: klaynt de ɛnkript di ki wɔd dɛn wit di rum ki; node de kip opaque token dɛn; lukɔp na ɛksaktɔ-match pan sayfatɛks token, nɔ pleintɛks indeks.
privacy.h1_c: Metadata minimization na di post-Snowden kɔnsɛns — Signal bin pɔpulayz am insay 2014, WhatsApp bin fala wit sender-pseudo insay 2019. Enkript sɔch ova sayfatɛks token na di CryptDB (2011) ɛn ShadowCrypt (2014) patɛn. Vortex in implimɛnt na wan strip-dɔwn vɛshɔn we de tred sɔm kwɛstyɔn fleksibiliti fɔ simpul.
privacy.h2_a: `POST /api/privacy/erase` de mek di yuza rɔw nɔ no udat i bi, i de was dɛn sayfa tɛks we dɛn sɛn, i de dilit fayl dɛn, ɛn i de notis di fedaret kɔmpin dɛn.
privacy.h2_b: Sava-sayd: `yuzman` row in sɛnsitiv fil dɛn ziro (`yuz nem = "dilit-<id>"`, `fon = nul`, `imel = nul`, `display_nem = "[dilit]"`); `messages.ciphertext` sɛt NULL fɔ ɔl di row dɛn usay `sender_id = u.id`; fayl dɛn we gɛt link frɔm dɛn mɛsej dɛn de we dɛn dɔn dilit frɔm disk. Fɛdaret kɔmpin dɛn kin gɛt wan sayn `{ivent: "erasure", yuz_id, sayn_bay}` gɔsip; dεn de rכn di sem purge na dεn sayd insay 72 h (SLA).
privacy.h2_c: Rayt fɔ ɛras na GDPR Atikul 17 rikwaymɛnt frɔm 2018. CCPA fala insay 2020; LGPD (Brazil) in 2021. Vortex ship di primitiv ɔt-ɔf-di-bɔks so ɔpreshɔn dɛn na rigyuletɛd jɔrisdikshɔn nɔ nid fɔ bil am. Di 72 h fedareshɔn SLA de mach GDPR in 30 de rispɔns winda wit edrum fɔ prɔpageshɔn.
privacy.h3_a: `GET /api/privacy/export` de strim wan zip: profayl JSON, sɛn/risiv sayfatɛks, fayl rɛfrɛns wit ɛni-fayl rut ki, kɔntakt list.
privacy.h3_b: Jɛnɛreshɔn na async bikɔs big akɔn dɛn kin tek minit. Klaynt POST dɛn rikwest → node ɛnkyu wok → wok de rɔn na bakgrɔn → klaynt poll `/api/privacy/export/{job_id}` → 200 wit sayn URL we i rɛdi. Zip kɔntinyu: `profile.json`, `rooms.jsonl` (wan pan ɛni rum), `messages.jsonl.enc` (sayfatɛks + fɔ ɛni fayl rut ki), `fayl/` (dɔwnlod-as-is blob).
privacy.h3_c: Data pɔtabiliti na di twin rikwaymɛnt wit ɛras insay GDPR. Apple, Google, Telegram, Signal ɔl gɛt tek-ɔut tul dɛn. Vortex's ad di ki matirial (file_root per file) so di yuza dɛn kin dɛkript di ɛkspɔt lokal — ɔdasay di ɛkspɔt nɔ yuslɛs. Witout dis ditel di Apple / Google takeouts na ifektivli plaintext-onli bikos dem don olredi decrypt.
privacy.h4_a: Panik wayp: lɔng-pres di Vortex logo fɔ 5 sɛkɔn fɔ pwɛl ɔl di ki dɛn ɛn di data we dɛn dɔn kech na di divays wantɛm wantɛm. I nɔ go ebul fɔ chenj.
privacy.h4_b: Klaynt-sayd: pan 5-sɛkɔn lɔng-prɛs, sho kɔnfɔmeshɔn; pan kɔnfɔm, kɔl `waypKeychainItems()` / `kliarKistɔr()` / `lɔkalStɔrej.kliar() + indeksDB.databases().fɔƐvri(dilitDatabase)`. Cashed ciphertext nɔ de igen, di ki dɛn nɔ de igen, JWT dɛn nɔ de igen. Opshɔnal kɔpl wayp: `POST /api/privacy/panic` bak tombstones di akɔn sava-sayd ɛn fedaret wan erasure gɔsip.
privacy.h4_c: Panik bɔtin / dɛd-man switch dɛn gɛt lɔng istri pan sikyɔriti mɛsej: Wickr in 2014 "Shred", Cryptocat in 2013 "Fɔgɛt", Signal in "Secure Deletion" prɔpɔzal (2016, dɛn nɔ ɛva ship am). Vortex in 5-sɛkɔn lɔng-prɛs na bay wilful at fɔ trig aksidɛntli — wi stɔdi haptik fidbak pan iPhone 15 ɛn Pixel 8 ɛn pik 5 s as di swit ples bitwin "fast inof insay imejensi" ɛn "nɔ kin faya bay poket-bɔt".
privacy.h1_f:
sender_pseudo = HMAC-SHA256(rum_sɔlt, pɔsin we sɛn_id)[:16]
  ⇒ DB dump: {rum, pɔsin we sɛn am_pseudo, sayfatɛks}
  ⇒ atak pɔsin nɔ ebul fɔ link sender_pseudo akɔdin to rum dɛn (difrɛn sɔl dɛn)

sɔch token = HMAC-SHA256(rum_ki, ki wɔd)
  ⇒ kwɛstyɔn "hello" ⇒ kɔmpyutayt token ⇒ ɛksaktɔ-match indeks lukɔp
  ⇒ node nɔ de ɛva si pleintɛks ki wɔd
privacy.h2_f:
POST /api/prayvesi/ɛras (sɛlf-savis)
  UPDATE yuza dɛm SET yuzɛn nem='dilit-'||id, fon=NULL, imel=NULL, ... WHERE id=$u
  UPDATE mɛsej dɛn SET sayfatɛks=NULL WHERE sɛnda_id=$u
  DELETE FROM fayl dɛn WHERE dɛn dɔn ɔplod_bay=$u
  gossip {ivent:"erasure", yuza_id, sig:Ed25519(rilis_priv, ivent)}

debugging.title: Dibɔg ɛn diagnostik
debugging.subtitle: Tul fɔ trak dɔŋ ishu dɛn na dev, stej, ɛn prod.
debugging.intro: Ɛvri sabsistim gɛt strɔkchɔ lɔg ɛn wan /mɛtrik sɔfa. Na dis na di usual diagnosis plebuk.
debugging.h1p1: JSON-strɔkchɔ bay difɔlt. `logger.info("akshɔn", ekstra={"yuz_id": ...})` de prodyuz `{"ts":..., "lvl":"INFO", "msg":"akshɔn", "yuz_id": ...}`.
debugging.h1p2: Rotate na 100 MB; kip 14 gens we dɛn dɔn gzip.
debugging.h1p4: Kɔrɛleshɔn id: ɛvri rikwest kin gɛt wan `X-Rɛkwɛst-Id`; RPC dɛn we de dɔŋstrim de yuz am bak.
debugging.h2p2: RED: ret / mistek / durayshɔn fɔ ɛni rod.
debugging.h2p3: USE: yutilizeshɔn / sɛtyureshɔn / mistek fɔ ɛni DB pul, WebSocket fan-ɔt, TURN rilay.
debugging.h2p4: Kastom: aktif rum, mɛsej/dɛn, stɔl-lɛvɛl histogram.
debugging.h3p1: `py-spy` fɔ rɔntaym sampul. Ataya to di node we de rɔn PID.
debugging.h3p2: `memray` fɔ hip profayl. 1 minit snapshot de sho lik kwik kwik wan.
debugging.h3p3: Rust ɛkstenshɔn `vortex_chat` de ɛkspɔt `--profile` flag we de rayt wan trays we kɔmpitabl wit flamegraf.
debugging.h4p1: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` de rɔn rɛjista/lɔgin/sɛnd/risiv/lɔg ɔut agens wan lokal node. Exits non-ziro pan ɛni fayl.
debugging.h4p2: CI de ron smok pan evri PR as well as pan merges to main.
debugging.h4p3: Prodakshɔn smok: ɛksternal prob we de hit wan kanari akɔn wan tɛm pan minit.
debugging.h1_a: Lɔg dɛn na JSON-strɔkchɔ bay difɔlt. Ɛvri lɔg layn inklud ts, lɛvɛl, mɔdyul, mɛsej, ɛn wan kɔrɛleshɔn id.
debugging.h1_b: `logger.info("yuz_kriet", ekstra={"yuz_id": u.id})` prodyuz `{"ts":"2026-04-21T10:23:14.127Z", "lvl":"INFO", "mod":"ɔth", "msg":"yuz_kriet", "yuz_id": 42, "req_id": "..."}`. Kɔrɛleshɔn id kɔmɔt frɔm `X-Rɛkwɛst-Id` hεda; evri dכwnstrim RPC de yuz am bak. Rotashɔn na 100 MB; kip 14 jɛnɛreshɔn dɛn gzipped. Level per-modul via `LOG_LEVEL_<MODULE>=DEBUG`.
debugging.h1_c: Structured JSON logging na di kɔrɛnt kɔnsɛns — we Stripe, Datadog, ɛvri mɔdan obshɔbibiliti vendor adopt. Kɔrɛleshɔn ID dɛn de tray to X-Rɛkwɛst-Id (RFC 4557) ɛn bi kanonik insay maykrosavis dɛn via Jaeger / Zipkin (2015). Vortex de yuz wan simpul hεda-prכpagεt kכrεleshכn id pas distribyushכn trays biכs di distribut-trayz tul de ad kכmplisiti we wi nכ nid yet.
debugging.h2_a: Prometheus mɛtrik na `/mɛtrik` (admin-ɔtɛnɛtik insay prodakshɔn). Grafana dashbɔd dɛn we dɛn ship insay `diploy/grafana/`.
debugging.h2_b: RED mɛtrik fɔ ɛni rod: rikwest rɛt, mistek rɛt, durayshɔn histogram. USE mɛtrik fɔ ɛni risɔs: DB pul yutilayzeshɔn, WebSocket fan-ɔt sɛtyureshɔn, TURN rilay bandwid. Kastɔm: aktif rum dɛn, mɛsej dɛn fɔ wan sɛkɔn, stɔl-lɛvɛl histogram. Admin dashbɔd na `/admin/metrics` de sho di chɛt dɛn we de ɔp; Prometheus de skrap fɔ ful istri.
debugging.h2_c: RED (rɛt / mistek / durayshɔn) na Weaveworks in 2016 akɔdin. USE (yutilayzeshɔn / sɛtyureshɔn / mistek) na Brendan Grɛg in 2013 mɛtodɔlɔji. Tugeda dɛn de kɔba savis-lɛvɛl ɛn risɔs-lɛvɛl signal dɛn. Prometheus + Grafana na di opin-sɔs difɔlt frɔm 2016.
debugging.h3_a: `py-spy` fɔ rɔntaym sampul; `memray` fɔ hip snɛpsho dɛn; `vortex_chat` Rust ekstenshɔn gɛt `--prɔfayl` fɔ flamegraf trays.
debugging.h3_b: `py-spy record -o profile.svg --pid <node>` fɔ 60 s de prodyuz wan flamegraf SVG we de sho hot Python stak. `memray run -o mem.bin <cmd>` de trak alɔkeshɔn dɛn; `memray flamegraf mem.bin` de rɛnd. Rust ekstenshɔn de ɛkspɔt intanɛnt profayl dɛn as Chrome-tracing JSON we dɛn kɔl am wit `--profile`. Pe ɛni wan pan dɛn wit wan lod-tɛst we de rɔn tru `scripts/smoke/all.sh` fɔ kɔnsistɛns shep dɛn.
debugging.h3_c: py-spy (2018) na wan nɔ-intrusive statystik profayl we de ataya to wan rɔn Python prɔses we nɔ gɛt kɔd chenj — di Go fɔ Python profayl. memray (Bloomberg, 2022) na di bεst Python hip profayl tide. Rust in yon profayl ekosistim na machɔ bɔt i nɔ intagret bɛtɛ; wi ɛkstenshɔn de ɛkspɔt Chrome-tracing spɛshal bikɔs ɛvri brawza gɛt viewer we dɛn bil insay.
debugging.h4_a: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` ɛgzampul dɛn de rɛjista/lɔgin/sɛnd/risiv/lɔg ɔut agens wan lokal node. CI de ron am pan ɛvri PR.
debugging.h4_b: Smok de rɔn insay ~5 sɛkɔn. Krio tu fresh akaunt, opin wan DM, sen mɛsej, verify delivri, log ɔl tu. Exits non-ziro pan ɛni fayl. CI invok am post-bild. Wan separet prod-smok kanari de rɔn ɛvri minit frɔm wan ɛksternal prob agens wan dediket tɛst akɔn na di prodakshɔn node.
debugging.h4_c: Smok tɛst na Toyota faktri mɛtafɔ (1950s) — rɔn wan kwik chɛk fɔ kɔnfɔm se di sistɛm nɔ klia wan brok. Insay sɔftwɛl dɛn bin bi standad afta Maykɛl Fɛdas in "Wɔking Effectively wit Legacy Code" (2004). Vortex in smok skript na ~200 layn dɛn fɔ bash + kɔl.

testing.title: Testing strateji
testing.subtitle: 29 k layn dɛn fɔ tɛst akɔdin to Python, Swift, Kotlin, JS.
testing.intro: Ɛvri layt gɛt in yon tɛst suit. CI de ron ol dεm insay כnda 10 minit.
testing.h1p1: `pytest app/tests` de kɔba routers, sikyɔriti, transpɔt, bot.
testing.h1p2: Hypothesis prɔpati-bɛs tɛst dɛn pan kripto: `assert decrypt(encrypt(m, k), k) == m` fɔ 1000 random m.
testing.h1p3: AFL-stayl fuz pan WAF: milyan malformed inputs — asɛt nɔ 5xx lik.
testing.h2p1: `swift test` in `ios/Modules/` de ron yunit tɛst agens RFC 7748 / 8032 / 5869 / 8446 tɛst vektɔ dɛn.
testing.h2p2: XCUI tɛst dɛn de drɛb SwiftUI views insay wan edlɛs simyulatɔ; snɛpsho we dɛn kɔmpia am.
testing.h3p2: `./gradlew connectedCheck` de rɔn instrɔmɛnt tɛst dɛn pan wan ɛmulatɔ we de rɔn.
testing.h4p1: Playwright de drayv di wɛb klaynt, edlɛs Chrome + edlɛs Fayafaks. Kɔl dɛn de ɛksɛsayz wit `--yuz-fake-ui-fɔ-midya-strim`.
testing.h4p2: Sɛnario: rɛjista tu akɔn → DM → sɛn fayl → dilit → chɛk fɔ sink → dɔn.
testing.h1_a: Python tɛst dɛn de yuz pytest + kɔvarej. Evri router, evri sekuriti primitiv, evri transpot module get test. ~80 % kɔvarej.
testing.h1_b: `pytest app/tests` de ron di ful suit insay ɔnda 2 minit pan wan kɔr. Hypothesis prɔpati-bɛs tɛst pan kripto primitiv: `assert decrypt(encrypt(m, k), k) == m` fɔ 1000 random mɛsej dɛn. AFL-stayl fכz tεst dεm pan di WAF: milכn mכlfכm input dεm we dεn asεrt fכ prodyuz 4xx (nכto 5xx) rεspכns. `pytest --cov=app` fɔ kɔvarej.
testing.h1_c: pytest (Holger Krekel, 2009) na di de-fakto Python tɛst rɔna. Hypothesis (2015) fɔ prɔpati-bɛs tɛst pɔt di KwikChɛk aydia frɔm Haskell. AFL (Michał Zalewski, 2013) fɔ fuz na di kanonik kɔvarej-gayd fuz. Vortex in stak na men tin; di onli flawa na wi prεfrεns fכ pytest parametrisation ova tεst-klas inhεritεns.
testing.h2_a: Swift tɛst dɛn na `ios/Modules/` kɔba kripto primitiv dɛn agens RFC tɛst vektɔ dɛn plus SwiftUI snɛpsho tɛst dɛn.
testing.h2_b: `swift test` frɔm `ios/Modules/` de rɔn yunit tɛst dɛn insay ɔnda 1 s. RFC 7748 (X25519) vektɔ dɛn. RFC 8032 (Ed25519) vektɔr dɛn. RFC 5869 (HKDF) vektɔ dɛn. RFC 8446 (TLS 1.3) fiks dɛn. SwiftUI privyu snɛpshɔt dɛn we dɛn kɔmpia via imej difrɛns agens di git-trak beslayn; rigrɛshɔn pan ɛni piksɛl de fel di bild.
testing.h2_c: Test kripto agens ɔfishal tɛst vektɔ na di mɔs buletpruf prɔsis — if yu kɔd gri wit di RFC vektɔ, i kɔnfɔmant bay difinishɔn. Snapshot tɛst fɔ SwiftUI na ~2022 stet ɔf di at, we dɛn dɔn pɔpul bay pointfreeco/swift-snapshot-testing. Vortex de yuz wan minimal in-haus vεshכn fכ avכyd di dipεndεns.
testing.h3_a: Kotlin tɛst dɛn: JVM-onli via `./gradlew tɛst`; instrumented via `./gradlew connectedCheck` pan wan ɛmulatɔ we de rɔn.
testing.h3_b: `./gradlew test` de rɔn insay sɔm sɛkɔn — nɔ Andrɔyd fremwɔk nid, jɔs JUnit + Hilt-android-testing. Yunit-tɛst target: kripto, prɛzɛnt, kɔrotin-bɛs flɔ. `./gradlew connectedCheck` de spin op wan emulator, instɔl di ap, rɔn UI tɛst dɛn via Espresso. E2E de flɔ: login → sɛn mɛsej → si na chat.
testing.h3_c: Separet JVM-onli tɛst frɔm instrɔmɛnt tɛst na di Andrɔyd 2019+ kɔnvɛnshɔn. JVM tεst dεm de fast (sεkכnd); instrכmεnt tεst dεm de slo (minit). Robolectric (2014) bin yus fɔ brij di gap bɔt dɛn dɔn riples am bɔku pan dis split insay mɔdan Andrɔyd divɛlɔpmɛnt.
testing.h4_a: Playwright de drayv di wɛb klaynt insay edlɛs Chrome ɛn Firefox, ɛksɛsayz rial rɛjista → DM → kɔl flɔ.
testing.h4_b: `playwright-tests/` de ol sɛnɛriɔ dɛn na TaypSkript. Wan trowe node + Postgres de spun op fɔ ɛni tɛst sɛshɔn via docker kɔmpoz. Tɛst dɛn de drɛb di wɛb UI: rɛjista tu akɔn, opin DM, sɛn mɛsej, chɛk di delivri, mek vidio kɔl wit `--yuz-fake-ui-fɔ-midya-strim` + `--yuz-fake-divays-fɔ-midya-strim` flag dɛn so Chrome go jenarayz sɛntetik ɔdio/vidio. Scenarios run in parallel via Ple Rayt wokman dɛm.
testing.h4_c: Playwright (Microsoft, 2020) bin tek ples fɔ Selenium fɔ mɔs wɛb E2E tɛst bikɔs i fast, i rili izi, ɛn i gɛt bɛtɛ dibɔg. WebRTC tɛst insay brawza dɛn we nɔ gɛt ed na bin pen pɔynt te Chrome 69 ad fek-divays flag dɛn; sins den i don bi standad praktis.

apiSurface.subtitle: εvri HTTP εndpכynt di no de εkspכz, grup bay εria.
apiSurface.intro: Dis na di list we gɛt pawa fɔ di rod dɛn we pipul dɛn kin pas. Ɛni ɛndpɔynt kad de ɛkspɛn fɔ sho di rizin, ɔth taya, riŋwe / rispɔns skima, mistek tebul, ɛn wan kɔl ɛgzampul. Intanɛt haus kipin rod dɛn ɔnda `/internal/*`, dɛn nɔ put dɛn bay polisi.

auth.title: Ɔthɛntishɔn
auth.subtitle: Rɛjista, login, rifresh, rivok — ɛn di rikavari pat dɛn.
auth.intro: Ɔl di rod dɛn we de ɔnda `/api/ɔtɛnɛshɔn/*`. Di JWT we kɔmɔt frɔm wan saksesful lɔgin de kɛr `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, typ: access|refresh}` sayn HS256 oba di node in sikrit. Akses de las 15 min, rifresh 30 dez.

register.title: POST /api/ɔthɛntishɔn/rɛjista
register.subtitle: Krio nyu yuza wit X25519 aydentiti + Argon2id paswɔd.
register.h1_a: Krio nyu yuza akaunt ɛn gi wan initial JWT pe. Bind di yuza in lɔng-layv X25519 pɔblik ki to di akɔn frɔm di fɔs kɔl.
register.h1_b: Node validet ɔl di fil dɛm via Pydantic, chɛk yuzɛn nem ɛn x25519_public_key yuniknɛs, rɔn Argon2id (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) pan di paswɔd, insayt insay `yuz`, `yuz_divays`, `push_sabskripshɔn`, mints akses + rifresh JWTs.
register.h1_c: Shipped in v0.0.1 as di fɔs ɛndpɔynt. Di X25519 pubkey paramita bin ad insay v0.0.2 afta dɛn rili no se aydentiti ɛn akɔn nid fɔ mek atɔmik — ɔdasay di sava kin MITM wan yuza bitwin rɛjista ɛn fɔs ki ɔplod.
register.h2_a: I nid fɔ gɛt: **nɔbɔdi**. Di midulwɛr `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` de get dis rod ɛn rijɛkt wit `401 unauthenticated` if di kredɛns we dɛn nid nɔ de ɔ i nɔ valid.
register.h2_b:
- `nɔbɔdi` — nɔ ɔtɛnɛtik (pri-lɔgin).
- `jwt` — Bearer JWT akses token na di `Atɔrayzayshɔn` hεda.
- `rifresh` — Bearer JWT rifresh token.
- `admin` — JWT we in klem dɛn gɛt `is_admin: tru`.
- `peer-signed` — rikwest bɔdi we dɛn sayn wit wan piɔ we yu trɔst in Ed25519 ki.
register.h2_c: Di ɔth tier de sho di prinsipul fɔ lɛst prɛvilɛj: prɛ-lɔgin ɛndpɔynt dɛn strikt wan limited to akɔn krieshɔn ɛn rikavari; ɔltin biɛn wan JWT de si rial yuza; admin ɛndpɔynt dɛn de sho wan badge na di UI so misyuz na tin we pɔsin kin si.
register.h3_a: JSON bɔdi wit mandatory yuzɛn nem + paswɔd + x25519_pɔblik_ki; opshɔnal fon (E.164), imel (RFC 5322 lite), displei_nem, avatar_emoji, invayt_kɔd, kayba_pɔblik_ki.
register.h3_f:
{
  "yuz nem": "alis", // [a-z0-9_]{3,30}
  "paswɔd": "...", // ≥ 8 char
  "x25519_public_key": "<64-hɛks>", // 32 bayt heks
  "display_name": "Alice", // opshɔnal
  "fon": "+15551234567", // opshɔnal, E.164
  "imel": "a@example.com", // opshɔnal
  "avatar_emoji": "🦊", // opshɔnal, 1 imɔji
  "invite_code": "...", // opshɔnal if INVITE mod
  "kyber_public_key": "<1184 hex>" // opshɔnal, fɔ PQ
} .
register.h4_a: 201 Dɛn mek am wit di JWT pe ɛn di nyu yuza in kanonik profayl.
register.h4_f:
{
  "ok": na tru, .
  "akses_token": "eyJ...", // 15 min TTL
  "rɛfresh_token": "eyJ...", // 30 dez TTL
  "yuz_id": 42, 2019.
  "yuz nem": "alis",
  "display_nem": "Alis" we de sho se di tin dɛn we de apin.
  "avatar_url": nɔ gɛt ɛnitin fɔ du wit am, .
  "x25519_pɔblik_ki": "<64 heks>",
  "kyber_pablik_ki": "<hɛks>".
} .
register.h5: Mistek dɛn we dɛn kin mek
register.h5_a: Standart validɛshɔn + tu domɛyn-spɛsifi k rijɛkt dɛn. `409 username_taken` we di nem de; `409 pubkey_reused` we di X25519 pɔblik ki dɔn ɔlrɛdi rɛjista to ɔda akɔn.

  }'.

login.title: POST /api/ɔtɛnɛshɔn/lɔgin
login.subtitle: Verifay yuzɛn nem + paswɔd, ritɔn JWT pe.
login.h1_a: I de chenj kredibiliti fɔ wan JWT pe. Di paswɔd de verify agens di Argon2id hash na `users.password_hash`. Taym na kɔnstant-taym ivin fɔ yuz nem dɛn we dɛn nɔ no fɔ rɛsist enumɛreshɔn.
login.h1_b: Luk di yuza bay smɔl smɔl yuzɛn nem, de rɔn `argon2.PasswordHasher.verify(stored, submitted)`. If di yuza nɔ de, i de verify agens wan prɛ-kɔmpyut dɛmi hash fɔ ikwal di tɛm. Sakses → isyu JWT + `yuz_divays` row.
login.h1_c: Shipped wit rejista in v0.0.1. Konstant-taym dummy hashing ad in v0.0.2 afta risach pipul sho timing enumeration pan di initial dizain.
login.h2_a: I nid fɔ gɛt: **nɔbɔdi**. Di midulwɛr `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` de get dis rod ɛn rijɛkt wit `401 unauthenticated` if di kredɛns we dɛn nid nɔ de ɔ i nɔ valid.

- `nɔbɔdi` — nɔ ɔtɛnɛtik (pri-lɔgin).
- `jwt` — Bearer JWT akses token na di `Atɔrayzayshɔn` hεda.
- `rifresh` — Bearer JWT rifresh token.
- `admin` — JWT we in klem dɛn gɛt `is_admin: tru`.
- `peer-signed` — rikwest bɔdi we dɛn sayn wit wan piɔ we yu trɔst in Ed25519 ki.
login.h2_c: Di ɔth tier de sho di prinsipul fɔ lɛst prɛvilɛj: prɛ-lɔgin ɛndpɔynt dɛn strikt wan limited to akɔn krieshɔn ɛn rikavari; ɔltin biɛn wan JWT de si rial yuza; admin ɛndpɔynt dɛn de sho wan badge na di UI so misyuz na tin we pɔsin kin si.
login.h5: Mistek dɛn we dɛn kin mek
login.h5_a: Standart Vortex mistek envlop `{eror, stetus, pat}`. `401` pan bad kredibiliti; `403` pan inɔf prɛvilɛj; `422` pan validɛshɔn; `429` pan ret limit; `5xx` pan intanɛnt mistek.
login.h5_f:
401 invalid_credentials bad yuzɛn nem ɔ paswɔd
401 account_suspended akɔn dɔn stɔp
401 totp_rikwayd saplae totp ɛn tray bak
429 rit_limited >10 tray/min/IP

refresh.title: POST /api/ɔtɛnɛshɔn/rifresh
refresh.subtitle: Tred wan rifresh JWT fɔ wan fresh akses JWT.
refresh.h1_a: Mint wan fresh 15 minit akses token we yu nɔ aks di yuza fɔ di paswɔd bak. Dɛn kin yuz am we di akses token we de naw dɔn nia fɔ dɔn ɔ jɔs dɔn gi bak wan 401.

refresh.h1_c: Fɔ fala RFC 6749 OAuth 2.0. Rifresh roteshɔn de ɔf bay difɔlt fɔ avɔyd rɛs we bɔku klaynt dɛn de rifresh wan tɛm.

patch.h2_a: I nid fɔ gɛt: **jwt**. Di midulwɛr `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` de get dis rod ɛn rijɛkt wit `401 unauthenticated` if di kredɛns we dɛn nid nɔ de ɔ i nɔ valid.

- `jwt` — Bearer JWT akses token na di `Atɔrayzayshɔn` hεda.
- `rifresh` — Bearer JWT rifresh token.
- `admin` — JWT we in klem dɛn gɛt `is_admin: tru`.
- `peer-signed` — rikwest bɔdi we dɛn sayn wit wan piɔ we yu trɔst in Ed25519 ki.
