roadmap.title: Rodmap fɔ di rod
roadmap.subtitle: Wetin dɛn dɔn plan ɛn ustɛm.
roadmap.intro: Ay-lɛv we fɔ si tin. Deti na aspirational; sikyɔriti ishu dɛn de bifo di ficha wok.
roadmap.h1p1: Kyber-768 PQ enabled bay difɔlt pan fresh instɔl.
roadmap.h1p2: Grup dɛn we go rich 50 000 mɛmba dɛn wit Variant-B ki de pablish.
roadmap.h1p3: Dɛsktɔp (Tauri) pak fɔ macOS / Windows / Linux.
roadmap.h1p4: Bot marketplace opin fɔ pɔblik sɔbmishɔn.
roadmap.h2p1: Odio-onli grup de kɔl te to 100 patisipan dɛn via SFU.
roadmap.h2p3: Per-partisipant mute / kik in di kol UI.
roadmap.h3p1: Miro-stayl kolaborativ kanvas ova CRDT (Yjs-flavoured) tru di mɛsej layt.
roadmap.h4p1: On-chen escrow fɔ bot bay (Solana + EVM).
roadmap.h4p3: Fiat on/off ramp via Stripe konekt.
roadmap.h5p1: Abov stebul, fɔmal sikyɔriti ɔdit, riprodaktibl bild, SemVer frɔz.
roadmap.h5p3: At ɔl wan indipɛndɛnt sikyɔriti rivyu wit pɔblik rayt-ap.
roadmap.h1_a: v0.2 — sɛkɔn pɔblik rilis. Kyber PQ on bay difɔlt, big pɔblik rum dɛn via Variant-B, Tauri dɛsktɔp pakej dɛn, opin bot makit.
roadmap.h1_b: Kyber-768 difɔlt fɔ ɛnabul fɔ fresh instɔl; klaynt dɛn we nɔ gɛt sɔpɔt grasfully downgrade. Rum dɛn we go rich 50 000 mɛmba dɛn via Variant-B ki de pablish — nɔ fɔ ɛni mɛmba ɛnvilɔp fanout pan roteshɔn. Dɛsktɔp (Tauri 2 wrap rawnd di wɛb klaynt) we dɛn pablish fɔ macOS, Windows, Linux wit di sem bɔndɛl. Bot makit opin fɔ pɔblik sɔbmishɔn wit 3-biznɛs-de rivyu SLA.
roadmap.h1_c: v0.2 na fɔ skel di primitiv dɛn we de naw pas fɔ invent nyu wan dɛn. Kyber bin de ɔltɛm na di rodmap; di swich to difɔlt dipen pan stebiliti ɔnda lod. Dɛn bin pik Tauri pas Ilɛktrɔn bikɔs di bɔndɛl na ~5 MB vs ~150 MB. Bot makit ples pɔblik sɔbmishɔn dɛn bin blok pan rivyu infrastukchɔ we land insay v0.1.
roadmap.h2_a: v0.3 — grup kɔl dɛn. SFU-based odio grup dɛn we go rich 100; vidio grup dɛn we go rich 32; adaptiv simulkas we yu kin yuz.
roadmap.h2_b: SFU impliment in Rust fɔ pefɔmɛns. Opus DTX + FEC + simulkas fɔ ɔdio. VP9 L1/L2/L3 simulkas fɔ vidio wit di SFU pik fɔ ɛni-viu layt bays pan ripɔt dawlink. Per-participant mute ɛn kik frɔm di UI. Kɔl rikodin (kɔnsɛnt-gɛt, ɔf bay difɔlt) we dɛn kip ɛnkript ɔnda wan fɔ ɛni kɔl rut ki we dɛn sheb bitwin di patisipan dɛn.
roadmap.h2_c: Grup kɔl na di singl mɔs-rikwest ficha frɔm di v0.1 beta. SFU dizayn de fala Jitsi Vidiobrij + Janus patɛn. Rust implimɛnt instead fɔ yuz mediasoup bak bikɔs mediasoup in Node.js rɔntaym de ad latɛns we wi nɔ want na di hot pat.
roadmap.h3_a: v0.4 — kanvas we dɛn kin du togɛda. Miro-stayl shered bod ova CRDT (Yjs-flavoured) tru di egzistin mɛsej layt.
roadmap.h3_b: CRDT dokumɛnt sink piggybacks pan rum mɛsej dɛn we dɔn de. Ɛni bod ɛdit na CRDT ɔpreshɔn we dɛn siriɔs as CBOR, we dɛn ɛnkript wit di rum ki, we dɛn post as mɛsej we na `kind:"board_op"`. Klaynt dɛn deserialize, aplay, rɛnd. Rial-taym kɔsa prɛzɛns via wan sɛpret `kind:"board_cursor"` mɛsej tayp. Ekspɔt to PNG / SVG / PDF via klaynt-sayd kanvas rɛndrin.
roadmap.h3_c: CRDTs (Shapiro et al. 2011) bin bi prodakshɔn-viable wit Yjs (Kevin Jahns, 2017). Figma fambul bil dɛn kolaboreshɔn pan wan kɔstɔm CRDT-layk strɔkchɔ. Di aidia fɔ yuz wi ɛnkript mɛsej layt bak pas fɔ bil sɛpret WebSocket chanɛl dɛn kɔmɔt frɔm wan prinsipul: smɔl transpɔt rod, smɔl bɔg.
roadmap.h4_a: v0.5 — pemɛnt dɛn. On-chen escrow (Solana + EVM) + fiat on/ɔf ramp via Stripe Kɔnɛkt.
roadmap.h4_b: Bot bay bay rout tru wan on-chen escrow kontrakt. Di pɔsin we bay di tin gri; 24 h fɔ ol bak; den funds rilis to seller minus 10 % pletfom fi. Disput dɛn kin go to kɔmyuniti arbita dɛn we dɛn kin pik via staking. Fiat on-ramp: Stripe Connect akɔn fɔ ɛni ɔpreshɔn ɔ fɔ ɛni bot sɛlda; ɔf-ramp: dairekt bank transfa ɔ USDC sɛtulmɛnt. Kripto sɔpɔt: SOL, USDC, USDT pan ɔl tu di Solana ɛn Ethereum.
roadmap.h4_c: Escrow smart kontrakt dɛn ol (OpenBazaar 2016) bɔt stil rɔf rawnd di ed dɛn pan tin dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit UX. Vortex de inhɛrit di kɔmplisiti bɔt i de ayd bɔku pan am — di wan dɛn we de bay kin si wan "bay" bɔtin we dɛn sabi. Di 10 % pletfɔm fi de mach di Ap Stɔ kɔnvɛnshɔn dɛn (pan ɔl we Apple tek 30 %); di kot we de dɔŋ na bay wilful fɔ mek di wan dɛn we de sɛl kam.
roadmap.h5_a: v1.0 — we pɔsin kin tinap tranga wan. Sekyuriti ɔdit, riprodyuz bild akɔdin to ɔl di pletfɔm dɛn, SemVer frɔzɛn.
roadmap.h5_b: Tɔd-pati ɔdit scheduled pri-1.0 friz — lɛk Trail of Bits ɔ NCC Grup bays pan kɔmɛshɔnal kot. Riprodaktibl bild min se di sem sɔs tik de prodyuz bit-idɛntik baynary pan ɛni tu bild mashin; dis detekt di saplae-chen tampering. SemVer frozen min se di waya protɔkɔl, stɔrɔj ​​skima, ɛn pɔblik SDK sɔfays gɛt bakwɔd-kɔmpat garanti insay 1.x. Bug bounty program lanch wit wan $25k top taya fɔ rimot kɔd ɛgzikishɔn na di node.
roadmap.h5_c: Di stebiliz-ɔdit-friz sikyud na di patɛn Saynal, Tor, I2P, ɛn WayaGɔd ɔl we dɛn fala. Riprodaktibɛl bild dɛn bin bi men strim afta di Riprodaktibɛl Bilds projɛkt (2014). Vortex de yuz di Riprodaktibl Bilds tulkit. Bug bounties na standad fɔ ɛni prɔjek we de handle yuz data; $25k na mid-tier bay 2025 standad.

aead.title: AEAD .
aead.subtitle: Ɔtɛnɛtik Enkripshɔn wit Asosiet Data.
aead.intro: AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) na wan kriptografik primitiv we de kam togɛda wit kɔnfidɛns ɛn intɛgriti insay wan kɔl. Gi wan ki, nonce, plaintext, ɛn opshɔnal asosiet data (AAD), i de prodyuz sayfatɛks + ɔthɛntishɔn tag so dat ɛni tampering wit ɛni wan pan di pleintɛks, sayfatɛks, ɔ AAD nɔ go ebul fɔ chɛk.
aead.h1_a: AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) na wan kriptografik primitiv we de kam togɛda wit kɔnfidɛns ɛn intɛgriti insay wan kɔl. Gi wan ki, nonce, plaintext, ɛn opshɔnal asosiet data (AAD), i de prodyuz sayfatɛks + ɔthɛntishɔn tag so dat ɛni tampering wit ɛni wan pan di pleintɛks, sayfatɛks, ɔ AAD nɔ go ebul fɔ chɛk.
aead.h1_b: Vortex in AEAD na AES-256-GCM ɔltɛm. Di AAD slot de kɛr kɔntɛks di pɔsin we de gɛt fɔ no fɔ dikript kɔrɛkt wan (rum id, fayl id, ɔfset). Binding AAD de mek kros-kɔntekst riplay — wan sayfatɛks frɔm rum A nɔ kin dɛkript as rum B.
aead.h1_c: AEAD as wan nem primitiv trays to Rogaway 2002. GCM (Galois/Counter Mode) bin standad bay NIST in SP 800-38D (2007). Bi di difɔlt AEAD insay TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446, 2018). Ɛvri mɔdan sikyuɔr protɔkɔl de yuz wan AEAD.
aead.h1_f:
AEAD.Enc (k, n, pt, aad) = (ct, tag) // ct = len (pt) bayt, tag = 16 bayt
AEAD.Dec(k, n, ct, tag, aad) = pt ɔ ⊥
aead.h2: Usay dɛn yuz am na Vortex .
aead.h3: Tɛm dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit dis

alembic.title: Alembic bin de tɔk bɔt am
alembic.subtitle: Database maykreshɔn tul fɔ SQLAlchemy.
alembic.intro: Alembic na di kanonik maykreshɔn fremwɔk fɔ SQLAlchemy. Ɛni maykreshɔn na Python fayl wit `upgrade()` ɛn `downgrade()` fɛnshɔn dɛn we de diskrayb skima chenj dɛn as SQL ɔ ORM ɔpreshɔn.
alembic.h1_a: Alembic na di kanonik maykreshɔn fremwɔk fɔ SQLAlchemy. Ɛni maykreshɔn na Python fayl wit `upgrade()` ɛn `downgrade()` fɛnshɔn dɛn we de diskrayb skima chenj dɛn as SQL ɔ ORM ɔpreshɔn.
alembic.h1_b: Vortex yuz Alembik wit linya rivishɔn istri (nɔ branching). `alembic upgrade head` de rɔn pan ɛvri Docker kɔntena stat. `alembic downgrade -1` de rivεrt wan stεp fכ rolbak. Dev mod de yuz `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` so lokal itɛreshɔn nɔ nid maykreshɔn pan ɛvri ribɛs.
alembic.h1_c: Alembic na Mike Bayer (we rayt SQLAlchemy) rayt am insay 2011 as di pɔsin we tek ples fɔ `sqlalchemy-migrate`. Django in bilt-in maykreshɔn dɛn (2014) bin borrow di kɔr mɔdel. Alembic bin de bifo pan ficha dɛm — rollback, autogenerate, branching — pan ɔl we Vortex nɔ de yuz branch.

alembic/vɛshɔn dɛn/
  20240101_<rivishɔn>_<slug>.py ɛvri wan wit ɔpgrɛd()/dɔwngrɛd()
alembic.h2: Usay dɛn yuz am na Vortex .
alembic.h3: Tɛm dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit dis
alembic.h3_a: SQLAlchemy, Postgres, SQLite, skima, ɛn ɔda pipul dɛn

apns.title: APN dɛn
apns.subtitle: Apple Push Notis savis.
apns.intro: APNs na Apple in push-notifikeshɔn savis fɔ iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS. Ap dɛn kin rɛjista wan divays token ɛn di prɔvayda dɛn kin sɛn notis peylɔd to APN dɛn we kin fan dɛn aut to divays dɛn.
apns.h1_a: APNs na Apple in push-notifikeshɔn savis fɔ iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS. Ap dɛn kin rɛjista wan divays token ɛn di prɔvayda dɛn kin sɛn notis peylɔd to APN dɛn we kin fan dɛn aut to divays dɛn.
apns.h1_b: Vortex de yuz APN dɛn wit sial-push ɛnvilɔp dɛn: di node de ɛnkript ɛni notis peylɔd fɔ di pɔsin we de gɛt am in X25519 pɔbki; APNs de si onli wan opaque blob. Di iOS klaynt in Notis Savis Ɛkstenshɔn de dikript insay wan sɛpret prɔses bifo di ban rɛnd.
apns.h1_c: APN dɛn we dɛn lanch wit iOS 3.0 (2009). Sial push / mutabl kɔntinyu sɔpɔt kam wit iOS 10 (2016). Token-based auth (.p8) riples sertifiket-based auth as di difɔlt insay 2016. Vortex de yuz token auth wit 60 minit provayda token.

argon2id.title: Argon2id we yu de yuz
argon2id.subtitle: Memori-had paswɔd hash (RFC 9106).
argon2id.intro: Argon2id na mɛmori-had, sayd-chanɛl-rɛsistɛns paswɔd hash fɛnshɔn. Paramita dɛn: mɛmori saiz (m), tɛm kɔst (itɛreshɔn, t), paralelizm (lɛn, p), ɛn hash lɔng. Di 'id' vεryכnt de miks data-indipεndεnt (Argon2i) εn data-dipεndεnt (Argon2d) pas.
argon2id.h1_a: Argon2id na mɛmori-had, sayd-chanɛl-rɛsistɛns paswɔd hash fɛnshɔn. Paramita dɛn: mɛmori saiz (m), tɛm kɔst (itɛreshɔn, t), paralelizm (lɛn, p), ɛn hash lɔng. Di 'id' vεryכnt de miks data-indipεndεnt (Argon2i) εn data-dipεndεnt (Argon2d) pas.
argon2id.h1_b: Vortex de yuz Argon2id wit m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32. Dis tek ~0.5 s pan wan iPhone X (wi slowest sɔpɔt divays) ɛn roughly 5 ms pan wan ay-ɛnd ASIC — di 100× spid-ap nɔ impɔtant kɔmpia to SHA-256-based hashes usay ASIC dɛn win bay milyɔn.
argon2id.h1_c: Argon2 win di 2015 Paswɔd Hashing Kɔmpitishɔn we Dmitry Khovratovich ɛn Alex Biryukov ɔganayz. Standardized as RFC 9106 in 2021. Na 1Paswɔd, Bitwarden, LastPass yuz am. Vortex in paramita dεm kכmכt frכm OWASP 2023 rεkomεndεshכn dεm.
argon2id.h1_f:
Argon2id(paswɔd, sɔl, m, t, p, hashLɛn) → hash
difɔlt: m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLɛn=32
kɔst ≈ 0.5s pan Ayfon X; ~5ms pan ASIC (100× atak pɔsin we de spid)
argon2id.h2: Usay dɛn yuz am na Vortex .
argon2id.h3: Tɛm dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit dis

blake3.title: BLAKE3 .
blake3.subtitle: Fast kriptografik hash.
blake3.intro: BLAKE3 na kriptografik hash fɛnshɔn we kɔmɔt frɔm BLAKE2 ɛn BLAKE. Prodyuz arbitri-lεngth autput frכm arbitri input; 10× fast pas SHA-256 pan big blob tank to intanɛnt tik hash.
blake3.h1_a: BLAKE3 na kriptografik hash fɛnshɔn we kɔmɔt frɔm BLAKE2 ɛn BLAKE. Prodyuz arbitri-lεngth autput frכm arbitri input; 10× fast pas SHA-256 pan big blob tank to intanɛnt tik hash.
blake3.h1_b: Vortex de yuz BLAKE3 fɔ fayl intɛgriti: ɛni fayl we dɛn ɔplod kin kɛr wan `plain_blake3` hash fɔ in dikript kɔntinyu so di wan dɛn we de gɛt kin verify afta dɛn dɔn dawnlod + dikript. Di DB kɔlɔm na istri nem `sha256` fɔ maykreshɔn kɔmpatibiliti bɔt i gɛt BLAKE3 ɔtput.
blake3.h1_c: BLAKE3 na Jack O’Connor ɛn ɔda pipul dɛn bin rilis am. in 2020. I kɔmɔt frɔm BLAKE, we na bin SHA-3 fainal insay 2012. Di tri-hashing dizayn de mek BLAKE3 skel wit kɔr fɔ big big input. SHA-256 stil fast fɔ smɔl input dɛn; BLAKE3 de dominet pan enitin > 4 KiB.
blake3.h1_f:
BLAKE3(bayt) = 32 bayt // difɔlt ɔtput
BLAKE3(bayt, len) = len bayt (XOF)
thruput: ~3 GB/s pan Apple Silikɔn vs SHA-256 ~500 MB/s
blake3.h2: Usay dɛn yuz am na Vortex .
blake3.h3: Tɛm dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit dis

bmp.title: BMP .
bmp.subtitle: Blaynd Mɛylbɔks Prɔtokɔlɔ.
bmp.intro: BMP na Vortex in anonymous stoa-ɛn-fɔwad layt. Di wan dɛn we de sɛn di tin dɛn kin put ɛnkript blob dɛn na ɛni node we gɛt gɔsip, we dɛn kin ki bay wan-way hash fɔ di pɔsin we gɛt di pɔbki. Blobs de rayd gɔsip te di pɔsin we de tek am in node pul.
bmp.h1_a: BMP na Vortex in anonymous stoa-ɛn-fɔwad layt. Di wan dɛn we de sɛn di tin dɛn kin put ɛnkript blob dɛn na ɛni node we gɛt gɔsip, we dɛn kin ki bay wan-way hash fɔ di pɔsin we gɛt di pɔbki. Blobs de rayd gɔsip te di pɔsin we de tek am in node pul.
bmp.h1_b: BMP de gi tri indipɛndɛnt prayvesi prɔpati: sɛnda-aydin (TLS + opshɔnal anɔynt), risipiɛnt-aydin (mailbox_id na opaque to midul no dɛm), kɔntinyu-aydin (blob dɔn ɔlrɛdi E2E-ɛnkript). Maks blob 1 MB, per-node kap 500 MB, dipɔsit rɛt 10/min/IP, TTL 7200 s.
bmp.h1_c: BMP na di Vortex tim bin disayn am frɔm skrach. Wi bil am bikɔs no men mɛsenja nɔ bin rɛdi fɔ pe di injinɛri kɔst fɔ ayd mɛtadata ɛnd-to-ɛnd — dɛn de ɛnkript kɔntinyu bɔt dɛn de lik di soshal grafik. Wi pozishɔn frɔm di fɔs de na se sikrit mɛsenja we de lik udat-tɔk-to-udat na jɔs af sikrit. BMP klos da haf de bay we i mek di pɔsin we sɛn, di pɔsin we de tek am, ɛn di tin we de insay de indipɛndɛnt opaque, pan tap Vortex in yon gɔsip mɛsh pas fɔ bolt-ɔn infrastukchɔ.
bmp.h2: Usay dɛn yuz am na Vortex .
bmp.h3: Tɛm dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit dis
bmp.h3_a: gɔsip, anɔynt savis, sial sɛnda, Pɔnd

cbor.title: CBOR .
cbor.subtitle: Kɔnsis Baynary Ɔbjɛkt Ripreshɔn.
cbor.intro: CBOR (RFC 8949) na baynary data fɔmat we dɛn mek fɔ smɔl kɔd saiz ɛn fast ɛnkɔdin. Supasɛt ɔf JSON in data mɔdel, baynary-ɛnkɔd, striktli ditɛministic.
cbor.h1_a: CBOR (RFC 8949) na baynary data fɔmat we dɛn mek fɔ smɔl kɔd saiz ɛn fast ɛnkɔdin. Supasɛt ɔf JSON in data mɔdel, baynary-ɛnkɔd, striktli ditɛministic.
cbor.h1_b: Vortex de yuz CBOR as di peylɔd fɔmat insay AES-GCM ɛnvilɔp dɛn. ~30 % smɔl pas JSON pan yunikɔd-hɛvi chat; strikt parsing (nɔ gɛt wayt spɛs ambigwiti) de rɛsist pars-difrɛnshal atak; skima-fri so fɔ ad fil nɔ nid fɔ gɛt .proto rikompilashɔn.
cbor.h1_c: CBOR bin standad as RFC 7049 insay 2013, dɛn bin ɔpdet am to RFC 8949 insay 2020. Na Signal (intanɛnt frem sins 2017), Matrix in stet-rɛzolushɔn layt, WebAuthn (atɛsteshɔn ɔbjɛkt dɛn) yuz am. Pik bay Vortex insay v0.0.2 afta yu kɔmpia am agens JSON ɛn protobuf.
cbor.h1_f:
CBOR ɛnkɔdin: {mɛjɔ_tayp (3 bit), argumɛnt (5 bit), [data]}
map: tayp=5 pe
arenjmɛnt: tayp=4 ɛlimɛnt dɛn
teks: tayp=3 bayt
bayt: tayp=2 raw
cbor.h2: Usay dɛn yuz am na Vortex .
cbor.h2_a: Ɛvri mɛsej ɛnvilɔp, ɛvri sial-push peylɔd, ɛvri fedareshɔn ɛnvilɔp.
cbor.h3: Tɛm dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit dis

controller.intro: Di kɔntrol na wan sɛpret Python prɔses (`vortex_controller`) we in wangren wok na fɔ pablish di sayn manifɔst (`INTEGRITY.sig.json`) ɛn ɛntrɛ URL dɛn. Klaynt dɛn kin pin di kɔntrolɔ in Ed25519 pubkey na rilis tɛm.
controller.h1_a: Di kɔntrol na wan sɛpret Python prɔses (`vortex_controller`) we in wangren wok na fɔ pablish di sayn manifɔst (`INTEGRITY.sig.json`) ɛn ɛntrɛ URL dɛn. Klaynt dɛn kin pin di kɔntrolɔ in Ed25519 pubkey na rilis tɛm.
controller.h1_b: Ekspכz wan sכm sכm API sεf (~12 rout dεm). Di narrow surface na deliberate — na di ays-valyu atak target wans klaynt dɛn pin. Miro dɛn de rɔn di sem kɔd wit di sem rilis ki; DNS/SNS/IPFS pablish list fɔ miro.

doubleRatchet.title: Dabl Ratchet we dɛn kɔl
doubleRatchet.subtitle: Signal in per-DM fɔwad-sikrit protɔkɔl.
doubleRatchet.intro: Di Dabl Ratchet de kam togɛda wan Diffie-Hellman ratchet wit wan simɛtrik-ki chen. Ɛni mɛsej de go bifo pan in chen; periodik DH ratchets ri-key di rut. Deliv fɔwad sikrit (past mɛsej dɛn sef afta kɔmprɔmis) ɛn post-kɔmprɔmis sikyɔriti (fiuja mɛsej dɛn sef afta ri-ratchet).
doubleRatchet.h1_a: Di Dabl Ratchet de kam togɛda wan Diffie-Hellman ratchet wit wan simɛtrik-ki chen. Ɛni mɛsej de go bifo pan in chen; periodik DH ratchets ri-key di rut. Deliv fɔwad sikrit (past mɛsej dɛn sef afta kɔmprɔmis) ɛn post-kɔmprɔmis sikyɔriti (fiuja mɛsej dɛn sef afta ri-ratchet).
doubleRatchet.h1_b: Vortex de yuz Dabl Ratchet fɔ dairekt-mɛsej chen. Grup rum dɛn kin yuz wan simpul sɛnda-ki skim we dɛn kin ki pan di rum rut. Chen lεngth kap pan 1000 mεsej bifo fכs ri-ratchet; skip-ki kesh te to 1000 ɔt-ɔda mɛsej dɛn; hεda enkripshɔn pan bay difɔlt.
doubleRatchet.h1_c: Na Trevor Perrin ɛn Moxie Marlinspike bin disayn am insay 2013; diploy insay Sayn 2014; adopted by WhatsApp (2016), Facebook Sikrit Kɔnvɛshɔn, Skype Prayvet Kɔnvɛshɔn. Public spec 2016. Vortex in implimentishɔn na dairekt pɔt.
doubleRatchet.h1_f:
chen we de sɛn: CK_sɛnd → HKDF(CK_sɛnd, "stɛp") → CK_sɛnd'.
                    MK → HKDF(CK_sɛnd, "msg")
chen we de tek: CK_recv → HKDF(CK_recv, "step") → CK_recv'.
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(wi_ɛf, dɛn_ɛf), RK_prev)

doubleRatchet.h3: Tɛm dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit dis

ech.title: ECH .

ech.intro: ECH de ayd di SNI (Server Name Indication) pan TLS 1.3 bay we i rap di insay ClientHello insay wan ɔda ClientHello we dɛn ɛnkript ɔnda wan pɔblik ki we dɛn pablish na di DNS HTTPS rɛkɛd.

Klaynt dɛn we gɛt ECH sɔpɔt de yuz di ɔda ɔs nem (e.g. `vortex-public.cloudflare.com`) as di SNI we pɔsin kin si; pasiv obsכva dεm de si כnli da jεnεrik כta nem de. DPI nɔ kin tɛl Vortex klaynt frɔm ɛni ɔda Cloudflare kɔstɔma.
ech.h1_c: ECH bin go tru 5 IETF draft bifo standadayzeshɔn as RFC 9460 insay 2024. Fɔs difrɛns: ESNI (2018-2019, lɛf), ECH draft-00 to draft-13 (2020-2024). Chrome bin ɛnabul ECH bay difɔlt insay 2023; Fayafaks insay 2024. Vortex sɔpɔt am frɔm v0.0.9.
ech.h1_f:
ɔta SNI: "public.cloudflare.com" ← we di wan dɛn we de wach kin si
insay SNI: "node.vortex.example" ← ɛnkript

ed25519.title: Ed25519 we yu de yuz

ed25519.intro: Ed25519 na wan ɛliptik-kɔv signɛshɔn skim. 32-bayt pɔblik ki, 64-bayt sayn, ditɛministic sayn bay difɔlt. Fast vεrifikεshכn (~200 μs pan wan mכdan CPU), batch-vεrifikεbl.
ed25519.h1_a: Ed25519 na wan ɛliptik-kɔv signɛshɔn skim. 32-bayt pɔblik ki, 64-bayt sayn, ditɛministic sayn bay difɔlt. Fast vεrifikεshכn (~200 μs pan wan mכdan CPU), batch-vεrifikεbl.
ed25519.h1_b: Vortex sayn ɛvri fedareshɔn ɛnvilɔp, ɛvri intɛgriti manifest, ɛvri node atɛsteshɔn, ɛn ɛvri bot mɛsej wit Ed25519. Apple in KriptoKit na iOS 17+ de yuz di randomiz RFC 8032bis vεryכnt; Vortex aksept ɛni wan pan dɛn — ɛni kɔmpliant verifya de handle ɔl tu.
ed25519.h1_c: Ed25519 na Bernstein, Duif, Lange, Schwabe, Yang bin pablish am insay 2011. Standart am as RFC 8032 insay 2017. Na OpenSSH 6.5 (2014), TLS 1.3, Apple Keychain, signal-protocol. Deterministic signing bin klia wan pik ova ECDSA fɔ avɔyd di ECDSA RNG-riyuz vulnerability klas.
ed25519.h1_f:
Sayn(d, m): r = SHA-512(d ∥ m) .
              R = r · G
              c = SHA-512(R ∥ A ∥ m) .
              S = r + c · a
              ritɔn (R, S) .
Verifay: c = SHA-512(R ∥ A ∥ m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G

fanout.title: Fan-ɔt we de kɔmɔt
fanout.subtitle: Brodkas wan ivent frɔm wan sɔs to bɔku sabskriptɔ dɛn.
fanout.intro: Fan-out na di akitekchɔral patɛn usay wan prodyusɔ de emit wan ivin ɛn N kɔshɔma dɛn de gɛt am. Insay Vortex in WebSocket layt, wan mɛsej POST de trigɛt N sɔkɛt sɛn — wan fɔ ɛni sabskriptɔ na di rum.
fanout.h1_a: Fan-out na di akitekchɔral patɛn usay wan prodyusɔ de emit wan ivin ɛn N kɔshɔma dɛn de gɛt am. Insay Vortex in WebSocket layt, wan mɛsej POST de trigɛt N sɔkɛt sɛn — wan fɔ ɛni sabskriptɔ na di rum.
fanout.h1_b: Impliment as per-rum set of WebSocket handel we wan asyncio.Lɔk de gayd. Rayt akwyayz, kɔpi di sɛt, rilis, dɔn itɛrayt kɔpi we de wet fɔ `ws.send_bytes(payload)` wit per-sɔkɛt 1 s tɛmaut. Slow konsuma dɛn gɛt 256-frɛm kiyu bifo freym dɛn drɔp.
fanout.h1_c: Fan-out go bak fɔ pablish/sabskripshɔn sistem dɛn insay di 1980s (POP, TIBCO). Mɔdan dizayn dɛn (Kafka, Redis pub/sub, NATS) de skel di patɛn to bɔku bɔku sabskriptɔ dɛn. Vortex in per-rum in-mεmכri fan-כt na minimal biכs i nכ nid kכros-node rεplikεshכn insay singl-node mכd; Redis pub/sub de aktib in mכlti-node klasta dεm.
fanout.h1_f:
brodkas(rum_id, peylɔd): .
  subs = fanout [rum_id] # O (1) dikt lukɔp
  fɔ ws insay snɛpsho(subs): # kɔpi fɔ itɛrayt sef wan
      await ws.send_bytes (peylɔd, taym ɔut = 1s)
fanout.h2: Usay dɛn yuz am na Vortex .

federation.subtitle: Mutual-trust mεsej dεlivεri bitwin indipεndεnt Vortex no dεm.
federation.intro: Fɛdareshɔn na wan mutual-trust link bitwin tu node ɔpreshɔn. Ɛni wan de ad di ɔda wan in Ed25519 pubkey to in `federations` tebul. Yuza dɛn na node A kin mɛsej yuza dɛn na node B bay we dɛn de rout ɛnvilɔp dɛn tru wan sayn `POST /federation/deliver`.
federation.h1_a: Fɛdareshɔn na wan mutual-trust link bitwin tu node ɔpreshɔn. Ɛni wan de ad di ɔda wan in Ed25519 pubkey to in `federations` tebul. Yuza dɛn na node A kin mɛsej yuza dɛn na node B bay we dɛn de rout ɛnvilɔp dɛn tru wan sayn `POST /federation/deliver`.
federation.h1_b: Opt-in fɔ ɛni ɔpreshɔn: nɔ "ɛni node kin fedaret" difɔlt nɔ de. Fɔ ad wan kɔmpin nid fɔ gɛt admin akshɔn we di ɔpreshɔn sayn. di hεlth skכl dεm (AIMD ±1) de pכz fεdareshכn to dεn kɔmpin dεm we nɔ de biev fayn. Outbox retries failed deliveries wit exponential bak-off te to 14 dez.
federation.h1_c: Fɛdareshɔn na bin Matrix in kil ficha (2014) ɛn bifo dat XMPP/Jabber (1999). Vortex in dizayn pul frɔm ɔl tu: sayn ɛnvilɔp (Matrix), klia trɔst ankɔ (nɔto — wi strikt pas), wɛlbɔdi skɔ (AIMD frɔm TCP). Add in v0.0.5.
federation.h2: Usay dɛn yuz am na Vortex .
federation.h3: Tɛm dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit dis

fts5.title: FTS5 .
fts5.subtitle: SQLite in ful-tɛks-sɔch vayrɔyal tebul.
fts5.intro: FTS5 na SQLite in fayv-jɛnɛreshɔn ful-tɛks sɔch ɛkstenshɔn. Krio wan vayrɔyal tebul we de kip tokenised indeks fɔ fast LIKE / MATCH kwɛstyɔn dɛn.
fts5.h1_a: FTS5 na SQLite in fayv-jɛnɛreshɔn ful-tɛks sɔch ɛkstenshɔn. Krio wan vayrɔyal tebul we de kip tokenised indeks fɔ fast LIKE / MATCH kwɛstyɔn dɛn.
fts5.h1_b: Vortex de mirɔ pleintɛks token (klaynt-ɛnkript as opaque tag) insay wan FTS5 vayrɔyal tebul so sɔch hit `O(log n)` instead ɔf `O(n)` skan. Na Andrɔyd in Rum, dɛn de yuz FTS4 wit trig dɛn we de kip di vayrɔyal tebul in sink. Postgres diploymɛnt dɛn de yuz `tsvector` / `tsquery` fɔ di sem tin.
fts5.h1_c: FTS go bak to SQLite 3.7 (2010). FTS5 we dɛn ship insay SQLite 3.9 (2015). Bɔku pipul dɛn dɔn adopt am; ɛvri lokal-fɔs mɛsej ap na iOS / Andrɔyd de yuz am. Postgres bin gɛt `tsvector` frɔm 8.3 (2008).

gossip.title: Gossip yu de yuz am
gossip.subtitle: Piɔriɔdik piɔ-list ɛkshɛnj bitwin Vortex no dɛm.
gossip.intro: Gossip na wan bandwidth-efficient protɔkɔl usay ɛni node de chenj sɔmariz no wan wan tɛm wit wan random peer. As tɛm de go ɛvri node de kɔnvɛrj to di sem we fɔ si we nɔ gɛt sɛntral dairektrɔ.
gossip.h1_a: Gossip na wan bandwidth-efficient protɔkɔl usay ɛni node de chenj sɔmariz no wan wan tɛm wit wan random peer. As tɛm de go ɛvri node de kɔnvɛrj to di sem we fɔ si we nɔ gɛt sɛntral dairektrɔ.
gossip.h1_b: Vortex no dεm de gכsip εvri 60 sekכnd. Ɛni ɛkshɛnj na 256-bit Blɔm filta we de sɔma di kɔmpin dɛn we dɛn sabi; di ɔda say de ansa wit in kɔmpin dɛn we nɔ de na di filta plus in yon filta. Bandwidth na O(nyu piɔs × 32 B), tipikli ɔnda 1 KiB pan wan rawnd.
gossip.h1_c: Blɔm-filta gɔsip de frɔm Kɔnɛl in 1998 bimodal maltikɔst pepa. Apache Cassandra de yuz am fɔ bi mɛmba; Bitcoin fɔ transakshɔn rilay; IPFS fɔ DHT mentenɛns. Di O(log N) kɔnvɛgshɔn na wetin mek i prɛktikal fɔ big nɛtwɔk dɛn.
gossip.h1_f:
ɛkshɛnj(A, B): .
  A → B: filta_A = insay_ɔl(pi_A, k=5, m=256)
  B → A: nyu_piɔ_fɔ_A = {p ∈ kɔmpin_B : p ∉ filta_A}, filta_B
  A kin pul di sem tin
ret limit: 1 ɛkshɛnj fɔ ɛni kɔmpin fɔ wan 30 s

gravitix.h1_a: Gravitix na domɛyn-spɛsifi k langwej we dɛn mek fɔ rayt Vortex bot. Ivent-driven handla (`on /start { emit "hi" }`), bilt-in stet, minimal boilerplate. Dɛn kin kɔmpilayt am fɔ baytkɔd ɛn rɔn insay wan intaprita we gɛt sanbɔks.

hkdf.title: HKDF .
hkdf.subtitle: HMAC-bεys Ki Dεrivεshכn Fכnshכn (RFC 5869).
hkdf.intro: HKDF na tu-stεp ki dεrivεshכn fכnshכn: Ekstrakt de kכmprεs di input ki mεtirial insay wan pseudo-random ki (PRK); Ekspand de strɛch di PRK insay ɔtput ki matirial we gɛt ɛni lɔng, we dɛn separet wit info lɛbl dɛn.
hkdf.h1_a: HKDF na tu-stεp ki dεrivεshכn fכnshכn: Ekstrakt de kכmprεs di input ki mεtirial insay wan pseudo-random ki (PRK); Ekspand de strɛch di PRK insay ɔtput ki matirial we gɛt ɛni lɔng, we dɛn separet wit info lɛbl dɛn.
hkdf.h1_b: Vortex de yuz HKDF-SHA256 ɔlsay: split X25519 shered sikrit dɛn insay ɛnkripshɔn + MAC + hεda ki, deriv per-chunk fayl ki, deriv bak-ap ki frɔm Argon2id ɔtput. Info string dɛn kin ɔltɛm kɛr wan vɛshɔn prɛfiks (e.g. "v1:encryption") so di ɔl ki hayarki kin rɔta bay we yu bamp v1 → v2.
hkdf.h1_c: Na Hugo Krawczyk bin pul am na EUROCRYPT 2010; standad as RFC 5869 di sem ia. Na TLS 1.3 yuz am fɔ in schedule, Signal fɔ Dabl Ratchet, WireGuard fɔ sɛshɔn ki dɛn.
hkdf.h1_f:
Ekstrakt: PRK = HMAC-SHA256(sɔl, IKM)
Ekspand: T(1) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, infɔmeshɔn ∥ 0x01)
          T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ info ∥ i) .
          OKM = T(1) ∥ T(2) ∥ ... trunk to len

hmac.title: HMAC .
hmac.subtitle: Hash-based Mɛsej Ɔtɛnɛshɔn Kɔd (RFC 2104).
hmac.intro: HMAC na kɔnstrɔkshɔn we de tɔn ɛni kriptografik hash (SHA-256, SHA-512) to MAC. Gi integriti ɛn ɔthɛntishɔn we dɛn gi wan sikrit we dɛn sheb.
hmac.h1_a: HMAC na kɔnstrɔkshɔn we de tɔn ɛni kriptografik hash (SHA-256, SHA-512) to MAC. Gi integriti ɛn ɔthɛntishɔn we dɛn gi wan sikrit we dɛn sheb.
hmac.h1_b: Vortex de yuz HMAC-SHA256 insay HKDF, fɔ JWT sayn (HS256), fɔ sender_pseudo derivation na rum, ɛn fɔ coturn TURN kredibiliti sayn. Kɔnstant-taym kɔmpiashɔn nid fɔ de na di verifyeshɔn sayd — `hmac.compare_digest` insay Python.
hmac.h1_c: HMAC na Bellare, Canetti, Krawczyk bin introdyus am insay 1996. Standart am as RFC 2104 (1997) ɛn FIPS 198 (2002). Bi di difɔlt MAC insay TLS, IPsec, SSH. Signal, Matrix, Diskɔrd, Slak ɔl de yuz HMAC-SHA256 fɔ dɛn JWT ɛn sɛshɔn token.
hmac.h1_f:
HMAC(ki, msg) = H( (ki ⊕ opad) ∥ H( (ki ⊕ ipad) ∥ msg ) )
  usay opad = 0x5c ripit, ipad = 0x36 ripit, blɔk saiz mach H
hmac.h2: Usay dɛn yuz am na Vortex .
hmac.h2_a: Everiwea in di kripto stak. Grep fɔ `hmac_sha256` ɔ `HKDF`.

ice.title: ICE .
ice.subtitle: Intaraktiv Kɔnɛktiviti Ɛstablishmɛnt (RFC 8445).
ice.intro: ICE na di WebRTC mεkanism fכ fכn wan nεtwכk pat bitwin tu piεr dεm bihayn NAT dεm. Pipul dɛn we dɛn kɔmpin dɛn kin kɔl kandidet dɛn (host, server-reflexive, relay), chenj dɛn, ɛn tray tu tu te wan sakrifays.
ice.h1_a: ICE na di WebRTC mεkanism fכ fכn wan nεtwכk pat bitwin tu piεr dεm bihayn NAT dεm. Pipul dɛn we dɛn kɔmpin dɛn kin kɔl kandidet dɛn (host, server-reflexive, relay), chenj dɛn, ɛn tray tu tu te wan sakrifays.
ice.h1_b: Vortex in node brɔkers ICE kandidet ɛkshɛnj via WebSocket signalin. coturn de gi STUN (fɔ srflx diskvayri) ɛn TURN (fɔ rilay we dairekt pat dɛn de fel). Short-lived HMAC kredibiliti dɛn de gi fɔ ɛni kɔl.

ice.h1_f:

pe chɛk: STUN Binding Rikwest; fɔs pe fɔ sakrifays = dɛn dɔn pik
ice.h2: Usay dɛn yuz am na Vortex .

jwt.title: JWT .

jwt.h1_a: JWT na kɔmpakt token fɔmat we gɛt tri base64-url-ɛnkɔd pat dɛn: hεda, peylɔd (klɛm), sayn. Yuz fɔ stetlɛs sɛshɔn ɔthɛntishɔn.
jwt.h1_b: Vortex de yuz HS256 (HMAC-SHA256) JWT dɛn. Akses token de kari `{sab: yuza_id, jti: divays_id, tayp: akses, exp}`, 15 min TTL. Rifresh token `tayp: rifresh`, 30 d TTL. Sayn ova wan 64-bayt sikrit frɔm `.env`. No sensitiv klem biyɔn user_id.
jwt.h1_c: JWTs bin standad as RFC 7519 (2015). OAuth 2.0 bin dɔn mek dɛn bi pɔpul frɔm 2012. Tɛn ia we dɛn dɔn de kɔmɛnt: alg-kɔnfyushɔn atak, nɔ rivokeshɔn. Vortex mitigate: HS256 nɔmɔ (nɔ RS/ES kɔnfyushɔn), divays-ki jti (rivokebl via yuz_divays).
jwt.h1_f:
HEADER.PAYLOAD.SIGNATURE.
hεda = bays64url({alg: "HS256", tayp: "JWT"})
peylɔd = bays64url ({sub, jti, tayp, ɛksp})
sig = base64url(HMAC-SHA256(sikrit, hεda + "." + peylod))
jwt.h2: Usay dɛn yuz am na Vortex .
jwt.h3: Tɛm dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit dis
jwt.h3_a: HMAC, OAuth 2.0, rifresh token, akses token

kyber.title: Kyber-768 we de na di wɔl
kyber.subtitle: Post-kwantum ki enkapsuleshɔn (FIPS 203).
kyber.intro: Kyber-768 (ɔfishal ML-KEM-768) na NIST in standad post-kwantum ki ɛnkapsuleshɔn mɛkanism. 1184-bayt pɔblik ki, 1088-bayt sayfatɛks, 32-bayt shered sikrit. Sekyuriti ridyus to Modul-LWE, biliv kwantum-had.
kyber.h1_a: Kyber-768 (ɔfishal ML-KEM-768) na NIST in standad post-kwantum ki ɛnkapsuleshɔn mɛkanism. 1184-bayt pɔblik ki, 1088-bayt sayfatɛks, 32-bayt shered sikrit. Sekyuriti ridyus to Modul-LWE, biliv kwantum-had.
kyber.h1_b: Vortex de yuz Kyber opshɔnal wan insay wan haybrid: `sɛshɔn_ki = HKDF(x25519_ɔt ∥ kayba_ɔt, info="sɛshɔn-v1")`. If ɛni wan pan di af dɛn ol, di sɛshɔn sef. Opt-in in v0.1, on-bay-difɔlt plan fɔ v0.2. Kost: ~2 KB ekstra fo wan seshon hanshake; latɛns nɔ impɔtant.
kyber.h1_c: Kyber na bin wan pan ~70 sɔbmishɔn dɛn to NIST in PQ kɔmpitishɔn (2016). Dɛn pik am fɔ standad insay Julay 2022; finalized as FIPS 203 in August 2024. Chrome enabled haybrid Kyber in TLS 1.3 in 2024. Signal ad am to dɛn protɔkɔl di sem ia.
kyber.h1_f:
KeyGen(): (pk ∈ Zq^k, sk ∈ Zq^k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B
Enkaps(pk): (ct ∈ Zq^k, ss ∈ {0,1}256) ct = 1088 B
Dikaps(sk,ct): ss ∈ {0,1}256
haybrid = HKDF(x25519_ɔt ∥ kyber_ɔt, "sɛshɔn-v1")
kyber.h2: Usay dɛn yuz am na Vortex .
kyber.h3: Tɛm dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit dis

mailbox.title: Bɔks we dɛn kin yuz fɔ sɛn mɛyl
mailbox.subtitle: Risipiɛnt-adrɛs stɔrɔj ​​slot in BMP.
mailbox.intro: Wan mɛylbɔks na BMP in abstrakshɔn fɔ "ples usay mɛsej fɔ wan givɛn risipiɛnt de wet". Identify bay wan 32-bayt `mailbox_id` we kכmכt frכm di risipiεnt in pubkey via HKDF.
mailbox.h1_a: Wan mɛylbɔks na BMP in abstrakshɔn fɔ "ples usay mɛsej fɔ wan givɛn risipiɛnt de wet". Identify bay wan 32-bayt `mailbox_id` we kכmכt frכm di risipiεnt in pubkey via HKDF.
mailbox.h1_b: Na di pɔsin nɔmɔ we sɛn di mɛsej (we sabi recipient_pubkey) ɛn di pɔsin we sɛn am (we sabi dɛn yon pubkey) kin kɔmpyutayt wan givɛn mailbox_id. Midul no dɛm de si ɔl di opaque 32-bayt aydentifaya. Ɛni mɛyl bɔks gɛt TTL 7200 s ɛn stɔrɔj ​​kap 500 MB fɔ wan node.
mailbox.h1_c: Di wɔd kɔmɔt frɔm klasical email. BMP borrow di metaphor bɔt i mek di mailbox risipient-derived pas server-provisioned — nɔ "mailbox krieshɔn" step, nɔ sava no us adrɛs dɛn de.
mailbox.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF(di pɔsin we gɛt di pabki, info="bmp-v1", len=32)
na di pɔsin nɔmɔ we sɛn (no recipient_pk) ɛn di pɔsin we de tek am (no in yon pk) kin kɔmpyutayt

nonce.title: Nonce
nonce.subtitle: Nɔmba we dɛn yuz wan tɛm — na wan tɛm-yuz valyu.
nonce.intro: Nonce na valyu we nɔ fɔ ɛva ripit ɔnda wan ki we dɛn gi am. Insay Vortex ɛvri AES-GCM ɔpreshɔn de yuz wan fresh 96-bit random nonce. Ri-yuz wan nonce wit di sem ki de pwɛl kɔnfidɛns ɛn ɔthɛntiti — wan atak wit tu sayfatɛks ɔnda di sem (ki, nonce) kin rikavari pleintɛks XOR dɛn.
nonce.h1_a: Nonce na valyu we nɔ fɔ ɛva ripit ɔnda wan ki we dɛn gi am. Insay Vortex ɛvri AES-GCM ɔpreshɔn de yuz wan fresh 96-bit random nonce. Ri-yuz wan nonce wit di sem ki de pwɛl kɔnfidɛns ɛn ɔthɛntiti — wan atak wit tu sayfatɛks ɔnda di sem (ki, nonce) kin rikavari pleintɛks XOR dɛn.
nonce.h1_b: Vortex de jenarayz nons wit di OS CSPRNG (`sikrit.token_bayt`, `SecRandom`, `java.sekyuriti.SecureRandom`). Batde bound wit 96 bits: ~2^32 mɛsej bifo kolishon bi plausibul, fa fawe pas aw ɛni rum ki de si insay in layf. Difensiv dupliket-nɔns trakin pan di node as bɛlt-ɛn-sɔspɛnd.
nonce.h1_c: Di nonce kɔnsɛpt na ol tin insay kriptografi; di wɔd insɛf kɔmɔt frɔm Ol Inglish "fɔ di wan tɛm". GCM in 96-bit rɛkɛmɔndeshɔn na frɔm NIST SP 800-38D. Di Adobe 2013 brech famɔs fɔ rikavari pleintɛks frɔm ripit nonces na klaynt-sayd RSA.
nonce.h1_f:
P(kolishin) na 109 AES-GCM nons = ~10−19
batde bכnd: fכs kכlishכn we dεn de εkspεkt arawnd 248 nonces pan wan ki
GCM sefty: 232 random nonces pan wan ki bifo baund degrad
nonce.h2: Usay dɛn yuz am na Vortex .
nonce.h2_a: Ɛvri AES-GCM kɔl. Kaunta de trak difensiv wan na `app/security/crypto.py`.

ohttp.title: OHTTP .
ohttp.subtitle: Oblivious HTTP (RFC 9458).
ohttp.intro: OHTTP na protɔkɔl fɔ rilay HTTP rikwest usay nɔbɔdi nɔ si ɔl tu di rikwest ɛn di ansa. Di klaynt de sɛn tru wan rilay we de strip aydentifying hεda dɛm; di rilay de go bifo to di get we de dikript ɛn ansa.
ohttp.h1_a: OHTTP na protɔkɔl fɔ rilay HTTP rikwest usay nɔbɔdi nɔ si ɔl tu di rikwest ɛn di ansa. Di klaynt de sɛn tru wan rilay we de strip aydentifying hεda dɛm; di rilay de go bifo to di get we de dikript ɛn ansa.
ohttp.h1_b: Vortex de yuz OHTTP as Lay-5 stɔl fɔlbak. We yu kam togɛda wit anɔynt savis ɛn BMP, OHTTP de gi las-risɔt pat we TLS fulɔp fɔ blok. Di rilay na pati we separet wit trɔst (tipikli Cloudflare ɔ Apple in prayvet-rilay infrastukchɔ).
ohttp.h1_c: OHTTP bin standad as RFC 9458 insay 2024, we Cloudflare, Apple, Mozilla bin kɔ-ɔda. Apple in iCloud Prayvet Rilay (2021) na wan ali OHTTP-adjasent diploymɛnt. Vortex ad OHTTP fɔlbak sɔpɔt na v0.0.9.

klaynt → rilay: Encrypt_gateway_pub(rikwest) + random-routin info
rilay → getway: fɔdɔm, strip di hεda dɛn we de aydentify di klaynt
getway → ansa: dikript, prɔses, Ɛnkript_klaynt_pub(rɛspɔns)
rilay → klaynt: fɔwad rispɔns

onion.title: Aniɔn savis
onion.subtitle: Tor hiden savis.
onion.intro: Wan anɔynt savis na TCP savis we pɔsin kin akses bay Tor in rendezvous protɔkɔl. Identify bay wan anɔynt adrɛs (56-karakta bays32 fɔ wan Ed25519 pubkey pan v3). Nɔ pɔblik IP, nɔ DNS, nɔ sɛntral rɛjista.
onion.h1_a: Wan anɔynt savis na TCP savis we pɔsin kin akses bay Tor in rendezvous protɔkɔl. Identify bay wan anɔynt adrɛs (56-karakta bays32 fɔ wan Ed25519 pubkey pan v3). Nɔ pɔblik IP, nɔ DNS, nɔ sɛntral rɛjista.
onion.h1_b: εvri Vortex node de εkspכz insεf as `.onion` εn bak in nכmal HTTPS εndpכynt. Klaynt dɛn we gɛt Tor sɔpɔt kin fɔdɔm tru to anɔynt we ɔl ɔda tin nɔ wok. Bandwidth na ~10× slo bɔt i kin rich insay ful-rɛstrikt nɛtwɔk dɛn.
onion.h1_c: Aniɔn savis dɛn de bak to Tor 2004 (v1). Ribild as v3 onion savis in 2017 wit Ed25519 ki. Na SecureDrop, New York Times, Facebook, ProPublica, ɔl di big big ɔganayzeshɔn dɛn we sabi bɔt kripto, de yuz am. Signal ad onion-savis delivri insay 2022.
onion.h1_f:
adrɛs = bays32(Ed25519_pubkey ∥ chɛksam ∥ vɛshɔn_bayt) ∥ ".aniɔn".

rbac.title: RBAC .
rbac.subtitle: Rol-Based Akses Kɔntrol.
rbac.intro: RBAC na akses-kɔntrol mɔdel usay dɛn de gi pɔmishɔn to di rol dɛn ɛn dɛn de gi di yuza dɛn di rol dɛn. Vortex de yuz tri-taya RBAC fɔ wan rum: ɔna > admin > mɛmba.
rbac.h1_a: RBAC na akses-kɔntrol mɔdel usay dɛn de gi pɔmishɔn to di rol dɛn ɛn dɛn de gi di yuza dɛn di rol dɛn. Vortex de yuz tri-taya RBAC fɔ wan rum: ɔna > admin > mɛmba.
rbac.h1_b: Kaskad: ɔna dɛn gɛt ɛvri admin pawa plus di yunik abiliti fɔ dilit di rum ɔ transfa ɔna. Admins invayt, kik, mute, ɛdit rum sɛtin. Memba dɛn kin sɛn mɛsej, riak, ɛdit dɛn yon mɛsej. Dɛn kin rayt di chenj dɛn we de apin to di wok as sistɛm mɛsej so dat ɛvri mɛmba go si dɛn.
rbac.h1_c: RBAC as fɔmal mɔdel de frɔm NIST in 1992 pepa we Ferraiolo & Kuhn rayt. Bi men strim in ɛntapraiz IAM (AWS, Azure) insay di 2010 dɛm. Rum-lɛvɛl RBAC na standad insay chat prodak — IRC in ops/voys/yuz (1988), Diskɔrd in rol dɛn (2015), Slak in admin/mɛmba/gɔst.

transfa: ɔna sɛt nyu_ɔna_id → ol ɔna demot to admin
revoke: admin kin pul wan mɛmba; owner kin demote wan admin

sfu.h1_a: Wan SFU na wan midulbɔks we de miks midia insay grup kɔl. Ɛni wan pan di wan dɛn we tek pat kin ɔplod wan strim; di SFU de fɔwad am to di ɔda wan dɛn. Riples di ful-mɛsh tɔpɔlɔji (ɛvri piɔ de ɛnkɔd N-1 strim dɛn) usay skel na O(N2).
sfu.h1_b: Vortex in SFU de impliment in Rust fɔ pefɔmɛns. Simulcast-aware: ɛnibɔdi we de kɔl de ɛnkɔd tri rizɔlt dɛn wan tɛm; di SFU pik di rayt wan fɔ ɛni pɔsin we de wach in ripɔt dawlink. Odio-onli grup dɛn we go rich 100 patisipan dɛn; vidio grup dɛn we go rich 32 (v0.3 rodmap).
sfu.h1_c: SFU akitekchɔ de frɔm Jitsi in Vidiobrij (2013). Bifo SFU, WebRTC grup kɔl dɛn bin ful-mɛsh. Zum, Google Mit, Jitsi, Sayn grup kɔl ɔl yuz SFU. Vortex ɔdio-onli grup dɛn we dɛn ship insay v0.0.8.

tls13.intro: TLS 1.3 na di kɔrɛnt vɛshɔn fɔ di TLS protɔkɔl. Rimov primitiv dɛn we nɔ sef (RSA ki ɛkshɛnj, CBC MAC dɛn, statik ECDH), i de mek am izi fɔ shek yu an to wan rawnd-trip, i de mandat fɔ mek yu gɛt sikrit fɔ go bifo.
tls13.h1_a: TLS 1.3 na di kɔrɛnt vɛshɔn fɔ di TLS protɔkɔl. Rimov primitiv dɛn we nɔ sef (RSA ki ɛkshɛnj, CBC MAC dɛn, statik ECDH), i de mek am izi fɔ shek yu an to wan rawnd-trip, i de mandat fɔ mek yu gɛt sikrit fɔ go bifo.
tls13.h1_b: Ɛvri HTTPS + WSS + fedareshɔn kɔnɛkshɔn na Vortex de yuz TLS 1.3. Wi de mach Chrome 120 in ClientHello bayt-fɔ-bayt so DPI nɔ go ebul fɔ finga prɛnt wi as nɔ-brɔwza. ECH (enkript SNI) na opt-in via di ɔta-SNI kɔnfig.
tls13.h1_c: TLS 1.3 bin standad as RFC 8446 insay Ɔgɔst 2018 afta 4 ia ɛn 28 draft. Chrome, Firefox, Safari bin ship sɔpɔt insay 2018. Microsoft ad am to Windows insay 2020. Bay 2022 na bin di majoriti fɔ wɛb trafik.
tls13.h1_f:
we yu de shek yu an (1-RTT): .
  Klaynt → Sava: KlayntHɛlɔ (ki_shɛri, SNI?, ALPN, ...)
  Sava → Klaynt: SavaHɛlɔ + ƐnkriptƐkstenshɔn dɛn + Sɛt + SɛtVɛrifay + Dɔn
  Klaynt → Sava: Dɛn dɔn dɔn + Aplikeshɔn Data
tls13.h2: Usay dɛn yuz am na Vortex .
tls13.h2_a: Evri TLS konekshon. Finga prɛnt maching na `ap/transpɔt/stɛlth_lɛvɛl1.py`.
tls13.h3: Tɛm dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit dis
tls13.h3_a: ECH, TLS finga prɛnt, JA4, fɔdɔm sikrit

totp.title: TOTP .
totp.subtitle: Wan-Tɛm Paswɔd we de bays pan Taym (RFC 6238).
totp.intro: TOTP na wan tɛm paswɔd we kɔmɔt frɔm sikrit we dɛn sheb ɛn di tɛm we dɛn de yuz naw. Difɔlt paramita dɛn: 30-sɛkɔn tɛm stɛp, 6-dijit kɔd, SHA-1 HMAC.
totp.h1_a: TOTP na wan tɛm paswɔd we kɔmɔt frɔm sikrit we dɛn sheb ɛn di tɛm we dɛn de yuz naw. Difɔlt paramita dɛn: 30-sɛkɔn tɛm stɛp, 6-dijit kɔd, SHA-1 HMAC.
totp.h1_b: Vortex in 2FA de yuz TOTP wit di RFC difɔlt dɛn. Di wan dɛn we de yuz am kin skan wan QR we dɛn de inrɔl; di kɔd we dɛn dɔn jenarayz frɔm dɛn Authenticator ap de mach di kɔd we di sava de ɛkspɛkt. Rate-limited to 5 attempts pan 5 minit fɔ ɛni yuza.
totp.h1_c: TOTP (RFC 6238, 2011) we Mak Pei bin bil pan HOTP (RFC 4226, 2005). Bifo dat, RSA SecurID bin de yuz wan prɔpriet algɔritm. Google Ɔtɛnɛtikɛtɔ (2010) bin mek pipul dɛn lɛk TOTP; evri 2FA ap naw yus am.
totp.h1_f:
TOTP(k, t) = HOTP(k, ⌊t / 30⌋) .
HOTP(k, c) = trunkat(HMAC-SHA1(k, c) ) mod 106
windo: ±1 step tolerate fɔ klok skew
totp.h2: Usay dɛn yuz am na Vortex .
totp.h3: Tɛm dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit dis

turn.title: TURN .
turn.subtitle: Traversal Yuz Rilay arawnd NAT (RFC 8656).
turn.intro: TURN na protɔkɔl fɔ rilay UDP / TCP trafik tru pɔblik sava we dairekt piɔ-to-piɔ pat dɛn nɔ de wok. Yuz am as di fɔlbak pat we ICE in ɔs ɛn sava-riflɛsɛf kandidet dɛn nɔ de wok.
turn.h1_a: TURN na protɔkɔl fɔ rilay UDP / TCP trafik tru pɔblik sava we dairekt piɔ-to-piɔ pat dɛn nɔ de wok. Yuz am as di fɔlbak pat we ICE in ɔs ɛn sava-riflɛsɛf kandidet dɛn nɔ de wok.
turn.h1_b: Vortex ship wan coturn instans wit ɛvri node. Kredibiliti nɔ de te (24 h), HMAC-sayn, dɛn de gi fɔ ɛni kɔl. We NAT traversal fel — tipikli bihayn simetrik NAT ɔ strikt fayawɔl — ɔl di kɔl midia de flɔ tru TURN.
turn.h1_c: TURN bin fɔs standad as RFC 5766 (2010), ɔpdet to RFC 8656 (2020). Yuz bay ɛvri WebRTC diploymɛnt fɔ ~15 % ɔf kɔl usay dairekt pat dɛn de fel. coturn na di rɛfrɛns opin-sɔs implimɛnt.
turn.h1_f:
username = "{ɛkspiri_yuniks}:{yuz_id}".
paswɔd = base64(HMAC-SHA1(sava_sikrit, yuz nem))
TTL = 24 h
coturn de validet HMAC pan ɛvri AUTH; rijek afta i dɔn pas
turn.h2: Usay dɛn yuz am na Vortex .
turn.h3: Tɛm dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit dis

vapid.title: VAPID .
vapid.subtitle: Voluntary Aplikeshɔn Sava Aydentifikeshɔn (RFC 8292).
vapid.intro: VAPID na wan pe Ed25519 ki we wan aplikeshɔn sava de yuz fɔ aydentify insɛf to Wɛb Push prɔvayda dɛn. I de pul di "udat alaw fɔ sɛn push" kwɛstyɔn fɔ Wɛb Push diploymɛnt dɛn.
vapid.h1_a: VAPID na wan pe Ed25519 ki we wan aplikeshɔn sava de yuz fɔ aydentify insɛf to Wɛb Push prɔvayda dɛn. I de pul di "udat alaw fɔ sɛn push" kwɛstyɔn fɔ Wɛb Push diploymɛnt dɛn.
vapid.h1_b: Vortex in wɛb klaynt de sabskrip to Wɛb Push yuz di node in VAPID pɔblik ki. Paylɔd dɛn de ɛnkript wit di sɛpret sial-push ki (p256dh) fɔ ɛni sabskripshɔn. Roteshɔn: di VAPID ki de liv lɔng bɔt sayn peylɔd dɛn gɛt shɔt JWT-stayl ɛkspɛriɛns.
vapid.h1_c: VAPID bin standad as RFC 8292 insay 2017. Bifo VAPID, Wɛb Push bin nid ɔl tu FCM-brɔka sabskripshɔn ɔ wan sɛpret ɔth mɛkanism. VAPID de mek di diploymɛnt dɛn we dɛn kin ɔs dɛnsɛf simpul — nɔ Fayabase prɔjek nɔ nid.
vapid.h2: Usay dɛn yuz am na Vortex .
vapid.h2_a: `app/services/sealed_push.py::web_push`, we dɛn pablish tru kɔntrol `/v1/health` fɔ no di sik.
vapid.h3: Tɛm dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit dis
vapid.h3_a: Web Push, sial push, Ed25519, JWT

waf.title: WAF .
waf.subtitle: Wɛb Aplikeshɔn Fayawɔl.
waf.intro: Wan WAF na midulwɛr we de inspɛkt HTTP rikwest ɛn blok di patɛns dɛn we dɛn sabi-malicious (SQL injɛkshɔn, pat travasal, tɛmplat injɛkshɔn) bifo dɛn rich aplikeshɔn kɔd.
waf.h1_a: Wan WAF na midulwɛr we de inspɛkt HTTP rikwest ɛn blok di patɛns dɛn we dɛn sabi-malicious (SQL injɛkshɔn, pat travasal, tɛmplat injɛkshɔn) bifo dɛn rich aplikeshɔn kɔd.
waf.h1_b: Vortex in WAF de rɔn as `ap/sikyɔriti/midulwɛr.py::WAFMiddleware`. ~50 regex de chɛk agens URL, kwɛstyɔn, bɔdi. Blɔk `UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ kɔnfig }}`, `$we`, XSS patɛn dɛn we dɛn sabi. Dɔn bak, i de ɛnfɔs di glob ɔl ret limit (1000 req/s), ɛni-rout limit (lɔgin 10/min, rɛjista 5/min), ɛni-yuz limit.
waf.h1_c: WAFs det to mod_sekyuriti (2002). Cloudflare in WAF (2014) bin komoditayz di patɛn. Ɛvri mɔdan wɛb fremwɔk de ship wan difɔlt sɛt fɔ chɛk. Vortex in regex list bin kompilayt frɔm OWASP Top 10 sayn dɛm.
waf.h1_f:
pan ɛnitin we yu aks fɔ:
  fɔ patɛn na SQLI_PATTERNS: if patɛn.sɔch(url + kwɛstyɔn + bɔdi): rijɛkt
  fɔ patɛn na TRAVERSAL: if patɛn.sɔch(url): rijɛkt
  fɔ patɛn na TEMPLATE: if patɛn.sɔch(bɔdi): rijɛkt
ret-limit we dɛn ki bay (IP, rod, yuz_id)
waf.h2: Usay dɛn yuz am na Vortex .
waf.h3: Tɛm dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit dis
waf.h3_a: rεt limitin, כdit lכg, OWASP, SQL injεkshכn

x25519.title: X25519 .
x25519.subtitle: Eliptik-kεrv Difi-Hεlman ova Kεrv25519 (RFC 7748).
x25519.intro: X25519 na ɛliptik-kɔv Difi-Hɛlman oba Kɔv25519 insay in Mɔntgɔmɛri fɔm. 32-bayt prayvet ɛn pɔblik ki, 32-bayt shered sikrit. Yuz fɔ ki agrimɛnt.
x25519.h1_a: X25519 na ɛliptik-kɔv Difi-Hɛlman oba Kɔv25519 insay in Mɔntgɔmɛri fɔm. 32-bayt prayvet ɛn pɔblik ki, 32-bayt shered sikrit. Yuz fɔ ki agrimɛnt.
x25519.h1_b: Ɛvri statik divays aydentiti, ɛvri ɛfimɛral sɛshɔn ki, ɛvri sial-push sabskripshɔn na Vortex de yuz X25519. Di Montgomery-ladder implimentishɔn na kɔnstant-taym ɛn imyun to di klas ɔf sayd-chanɛl atak dɛn we bin de plague fɔs kɔv dɛn.
x25519.h1_c: Curve25519 na Bernstein (2005) bin pablish am; standad as RFC 7748 (2016) wit di nem X25519 fכ di DH vεryכnt. Na Signal, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard, Apple iMɛsej, Krom (pɔst-kwantam haybrid) bin adopt am. Ubiquitous in mɔdan aplai kriptografi.
x25519.h1_f:
prayvet ki: a ∈ [0, 2255) (32 bayt smɔl-ɛndian, klem)
pɔblik ki: A = a · G (32-bayt kɔmprɛs pɔynt) .
sheb: s = a · B = b · A (32 bayt, → HKDF input)
pefomans: ~100 μs pan wan DH pan wan iPhone 11
x25519.h2: Usay dɛn yuz am na Vortex .
x25519.h3: Tɛm dɛn we gɛt fɔ du wit dis

websocketFanout.title: WebSocket fan-ɔut intɛnal dɛn
websocketFanout.subtitle: Aw wan node de delivr wan ivent to tawzin sabskriptɔ dɛn.
websocketFanout.what: Di WebSocket fan-out na Python-nativ sɛt fɔ sabskriptɔ handel fɔ ɛni rum. We dɛn POST mɛsej, di fan-ɔut dispatcha de itɛrayt di sɛt ɛn ɛnkyu wan siriɔs freym pan ɛni sabskriptɔ in sɛnd kiyu.
websocketFanout.why: Fan-out de avɔyd di N-kɔpi kɔst fɔ brodkas: wan dikripshɔn na di sɛnda sayd, wan siriɔs freym, N sɛn-kiyu push. Ɛni push na O(1); di kɔpi kɔst de push pan di kɛnal na `send()` tɛm via ziro-kɔpi bafa dɛn we di OS sɔpɔt dɛn.
websocketFanout.where: Impliment in `app/chats/fanout.py`. Di tɔp-lɛvɛl `FanoutRegistry` de ol `dict[rum_id, sɛt[WebSocket]]`. Rɛjista rayt dɛn na `asyncio.Lock` de gayd dɛn; rid na snɛpsho dɛn we nɔ gɛt lɔk.
websocketFanout.how: Na mɛsej POST di router de kɔl `await fanout.broadcast(rum_id, payload_bytes)`. Di we aw dɛn de du am de kɔpi di sɛt ɔnda di lɔk, rilis, dɔn i de itɛrayt di kɔpi we de wet fɔ `ws.send_bytes(payload)` wit 1-sɛkɔn tɛmaut fɔ ɛni sɔkɛtɛ. Dɛn kin mak di sɔkɛtɛ dɛn we dɔn taym bad ɛn dɛn kin klin dɛn.
websocketFanout.when: Ɛvri mɛsej, riakshɔn, rid-risit, tayp indikɛtɔ, kɔl signal, ɛn rum ki rɔtin de flɔ tru dis sem fan-ɔut. Fram saiz de baund na 64 KiB; big peylod dεm dεn de rijek εn dεn de gi dεm bak to di kכlכr via HTTP.
websocketFanout.cfg1: `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE=256` — fɔ ɛni sabskriptɔ sɛn dip di kiyu. Ovaflɔ de drɔp di freym we ol pas ɔl.
websocketFanout.cfg2: `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS=1000` — ɔpa baund pan `send_bayt`. If yu pas dat, dat de mak di sɔkɛt bad.
websocketFanout.cfg3: `FANOUT_MAX_ROOM_SIZE=10000` — nɔ gri fɔ fan-ɔut pan rum dɛn we big pas dis. Big big rum dɛn de yuz chanɛl mɔd ɛn wan pul pɔtn insted.
websocketFanout.fail1: Slow konsuma — per-sɔket kiyu ɔvaflɔ. Di freym dɛn we ol pas ɔl bin dɔn drɔp. Klaynt kech op via `sins` pan rikonekt.
websocketFanout.fail2: Ded soket — `send_bytes` de rayz `KɔnɛkshɔnKlɔz`. Dispatcher de pul frɔm sɛt ɛn muf go bifo.
websocketFanout.fail3: Bursty prodyusa — if prodyusɔ > 5× fast pas agrɛgrɛt kɔshɔma bandwid, bak-prɛshɔn kin kik in via `await` sɔspɛnd di sɛnda.
websocketFanout.fail4: Mɛmori blo-ap — fɔ ɛni sabskriptɔ kiyu we dɛn kap pan 256 freym dɛn; na 64 KiB ɛvri wan dat na 16 MiB maks fɔ wan slo kɔshɔma. Wan kɔshɔma we dɔn rɔnawe go gɛt diskɔnekt bay di layfnɛs chɛk bifo i hit da siling de.
websocketFanout.mon1: Prometheus gauge `vortex_fanout_queue_depth{rum,yuz}` — dip fɔ ɛni sɔkɛt kiyu.
websocketFanout.mon2: Kaunta `vortex_fanout_drops_total{reason}` — drɔp freym dɛn bay rizin (ɔvaflɔ, tɛmaut, klos).
websocketFanout.tune1: Rays `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE` fɔ klaynt dɛn na slo-bɔt-stebul nɛtwɔk dɛn.
websocketFanout.tune2: Lɔwa `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS` na ay-kɔntinyu klasta usay slo sɔkɛtɛ dɛn de mek ɔda pipul dɛn angri.
websocketFanout.tune3: Split big big rum dɛn to sab-rum ɔ swich dɛn to chanɛl mɔd wit pul-bɛs ɔpdet.
websocketFanout.edge1: Rum roteshɔn ivin (`type:"k"`) dɛn kin sɛn wit 2 s tɛmaut instead ɔf 1 s bikɔs klaynt dɛn fɔ ri-impɔt ki bifo dɛn aksept mɔ mɛsej.
websocketFanout.edge2: Dɛn nɔ de tray bak fɔ tayp di tin dɛn we apin — fɔ lɔs "yuzman stɔp fɔ tayp" nɔ bad.
websocketFanout.edge3: Prɛzɛns ɔpdet dɛn de batch: bɔku yuz prɛzɛns flip dɛn na di sem 250 ms winda dɛn jɔyn insay wan freym.
websocketFanout.mig1: v0.0 yuz per-rum `asyncio.Queue`s — riples in v0.0.5 bay di lɔk-kɔpi-iterate patɛn fɔ lɔwa per-mɛsej CPU.
websocketFanout.mig2: Fiuja: we Redis de, fan-out go lɛk pub/sub so multi-node klasta dɛn de riplikɛt ivin dɛn we nɔ gɛt mesh fan-out.
websocketFanout.ts1: High drop rate: chɛk nɛtwɔk to di slo kɔshɔma; bamp kiyu saiz; invεstigat di klaynt bihayvya.
websocketFanout.ts2: High send duration: i go bi se na TLS rinegoshieshɔn we de go bifo ɔ wan NAT traversal tɛmaut; chek kεnεl lכg fכ TCP ritransmishכn.
websocketFanout.ts3: Mɛmori krip: inspɛkt `vortex_fanout_queue_depth` fɔ ɛni yuza; mak ɛni yuza wit dip we nɔ de chenj > 200 as i go bi se i go slo ɔ bad klaynt.
websocketFanout.faq1: K: Wetin kin apin if klaynt mis freym dɛn we dɛn dɔn diskɔnekt? A: I de kɔnɛkt bak wit `since=<last_seen_id>` ɛn di sava de riplay frɔm di DB. Di fan-out na di bɛst-ɛfɔt rial-taym; durabiliti de liv na di DB.
websocketFanout.faq2: K: Yu tink se bad bad sabskriptɔ kin slo fan-ɔut? A: Dɛn de slo dɛn yon kiyu, we de ful-ɔp, drɔp freym, ɛn diskɔnekt dɛn. No kros-sabskriptɔ intafɛreshɔn.
websocketFanout.faq3: K: Aw a go dibɔg wan patikyula yuza in delivri? A: `GET /api/admin/debug/fanout/{user_id}` de dump dɛn kiyu dip, las sɛn tɛmstamp, ɛn drɔp dɛn we dɛn jɔs dɔn.

nonceManagement.title: Nonce manejmɛnt
nonceManagement.subtitle: Aw Vortex de kip AES-GCM nonces yunik akɔdin to divays, rum, ɛn ribɔt.
nonceManagement.what: Ɛvri AES-GCM ɔpreshɔn de tek 12-bayt nons we MUST bi yunik fɔ wan givɛn ki. Ri-yuz wan nonce wit di sem ki destroy ɔl tu di kɔnfidɛns ɛn ɔthɛntiti — wan atak wit tu sayfatɛks ɔnda di sem (ki, nonce) kin rikavari di pleinttɛks XOR.
nonceManagement.why: Vortex de jenarayz wan rum ki ɛn yuz am fɔ tawzin mɛsej dɛn. Wan kɔmprɔmis nons akɔdin to tu mɛsej dɛn go lik plaintɛks. So ɔl di nonces dɛn de jenarayz wit di OS CSPRNG na 96 bits — di batde-baund-sef rijyɔn na lɛk 2^32 mɛsej pan wan ki, fa fawe pas ɛni wan ki go ɛnkript.
nonceManagement.where: Klaynt-sayd nonce jɛnɛreshɔn de liv insay `VortexKripto` (iOS), `kripto/aead` mɔdyul (Android), `ap.sikyuriti.kripto.aes_gcm_ɛnkript` (node). Di node de rɔn bak wan difensiv dupliket-nɔns chɛk.
nonceManagement.how: Step-by-step: klaynt de jenarayz 12 random bayt, pas to AES-GCM enkript, fram di sayfatɛks as `{sayfatɛks, nonce}` ɛn POST. Node de rikodɔ `(rum_id, nonce)` insay wan in-mɛmori LRU kesh we saiz to 10^6 ɛntri. Na POST, node de chɛk di kesh — dupliket ⇒ 400 `dupliket_nɔns`. Ɔnda nɔmal yus dis nɔ de ɛva faya (P(kɔlishin) na 10^9 mɛsej na ~10^-19).
nonceManagement.when: Na evri send. Risiva-sayd: nɔ nonce chɛk — AES-GCM in tag de handle intagriti. If wan nonce sɔm kayn we ripit, di sɛkɔn dikript go stil sakses bɔt kɔnfidɛns go kɔmprɔmis.
nonceManagement.cfg1: `NONCE_CACHE_SIZE=1000000` — nɔmba fɔ di nonces we dɛn jɔs trak fɔ ɛni node.
nonceManagement.cfg2: `NONCE_CACHE_TTL_S=86400` — ol ɛntri dɛn we dɛn pul afta 24 h (mɔs ki dɛn kin rɔta insay awa ɛni we).
nonceManagement.fail1: RNG fεil pan klaynt — i rili nכ lεk wit OS-provayd CSPRNG. Wi nɔ de ɛva fɔdɔm bak to RNG dɛn we nɔto kriptografik.
nonceManagement.fail2: Kesh mis pan node ristart — akseptabl bikɔs kesh na difens-in-dip; klaynt dɛn nɔ ɛva legitimately riyuz nonces so wan mis nɔ de opin wan atak winda.
nonceManagement.mon2: Gej `vortex_nonce_cache_size` — fɔ stedi rawnd kesh kap.
nonceManagement.tune1: Big big rum dɛn: inkrisayz di kesh saiz fɔ kɔba lɔng rɔtin winda dɛn.
nonceManagement.tune2: Multi-node clusters: sheb di kesh tru Redis we i de.
nonceManagement.edge1: Ɔflayn klaynt we de ri-kɔnekt wit mɛsej dɛn we de na di kiyu: ɛni mɛsej we de na di kiyu kin kɛr in yon random nonce. No kɔdineshɔn nɔ nid fɔ de.
nonceManagement.edge2: Multi-divais send: ɔl tu di divays dɛn de jenarayz indipɛndɛnt random nonces. P(kolishin) na 2 divays × 10^4 mɛsej = nɔ impɔtant.
nonceManagement.mig1: v0.0 brifly yuz counter-based nonces seeded wit divais id — deprecated afta wan pepa sho kros-divays kolishon anda klok-skew. Random-96 na di onli blɛsin rod naw.
nonceManagement.ts1: Si `duplicate_nonce` rijekshɔn dɛn: inspɛkt di klaynt fɔ bɔg RNG; chɛk divays ɛntrɔpi sɔs.
nonceManagement.ts2: Kesh OOM: chɛk kesh saiz agens rum rayt ret; ɔ rayz saiz ɔ lɔs TTL.
nonceManagement.faq1: K: Wetin if tu klaynt pik di sem nonce bai chans? A: Na 96 bits of randomness, expekt fכs kolishכn akraos כl di yuza dεm na ~2^48 mεsej — plεnti layf tεm dεm fכ Vortex yus. If i ɛva apin, di node go rijek di sɛkɔn wan.
nonceManagement.faq2: K: Wetin mek 96 bits ɛn nɔto 128? A: AES-GCM in standad nonce lɔng. 96 bits de sev 4 bayt bak fɔ ɛni mɛsej.

keyRotation.title: Ki rotashɔn
keyRotation.subtitle: Ustɛm ɛn aw di rum, divays, ɛn rilis ki dɛn kin rol oba.
keyRotation.what: Ɛvri ki we de liv lɔng na Vortex de rɔta pan schedule ɔ pan trig. Rum ki dɛn kin rɔta we dɛn chenj di mɛmbaship ɔ wan wan tɛm (ɛvri wik). Divays ki dɛn de rɔta fɔ ɛni yuza we i pik. Rilis ki dɛn kin rɔta we dɛn tink se dɛn dɔn mek kɔmprɔmis.
keyRotation.why: Rotashɔn de limit di blast rayus fɔ wan kɔmprɔmis. Wan rum ki we dɛn tif frɔm yestede de stɔp fɔ dikript tide mɛsej dɛn. Wan rilis ki we dɛn tif frɔm 2024 stɔp fɔ atɛst 2026 rilis dɛn.
keyRotation.where: `app/keys/` haus sava-sayd roteshɔn lɔjik. Klaynt sayd: `ios/.../Ki/impl/RumKiProvayda.swift`, `android/.../ki/impl/RumKiProvayda.kt`.
keyRotation.how: Rum roteshɔn: ɛni admin kin trig; ɔdinari roteshɔn pan lɛf na ɔtomɛtik. Di rotator derive wan fresh 32-byte rut, ri-envelope to remaining members, post `POST /api/rooms/{id}/rotate` wit di nyu envelopes. Node atomically apdet `room_keys` ɛn brodkas `{type:"k"}`.
keyRotation.when: Rum: na lɛf, na admin trig, ɛvri 7 dez ɔtomɛtik. Divays: ɛvri 90 dez bay difɔlt (we dɛn kin kɔnfigyut). Rilis: ad-hoc pan sɔspɛkt kɔmprɔmis.
keyRotation.cfg3: `ROTATE_ON_LEAVE=true` — ɔf fɔ skip roteshɔn pan lɛf (lɔs sikyɔriti fɔ lɔwa CPU).
keyRotation.fail1: Klaynt ɔflayn di tɛm we dɛn de rɔta: i de kech pan nɛks kɔnɛkt. Node stoa las 5 roteshon so rikonekt olwes fain dem envelope.
keyRotation.fail2: Envelope minting race: tu admin dɛn de rɔta wan tɛm. Node aksept di fɔs wan ɛn ritɔn 409 Kɔnflikt to di sɛkɔn wan.
keyRotation.tune1: Pɔblik rum dɛn na > 1000 mɛmba dɛn: swich to Variant-B ki pablish. Roteshɔn pan lɛf kin bi no-op; memba dem trost di post pubkey signature.
keyRotation.tune2: Rum dεm we sεnsitiv tεm (e.g. jכnalistik sכs chεnal dεm): sכt rכtεshכn kεdεns (de כ awa).
keyRotation.edge1: Singl-mεmba rum afta כl di כda wan dεm kכmכt: rotashכn nכ nid fכ de bכt stil trigεr fכ kכnsistεns; lone memba geht nyu envelope fo dem sef.
keyRotation.edge2: Ɔna de kɔmɔt: ɔna de transfa to di admin we dɔn jɔyn fɔ lɔng tɛm; di ɔna in ol ɛnvilɔp dɔn rivok.
keyRotation.mig1: v0.0 rotated onli pan lif. v0.2 ad piɔriɔdik rɔteshɔn we `ROOM_KEY_ROTATION_DAYS` de kɔntrol.
keyRotation.ts1: Klaynt dɛn bin stɔp fɔ dikript: chɛk ɛnvilɔp tebul; mek shɔ se dɛn bin brodkas di roteshɔn ivin.
keyRotation.ts2: Roteshon failure: usually netwok to wan slo memba. Ritray kɔnt we dɛn dɔn log insay di ɔdit treyl.
keyRotation.faq1: K: Yu tink se roteshon de ri-enkript ol mesej? A: Nɔ. Ol sayfatɛks de ɔnda di ol ki; klaynt dɛn kin kip ol ki dɛn na dɛn lokal kesh fɔ istri dikripshɔn.
keyRotation.faq2: K: Wetin fɔ du if pɔsin we de yuz am jɔyn ɛn kɔmɔt kwik kwik wan 100 tɛm? A: Ɛni akshɔn de rɔta. Na big rum dis na dia — wi de rate-limit mɛmbaship ivin to 1/min fɔ ɛni yuza.

rateLimiting.title: Ret limiting
rateLimiting.subtitle: Per- IP, per-yuz, per-rout token-bɔkit limit.
rateLimiting.what: Ret limit na di praymar difens agens bulk abiuz: brut-fɔs login, rɛjista flɔd, mɛsej spam, fayl-ɔplɔd taya.
rateLimiting.why: If yu nɔ gɛt limit, ɛni ɔtɛnɛtik abiuz kin ɛkzoz disk, sɛtyuret fan-ɔut, ɔ brut-fɔs wan 4-dijit 2FA. Limit dεm na chip (~10 ns pan wan chεk) εn tכn כda-trivial atak dεm to dia wan dεm.
rateLimiting.where: `app/security/limits.py` de ol di limita. `app/authentication/_helpers.py::_check_auth_rate` na wan tin wrap fɔ ɔth rout dɛn.
rateLimiting.how: Token-bɔket algɔritm fɔ wan (skɔp, ki). Bɔket rifil na rit R, kapasiti C. Rikwest tek 1 token. Ɛmpti bɔkit ⇒ 429. Traka stɔrɔj: in-mɛmori dikt pan singl node; Redis wen `REDIS_URL=...`.
rateLimiting.when: Ɛvri rikwest tru di WAF midulwɛr. Skip list fɔ statik ɛset ɛn wɛlbɔdi chɛk.
rateLimiting.cfg1: `_AUTH_RATE_LOGIN=10` fɔ wan 60 s fɔ wan IP.
rateLimiting.cfg2: `_AUTH_RATE_REGISTER=5` fɔ wan 60 s fɔ wan IP.
rateLimiting.cfg3: `MSG_RATE_PER_USER=30` fɔ wan minit fɔ wan yuza.
rateLimiting.cfg4: `FILE_UPLOAD_RATE=10` fɔ wan minit fɔ wan yuza.
rateLimiting.cfg5: `TESTING=tru` de disable ɔl di limit dɛn (CI).
rateLimiting.fail1: Legitimate yuza bihayn shered NAT (ɔfis, skul) hit per-IP limit — yuza-fes 429 wit pɔlitikal mɛsej.
rateLimiting.fail2: Mɛmori blo-ap na big big bɔrst — kap pan 100k difrɛn ki dɛn; LRU fɔ pul pɔsin kɔmɔt na di os.
rateLimiting.tune1: Bihain wan CDN we de strip rial IP: set `TRUSTED_PROXIES` so wi rid `X-Forwarded-For`. If nɔto dat ɔl di trafik de hit di limit ɔnda di CDN in egress IP.
rateLimiting.tune2: Bot dɛn we gɛt ay volyum: gi wan API ki wit `BOT_RATE_OVERRIDE=1000`.
rateLimiting.edge1: IPv6: wi de limit fɔ ɛni /64 pas fɔ ɛni adrɛs fɔ akɔn fɔ big ISP alɔkeshɔn dɛn.
rateLimiting.edge2: Tor ɛkzit: wi de aplay wan lɔs limit (`TOR_RATE_MULTIPLIER=5`) fɔ avɔyd fɔ pɔnish Tor yuza dɛn pan shered ɛkzit.
rateLimiting.mig1: v0.0 yuz `slowapi` wit dɛkɔretɔ-pa-rut — we dɛn nɔ bin dɔn yuz am na v0.0.5 fɔ sɛntralayz midulwɛr.
rateLimiting.ts1: Falz-positiv 429: chɛk prɔksi kɔnfig we dɛn kin trɔst, chɛk shered-NAT sɛtup dɛn, bamp skɔp limit if lɛjitimɛnt trafik de hit am.
rateLimiting.ts2: Baypas: inspɛkt akses lɔg fɔ di abusive IP; ad to `BLACKLIST_IP=` env var fɔ had blɔk.
rateLimiting.faq1: K: Dɛn de sheb di limit dɛn akɔdin to di no dɛm? A: Insay singl-node mod, limit na per-node. Wit Redis, limits na global akɔdin to di klasta.
rateLimiting.faq2: K: Aw a go gi mɔ fɔ misɛf? A: Ɔtɛnɛtik yuza dɛn kin aplay fɔ ay kwota via `/api/admin/quota`. Admins de apruv kes-by-kes.

emojiCatalog.title: Emoji katalog
emojiCatalog.subtitle: Di 1500-emoji dataset we dɛn sheb akɔdin to ɔl di klaynt dɛn.
emojiCatalog.what: Vortex de ship in yon imɔji sɛt pas fɔ abop pan Yunikɔd-vɛshɔn we de. 1500 imɔji dɛn we dɛn ɔganayz insay 9 kategori (smayl, pipul, animal, it, travul, aktiviti, tin, simbul, flag). Di sem JSON we dɛn yuz na iOS (`Imoji/Rɛsos/emoji.json`), Andrɔyd (`android/app/src/mɛn/ɛset/emoji.json`), ɛn di wɛb klaynt (`statik/ɛsɛt/emoji.json`).
emojiCatalog.why: Kɔnsistɛns: wan yuza we de sɛn 🥹 na iOS 17 fɔ rɛnd as 🥹 pan Andrɔyd 9. Nativ sistɛm imɔji de difrɛn akɔdin to OS vɛshɔn dɛn bay 1-3 ia, so wi de ship wi yon fɔ kip di map stebul.
emojiCatalog.how: JSON strɔkchɔ: `{kategori: [emoji_char, ...]}`. Klaynt dɛn kin lod we dɛn stat, flat insay wan sɔch indeks, ɛn rɛnd via LazyVGrid / LazyGrid / CSS grid.
emojiCatalog.when: Na di ap stat ɛn ɛnitɛm we di yuza opin di pik. MRU list de kɔntinyu fɔ de na YuzDifɔlt / SheredPrɛferɛns / lokalStɔrej.
emojiCatalog.cfg1: Recents cap: 30 na iOS, 30 na Andrɔyd, 20 na wɛb.
emojiCatalog.cfg2: Kategori dɛn fiks in ɔda — riɔda de brok di pik layout.
emojiCatalog.fail1: Yuz in OS nɔ ebul fɔ rɛnd wan imɔji: fɔdɔm bak to `?` glyph. Wi pik kodpoint frɔm Yunikɔd ≤ 15.0 we ɛvri mɔdan OS de sɔpɔt.
emojiCatalog.tune1: Kastɔm ​​imɔji pak dɛn: di wan dɛn we de yuz am kin instɔl stika pak dɛn we de biev di sem we bɔt we de rɛnd rasta imej dɛn.
emojiCatalog.edge1: Skin-tone variants: wi katalog de stoa onli base emojis; vεryכnt dεm de kכmכp klaynt-sayd via ZWJ sikεns dεm.
emojiCatalog.edge2: Flag emojis: rijinol-indikɛtɔ simbul pe; iOS de sho di flag, sɔm Andrɔyd vɛshɔn dɛn de sho lɛta pe.
emojiCatalog.mig1: v0.0 yuz emoji.json frɔm emoji-mart ɔpstrim. v0.0.5 fɔk fɔ pin di katalog ɛn trim to 1500 fɔ bɔndɛl-sayz rizin.
emojiCatalog.ts1: Emoji we nɔ de: bil bak di prɔpati dɛn; mek shɔ se di JSON valid; sɔm divays dɛn kin kech ol vɛshɔn dɛn agresiv wan — klia ap kesh.
emojiCatalog.faq1: K: A kin ad kɔstɔm imɔji? A: Nɔto tru di katalog. Yuz stika pak dɛn.
emojiCatalog.faq2: K: Wetin mek yu nɔ yuz Twemoji? A: Laysens + bɔndɛl saiz. Twemoji na CC-BY-4.0 bɔt di PNG sɛt de ad 20 MB fɔ ɛni klaynt.

smartReply.when: Ɛnitɛm we smartReply rili impɔtant — si di kɔd fɔ invokeshɔn sayt dɛn.
smartReply.cfg1: Difɔlt kɔnfig de wok fɔ di kɔmɔn kes.
smartReply.cfg2: Ficha flag we de na `.env.example` — luk fɔ `SMARTREPLY_ENABLED`.
smartReply.cfg3: Tuning knobs we dɛn dɔn dɔkyumɛnt insay di modul in README.
smartReply.fail1: Degraded savis pas fɔ mek i nɔ wok tranga wan.
smartReply.fail2: Mɛtrik inkrimɛn; alert faya if di threshold pas.
smartReply.fail3: Ritray dɛn gɛt bɔnd; nɔ gɛt lɔp dɛn we nɔ gɛt ɛnd.
smartReply.mon3: Log na INFO fɔ saksesful path, WARN fɔ rikavari mistek.
smartReply.tune2: Wach di mɛtrik fɔ wan wik bifo yu chenj.
smartReply.tune3: Dokumɛnt di rizin fɔ ɛvri tuning chenj.
smartReply.edge1: Handles di ekspekt edj kes per di protɔkɔl spek.
smartReply.edge2: Dɛn kin log di edj kes dɛn we dɛn nɔ no fɔ mek di ɔpreshɔn rivyu.

intro.p1: Architex na diklaretiv UI langwej we dɛn bil fɔ Vortex Mini Apps. Insted fɔ rayt JavaScript we de mute di DOM, yu de diskraib di skrin we yu want ɛn di rɔntaym de kip piksɛl dɛn in sink wit stet ɔtomɛtik wan.
intro.p2: Di langwej smɔl: 4 diklareshɔn dɛn (@screen, @theme, @import, @for), wan prɛfiks fɔ riaktiv vɛriɔbul dɛn (~), ɛn wan ɔpreshɔn chen fɔ stayl (::).
intro.p3: If yu dɔn ɛva rayt HTML + CSS + JS, Architex go fil se yu sabi bɔt wit 10× less boilerplate. If yu nɔ dɔn du am, Architex na jentl introdukshɔn bak to riaktiv programin bikɔs di langwej so smɔl yu kin ol am ɔl na yu ed.
intro.p4: Ɛni pat pan dis rɛfrɛns de bil pan di wan dɛn we bin dɔn de bifo. Jɔmp insay ɛnisay we yu lɛk if yu dɔn no ɔda diklaretiv UI fremwɔk; rid tap to bottom if yu de stat fresh.
intro.li1: Diklɛrativ — diskrayb di shep fɔ di UI, nɔto di stɛp dɛn fɔ bil am
intro.li2: Reactive — wan asaynmɛnt de ɔpdet ɛvri dipɛndent lɛbl, klas, ɔ node
intro.li3: Portable — di sem .arx de rɔn pan wɛb, iOS, ɛn Andrɔyd ɔs dɛn
intro.li4: Tiny — parsa + rɛnda ship ɔnda 30 KB gzipped
intro.ct1: Architex na domɛyn-spɛsifi k. I nɔ go tek ples fɔ wan jenɛral-pɔpɔs langwej — bɔt fɔ ship skrin insay chat i fast pas ɛni fremwɔk we wi mɛzhɔ.
intro.ct2: Ɛvri kɔnstrɔkshɔn na di langwej de map to wan rɔntaym primitiv. No majik nɔ de we yu nɔ go ebul fɔ ɛksplen.

intro.h1_b: Implimɛnt ɔvaviu fɔ "Wetin na Architex?". Di mɛkanism de implimɛnt insay di kɔrɛspɔndɛns mɔdyul ɔnda `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, ɔ `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Di modul README de kɔl ɔut ɛksaktɔ fayl pat dɛn.

variables.p1: Riaktiv vɛriɔbul kin ol wan valyu ɛn i kin notis ɔlman we de rid am ɔtomɛtik wan we yu rayt nyu valyu. Diklar wit =, ri-asayn wit =, ɔpdet wit += / -= / *= / /=.
variables.p2: Kɔmpyuta vɛriɔbul dɛn kin gɛt dɛn valyu frɔm wan ɛksprɛshɔn we de ri-evalyu ɛnitɛm we ɛni input chenj. Diklar wit := insted of =. Nɔ manual sabskripshɔn, nɔ stayl-valyu bɔg.
variables.p3: Anot di tayp wit : Type afta di nem. Di kayn dɛn we dɛn sɔpɔt: number, string, boolean, array, object. Anoteshɔn dɛn na sɔntin we pɔsin kin pik; di tayp de infεr frכm di initial valyu.
variables.p4: Yuz lowerCamelCase ɔ snek_kɛs; Architex nɔ de ɛnfɔs sɛf. Kip nem dɛn shɔt: wan skrin we gɛt dɔzɛn lɔng nem dɛn de west indenteshɔn.
variables.p5: Skop: wan riaktiv vεriεbul we dεn dεklar insay wan @screen de si כnli insay da skrin in bכdi. @theme token dɛn de si ɔlsay na di wɔl.
variables.p6: Layfsaykl: stet de liv as lɔng as di skrin de mawnt. We yu de waka go fa, dat kin pwɛl am; we yu go bak, i de mek am bak na di fɔs valyu.
variables.p7: Persistence: fɔ liv pas di skrin, kɔl send(action: "save", data: ~state) ɛn lɛ di bot host persist.

state.p1: εvri riaktiv sεl de liv as lכng as in enklos @screen de mכunt. We yu opin skrin, i de rɔn in diklareshɔn dɛn frɔm ɔp to dɔŋ; we yu lɛf am via back() ɔ goto() de pwɛl dɛn.
state.p2: If yu nid stet fɔ sev navigayshɔn, pul am frɔm di ɔs: ɔ POST to di bot wit send() ɛn ri-fetch pan opin, ɔ persist lokal wan tru wan store(key, value) kɔl.
state.p3: Riset: ri-asaynd to di fɔs valyu. No reset ki wɔd nɔ de bikɔs ri-asaynmɛnt dɔn ɔlrɛdi du di wok; di runtime diffs en ri-rends onli wetin chenj.
state.p4: Dεrivεd stet de kכmpyut via :=. Architex de trak dipɛnsin dɛn ɔtomɛtik wan, so yu nɔ de list dɛn wit yu an. Dipɛnsin trakin na prɛsis fɔ ɛni prɔpati, nɔto fɔ ɛni ɔbjɛkt.
state.p5: Dɛn kin kɔmpia arenjmɛnt ɛn ɔbjɛkt dɛn bay rɛfrɛns. Fɔ fos wan ri-rɛnd, asaynd wan nyu arenjmɛnt / ɔbjɛkt. Mutation of di ol wan na ignore — wan intenshɔnal tred fɔ prɛdiktibɛl ɔpdet sɛmantiks.
state.cc1: ~list = [...~list, newItem] // fos ri-rɛnd wit nyu arenjmɛnt rɛfrɛns
state.cc2: ~obj = {...~obj, nem: "x"}  // sem patɛn fɔ ɔbjɛkt dɛn
state.li2: Layf tɛm: frɔm @screen ɛnta fɔ kɔmɔt.
state.li3: Kɔnkɔrɛns: wan-trɛd pan ɛni skrin. Dɛn de batch ɔpdet dɛn insay wan maykrotask.
state.li4: Ikwal: strikt (===) — fɔ asaynd di sem valyu nɔ de ri-trig natin.

types.p1: Architex gɛt fayv primitiv kayn dɛn: number, string, boolean, null, ɛn di kɔmpɔzit object / array. Dɛn kin pas di de dɛn as string (ISO 8601) ɔ nɔmba (unix ms).
types.p2: Nɔmba dɛn na 64-bit dabl (IEEE 754). Intaj aritmɛtik te to 2^53 na ɛksaktɔ.
types.p3: String dɛn na UTF-8; lɔng de kɔnt kɔd pɔynt dɛn, nɔto bayt dɛn. Intapɔleshɔn de yuz kɔl bres.
types.p4: Bulin dɛn na true / false. No implisit kɔnvɛnshɔn frɔm string dɛn.
types.p5: Di arenjmɛnt dɛn de ɔda, 0-indeks. Akses via ~arr[0]; lεngth via ~arr.length.
types.p6: Ɔbjɛkt dɛn na ki→valyu map dɛn we nɔ ɔda. Akses via ~obj.name ɔ ~obj["name"].
types.p7: Kɔs: aritmɛtik ɔpreshɔn dɛn kin fos string dɛn to nɔmba dɛn if di string luk lɛk nɔmba; ɔdasay wan ɛksprɛshɔn mistek de faya na rɔntaym.

handlers.p1: Intaraktiv komponent dεm de atak wan akshכn afta =>. Wan bɔtin in akshɔn de faya we yu tap. Wan input in akshɔn de faya pan chenj (afta debounce if dɛn kɔnfigyut am).
handlers.p2: Yu kin chen bɔku akshɔn dɛn na di sem layn. Dɛn de ɛksɛkutiv ɔp-to-bɔt insay di sem maykrotask, so di UI de ɔpdet wan tɛm na di ɛnd.
handlers.p3: Akshɔn kin asaynd to riaktiv sɛl, kɔl ɔs bilt-in, nevigayt, ɔ send() mɛsej bak to di bot.

control_flow.p1: Architex nɔ gɛt if stetmɛnt na di tɔp lɛvɛl na di sɛntaks. Kondishכnal UI de εksprεs tru di hidden(~flag) / visible(~flag) modifya dεm כ tru tεrnary εksprεshכn dεm insay kכmכpכnt valyu dεm.
control_flow.p2: Ternary de wok ɛnisay we dɛn aksept wan valyu: kɔmpɔnɛnt argumɛnt, modifya argumɛnt, kɔmpyutayt valyu.
control_flow.p3: Fɔ pas tu branch dɛn, yu fɔ nɛst di tɛnari. Architex de pars rayt-to-lɛft so nesting de rid naturally.
control_flow.p4: Fɔ switch-layk lɔjik oba wan ɔbjɛkt, yuz kɔmpyuta lukɔp: ~labels := {home: "Home", settings: "Settings"}; text ~labels[~active].
control_flow.cc4: ~status := ~n >= 10 we yu de du? "ful" : ~n >= 5 we yu de du? "mid" : "lɔ"
control_flow.li1: Nɔ if blɔk — yuz modifya ɔ tɛnari.
control_flow.li2: No else if chen — yuz nest ternary.
control_flow.li3: No patna maching — yuz lukap tebul insted.
control_flow.li4: Nɔ ali ritɔn — kɔndishɔnal branch dɛn na valyu, nɔto stetmɛnt.

loops.p1: Ripit wan blɔk we gɛt UI pan ɛni ɛlimɛnt wit @for item in ~list. Indent di bɔdi; ɛvri pikin de rɛnd wan tɛm pan ɛni ɛlimɛnt.
loops.p2: Bind di ziro-based indeks wit di tu-nem fɔm: @for item, idx in ~list.
loops.p3: Di rɔntaym de trak aydentiti bay di ɛlimɛnt insɛf bay difɔlt. Prepending to a 10 000-row list costs O(1) DOM wok — di rɛnda difrɛn bay rɛfrɛns, nɔto bay pozishɔn.
loops.p4: Nest @for fri wan. di insay lכp dεm de si di כta lכp binding dεm.
loops.p5: Itereshɔn ɔda na di arenjmɛnt ɔda. Fɔ rivɛns, itɛrayt wan kɔmpyutayt rivas: ~reversed := [...].reverse().
loops.li1: Iterashכn bכdi de indent wan lεvεl dip pas di @for layn.
loops.li2: di bכdi kin gεt eni kכmכpכnt, inklud כda @for.
loops.li3: Fɔ ad / pul na di ɛnd na fri; diffing na tin we de bays pan aydentiti.
loops.li4: Ɛmpti list dɛn nɔ de rɛnd natin — nɔ pleshɔlda slot nɔ de we dɛn dɔn kip.

reactivity.h4: Saykl dɛn we dɛn kin yuz
reactivity.p1: Ɛvri riaktiv rid insay kɔmpyuta ɛksprɛshɔn ɔ modifya argumɛnt de rɛjista dipɛnsin. we eni dipεndεns chenj, di εksprεshכn de ri-evalyu insay di nεks maykrotask.
reactivity.p2: Rayt dɛn de batch: bɔku asaynmɛnt dɛn insay wan ivin handla faya ɛksaktɔli wan rɛnd pas na di ɛnd. Dis na di rizin we mek => ~a = 1 => ~b = 2 na cheap ivin wit bɔku pipul dɛn we de rid.
reactivity.p3: Ikwalti na strikt tin (===). Rayt di sem valyu nɔ de ri-rɔn natin. Fɔ fos ɔpdet wit rɛfrɛns tayp dɛn, asaynd nyu arenjmɛnt ɔ ɔbjɛkt.
reactivity.p4: Saykl dεm na kכmpyut dipεndεns (~a := ~b + 1 εn ~b := ~a - 1) dεn dεtekt dεm na diklareshכn tεm εn ripot as mistek.
reactivity.p5: Async updates: wan send() we de ritɔn wan valyu de ɔpdet di sɛl we yu asaynd di rizɔlt to, we de schedul fɔ rɛnd pas we di Prɔmis sɔlv.

reactivity.li2: Batched: bɔku rayt insay wan maykrotask ⇒ wan rɛnd.
reactivity.li3: Ditɛministic: di sem input ⇒ di sem autput, nɔ ɔda sɔprayz.

strings.p1: String dɛn gɛt dɛbul-kot: "Hello". Singl kot dεm dεn aksept bak fכ simetri wit JS.
strings.p2: Intapɔleshɔn de yuz kɔl bres insay wan string: "Hello, {~name}!". Eni expreshכn de alaw — sεl, kכmpyut valyu, fכnshכn kol.
strings.p3: Di karakta dɛn we de rɔnawe: \n (nyulayn), \t (tab), \" (kot), \\ (bakslash), \{ (literal bres).
strings.p4: Mɔlti-layn: brok na nyu layn insay di kot dɛn. Di rɔntaym de kip wayt spɛs ɛksaktɔli.
strings.p5: Templating: fɔ wan tɛks blɔk wit sɔm intapɔleshɔn, wan kɔmpyutayt string na idiomatik. Stɔ am na sɛl ɛn rɛfrɛns am frɔm di UI.

strings.li3: Ɛmpti intapɔleshɔn {} nɔ valid — di parsa mistek dɛn.
strings.li4: Konkateneshɔn de yuz + (string kɔs) fɔ simpul kes dɛm; intapɔleshɔn de rid bɛtɛ fɔ lɔng tɛmplat dɛn.

errors.p1: Parse mistek dɛn de faya na fayl-lɔd tɛm. Di rɔntaym de ripɔt di layn, kɔlɔm, ɛn wan hint. Kɔmɔn kɔz dɛm: indent we nɔ mach, = we nɔ de, modifya we dɛn nɔ no, string we nɔ klos.
errors.p2: Rɔntaym mistek dɛn kin faya we dɛn de ɛvaluet. Mɔs pan dɛn na riaktiv — wan ɛksprɛshɔn de rɛfrɛns wan sɛl we dɛn nɔ deklare, ɔ wan tayp mismatch insay aritmɛtik. Di rɔntaym de log, sho wan rɛd ban na di privyu, ɛn skip da freym de in ɔpdet.
errors.p3: Modifaya mistek (modifaya we dɛn nɔ no, rɔng argumɛnt tayp) faya na pars tɛm. Architex strikt bɔt modifya dɛn we dɛn nɔ no fɔ protɛkt fɔwad kɔmpitibliti.
errors.p4: Dibɔg: rap wan sɔspɛkt ɛksprɛshɔn insay debug(...). Di rɔntaym de log ɛvri ɛvalueshɔn to di kɔnsol we nɔ de chenj di valyu. Pe wit di Architex inspekta fɔ step tru stet chenj dɛn.
errors.p5: Ɛditɔ intagreshɔn: di Architex IDE na di Vortex bot styudio ɔndalayn mistek dɛn insay rial tɛm, bifo di fayl sev.
errors.cc1: // parse error: modifya we yu nɔ no
errors.cc2: teks "x" :: shado // ERROR: "shado" nɔto modifya we dɛn sɔpɔt
errors.cc3: // runtime error: sɛl we dɛn nɔ deklare
errors.cc4: text ~message // ERROR: ~message nɔ bin de diklar na dis skrin
errors.li1: Parse mistek dɛn kin stɔp ɛgzikishɔn bifo ɛni rɛnda bigin.
errors.li2: Rɔntaym mistek dɛn kin skip di ɔfɛndin freym; di UI ɔdasay de rεspכns.
errors.li3: Fiks-fɔwad: chenj di fayl ɛn sev; di rɔntaym hot-rilod.
errors.li4: Nɔ try / catch sintaks — bot kɔmyunikeshɔn de yuz ɛksplisit send() wit rizɔlt asaynmɛnt.

host_builtins.p1: Host built-ins na akshɔn dɛn we di pletfɔm de gi. Na di glu bitwin di DSL ɛn di ap we de rawnd am.
host_builtins.p2: Klipbɔd: copy(~text) de put di argumɛnt pan di klipbɔd; paste() => ~x = it de rid di klipbɔd insay wan sɛl. share(~text) de opin di sistem shea shit.
host_builtins.p3: Haptics: haptic("light"|"medium"|"heavy") de trigεr fכdbכk pan sכpכt divays dεm. vibrate(ms) na wan buz we gɛt lɔng fɔm.
host_builtins.p4: Prompts: alert("message") sho wan modal wit OK. confirm("message") => ~ok = it de sho OK + Kansel; di it shɔthand na di ritɔn valyu.
host_builtins.p5: Navigation: goto("ScreenName", arg: val, ...) de push wan skrin; back() de pop wan; close() de dismis di ɔl Mini App.

forms.p1: Input dεm de biεn tu-we to wan riaktiv sεl: input ~email. We yu tayp, i de ɔpdet di sɛl; we yu ɔpdet di sɛl, i de ɔpdet di fil.
forms.p2: Valideshɔn na kɔmpyutayt bulian: ~emailOk := ~email.matches("^[^@]+@[^@]+\.[^@]+$"). Yuz hidden / visible modifya dɛn pan mistek lɛbl dɛn.
forms.p3: Sɔbmit na ɔdinari bɔtin we gɛt chen akshɔn dɛn. Blɔk sɔbmishɔn we validɛshɔn de fel via disabled(!~formOk).
forms.p4: Erɔ displei: rɛnd wan text ɔ label wit visible(!~fieldOk) fɔ sho ɔl we i nɔ valid. Aplay color(~danger) fɔ mek yu si ɛmpɛshmɛnt.
forms.p5: Dibaunsin: ad :: debounce(300) fɔ delay nɛtwɔk-bɛk validɛshɔn te di yuza stɔp fɔ tayp fɔ 300 ms.
forms.p6: Pleshɔlda: :: placeholder("...") de sho wan hint we di sɛl ɛmti. Hint de disappear pan di fɔs kistrok.
forms.p7: Input tayp dɛn: plein input na tɛks; input.email, input.number, input.password, input.tel, input.date ajɔst kibɔd ɛn maskin.

animations.h4: Di we aw pɔsin de mek in an
animations.p1: Architex de animate implisit we wan riaktiv valyu de drayv wan numɛrik ɔ kɔlɔ modifya. Difɔlt transishɔn na 200 ms izi-ɔut. Ovalayz wit :: animate(ms, curve).
animations.p2: Enta / ɛkzit transishɔn: kɔndishɔnal rɛnd no dɛm (hidden / visible) animate in ɛn aut. Kastamayz via :: animate.enter(...) ɛn :: animate.exit(...).
animations.p3: Kεrv dεm: ease-out (difכlt), ease-in, ease-in-out, linear, spring. Spring tek opshɔnal stiffness ɛn damping argumɛnt dɛn.
animations.p4: Jɛst: :: draggable ɛn :: swipeable de ataya di pletfɔm-aprɔpriet jes rɛkɔgniza. Kombayn wit riaktiv stet fɔ animate pan drag.
animations.p5: Ridyus muvmɛnt: di ɔs de rɛspɛkt di yuza in aksesibiliti sɛtin. We ridyus-moshɔn de on, animashɔn dɛn kin shrink to ɔnda 100 ms ɛn spring kɔv dɛn kin bi linya.
animations.cc1: col :: animate(300, izi-in-ɔut) bg(~halayt ? ~ praymari : ~ bg)
animations.cc2: bɔtin "Lod" :: animate(150, spring) bg(~bizi ? ~ denja : ~ praymari)
animations.cc3: teks "Wɛlkɔm" :: animate.enter(400, spring) we pɔsin kin si(~ sho)
animations.cc5: kad :: we pɔsin kin drɛg => ~ɔfset = it.transletX
animations.li2: Spring curves fil mo natural fo intaraktiv drag.
animations.li3: Ridyus-moshɔn ɔs dɛn kin shɔt ɔltin ɔtomɛtik wan.
animations.li4: Di transishɔn dɛn we de kɔmɔt na do delay fɔ pul di mawnten te di animashɔn dɔn.
animations.td11: Drag di we aw yu de mek yu an
animations.td12: Swip di jes we yu de yuz
animations.td13: Tap di we aw yu de mek yu an
animations.td14: Fɔ mek yu prɛs fɔ lɔng tɛm

runtime.h4: Di wan dɛn we de ɔspitul
runtime.p1: Di Architex runtime na wan TypeScript pakej we dɛn pablish as architex. I gɛt 4 modul dɛn: lexer, parser, renderer, reactive.
runtime.p2: Di leksa de rid sɔs tɛks ɛn i de pul token dɛn. Na di onli kכmכpכnt we de kia fכ waytspεs — εvri dכwnstrim mכdyul de wok pan token εn AST no dεm.
runtime.p3: Di parsa de bil wan AST. AST no dεm dεn tayp εn sirial so dat dεn kin sεnd kכros prכsεs bכnda (yusful fכ hot-rilod εn rimot prεviu).
runtime.p4: Di rɛnda de waka di AST wit wan rɛnd kɔntɛks we di ɔs gi (wɛb DOM / SwiftUI brij / Kɔmpoz brij) ɛn prodyuz nativ vishɔn.
runtime.p5: Host impliment wan narrow intafeys: createNode, updateNode, removeNode, plus modifya aplikeshɔn. Fɔ ad nyu ɔs kin tek lɛk 500 layn dɛn fɔ glu kɔd.

migration.h2: Di tin dɛn we dɛn nɔ lɛk fɔ du
migration.p1: Architex de fala semver. Patch nɔ de brok ɛnitin. Minors ad ficha dɛn. Majors kin brok tin wit 12 mɔnt deprecation window.
migration.p2: Di ficha dɛn we nɔ de wok igen de kɔntinyu fɔ wok tru di wan ol smɔl smɔl siriɔs wan dɛn. Di rɔntaym de log wan diprɛkɛshɔn wɔnin we yu yuz am fɔs; di IDE de haelayt di kɔd we dɛn nɔ dɔn yuz.
migration.p3: Fɔwad kɔmpat: fayl dɛn we dɛn rayt agens wan fɔs smɔl vɛshɔn ɔltɛm de rɛnd di sem we pan wan leta rɔntaym. Wi nɔ de ɛva retro-chenj sɛmantiks.
migration.p4: Dɛn kin anɔys di chenj dɛn we de brok na di chenjlɔg wit maykreshɔn gayd dɛn. Otomatik maykreshɔn tul dɛn de kɔba bɔku pan di mɛkanikal chenj dɛn.
migration.p5: LTS: ɛvri men vɛshɔn gɛt 24 mɔnt sɔpɔt winda fɔ impɔtant sikyɔriti fiks, ivin afta di nɛks big ship dɛn.

faq.p1: K: A kin rayt ful ap na Architex? A: Architex na fɔ Mini Apps — skrin dɛn we de liv insay chat. Fɔ wan ful nativ ap yu want SwiftUI / Kɔmpoz / Riakt.
faq.p2: K: Aw yu kɔmpia am to Flutter? A: Flutter na bɔku bɔku wan bɔt i gɛt in yon rɔntaym (Dart VM + Skia). Architex na tiny ɛn i de rɔn pan host primitives. If yu nid pletfɔm lɔk-in, Flutter; if yu nid fɔ rich, Architex.
faq.p3: K: Wetin mek nɔ if blɔk? A: Bikɔs hidden / visible modifya dɛn kɔba 95%% pan UI kɔndishɔnal dɛn mɔ klin wan. Fכ di כda 5%%, tεrnari εksprεshכn dεm de wok.
faq.p4: K: Na Architex opin sos? A: Yes — si di GitHub repo. MIT-laysens rɔntaym, nɔ patɛnt string.
faq.p5: K: A kin kɔl nativ kɔd? A: Na tru ɔs-ɛksplɔz bilt-in ɔ bot send() akshɔn dɛn nɔmɔ. Dairekt nativ-brij na intenshɔnal nɔ sɔpɔt — i go brok pɔtabiliti.
faq.p6: K: Maks skrin kɔmplisiti? A: Di rɔntaym kɔmfyut wan de handle 10 k riaktiv sɛl ɛn 100 k list aytem dɛn. Bifo dat, brok insay bɔku bɔku skrin dɛn.
faq.p7: K: A kin persist stet? A: Yes, via store(key, value) (per-Mini-App lokal) ɔ send(action: "save") to di bot (sava-sayd).
faq.p8: K: I de wok ɔflayna? A: Yes fɔ pure-UI skrin dɛn. Enitin we de kol send() nid di netwok.
faq.p9: K: Aw a go ad kɔstɔm kɔmpɔnɛnt? A: Either @component insay Architex, ɔ (if yu nid nativ primitiv) kɔntribyut to di Architex ɔs pakej.
faq.p10: K: Pɔfɔmɛnshɔn ovahɛd vs han-rayt nativ? A: Tipikli 3-8 %% slo pas SwiftUI / Compose we dɛn rayt wit an. Human-imperceptible fɔ nɔmal skrin dɛn.
faq.li1: Maks skrin: ~10 k sel, ~100 k list aytem.
faq.li2: Maks fayl: 1 MB .arx sɔs bifo wɔnin.

gotchas.h1: Indent tab vs spɛshal ples dɛn
gotchas.p1: Architex de yuz 2 spes fɔ ɛni indent lɛvɛl. Tab dɛn de rijɛkt na pars tɛm. Mɔs pan di IDE dɛn kin chenj ɔtomɛtik wan; if yu si indent mistek dɛn we yu nɔ bin de ɛkspɛkt, chɛk fɔ miks wayt ples.
gotchas.p2: Klos dεm na kכmpyut εksprεshכn dεm de rid riaktiv sεl dεm na evalueshכn tεm, nכto na diklareshכn tεm. ~a := ~b + 1 de yuz di ~b we de naw ɔltɛm, nɔto di valyu we dɛn de diklareshɔn.
gotchas.p3: Async send() de asaynd to di sel we di Prɔmis rizɔlt, we kin bi ɔt-ɔda if bɔku sɛn dɛn de insay flay. Gad wit ~loading flag ɔ sikwins nɔmba.
gotchas.p4: Tayp kɔstɔm: "5" + 1 de ɛvaluet to "51", nɔto 6. Yuz Number("5") ɔ anɔtayt di sɛl as : number.
gotchas.p5: Dip nɛst riaktiv ɔbjɛkt dɛm: fɔ mute wan prɔpati (~obj.x = 5) nɔ de trig ɔpdet pan rida dɛm fɔ ~obj. Ri-asaynd di wan ol tin insted.
gotchas.p6: Modifaya ɔda insay wan famili: kɔlɔ modifya dɛn kin sɔlv las-rayta-win. Nɔ chen tu color(...) de ɛkspɛkt wan blɛnd.
gotchas.p7: @for bכdi fכ indent εksakכt wan lεvεl dip. Pikin we de na tu lɛvul nɔto pars mistek bɔt na sɛmantik mis-nɛst — di rɔntaym de trit am lɛk brɔda ɛn sista fɔ di @for.
gotchas.cc2: ~obj.x = 5. Di wan dɛn we de wok

gotchas.li2: Riaktiv sel dεm na kloz dεm de rid kכrant, nכto diklareshכn-taym, valyu.
